class GraphSqlVersioningMode(StrEnum):
    APPLICATION = "application"
    SPARSE = "sparse"
    TIP = "tip"
    DOLT = "dolt"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SqlGraphExecutionCtx:
    graph_id: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    revision_id: RevisionId | None
    branch_anchor: BranchId | None
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]]
    versioning_mode: GraphSqlVersioningMode
    dialect_name: str
    supports_recursive_cte: bool
    supports_distinct_on: bool
    dolt_commit_hash: str | None = None
    inherited_branch_visibility: bool = False
    revision_is_current: bool = False
    # Symbolic SQL expressions for the revision and branch values. These are
    # populated by the graph terminal's ``compile()`` step from either a
    # literal value (wrapped in ``SqlParam``) or an upstream prerequisite
    # step's CTE binding (``SqlCteFieldRef``). Strategies that need to embed
    # these values in generated SQL must consume the expression form rather
    # than re-materializing the concrete IDs.
    revision_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None
    branch_anchor_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None
    include_staged_working_set: bool = False
    revision_branch_index_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    revision_parent_table: SqlTableName | None = None


def resolve_graph_versioning_mode(
    *,
    has_branch_anchor: bool,
    prefer_tip_strategy: bool,
    tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization,
) -> GraphSqlVersioningMode:
    """Select the graph SQL versioning mode from symbolic inputs.

    ``has_branch_anchor`` is ``True`` when a branch anchor is available either
    as a literal value or as an upstream prerequisite-step ref. The actual
    branch value does not need to be materialized at compile time; its
    presence alone is sufficient to know whether sparse/tip tables should be
    targeted instead of the application-versioned main tables.
    """
    if prefer_tip_strategy and has_branch_anchor and tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED:
        return GraphSqlVersioningMode.TIP
    if has_branch_anchor:
        return GraphSqlVersioningMode.SPARSE
    return GraphSqlVersioningMode.APPLICATION


GraphRefVariant = Literal["scalar", "object", "scalar_sequence", "object_sequence"]


class GraphLazyStepRegistrar:
    """Narrow intent-registration surface for pure graph handles."""

    __pure_lazy_surface__ = True
    __slots__ = ("_add_intent_fn", "_bind_result_fn", "_next_ref_fn", "_plan")

    def __init__(
        self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        *,
        next_ref_fn: Callable[[], str],
        add_intent_fn: Callable[[ServerPlanStep[Any]], LazyResult[Any]],
        plan: BaseServerPlan | None = None,
        bind_result_fn: Callable[
            [
                SemanticPlan,
                GraphSnapshotInput,
                ServerPlanRefId,
            ],
            LazyResult[Any],
        ]
        | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._next_ref_fn = next_ref_fn
        self._add_intent_fn = add_intent_fn
        self._plan = plan
        self._bind_result_fn = bind_result_fn

    def next_ref(self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar) -> str:
        return self._next_ref_fn()

    def add_intent[T](self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar, step: ServerPlanStep[T]) -> LazyResult[T]:
        return cast(LazyResult[T], self._add_intent_fn(step))

    def compose_branch_route_guard(
        self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        candidate: BranchRouteProofStep,
    ) -> tuple[BranchRouteProofStep, bool]:
        """Compose graph route assumptions under one request-owned guard."""
        if self._plan is None:
            return candidate, True
        return self._plan.compose_branch_route_guard(candidate)

    def scalar_ref_for[T](
        self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        value: T | ScalarServerRef[T],
    ) -> ScalarServerRef[T]:
        if isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
            ref_id = value.ref_id
            if ref_id is not None and self._plan is not None:
                from l2070_batching.seeded_constants import read_seeded_constant_from_ctx

                found, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(self._plan, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
                if found:
                    builder_context = LazyBuilderContext(self._plan)
                    return cast(
                        "ScalarServerRef[T]",
                        builder_context.ref_for(seed_value, variant="scalar", type_hint=type(seed_value)),
                    )
            return value
        if self._plan is not None:
            builder_context = LazyBuilderContext(self._plan)
            return cast(
                "ScalarServerRef[T]",
                builder_context.ref_for(value, variant="scalar", type_hint=type(value)),
            )
        return ServerRefs.scalar(value)

    def server_ref_from_step[T](
        self: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        variant: GraphRefVariant,
        *,
        type_hint: type[T] | None = None,
    ) -> ServerRef[Any]:
        plan_ref = ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
        if variant == "scalar":
            return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(plan_ref, variant="scalar")
        if variant == "object":
            return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(plan_ref, variant="object", type_hint=type_hint)
        if variant == "scalar_sequence":
            return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(plan_ref, variant="scalar_sequence")
        return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(plan_ref, variant="object_sequence", type_hint=type_hint)

    def bind_result_lazy(
        self,
        semantic_plan: SemanticPlan,
        *,
        snapshot: GraphSnapshotInput,
        result_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> LazyResult[Any]:
        bind_result_fn = self._bind_result_fn
        if bind_result_fn is None:
            msg = "graph registrar cannot bind an induced result plan"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return bind_result_fn(semantic_plan, snapshot, result_ref)


class _InducedGraphResultBinder(GraphLazyStepRegistrar):
    """Narrow graph registrar that binds transaction-free induced result plans."""

    __slots__ = ()

    def __init__(self, txn: object) -> None:
        owner = cast("SyncVersionedReadTransaction", txn)

        def bind_result(
            semantic_plan: SemanticPlan,
            snapshot: GraphSnapshotInput,
            result_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        ) -> LazyResult[Any]:
            from l7200_versioned_transactions.induced_fragment_adapter import (
                bind_versioned_graph_result_plan,
            )

            plan, selected_ref = bind_versioned_graph_result_plan(
                owner,
                semantic_plan,
                snapshot=snapshot,
                result_ref=result_ref,
            )
            return plan.publish_lazy_result(selected_ref)

        def unavailable_next_ref() -> str:
            raise RuntimeError("induced result binder cannot allocate graph refs")

        def unavailable_add_intent(_step: ServerPlanStep[Any]) -> LazyResult[Any]:
            raise RuntimeError("induced result binder cannot register graph intents")

        super().__init__(
            next_ref_fn=unavailable_next_ref,
            add_intent_fn=unavailable_add_intent,
            bind_result_fn=bind_result,
        )

def sql_plan_graph_query_for_revision(
    *,
    plan_owner: object,
    graph_id: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
    revision_id: RevisionId,
    versioning_strategy_preview: object | None = None,
) -> SqlPlanGraphQuery:
    owner = cast(Any, plan_owner)
    plan = owner._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    registrar = graph_lazy_step_registrar(
        next_ref_fn=plan._next_ref,
        add_intent_fn=owner._add_intent,
        plan=plan,
    )

    if isinstance(graph_id, ScalarServerRef):
        graph_id_ref = graph_id
    else:
        builder_context = LazyBuilderContext(plan)
        graph_id_ref = cast(
            "ScalarServerRef[GraphId]",
            builder_context.ref_for(graph_id, variant="scalar", type_hint=GraphId),
        )

    def pending_ctx_config_factory() -> _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig:
        return _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig(
            graph_id_ref=graph_id_ref,
            graph_type=graph_type,
            revision_literal=revision_id,
            revision_ref_id=None,
            branch_anchor_literal=None,
            branch_anchor_ref_id=None,
            prefer_tip_strategy=False,
            tip_materialization=BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED,
            branch_table=None,
        )

    return SqlPlanGraphQuery(
        registrar=registrar,
        pending_ctx_config_factory=pending_ctx_config_factory,
        graph_id=graph_id_ref,
        graph_id_source=graph_id,
        graph_type=graph_type,
        versioning_strategy_preview=versioning_strategy_preview,
    )


def _copy_graph_pattern(pattern: GraphQueryPattern) -> GraphQueryPattern:
    algebra_kwargs: dict[str, object]
    if pattern.elements:
        algebra_kwargs = {"elements": deepcopy(pattern.elements)}
    else:
        algebra_kwargs = {
            "paths": deepcopy(pattern.paths),
            "filters": deepcopy(pattern.filters),
            "exists_conditions": deepcopy(pattern.exists_conditions),
            "optional_blocks": deepcopy(pattern.optional_blocks),
            "union_blocks": deepcopy(pattern.union_blocks),
            "minus_blocks": deepcopy(pattern.minus_blocks),
        }
    return GraphQueryPattern(
        **cast("Any", algebra_kwargs),
        select_fields=deepcopy(pattern.select_fields),
        order_by=deepcopy(pattern.order_by),
        path_result_order_by=deepcopy(pattern.path_result_order_by),
        group_by=deepcopy(pattern.group_by),
        aggregations=deepcopy(pattern.aggregations),
        overview_aggregation=deepcopy(pattern.overview_aggregation),
        having=deepcopy(pattern.having),
        binding_projections=deepcopy(pattern.binding_projections),
        induced_subgraph=pattern.induced_subgraph,
        limit=pattern.limit,
        offset=pattern.offset,
        distinct=pattern.distinct,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _build_graph_compile_context(
    pending_ctx_config_factory: Callable[[], _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig],
) -> _GraphCompileContextConfig:
    """Derive the compile-time context config for a graph terminal step.

    ``pending_ctx_config_factory`` is invoked at terminal-enqueue time (not
    handle-construction time) so any txn-dependent prerequisite steps (e.g.
    ``ResolveBranchForRevisionStep``) are injected into the current plan
    execution cycle. The resulting :class:`_GraphCompileContextConfig` carries
    only symbolic inputs (literals plus prerequisite ref ids); graph terminals
    synthesize :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` during ``compile()`` from this
    config plus ``CompilationContext`` without reading ``ResolvedRefs``.
    """
    from l7000_versioned_schema.branch_read_hint_cache import (
        BranchReadHintMissing,
        BranchReadPrediction,
        BranchReadTipRevisionMissing,
        ExplicitReadRevisionMissing,
        predict_from_hint_or_default,
    )

    pending_ctx_config = pending_ctx_config_factory()
    explicit_revision = pending_ctx_config.revision_literal if isinstance(pending_ctx_config.revision_literal, RevisionId) else None
    has_branch_authority = pending_ctx_config.branch_anchor_literal is not None or pending_ctx_config.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None
    should_predict_route = pending_ctx_config.prefer_tip_strategy or (has_branch_authority and explicit_revision is not None)
    prediction = (
        None
        if not should_predict_route
        else (
            predict_from_hint_or_default(
                hint=BranchReadHintMissing.NOT_FOUND,
                explicit_revision_id=(ExplicitReadRevisionMissing.CURRENT if explicit_revision is None else explicit_revision),
            )
            if pending_ctx_config.predicted_source is None
            else BranchReadPrediction(
                source=pending_ctx_config.predicted_source,
                predicted_tip_materialization=(pending_ctx_config.predicted_tip_materialization or BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED),
                predicted_tip_revision_id=BranchReadTipRevisionMissing.UNKNOWN,
            )
        )
    )
    return _GraphCompileContextConfig(
        graph_id_ref=pending_ctx_config.graph_id_ref,
        revision_literal=pending_ctx_config.revision_literal,
        revision_ref_id=pending_ctx_config.revision_ref_id,
        branch_anchor_literal=pending_ctx_config.branch_anchor_literal,
        branch_anchor_ref_id=pending_ctx_config.branch_anchor_ref_id,
        prefer_tip_strategy=pending_ctx_config.prefer_tip_strategy,
        tip_materialization=pending_ctx_config.tip_materialization,
        tip_materialization_ref_id=pending_ctx_config.tip_materialization_ref_id,
        tip_revision_ref_id=pending_ctx_config.tip_revision_ref_id,
        predicted_source=None if prediction is None else prediction.source,
        predicted_tip_materialization=(
            pending_ctx_config.predicted_tip_materialization if prediction is None else prediction.predicted_tip_materialization
        ),
        route_hint_identity=None if prediction is None else pending_ctx_config.route_hint_identity,
        permission_context_ref=pending_ctx_config.permission_context_ref,
        permission_context_type=pending_ctx_config.permission_context_type,
        force_application_versioning=pending_ctx_config.force_application_versioning,
        include_staged_working_set=pending_ctx_config.include_staged_working_set,
        requires_stable_route_snapshot=pending_ctx_config.requires_stable_route_snapshot,
        branch_table=pending_ctx_config.branch_table,
        revision_branch_index_table=pending_ctx_config.revision_branch_index_table,
        revision_parent_table=pending_ctx_config.revision_parent_table,
        selected_revision_tip_status=(
            SelectedRevisionTipStatus.CURRENT_TIP
            if (
                pending_ctx_config.selected_revision_tip_status is SelectedRevisionTipStatus.CURRENT_TIP
                or (pending_ctx_config.prefer_tip_strategy and pending_ctx_config.revision_literal is None)
            )
            else SelectedRevisionTipStatus.NOT_CURRENT_TIP
        ),
    )


@pure_lazy
def build_versioned_graph_compile_context(
    txn: object,
    *,
    graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
    prefer_tip_strategy: bool | None = None,
) -> _GraphCompileContextConfig:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps import intent_graph
    from l1400_types.unset import UNSET
    from l7000_versioned_schema.context_refs import get_versioned_lazy_context_refs
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.versioned_lazy_mixin import (
        _graph_branch_anchor_input,
        _graph_revision_input,
        _readthrough_user_session_delegates_graph_visibility,
        _transaction_revision_literal,
        _txn_domain,
        _versioned_lazy_materialization_policy,
    )

    from l7200_versioned_transactions.induced_fragment_adapter import _uses_unpinned_write_working_set

    owner = cast(Any, txn)
    context_refs = get_versioned_lazy_context_refs(owner)
    stable_revision_literal = _transaction_revision_literal(owner)
    materialization = _versioned_lazy_materialization_policy(owner)
    delegates_route_selection = _readthrough_user_session_delegates_graph_visibility(owner)
    if delegates_route_selection:
        resolved_prefer_tip = False
    elif prefer_tip_strategy is None:
        resolved_prefer_tip = bool(
            getattr(owner, "_prefer_tip_strategy", False)
            or context_refs.branch is not UNSET
            or isinstance(getattr(owner, "_branch_anchor", None), BranchId)
        )
    else:
        resolved_prefer_tip = prefer_tip_strategy

    def pending_ctx_config_factory() -> _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig:
        nonlocal stable_revision_literal
        resolved_materialization = materialization
        revision_literal, revision_ref_id = _graph_revision_input(owner, context_refs)
        observed_revision_literal = revision_literal if isinstance(revision_literal, RevisionId) else None
        if observed_revision_literal is not None:
            stable_revision_literal = observed_revision_literal
        elif stable_revision_literal is not None:
            revision_literal = stable_revision_literal
            revision_ref_id = None
        branch_anchor_literal, branch_anchor_ref_id = _graph_branch_anchor_input(
            owner,
            context_refs,
            resolved_materialization,
        )
        prediction_revision = revision_literal if isinstance(revision_literal, RevisionId) else None
        literal_branch_authority = branch_anchor_literal if isinstance(branch_anchor_literal, BranchId) else None
        if literal_branch_authority is None and isinstance(getattr(owner, "_lazy_branch", None), BranchId):
            literal_branch_authority = owner._lazy_branch
        policy_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        tip_revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        plan = owner._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
        binding = plan.versioned_read_context_binding()
        if binding is not None and observed_revision_literal is not None and binding.revision_id is None:
            binding = replace(binding, revision_id=str(observed_revision_literal))
            plan.bind_versioned_read_context(binding)
        if binding is not None:
            revision_ref = binding.revision_server_ref()
            if binding.revision_id is not None:
                revision_literal = RevisionId(binding.revision_id)
                revision_ref_id = None
                prediction_revision = revision_literal
            elif revision_ref is not None and revision_ref.ref_id is not None:
                revision_literal = None
                revision_ref_id = revision_ref.ref_id
            tip_revision_ref = binding.tip_revision_server_ref()
            if tip_revision_ref is not None:
                tip_revision_ref_id = tip_revision_ref.ref_id
            branch_ref = binding.branch_server_ref()
            if branch_ref is not None and branch_ref.ref_id is not None:
                branch_anchor_literal = None
                branch_anchor_ref_id = branch_ref.ref_id
            policy_ref = binding.tip_materialization_server_ref()
            if policy_ref is not None:
                policy_ref_id = policy_ref.ref_id
            if binding.tip_materialization is not None:
                resolved_materialization = replace(
                    resolved_materialization,
                    tip_materialization=binding.tip_materialization,
                )
        domain = _txn_domain(owner)
        if domain is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Versioned graph routing requires an explicit versioning domain")
        branch_table = SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.branch_model))
        revision_branch_index_table = SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.revision_branch_index_model))
        revision_parent_table = SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.revision_parent_model))
        backend_type = getattr(getattr(plan, "_backend_profile", None), "backend_type", None)
        if backend_type is None:
            backend_type = getattr(owner, "_serverplan_backend_type", None)
        if backend_type is None:
            backend_type = getattr(getattr(owner, "_backend_profile", None), "backend_type", None)
        if backend_type in (BackendType.POSTGRES, BackendType.SQLITE) and literal_branch_authority is not None:
            branch_anchor_literal = literal_branch_authority
            branch_anchor_ref_id = None
            if prediction_revision is not None:
                revision_literal = prediction_revision
                revision_ref_id = None
            policy_ref_id = None
            tip_revision_ref_id = None
        hint_branch_id = branch_anchor_literal if isinstance(branch_anchor_literal, BranchId) else None
        predicted_source = None
        predicted_tip_materialization = None
        route_hint_identity = None
        selected_revision_tip_status = SelectedRevisionTipStatus.NOT_CURRENT_TIP
        if hint_branch_id is not None:
            from l2000_connection.connection_cache_identity import connection_cache_identity
            from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import DatabaseIdentity, VersioningDomainName
            from l7000_versioned_schema.branch_read_hint_cache import (
                BranchReadHint,
                BranchReadHintCache,
                BranchReadHintIdentity,
                BranchReadWorkspaceScopeMissing,
                ExplicitReadRevisionMissing,
                predict_from_hint_or_default,
            )

            base_txn = getattr(owner, "_base_txn", None)
            conn = getattr(base_txn, "_conn", None)
            if conn is not None:
                identity = BranchReadHintIdentity(
                    database_scope=connection_cache_identity(DatabaseIdentity(conn.database_identity)),
                    versioning_domain=VersioningDomainName(domain.name),
                    workspace_id=(BranchReadWorkspaceScopeMissing.GLOBAL if domain.workspace_id is None else domain.workspace_id),
                    branch_id=hint_branch_id,
                )
                route_hint_identity = identity
                hint = BranchReadHintCache().get(identity)
                prediction = predict_from_hint_or_default(
                    hint=hint,
                    explicit_revision_id=(ExplicitReadRevisionMissing.CURRENT if prediction_revision is None else prediction_revision),
                )
                if isinstance(hint, BranchReadHint) and (prediction_revision is None or prediction_revision == hint.tip_revision_id):
                    selected_revision_tip_status = SelectedRevisionTipStatus.CURRENT_TIP
                if isinstance(hint, BranchReadHint) and prediction_revision is None:
                    revision_literal = hint.tip_revision_id
                    revision_ref_id = None
                predicted_source = prediction.source
                predicted_tip_materialization = prediction.predicted_tip_materialization
        return intent_graph.build_resolve_graph_execution_ctx_config(
            graph_id_ref=graph_id_ref,
            graph_type=graph_type,
            revision_literal=revision_literal,
            revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
            branch_anchor_literal=branch_anchor_literal,
            branch_anchor_ref_id=branch_anchor_ref_id,
            prefer_tip_strategy=resolved_prefer_tip,
            tip_materialization=resolved_materialization.tip_materialization,
            tip_materialization_ref_id=policy_ref_id,
            tip_revision_ref_id=tip_revision_ref_id,
            predicted_source=predicted_source,
            predicted_tip_materialization=predicted_tip_materialization,
            route_hint_identity=route_hint_identity,
            branch_table=branch_table,
            revision_branch_index_table=revision_branch_index_table,
            revision_parent_table=revision_parent_table,
            include_staged_working_set=_uses_unpinned_write_working_set(owner),
            requires_stable_route_snapshot=not hasattr(owner, "_staged_commit_id"),
            selected_revision_tip_status=selected_revision_tip_status,
        )

    return _build_graph_compile_context(pending_ctx_config_factory)


class SqlPlanGraphQuery(GraphQuery):
    _registrar: GraphLazyStepRegistrar
    _pending_ctx_config_factory: Callable[[], _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig]
    _graph_id: ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    _graph_id_source: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    _graph_type: type[Graph[Any]]
    _versioning_strategy: Any | None

class SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode: GraphNode[Any]](GraphTraversal[TNode]):
    """Pure traversal handle that lowers through the canonical query-builder path."""

    __slots__ = (
        "_after_refs",
        "_graph_id_source",
        "_graph_type",
        "_pending_ctx_config_factory",
        "_permitted_graph_id_source",
        "_registrar",
        "_terminal_binding_factory",
        "_graph_result_binding_factory",
        "_delegate_public_traversal",
    )

    def __init__(
        self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal,
        *,
        registrar: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        pending_ctx_config_factory: Callable[[], _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig],
        graph_id: ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
        graph_id_source: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
        permitted_graph_id_source: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
        graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
        start_node_id: SysId,
        node_type: type[TNode],
        edge_type: type[GraphEdge[Any]],
        direction: str,
        max_depth: int,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        terminal_binding_factory: Callable[[], GraphTerminalBinding] | None = None,
        graph_result_binding_factory: Callable[[type[Graph]], GraphResultIntentBinding] | None = None,
        delegate_public_traversal: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(graph_id, start_node_id, node_type, edge_type, direction, max_depth)
        self._registrar = registrar
        self._pending_ctx_config_factory = pending_ctx_config_factory
        self._graph_id_source = graph_id_source
        self._permitted_graph_id_source = permitted_graph_id_source
        self._graph_type = graph_type
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._terminal_binding_factory = terminal_binding_factory
        self._graph_result_binding_factory = graph_result_binding_factory
        self._delegate_public_traversal = delegate_public_traversal

    @pure_lazy
    def _to_builder(
        self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode],
        *,
        select_target: bool = True,
    ) -> SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]:
        builder = SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode](
            registrar=self._registrar,
            pending_ctx_config_factory=self._pending_ctx_config_factory,
            graph_id=self._graph_id,
            graph_id_source=self._permitted_graph_id_source,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            result_node_type=cast(type[TNode], self._node_type),
            after_refs=self._after_refs,
            terminal_binding_factory=self._terminal_binding_factory,
            graph_result_binding_factory=self._graph_result_binding_factory,
        )
        builder.node("start", self._node_type, sys_id=self._start_node_id, graph_sys_id=self._graph_id_source)
        builder._nodes["start"].type_is_constraint = False
        builder.path("start", "target", self._node_type, self._edge_type, self._direction)
        if self._min_depth == 1 and self._max_depth == 1:
            builder.one_hop()
        elif self._min_depth == 1:
            builder.one_to_n_hops(self._max_depth)
        else:
            builder.min_to_max_hops(self._min_depth, self._max_depth)
        for expression in self._filter_expressions:
            builder.where(expression)
        if self._limit is not None:
            builder.limit(self._limit)
        if select_target:
            builder.select("target")
        return builder

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode]) -> LazyResult[list[TNode]]:
        """Execute through the canonical graph terminal and its route authority."""
        if not self._delegate_public_traversal and self._terminal_binding_factory is not None:
            return self._to_builder().execute_lazy()
        from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.steps.graph_traverse import (
            PublicGraphTraversalIntent,
            _GraphTraversalApiConfig,
        )

        registrar = self._registrar
        pending_ctx_config = self._pending_ctx_config_factory()
        after_refs = self._after_refs
        terminal_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(registrar.next_ref())
        config = _GraphTraversalApiConfig(
            graph_id=self._graph_id_source,
            start_node_id=self._start_node_id,
            node_type=self._node_type,
            edge_type=self._edge_type,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            direction=self._direction,
            max_depth=self._max_depth,
            min_depth=self._min_depth,
            limit=self._limit,
            filter_exprs=list(self._filter_expressions),
            revision_id=pending_ctx_config.revision_literal,
            revision_ref_id=pending_ctx_config.revision_ref_id,
            after_refs=after_refs,
        )
        return cast("LazyResult[list[TNode]]", registrar.add_intent(PublicGraphTraversalIntent(terminal_ref_id, config)))

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_graph_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode]) -> LazyResult[GraphResult[TNode, GraphEdge]]:
        return self._to_builder(select_target=False).execute_graph_lazy()

    @legacy_sync
    def execute(self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode]) -> list[TNode]:
        _legacy_delegate_stub()

    @legacy_async
    async def execute_async(self: SqlPlanGraphTraversal[TNode]) -> list[TNode]:
        _legacy_delegate_stub()


@pure_lazy
def _endpoint_relation_patterns(
    relations: tuple[GraphWalkTransitionRelation[Any], ...],
) -> tuple[GraphEndpointRelationPattern, ...]:
    patterns: list[GraphEndpointRelationPattern] = []
    for relation in relations:
        expression = relation.path
        if (
            isinstance(expression, QuantifiedPath)
            and isinstance(expression.expression, PathSequence)
            and expression.min_depth == expression.max_depth == 1
            and expression.mode is PathMode.WALK
            and expression.search is PathSearch.ALL
        ):
            patterns.extend(_endpoint_relation_patterns((relation.model_copy(update={"path": expression.expression}),)))
            continue
        if isinstance(expression, PathSequence):
            for component_index, component in enumerate(expression.expressions):
                if (
                    isinstance(component, QuantifiedPath)
                    and isinstance(component.expression, PathStep)
                    and component.search is PathSearch.SHORTEST
                    and component.min_depth > 0
                ):
                    step = component.expression
                    assert step.source_binding is not None and step.target_binding is not None
                    group = f"walk_shortest_segment_{len(patterns)}"
                    for depth in range(1, component.max_depth + 1):
                        fixed = replace(component, min_depth=depth, max_depth=depth, search=PathSearch.ALL)
                        sequence = PathSequence(
                            expressions=(
                                *expression.expressions[:component_index],
                                fixed,
                                *expression.expressions[component_index + 1 :],
                            )
                        )
                        for item in _endpoint_relation_patterns((relation.model_copy(update={"path": sequence}),)):
                            if item.shortest_group is not None:
                                raise ValueError("Multiple nested shortest segments require separate comparison scopes")
                            pattern = GraphQueryPattern(
                                paths=list(item.pattern.paths),
                                filters=list(item.pattern.filters),
                                distinct=item.pattern.distinct,
                                binding_projections=[
                                    *item.pattern.binding_projections,
                                    NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="walk_shortest_source", node_variable=step.source_binding),
                                    NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="walk_shortest_target", node_variable=step.target_binding),
                                ],
                            )
                            patterns.append(
                                replace(
                                    item,
                                    pattern=pattern,
                                    shortest_group=group,
                                    path_depth=depth,
                                    contributes_transition=depth >= component.min_depth,
                                    shortest_columns=(
                                        GraphEndpointColumnName("__bind_walk_shortest_source_sys_id"),
                                        GraphEndpointColumnName("__bind_walk_shortest_target_sys_id"),
                                    ),
                                )
                            )
                    break
            else:
                component_index = -1
            if component_index != -1:
                continue
            for component_index, component in enumerate(expression.expressions):
                if (
                    isinstance(component, QuantifiedPath)
                    and component.mode is PathMode.WALK
                    and component.search is PathSearch.ALL
                    and 0 < component.min_depth < component.max_depth
                ):
                    for depth in range(component.min_depth, component.max_depth + 1):
                        fixed_component = replace(component, min_depth=depth, max_depth=depth)
                        fixed_sequence = PathSequence(
                            expressions=(
                                *expression.expressions[:component_index],
                                fixed_component,
                                *expression.expressions[component_index + 1 :],
                            )
                        )
                        patterns.extend(_endpoint_relation_patterns((relation.model_copy(update={"path": fixed_sequence}),)))
                    break
            else:
                component_index = -1
            if component_index != -1:
                continue
        if (
            isinstance(expression, QuantifiedPath)
            and isinstance(expression.expression, PathSequence)
            and (expression.min_depth == 0 or expression.max_depth > 1)
        ):
            segments = expression.expression.normalized_step_alternatives()[0]
            occupied = {
                binding
                for segment in segments
                for binding in (segment.source_binding, segment.target_binding, segment.edge_binding)
                if binding is not None
            }
            generated: list[GraphEndpointRelationPattern] = []
            shortest_group = f"walk_shortest_{len(patterns)}" if expression.search is PathSearch.SHORTEST else None
            first_depth = 1 if shortest_group is not None else max(1, expression.min_depth)
            for repetitions in range(first_depth, expression.max_depth + 1):
                expanded: list[PathStep] = []
                predicates: list[Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]]] = []
                bindings: dict[str, str] = {}
                previous = relation.source_binding
                used = set(occupied)
                segment_nodes: dict[str | None, str] = {}
                segment_edges: dict[str, str] = {}
                for index in range(repetitions * len(segments)):
                    segment = segments[index % len(segments)]
                    if index % len(segments) == 0:
                        segment_nodes = {segment.source_binding: previous}
                        segment_edges = {}
                    final = index == repetitions * len(segments) - 1
                    target = relation.target_binding if final else f"__walk_repeat_node_{index}"
                    while not final and target in used:
                        target = f"_{target}"
                    used.add(target)
                    prior_target = segment_nodes.get(segment.target_binding)
                    if prior_target is not None and prior_target != target:
                        predicates.append(
                            Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{prior_target}.sys_id")
                            == Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{target}.sys_id"),
                        )
                    else:
                        segment_nodes[segment.target_binding] = target
                    edge = f"__walk_repeat_edge_{index}"
                    while edge in used:
                        edge = f"_{edge}"
                    used.add(edge)
                    if segment.edge_binding is not None:
                        prior_edge = segment_edges.get(segment.edge_binding)
                        if prior_edge is not None:
                            predicates.append(
                                Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{prior_edge}.sys_id")
                                == Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{edge}.sys_id"),
                            )
                        else:
                            segment_edges[segment.edge_binding] = edge
                    for original, replacement in (
                        (segment.source_binding, previous),
                        (segment.target_binding, target),
                        (segment.edge_binding, edge),
                    ):
                        if original is None:
                            continue
                        if original == relation.source_binding:
                            bindings[original] = relation.source_binding
                        elif original == relation.target_binding:
                            bindings[original] = relation.target_binding
                        else:
                            bindings[original] = replacement
                    expanded.append(replace(segment, source_binding=previous, target_binding=target, edge_binding=edge))
                    previous = target
                    if (index + 1) % len(segments) == 0:
                        for predicate in relation.predicates:
                            rebound = predicate
                            for original, replacement in bindings.items():
                                rebound = _rebind_expression_variable(rebound, original, replacement)
                            predicates.append(rebound)
                        bindings = {}
                unrolled = relation.model_copy(
                    update={
                        "predicates": tuple(predicates),
                        "path": QuantifiedPath(
                            expression=PathSequence(expressions=tuple(expanded)),
                            min_depth=1,
                            max_depth=1,
                            mode=expression.mode,
                            search=expression.search,
                        ),
                    }
                )
                generated.extend(
                    replace(
                        item,
                        shortest_group=shortest_group,
                        path_depth=repetitions,
                        contributes_transition=repetitions >= expression.min_depth,
                    )
                    for item in _endpoint_relation_patterns((unrolled,))
                )
            if expression.min_depth == 0 or shortest_group is not None:

                def identity_predicate[ValueT, OwnerT: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
                    predicate: Expression[ValueT, OwnerT],
                ) -> Expression[ValueT, OwnerT]:
                    field_name = predicate.field
                    if isinstance(field_name, str) and "." in field_name:
                        root, suffix = field_name.split(".", 1)
                        if root in {relation.source_binding, relation.target_binding}:
                            field_name = suffix
                    return Expression[ValueT, OwnerT](
                        field=field_name,
                        operator=predicate.operator,
                        value=identity_predicate(predicate.value) if isinstance(predicate.value, Expression) else predicate.value,
                        left=identity_predicate(predicate.left) if isinstance(predicate.left, Expression) else predicate.left,
                        right=identity_predicate(predicate.right) if isinstance(predicate.right, Expression) else predicate.right,
                        logical_op=predicate.logical_op,
                        function=predicate.function,
                        args=[identity_predicate(arg) if isinstance(arg, Expression) else arg for arg in predicate.args],
                        owner=predicate.owner,
                        server_ref_dependencies=predicate.server_ref_dependencies,
                    )

                generated[0] = replace(
                    generated[0],
                    include_identity=True,
                    identity_contributes=expression.min_depth == 0,
                    identity_predicates=tuple(identity_predicate(p) for p in relation.predicates),
                    identity_node_types=(expression.source_type, expression.target_type),
                )
            patterns.extend(generated)
            continue
        alternatives = relation.path.normalized_step_alternatives()
        if len(alternatives) != 1 and not (
            isinstance(relation.path, PathStep) and len(relation.path.edge_types) == 1 and relation.path.direction == "both"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "composed walk transition paths do not support path choices",
            )
        steps = alternatives[0]
        preserve_expression = isinstance(relation.path, PathStep) or (
            isinstance(relation.path, QuantifiedPath)
            and not (relation.path.min_depth == 1 and relation.path.max_depth == 1 and not isinstance(relation.path.expression, PathStep))
        )
        used_bindings = {
            relation.source_binding,
            relation.target_binding,
            *(
                binding
                for step in steps
                for binding in (
                    step.source_binding,
                    step.edge_binding,
                    step.target_binding,
                )
                if binding is not None
            ),
        }

        def _internal_binding(kind: str, index: int) -> str:
            candidate_index = index
            while True:
                candidate = f"__walk_{kind}_{candidate_index}"
                if candidate not in used_bindings:
                    used_bindings.add(candidate)
                    return candidate
                candidate_index += 1

        lowered_steps: list[PathStep] = []
        previous_target = relation.source_binding
        for index, step in enumerate(steps):
            source_binding = step.source_binding or previous_target
            target_binding = step.target_binding or (
                relation.target_binding if index == len(steps) - 1 else _internal_binding("node", index)
            )
            lowered_steps.append(
                replace(
                    step,
                    source_binding=source_binding,
                    edge_binding=step.edge_binding or _internal_binding("edge", index),
                    target_binding=target_binding,
                ),
            )
            previous_target = target_binding
        nested_mode_predicates: list[Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]]] = []

        def components(item: PathExpression) -> list[PathExpression]:
            if isinstance(item, PathSequence):
                return [part for child in item.expressions for part in components(child)]
            if (
                isinstance(item, QuantifiedPath)
                and isinstance(item.expression, PathStep)
                and item.min_depth == item.max_depth
                and item.search is PathSearch.ALL
            ):
                step = item.expression
                repeated: list[PathStep] = []
                source = step.source_binding
                for hop in range(item.max_depth):
                    target = step.target_binding if hop == item.max_depth - 1 else _internal_binding("node", hop)
                    repeated.append(
                        replace(
                            step,
                            source_binding=source,
                            target_binding=target,
                            edge_binding=_internal_binding("edge", hop),
                        )
                    )
                    source = target
                constrained_bindings: list[str | None] = []
                if item.mode is PathMode.ACYCLIC:
                    constrained_bindings = [step.source_binding, *(part.target_binding for part in repeated)]
                elif item.mode is PathMode.TRAIL:
                    constrained_bindings = [part.edge_binding for part in repeated]
                nested_mode_predicates.extend(
                    Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{left}.sys_id") != Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{right}.sys_id")
                    for index, left in enumerate(constrained_bindings)
                    for right in constrained_bindings[index + 1 :]
                )
                return list(repeated)
            return [item]

        component_expressions = components(relation.path)
        if isinstance(relation.path, QuantifiedPath) and not preserve_expression:
            component_expressions = components(relation.path.expression)
        if len(component_expressions) == len(lowered_steps) and all(
            isinstance(component, PathStep) for component in component_expressions
        ):
            component_expressions = list(lowered_steps)
        component_expressions = [
            replace(component, edge_binding=component.edge_binding or _internal_binding("edge", index))
            if isinstance(component, PathStep)
            else component
            for index, component in enumerate(component_expressions)
        ]
        pattern_paths = (
            [
                PathPattern(
                    source=NodePattern(
                        variable=relation.source_binding,
                        node_type=relation.path.source_type,
                    ),
                    target=NodePattern(
                        variable=relation.target_binding,
                        node_type=relation.path.target_type,
                    ),
                    expression=relation.path,
                ),
            ]
            if preserve_expression
            else [
                PathPattern(
                    source=NodePattern(
                        variable=component.normalized_step_alternatives()[0][0].source_binding or relation.source_binding,
                        node_type=component.source_type,
                    ),
                    target=NodePattern(
                        variable=component.normalized_step_alternatives()[0][-1].target_binding or relation.target_binding,
                        node_type=component.target_type,
                    ),
                    expression=component,
                )
                for component in component_expressions
            ]
        )
        mode_predicates: list[Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]]] = list(nested_mode_predicates)
        if isinstance(relation.path, QuantifiedPath) and not preserve_expression and relation.path.mode is PathMode.ACYCLIC:
            node_bindings = [
                lowered_steps[0].source_binding,
                *(step.target_binding for step in lowered_steps),
            ]
            mode_predicates.extend(
                Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{left}.sys_id") != Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{right}.sys_id")
                for left_index, left in enumerate(node_bindings)
                for right in node_bindings[left_index + 1 :]
            )
        if isinstance(relation.path, QuantifiedPath) and not preserve_expression and relation.path.mode is PathMode.TRAIL:
            mode_predicates.extend(
                Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{left.edge_binding}.sys_id")
                != Expression[bool, GraphNode[Any]](field=f"{right.edge_binding}.sys_id")
                for left_index, left in enumerate(lowered_steps)
                for right in lowered_steps[left_index + 1 :]
                if {get_table_name(edge_type) for edge_type in left.edge_types}
                & {get_table_name(edge_type) for edge_type in right.edge_types}
            )
        pattern = GraphQueryPattern(
            paths=pattern_paths,
            filters=[FilterCondition(expression=predicate) for predicate in (*relation.predicates, *mode_predicates)],
            binding_projections=[
                NodeBindingProjection(
                    binding_name="walk_source",
                    node_variable=relation.source_binding,
                ),
                NodeBindingProjection(
                    binding_name="walk_target",
                    node_variable=relation.target_binding,
                ),
            ],
            distinct=False,
        )
        patterns.append(
            GraphEndpointRelationPattern(
                pattern=pattern,
                source_binding=relation.source_binding,
                target_binding=relation.target_binding,
                direction=GraphEndpointDirection(relation.direction.value),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(patterns)


class _SqlPlanGraphWalkQuery[TNode: GraphNode[Any]](GraphWalkQuery[TNode]):
    """Plan-owned public terminal for one personalized random walk."""

    __slots__ = ("_builder", "_pattern", "_request")

    def __init__(
        self,
        builder: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        request: PersonalizedRandomWalkRequest[TNode] | PageRankRequest[TNode],
        *,
        pattern: GraphQueryPattern | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._builder = builder
        self._pattern = _copy_graph_pattern(builder.pattern if pattern is None else pattern)
        self._request = request

    @pure_lazy
    def limit(self, value: int) -> _SqlPlanGraphWalkQuery[TNode]:
        return _SqlPlanGraphWalkQuery(
            self._builder,
            self._request.limit(value),
            pattern=self._pattern,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_lazy(self) -> LazyResult[GraphWalkResult[TNode]]:
        builder = self._builder
        induced = self._pattern.induced_subgraph
        if induced is None:
            msg = "personalized random walk requires induced_subgraph()"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        node_type = builder.result_node_type
        if node_type is None:
            msg = "personalized random walk requires a result node type witness"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        graph_type = builder._resolved_graph_type()
        if builder._graph_result_binding_factory is None:
            msg = "personalized random walk requires txn.graph(graph_id, graph_type)"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        binding = builder._graph_result_binding_factory(graph_type)
        snapshot = binding.snapshot
        binder = binding.result_binder
        if snapshot is None or binder is None:
            msg = "personalized random walk requires a transaction-owned result binder"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        fragment = snapshot.compose(
            node_type=node_type,
            edge_type=induced.edge_type,
            pattern=self._pattern,
            endpoint_patterns=_endpoint_relation_patterns(
                self._request.transition_relations,
            ),
        )
        semantic_builder = SemanticPlanBuilder(
            namespace=PlanNamespaceId("personalized-random-walk"),
            generation=PlanGenerationId("terminal"),
        )
        imported = fragment.import_into(semantic_builder)
        result_ref = semantic_builder.allocate_ref(kind="graph_walk_result")
        semantic_builder.add_step(
            ExecutePersonalizedRandomWalkIntent(
                result_ref,
                inputs=GraphAlgorithmIntentInputs(
                    node_relation_ref=imported.selected_nodes.output.ref_id,
                    edge_relation_ref=imported.selected_edges.output.ref_id,
                    graph_guard_ref=imported.visibility.guard_output.ref_id,
                    snapshot_ref=imported.visibility.snapshot_output.ref_id,
                    permission_provenance_ref=imported.visibility.permission_provenance_output.ref_id,
                    transition_relation_refs=tuple(relation.output.ref_id for relation in imported.endpoint_relations),
                ),
                fragment=imported,
                request=self._request,
                node_model=node_type,
                result_limit=self._request.result_limit,
                permission_manifest_sources=imported.visibility.permission_manifest_sources,
                origin=(
                    GraphWalkIntentOrigin.PAGERANK
                    if isinstance(self._request, PageRankRequest)
                    else GraphWalkIntentOrigin.PERSONALIZED_RANDOM_WALK
                ),
            ),
        )
        return cast(
            "LazyResult[GraphWalkResult[TNode]]",
            binder.bind_result_lazy(
                semantic_builder.freeze(),
                snapshot=imported.visibility.snapshot,
                result_ref=result_ref,
            ),
        )


@pure_lazy
def attach_branch_route_guard[T](
    *,
    binding: GraphTerminalBinding,
    compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig,
    terminal_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    step: ServerPlanStep[T],
    route_recipe_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> None:
    policy_ref_id = compile_context.tip_materialization_ref_id
    tip_revision_ref_id = compile_context.tip_revision_ref_id
    predicted_source = compile_context.predicted_source
    has_symbolic_authority = policy_ref_id is not None and tip_revision_ref_id is not None
    has_branch_authority = (
        isinstance(compile_context.branch_anchor_literal, BranchId) or compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None
    ) and compile_context.branch_table is not None
    if predicted_source is None or not (has_symbolic_authority or has_branch_authority):
        return
    if not has_symbolic_authority:
        policy_ref_id = None
        tip_revision_ref_id = None

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_route_guard import (
        BranchRouteProofStep,
        StableRouteSnapshotRequirement,
    )
    from l2070_batching.step import PublicationGateRequirement

    if isinstance(compile_context.revision_literal, RevisionId):
        selected_revision = ServerRefs.scalar(compile_context.revision_literal)
    elif compile_context.revision_ref_id is not None:
        selected_revision = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            compile_context.revision_ref_id,
            variant="scalar",
            type_hint=RevisionId,
        )
    elif tip_revision_ref_id is not None:
        selected_revision = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            tip_revision_ref_id,
            variant="scalar",
            type_hint=RevisionId,
        )
    else:
        selected_revision = None
    guard_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(binding.registrar.next_ref())
    intent_ref_id = terminal_ref_id if route_recipe_ref_id is None else route_recipe_ref_id
    branch_id = compile_context.branch_anchor_literal if isinstance(compile_context.branch_anchor_literal, BranchId) else None
    stable_snapshot = (
        StableRouteSnapshotRequirement.REQUIRED
        if compile_context.requires_stable_route_snapshot
        else StableRouteSnapshotRequirement.NOT_REQUIRED
    )
    if selected_revision is None:
        guard = BranchRouteProofStep.for_persisted_tip(
            guard_ref_id,
            policy_ref_id=policy_ref_id,
            tip_revision_ref_id=tip_revision_ref_id,
            predicted_source=predicted_source,
            intent_ref_id=intent_ref_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            branch_ref_id=compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id,
            branch_table=compile_context.branch_table,
            revision_branch_index_table=compile_context.revision_branch_index_table,
            route_hint_identity=compile_context.route_hint_identity,
            stable_snapshot=stable_snapshot,
        )
    else:
        guard = BranchRouteProofStep(
            guard_ref_id,
            policy_ref_id=policy_ref_id,
            tip_revision_ref_id=tip_revision_ref_id,
            selected_revision=selected_revision,
            predicted_source=predicted_source,
            intent_ref_id=intent_ref_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            branch_ref_id=compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id,
            branch_table=compile_context.branch_table,
            revision_branch_index_table=compile_context.revision_branch_index_table,
            route_hint_identity=compile_context.route_hint_identity,
            stable_snapshot=stable_snapshot,
        )
    composed_guard, is_new_guard = binding.registrar.compose_branch_route_guard(guard)
    if not isinstance(composed_guard, BranchRouteProofStep):
        raise TypeError("Branch route guard composition returned an incompatible step")
    if is_new_guard:
        binding.registrar.add_intent(composed_guard)
    step.require_publication_gate(
        PublicationGateRequirement(
            guard_ref=composed_guard.ref_id,
            guard_step=composed_guard,
        )
    )


class SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode: GraphNode[Any]](GraphQueryBuilder[TNode]):
    """Pure compile-time builder that registers SQL-backed graph intents."""

    __slots__ = (
        "_after_refs",
        "_graph_id_source",
        "_pending_ctx_config_factory",
        "_registrar",
        "_terminal_binding_factory",
        "_graph_result_binding_factory",
        "_versioning_strategy",
    )

    def __init__(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder,
        *,
        registrar: GraphLazyStepRegistrar,
        pending_ctx_config_factory: Callable[[], _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig],
        graph_id: ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
        graph_id_source: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId] | None = None,
        graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
        result_node_type: type[TNode] | None = None,
        versioning_strategy_preview: object | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        terminal_binding_factory: Callable[[], GraphTerminalBinding] | None = None,
        graph_result_binding_factory: Callable[[type[Graph]], GraphResultIntentBinding] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            graph_id=graph_id,
            graph_type=graph_type,
            result_node_type=result_node_type,
        )
        self._registrar = registrar
        self._pending_ctx_config_factory = pending_ctx_config_factory
        self._graph_id_source = graph_id_source or graph_id
        self._versioning_strategy = versioning_strategy_preview
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._terminal_binding_factory = terminal_binding_factory
        self._graph_result_binding_factory = graph_result_binding_factory

    @pure_lazy
    def _terminal_binding(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> GraphTerminalBinding:
        if self._terminal_binding_factory is not None:
            return self._terminal_binding_factory()
        return GraphTerminalBinding(
            registrar=self._registrar,
            pending_ctx_config_factory=self._pending_ctx_config_factory,
            graph_id_source=self._graph_id_source,
            after_refs=self._after_refs,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def _current_graph_id_ref(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        binding: GraphTerminalBinding,
    ) -> GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId]:
        return binding.registrar.scalar_ref_for(binding.graph_id_source)

    @pure_lazy
    def _enqueue_with_graph_ctx[T](
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        build_step: Callable[
            [ServerPlanRefId, _GraphCompileContextConfig, GraphTerminalBinding],
            ServerPlanStep[T],
        ],
    ) -> LazyResult[T]:
        """Enqueue a graph terminal with its compile-time context config.

        ``pending_ctx_config_factory`` is invoked at terminal-enqueue time (not
        handle-construction time) so any txn-dependent prerequisite steps are
        injected into the current plan execution cycle. The terminal step
        synthesizes :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` during ``compile()`` from the
        config carried in :class:`_GraphCompileContextConfig` plus
        ``CompilationContext``, so no ``ResolvedRefs`` read is required.
        """
        binding = self._terminal_binding()
        compile_context = _build_graph_compile_context(binding.pending_ctx_config_factory)
        terminal_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(binding.registrar.next_ref())
        step = build_step(terminal_ref_id, compile_context, binding)
        attach_branch_route_guard(
            binding=binding,
            compile_context=compile_context,
            terminal_ref_id=terminal_ref_id,
            step=step,
        )
        return binding.registrar.add_intent(step)

    @pure_lazy
    def _pattern_terminal_node_witnesses(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
    ) -> frozenset[type[GraphNode]]:
        witnesses: set[type[GraphNode]] = set()
        if pattern.paths:
            witnesses.add(pattern.paths[-1].target.node_type)
        for union_block in pattern.union_blocks:
            for branch in union_block.branches:
                witnesses.update(self._pattern_terminal_node_witnesses(branch))
        for optional_block in pattern.optional_blocks:
            witnesses.update(self._pattern_terminal_node_witnesses(optional_block.pattern))
        return frozenset(witnesses)

    @pure_lazy
    def _result_node_witness(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        *,
        allow_pathless_ambiguity: bool = False,
    ) -> type[GraphNode]:
        if not allow_pathless_ambiguity and not self.pattern.paths and not self.pattern.union_blocks and len(self._nodes) > 1:
            msg = f"Pathless graph execution requires exactly one declared node; found {len(self._nodes)}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if self.result_node_type is not None:
            return self.result_node_type
        induced = self.pattern.induced_subgraph
        if induced is not None:
            return induced.node_type
        if self._current_path is not None:
            msg = "Complete the current path before graph execution"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        terminal_witnesses = self._pattern_terminal_node_witnesses(self.pattern)
        if len(terminal_witnesses) == 1:
            return next(iter(terminal_witnesses))
        if terminal_witnesses:
            names = tuple(sorted(witness.__name__ for witness in terminal_witnesses))
            msg = f"Graph execution requires one terminal node type; found {names!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if len(self._nodes) == 1:
            return next(iter(self._nodes.values())).node_type
        msg = "Graph execution requires a result node type or a completed path"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    @pure_lazy
    def _graph_execute_config(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
        compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig,
        binding: GraphTerminalBinding,
        *,
        step_node_properties: bool = False,
        allow_pathless_ambiguity: bool = False,
    ) -> _GraphExecuteConfig:
        if not step_node_properties and self.pattern.has_step_node_properties():
            raise ValueError("per-step node properties require execute_paths()")
        return _GraphExecuteConfig(
            graph_id_ref=self._current_graph_id_ref(binding),
            compile_context=compile_context,
            graph_type=self._resolved_graph_type(),
            result_node_type=self._result_node_witness(
                allow_pathless_ambiguity=allow_pathless_ambiguity,
            ),
            pattern=self.pattern,
            nodes=dict(self._nodes),
            current_path=self._current_path,
            after_refs=binding.after_refs,
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[list[TNode]]:
        if not self.pattern.has_traversal_paths() and not self._nodes:
            return LazyResult.of([])
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphNodesStep[TNode](
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_one_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[TNode | None]:
        if not self.pattern.has_traversal_paths() and not self._nodes:
            return LazyResult.of(None)
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphOneStep[TNode](
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def count_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[int]:
        if not self.pattern.has_traversal_paths() and not self._nodes:
            return LazyResult.of(0)
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphCountStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding, allow_pathless_ambiguity=True),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def exists_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[bool]:
        if not self.pattern.has_traversal_paths() and not self._nodes:
            return LazyResult.of(False)
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphExistsStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding, allow_pathless_ambiguity=True),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_paths_lazy(
        self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode],
    ) -> LazyResult[list[GraphPathEvidenceRow]]:
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphPathsStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding, step_node_properties=True),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_bindings_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[list[GraphBindingRow]]:
        self._require_binding_projections()
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding, allow_pathless_ambiguity=True),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_aggregate_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        return self._enqueue_with_graph_ctx(
            lambda ref_id, compile_context, binding: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                config=self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, binding),
            ),
        )

    @pure_lazy
    def personalized_random_walk(
        self,
        *,
        seeds: tuple[GraphSeedWeight[TNode], ...],
        edge_selectors: tuple[GraphWalkEdgeSelector, ...] = (),
        transition_relations: tuple[GraphWalkTransitionRelation[TNode], ...] = (),
        restart_probability: float,
        policy: FixedIterationPolicy | ConvergencePolicy,
        dangling_policy: DanglingNodePolicy = DanglingNodePolicy.REDISTRIBUTE_TO_RESTART,
        self_loop_policy: SelfLoopPolicy = SelfLoopPolicy.INCLUDE,
        parallel_edge_policy: ParallelEdgePolicy = ParallelEdgePolicy.COUNT_EACH,
    ) -> GraphWalkQuery[TNode]:
        """Compose a graph walk before the induced relation materializes."""
        request = PersonalizedRandomWalkRequest[TNode](
            seeds=seeds,
            edge_selectors=edge_selectors,
            transition_relations=transition_relations,
            restart_probability=restart_probability,
            policy=policy,
            dangling_policy=dangling_policy,
            self_loop_policy=self_loop_policy,
            parallel_edge_policy=parallel_edge_policy,
        )
        return _SqlPlanGraphWalkQuery(self, request)

    @pure_lazy
    def pagerank(
        self,
        *,
        edge_selectors: tuple[GraphWalkEdgeSelector, ...] = (),
        transition_relations: tuple[GraphWalkTransitionRelation[TNode], ...] = (),
        restart_probability: float,
        policy: FixedIterationPolicy | ConvergencePolicy,
        self_loop_policy: SelfLoopPolicy = SelfLoopPolicy.INCLUDE,
        parallel_edge_policy: ParallelEdgePolicy = ParallelEdgePolicy.COUNT_EACH,
    ) -> GraphWalkQuery[TNode]:
        """Compose PageRank through uniform personalized-walk restart weights."""
        request = PageRankRequest[TNode](
            edge_selectors=edge_selectors,
            transition_relations=transition_relations,
            restart_probability=restart_probability,
            policy=policy,
            self_loop_policy=self_loop_policy,
            parallel_edge_policy=parallel_edge_policy,
        )
        return _SqlPlanGraphWalkQuery(self, request)

    @pure_lazy
    def _resolved_graph_type(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> type[Graph]:
        graph_type = self.graph_type
        if graph_type is None:
            msg = "Guarded graph builders require a concrete graph type"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return graph_type

    @pure_lazy
    def execute_graph_lazy(self: SqlPlanGraphQueryBuilder[TNode]) -> LazyResult[GraphResult[TNode, GraphEdge]]:
        graph_type = self._resolved_graph_type()
        if self._graph_result_binding_factory is None:
            msg = "Graph result execution requires an intent-owned visibility binding"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        binding = self._graph_result_binding_factory(graph_type)
        compile_context = _build_graph_compile_context(binding.pending_ctx_config_factory)
        terminal_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(binding.registrar.next_ref())
        terminal_binding = GraphTerminalBinding(
            registrar=binding.registrar,
            pending_ctx_config_factory=binding.pending_ctx_config_factory,
            graph_id_source=binding.visibility.graph_id_ref,
            after_refs=frozenset(),
        )
        config = self._graph_execute_config(compile_context, terminal_binding)
        config = _GraphExecuteConfig(
            graph_id_ref=config.graph_id_ref,
            compile_context=config.compile_context,
            graph_type=graph_type,
            result_node_type=config.result_node_type,
            pattern=config.pattern,
            nodes=config.nodes,
            current_path=config.current_path,
            after_refs=config.after_refs,
            result_visibility=replace(
                binding.visibility,
                preferred_source=compile_context.predicted_source,
            ),
        )
        intent = ExecuteGraphResultIntent[TNode](ref_id=terminal_ref_id, config=config)
        attach_branch_route_guard(
            binding=terminal_binding,
            compile_context=compile_context,
            terminal_ref_id=terminal_ref_id,
            step=intent,
        )
        return binding.registrar.add_intent(intent)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _SqlBranchTipRevisionExpr(SqlRenderable):
    branch_expr: SqlRenderable
    branch_table: SqlTableName

    def render(self, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

        return SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id")),
                from_=self.branch_table,
                where=SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    self.branch_expr,
                ),
                limit=1,
            )
        ).render(dialect)


@pure_lazy
def _copy_graph_pattern(pattern: GraphQueryPattern) -> GraphQueryPattern:
    """Copy a pattern and normalize symbolic operands without executing them."""
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression, freeze_semantic_expression_value
    from l2060_query_builder.plan_query_builder import _normalize_expression_server_values

    def copy_element(element: GraphPatternElement) -> GraphPatternElement:
        if isinstance(element, FilterCondition):
            expression = freeze_semantic_expression_value(
                _normalize_expression_server_values(element.expression),
            )
            assert isinstance(expression, Expression)
            return FilterCondition(expression=expression)
        if isinstance(element, PathPattern):
            return deepcopy(element)
        if isinstance(element, ExistsCondition):
            return ExistsCondition(
                pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern),
                negated=element.negated,
            )
        if isinstance(element, MinusBlock):
            return MinusBlock(pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern))
        if isinstance(element, OptionalBlock):
            return OptionalBlock(pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern))
        if isinstance(element, UnionBlock):
            return UnionBlock(
                branches=tuple(_copy_graph_pattern(branch) for branch in element.branches),
            )
        msg = f"Unsupported graph pattern element: {type(element).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    return GraphQueryPattern(
        elements=tuple(copy_element(element) for element in pattern.elements),
        select_fields=deepcopy(pattern.select_fields),
        order_by=deepcopy(pattern.order_by),
        path_result_order_by=deepcopy(pattern.path_result_order_by),
        group_by=list(pattern.group_by),
        aggregations=deepcopy(pattern.aggregations),
        overview_aggregation=deepcopy(pattern.overview_aggregation),
        having=deepcopy(pattern.having),
        binding_projections=deepcopy(pattern.binding_projections),
        induced_subgraph=pattern.induced_subgraph,
        limit=pattern.limit,
        offset=pattern.offset,
        distinct=pattern.distinct,
    )


def _graph_model_compiled_artifacts(
    model_cls: type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]],
) -> tuple[Any, Any, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        get_all_select_columns,
    )
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_widening import (
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name,
    )

    columns = tuple(
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in get_all_select_columns(model_cls)
    )
    hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    if hints is None:
        msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for graph node model {model_cls.__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    projection_model = cte_projection_row_model(
        f"{model_cls.__name__}GraphNodeProjection",
        columns,
        hints,
    )
    return compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
        CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=hints,
            model_cls=projection_model,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=model_cls,
                projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=("graph_node" if issubclass(model_cls, GraphNode) else "graph_edge"),
            source_tables=frozenset({get_table_name(model_cls)}),
        ),
    )


def _prefixed_graph_node_type_hints(
    node_type: type[GraphNode],
    node_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    raw_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(node_type, node_columns)
    if raw_hints is None:
        msg = (
            f"Graph node model {node_type.__name__} has incomplete SQL column type hints; "
            "declare a supported type for every transported field"
        )
        raise TypeError(msg)

    def prefixed(columns: frozenset[str]) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(f"__node_{column}" for column in columns)

    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.jsonb_columns),
        uuid_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.uuid_columns),
        timestamptz_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.timestamptz_columns),
        date_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.date_columns),
        time_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.time_columns),
        numeric_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.numeric_columns),
        bool_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bool_columns),
        integer_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.integer_columns),
        bigint_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bigint_columns),
        double_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.double_columns),
        text_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.text_columns),
        bytea_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bytea_columns),
    )
