def _merge_graph_result_type_hints(
    node_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
    edge_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=node_hints.jsonb_columns | edge_hints.jsonb_columns,
        uuid_columns=node_hints.uuid_columns | edge_hints.uuid_columns | frozenset({"__entity_id"}),
        timestamptz_columns=node_hints.timestamptz_columns | edge_hints.timestamptz_columns,
        date_columns=node_hints.date_columns | edge_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=node_hints.time_columns | edge_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=node_hints.numeric_columns | edge_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=node_hints.bool_columns | edge_hints.bool_columns,
        integer_columns=node_hints.integer_columns | edge_hints.integer_columns,
        bigint_columns=node_hints.bigint_columns | edge_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=node_hints.double_columns | edge_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=node_hints.text_columns | edge_hints.text_columns | frozenset({"__entity_kind"}),
        bytea_columns=node_hints.bytea_columns | edge_hints.bytea_columns,
    )


def _graph_result_compiled_artifacts(
    node_type: type[GraphNode],
    edge_type: type[GraphEdge],
    node_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
    edge_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
) -> tuple[CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    node_hints = _prefixed_graph_node_type_hints(node_type, node_columns)
    fields: list[CompiledOutputField] = [
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name="__entity_kind",
            output_column="__entity_kind",
            source_db_column="__entity_kind",
            role="graph_entity_kind",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        ),
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name="__entity_id",
            output_column="__entity_id",
            source_db_column="__entity_id",
            role="graph_entity_id",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        ),
    ]
    for column in node_columns:
        column_name = str(column)
        fields.append(
            CompiledOutputField(
                output_name=f"__node_{column_name}",
                output_column=f"__node_{column_name}",
                source_db_column=column_name,
                role="graph_node_transport",
                is_model_backed=False,
                include_in_json=False,
                include_in_hydration=False,
            ),
        )
    fields.extend(
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name=f"__edge_{column}",
            output_column=f"__edge_{column}",
            source_db_column=str(column),
            role="graph_edge_transport",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        )
        for column in edge_columns
    )
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(fields))
    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation(
        columns=tuple(
            DeclaredResultColumn(
                output_name=field.output_name,
                output_column=field.output_column,
                visibility="internal" if field.output_name.startswith("__") else "public",
            )
            for field in fields
        ),
        terminal_materialization_shape=output_shape.cte_output_columns,
    )
    edge_hints = _prefixed_graph_edge_type_hints(edge_type, edge_columns)
    output_columns = frozenset(output_shape.cte_output_columns)
    merged_hints = _merge_graph_result_type_hints(node_hints, edge_hints).filtered(set(output_columns))
    typed_columns = frozenset().union(*merged_hints.as_tuple())
    untyped_columns = output_columns - typed_columns

    def transport_field(column: str) -> str:
        return column.removeprefix("__node_").removeprefix("__edge_")

    uuid_columns = {
        column
        for column in untyped_columns
        if transport_field(column)
        in {
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "branch_id",
            "revision_id",
            "staged_commit_id",
            "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
        }
    }
    bool_columns = {column for column in untyped_columns if transport_field(column) in {"deleted", "sys_deleted"}}
    timestamptz_columns = {
        column
        for column in untyped_columns
        if transport_field(column) in {"created_at", "updated_at", "sys_created_at", "sys_updated_at"}
    }
    remaining_columns = untyped_columns - uuid_columns - bool_columns - timestamptz_columns
    complete_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=merged_hints.jsonb_columns,
        uuid_columns=merged_hints.uuid_columns | frozenset(uuid_columns),
        timestamptz_columns=merged_hints.timestamptz_columns | frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
        date_columns=merged_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=merged_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=merged_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=merged_hints.bool_columns | frozenset(bool_columns),
        integer_columns=merged_hints.integer_columns,
        bigint_columns=merged_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=merged_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=merged_hints.text_columns | frozenset(remaining_columns),
        bytea_columns=merged_hints.bytea_columns,
    )
    return output_shape, result_relation, complete_hints


def _is_current_revision_sentinel(value: object | None) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return False
    return str(value) == "current"


class GraphPathEvidenceRelationRow(GraphPathEvidenceRow):
    """Exact SQL-visible publication row for composed path evidence."""

    result_ordinal: int


def _graph_path_evidence_columns_and_hints() -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    """Derive path publication types from the semantic evidence relation."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.graph_path_relation_plan import (
        GraphPathRelationSchemas,
    )

    evidence_schema = GraphPathRelationSchemas().evidence
    columns = tuple(str(column.column_id) for column in evidence_schema.columns)
    model_columns = tuple(GraphPathEvidenceRelationRow.model_fields)
    if columns != model_columns:
        msg = f"Graph path evidence schema {columns!r} does not match publication model {model_columns!r}"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
        "uuid": set(),
        "int": set(),
        "bigint": set(),
        "bool": set(),
        "text": set(),
    }
    for column in evidence_schema.columns:
        type_hint = str(column.type_hint)
        target = typed_columns.get(type_hint)
        if target is None:
            msg = f"Graph path evidence column {column.column_id!s} has unsupported type hint {type_hint!r}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        target.add(str(column.column_id))
    return columns, SqlColumnTypeHints(
        uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid"]),
        integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["int"]),
        bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint"]),
        bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool"]),
        text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text"]),
    )


def _graph_path_required_int(row: Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue], field_name: str) -> int:
    value = row.get(field_name)
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | str):
        msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires an integer; received {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return int(value)


def _graph_path_required_id(row: Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue], field_name: str) -> SysId:
    value = row.get(field_name)
    if not isinstance(value, str | UUID | SysId):
        msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires a UUID; received {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return SysId(value)


def _process_graph_path_evidence_rows(
    raw_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue]],
) -> list[GraphPathEvidenceRow]:
    ordered_rows = sorted(
        raw_rows,
        key=lambda row: (
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "result_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "logical_step_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "segment_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "constituent_ordinal"),
        ),
    )
    evidence: list[GraphPathEvidenceRow] = []
    for raw_row in ordered_rows:
        row = dict(raw_row)
        projection_key = row.get("projected_source_key")
        row.pop("result_ordinal", None)
        if row.get("constituent_kind") == "edge" and row.get("constituent_sys_id") is None:
            edge_row = {
                "graph_sys_id": row.get("graph_sys_id"),
                "source_sys_id": row.get("source_sys_id"),
                "target_sys_id": row.get("target_sys_id"),
                "type_name": row.get("concrete_type_name"),
            }
            projected_id = projected_edge_row_sys_id(
                edge_row,
                projection_key,
                declared_type_name=ProjectedEdgeTypeName(str(row["declared_type_name"])),
            )
            if projected_id is None:
                msg = "Projected path evidence is missing its deterministic identity inputs"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            row["constituent_sys_id"] = projected_id

        for field_name in (
            "anchor_sys_id",
            "terminal_sys_id",
            "constituent_sys_id",
        ):
            row[field_name] = _graph_path_required_id(row, field_name)
        for field_name in (
            "predecessor_sys_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
        ):
            value = row.get(field_name)
            row[field_name] = None if value is None else _graph_path_required_id(row, field_name)
        row["graph_sys_id"] = GraphId(
            _graph_path_required_id(row, "graph_sys_id").unwrap_to_uuid(),
        )
        for field_name in (
            "depth",
            "logical_step_id",
            "logical_step_ordinal",
            "relation_branch_ordinal",
            "segment_ordinal",
            "constituent_ordinal",
        ):
            row[field_name] = _graph_path_required_int(row, field_name)
        for field_name in ("projected", "terminal_constituent_edge"):
            value = row.get(field_name)
            if not isinstance(value, bool | int):
                msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires a boolean; received {type(value).__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            row[field_name] = bool(value)
        evidence.append(GraphPathEvidenceRow.model_validate(row))
    return evidence

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphCompileContextConfig:
    """Symbolic graph execution-context inputs carried by graph terminal steps.

    The terminal step synthesizes :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` during ``compile()``
    from this config plus ``CompilationContext`` (backend / dialect / cached
    revision + branch on the active transaction). No ``ResolvedRefs`` access
    happens in ``preprocess()`` or ``compile()``; prerequisite refs declared
    here keep the ServerPlan dependency graph intact so any upstream scalar
    producers still run before the terminal.
    """

    graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    revision_literal: RevisionId | None
    revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    branch_anchor_literal: BranchId | None
    branch_anchor_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    prefer_tip_strategy: bool
    tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization
    branch_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    revision_branch_index_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    revision_parent_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    force_application_versioning: bool = False
    include_staged_working_set: bool = False
    requires_stable_route_snapshot: bool = True
    inherited_branch_visibility: bool = False
    selected_revision_tip_status: SelectedRevisionTipStatus = SelectedRevisionTipStatus.NOT_CURRENT_TIP
    tip_materialization_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    tip_revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    predicted_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None
    predicted_tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization | None = None
    route_hint_identity: BranchReadHintIdentity | None = None
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.graph_id_ref,
            site="_GraphCompileContextConfig.dependencies",
        )
        deps = set(graph_id_shape.dependency_refs) | {
            str(ref_id)
            for ref_id in (
                self.revision_ref_id,
                self.branch_anchor_ref_id,
                self.tip_materialization_ref_id,
                self.tip_revision_ref_id,
                self.permission_context_ref,
            )
            if ref_id is not None
        }
        return frozenset(deps)

    def has_branch_anchor_prereq(self) -> bool:
        return self.branch_anchor_literal is not None or self.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphResultVisibilityConfig:
    """Permission-aware graph source owned by one graph-result intent."""

    graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    graph_type: type[Graph]
    revision_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]
    domain: type[VersioningDomain]
    error_message: str
    preferred_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.graph_id_ref,
            site="_GraphResultVisibilityConfig.graph_id_ref",
        )
        revision_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.revision_id_ref,
            site="_GraphResultVisibilityConfig.revision_id_ref",
        )
        dependencies = {
            *graph_shape.dependency_refs,
            *revision_shape.dependency_refs,
        }
        if self.permission_context_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.permission_context_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphExecuteConfig:
    graph_id_ref: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]]
    result_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]]
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern
    nodes: Mapping[str, NodePattern]
    current_path: PathPattern | None
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    sql_visible_after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None
    auth_scope_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    result_visibility: _GraphResultVisibilityConfig | None = None


def _graph_execute_config_sql_visible_dependencies(
    config: _GraphExecuteConfig,
) -> frozenset[str]:
    graph_id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
        config.graph_id_ref,
        site="_graph_execute_config_sql_visible_dependencies",
    )
    after_refs = config.after_refs if config.sql_visible_after_refs is None else config.sql_visible_after_refs
    dependencies = (
        config.compile_context.dependencies() | graph_id_shape.dependency_refs | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in after_refs)
    )
    return frozenset(ref_id for ref_id in dependencies if not ref_id.partition(".")[0].startswith("seed_"))


def _dialect_for_graph_compile(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    graph_ctx: SqlGraphExecutionCtx,
) -> SqlDialect:
    from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_dialect import get_dialect

    dialect_name = graph_ctx.dialect_name.lower().replace("dialect", "")
    return get_dialect(dialect_name)


def _build_graph_execution_ctx(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    graph_id_ref: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
    compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig,
) -> SqlGraphExecutionCtx:
    """Synthesize :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` from compile-time inputs only.

    Reads are limited to ``CompilationContext`` attributes published by the
    executor (``backend_type``, ``dialect``, ``revision_id``, ``branch_id``,
    ``cte_refs``) and the terminal step's static config. Symbolic ref IDs
    from the compile context are lowered to :class:`SqlRenderable`
    expressions via :func:`lower_scalar_server_ref`, so the generated SQL
    references upstream CTE fields directly rather than materializing runtime
    values. No ``ResolvedRefs`` or ``materialized_pipeline`` access occurs
    here, keeping this path clear of the SPT-010 / SPT-024 runtime-value
    tripwires.
    """
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SysIdValue
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
        lower_scalar_server_ref,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef, ServerRefs
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchId as _BranchId
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import RevisionId
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import (
        GraphSqlVersioningMode,
        SqlGraphExecutionCtx as _Ctx,
    )
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import (
        resolve_graph_versioning_mode,
    )

    backend_type = ctx.backend_type
    dialect_name = type(ctx.dialect).__name__
    speculated_source = compile_context.predicted_source if ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_guarded_route_speculation else None
    selected_policy = ctx.selected_branch_policy_ref_id is not None and speculated_source is None
    revision_is_current_branch_tip = (
        speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        if speculated_source is not None
        else compile_context.selected_revision_tip_status is SelectedRevisionTipStatus.CURRENT_TIP
        or (selected_policy and ctx.branch_tip_materialized)
    )
    prefer_tip_strategy = (
        speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        if speculated_source is not None
        else ctx.prefer_tip_strategy
        if selected_policy
        else compile_context.prefer_tip_strategy
    )
    tip_materialization = (
        compile_context.predicted_tip_materialization
        if speculated_source is not None and compile_context.predicted_tip_materialization is not None
        else BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        if selected_policy and ctx.branch_tip_materialized
        else BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
        if selected_policy
        else compile_context.tip_materialization
    )

    revision_literal = compile_context.revision_literal
    revision_ref_id = compile_context.revision_ref_id
    revision_id: RevisionId | None
    if revision_literal is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(revision_literal):
        revision_id = RevisionId(str(revision_literal))
        revision_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif revision_literal is not None:
        revision_id = RevisionId.current()
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif revision_ref_id is not None:
        ctx_revision = ctx.revision_id
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None and str(revision_ref_id) in ctx.cte_refs:
            revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                revision_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(revision_ref, ctx, default_field="revision_id")
            revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx_revision)) if ctx_revision is not None else None
        elif ctx_revision is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx_revision):
            revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx_revision))
            revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
        elif prefer_tip_strategy and (
            tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
            or compile_context.branch_anchor_literal is not None
            or compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None
            or ctx.branch_id is not None
        ):
            revision_id = RevisionId.current()
            revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
        else:
            revision_ref = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                revision_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(revision_ref, ctx, default_field="revision_id")
            revision_id = None
    elif ctx.revision_id is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx.revision_id):
        revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx.revision_id))
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif (
        compile_context.branch_anchor_literal is not None or compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None or ctx.branch_id is not None
    ):
        revision_id = RevisionId.current()
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    else:
        msg = "Graph is not visible in the current versioned read context"
        raise db_exc.PermissionError(msg)

    branch_anchor_literal = compile_context.branch_anchor_literal
    branch_anchor_ref_id = compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id
    branch_anchor: _BranchId | None
    branch_anchor_expr: SqlRenderable | None
    if branch_anchor_literal is not None:
        branch_anchor = branch_anchor_literal
        branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif branch_anchor_ref_id is not None:
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None and str(branch_anchor_ref_id) in ctx.cte_refs:
            branch_anchor_ref: ScalarServerRef[_BranchId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                branch_anchor_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            branch_anchor_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
                branch_anchor_ref,
                ctx,
                default_field="branch_id",
            )
            branch_anchor = None
        elif ctx.branch_id is not None:
            branch_anchor = _BranchId(str(ctx.branch_id))
            branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
        else:
            branch_anchor_ref = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                branch_anchor_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            branch_anchor_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
                branch_anchor_ref,
                ctx,
                default_field="branch_id",
            )
            branch_anchor = None
    elif ctx.branch_id is not None:
        branch_anchor = _BranchId(str(ctx.branch_id))
        branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
    else:
        branch_anchor = None
        branch_anchor_expr = None

    has_branch_anchor = branch_anchor_expr is not None
    ctx_revision_is_concrete = ctx.revision_id is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx.revision_id)
    revision_literal_is_concrete = revision_literal is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(revision_literal)
    has_explicit_revision_selector = (
        revision_literal_is_concrete or ctx.explicit_revision_id is not None or revision_ref_id is not None or ctx_revision_is_concrete
    )
    has_revision_anchor = has_explicit_revision_selector and not revision_is_current_branch_tip
    if (
        prefer_tip_strategy
        and tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        and has_branch_anchor
        and not has_revision_anchor
        and revision_ref_id is None
        and revision_literal is None
        and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
        and not ctx_revision_is_concrete
    ):
        tip_revision_ref_id = compile_context.tip_revision_ref_id
        if tip_revision_ref_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError("TIP graph execution requires a persisted tip-revision ref")
        tip_revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            tip_revision_ref_id,
            variant="scalar",
        )
        revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            tip_revision_ref,
            ctx,
            default_field="revision_id",
        )
    inherited_branch_visibility = (
        compile_context.inherited_branch_visibility
        or has_explicit_revision_selector
        or (has_branch_anchor and prefer_tip_strategy and tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS)
    )
    if compile_context.force_application_versioning:
        versioning_mode = GraphSqlVersioningMode.APPLICATION
    elif speculated_source is not None:
        versioning_mode = GraphSqlVersioningMode.TIP if speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP else GraphSqlVersioningMode.SPARSE
    else:
        versioning_mode = resolve_graph_versioning_mode(
            has_branch_anchor=has_branch_anchor,
            prefer_tip_strategy=(prefer_tip_strategy and not has_revision_anchor),
            tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
        )

    graph_recursive_transport = ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_recursive_transport
    graph_distinct_transport = ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_distinct_transport
    return _Ctx(
        graph_id=graph_id_ref,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        branch_anchor=branch_anchor,
        graph_type=graph_type,
        versioning_mode=versioning_mode,
        dialect_name=dialect_name,
        supports_recursive_cte=graph_recursive_transport is GraphRecursiveTransport.RECURSIVE_CTE,
        supports_distinct_on=graph_distinct_transport is GraphDistinctTransport.DISTINCT_ON,
        dolt_commit_hash=None,
        inherited_branch_visibility=inherited_branch_visibility,
        revision_is_current=revision_id is not None and revision_id.is_current(),
        revision_expr=revision_expr,
        branch_anchor_expr=branch_anchor_expr,
        include_staged_working_set=compile_context.include_staged_working_set,
        revision_branch_index_table=compile_context.revision_branch_index_table,
        revision_parent_table=compile_context.revision_parent_table,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub:
    """Minimal compile-time backend shape required by SqlGraphQueryBuilder."""

    backend_type: BackendType


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub:
    """Compile-only transaction stub; runtime APIs must never be added here."""

    backend_stub: CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub

    @property
    def _conn(self: CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub) -> CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub:
        return self.backend_stub


def _versioning_strategy_from_graph_ctx(graph_ctx: SqlGraphExecutionCtx) -> VersioningStrategy:
    from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.application_versioning_strategy import (
        ApplicationVersioningStrategy,
    )
    from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.sparse_versioning_strategy import (
        SparseVersioningStrategy,
    )
    from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.tip_versioning_strategy import (
        TipVersioningStrategy,
    )
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import GraphSqlVersioningMode

    if graph_ctx.include_staged_working_set:
        from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.versioning_strategy import (
            WorkingSetVersioningStrategy,
        )

        if graph_ctx.revision_expr is None:
            raise RuntimeError("working-set graph queries require a revision expression")
        return WorkingSetVersioningStrategy(graph_ctx.revision_expr)

    revision_expr = graph_ctx.revision_expr
    branch_expr = graph_ctx.branch_anchor_expr

    if graph_ctx.versioning_mode == GraphSqlVersioningMode.DOLT:
        msg = "Native graph versioning must be replaced by a downstream lowering override"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    if graph_ctx.versioning_mode == GraphSqlVersioningMode.TIP:
        if branch_expr is None:
            msg = "Tip graph execution requires a resolved branch anchor"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return TipVersioningStrategy(graph_ctx.branch_anchor, branch_expr=branch_expr)
    if graph_ctx.versioning_mode == GraphSqlVersioningMode.SPARSE:
        if branch_expr is None:
            msg = "Sparse graph execution requires a resolved branch anchor"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return SparseVersioningStrategy(
            graph_ctx.revision_id,
            graph_ctx.branch_anchor,
            revision_expr=revision_expr,
            symbolic_revision_is_current=graph_ctx.revision_is_current,
            branch_expr=branch_expr,
            inherited_branch_visibility=graph_ctx.inherited_branch_visibility,
            revision_branch_index_table=graph_ctx.revision_branch_index_table,
            revision_parent_table=graph_ctx.revision_parent_table,
        )
    return ApplicationVersioningStrategy(graph_ctx.revision_id, revision_expr=revision_expr)


def _graph_compile_txn(backend_type: BackendType) -> CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub:
    return CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub(backend_stub=CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub(backend_type=backend_type))


def _working_set_graph_models(
    result_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]],
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
) -> tuple[type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]], ...]:
    models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
        str(get_table_name(result_node_type)): result_node_type,
    }
    induced = pattern.induced_subgraph
    edge_types: list[type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = []
    if induced is not None:
        models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(induced.node_type)), induced.node_type)
        edge_types.append(induced.edge_type)
    for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(pattern):
        for model_cls in (path.source.node_type, path.target.node_type):
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(model_cls)), model_cls)
        for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(step.source_type)), step.source_type)
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(step.target_type)), step.target_type)
            edge_types.extend(step.edge_types)
    overview = pattern.overview_aggregation
    if overview is not None:
        for _label, node_type in overview.node_models:
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(node_type)), node_type)
        edge_types.extend(edge_type for _label, edge_type in overview.edge_models)
    for edge_type in edge_types:
        projected_sources = get_projected_edge_sources(edge_type)
        if not projected_sources:
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(edge_type)), edge_type)
            continue
        for source in projected_sources:
            models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(source.owner_type)), source.owner_type)
            if source.target_lookup_type is not None:
                models.setdefault(str(get_table_name(source.target_lookup_type)), source.target_lookup_type)
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        _get_table_root_class,
    )

    # The working-set contract in docs/l9700_graph_query.rst requires one complete
    # shared-table relation, independent of which endpoint subtype is scheduled first.
    table_models: dict[SqlTableName, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {}
    for model in models.values():
        table_root = _get_table_root_class(model)
        if table_root is None:
            table_root = model
        if not issubclass(table_root, (GraphNode, GraphEdge)):
            raise TypeError(f"Working-set model root must be a graph node or edge: {table_root.__name__}")
        table_models.setdefault(get_table_name(table_root), table_root)
    return tuple(table_models.values())


def _working_set_graph_ctes(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    graph_ctx: SqlGraphExecutionCtx,
    *,
    result_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]],
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]]:
    if not graph_ctx.include_staged_working_set:
        return []
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SysIdValue
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
        lower_scalar_server_ref,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
        _versioned_merged_source_cte,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.graph.graph_sparse import (
        split_active_graph_cte,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.sql_graph_query import (
        _build_edge_cte_for_type,
    )
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef

    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        get_all_select_columns,
    )
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_widening import (
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name,
    )

    metadata_columns = {
        "sys_revision_id",
        "sys_staged_commit_id",
        "sys_deleted",
    }
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlCteName
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.polymorphic_multitable_cte import get_multitable_polymorphic_source_models
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.polymorphism.multitable_cte import build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition

    model_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    for model_cls in _working_set_graph_models(result_node_type, pattern):
        source_models = get_multitable_polymorphic_source_models(model_cls)
        if len(source_models) > 1:
            source_queries = {
                source_model: _versioned_merged_source_cte(
                    source_model,
                    ctx,
                    branch_id=graph_ctx.branch_anchor_expr,
                    include_deleted=False,
                    physical_data_columns=tuple(
                        column
                        for field_name in get_all_select_columns(source_model)
                        if (column := get_polymorphic_db_column_name(source_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) not in metadata_columns
                    ),
                )
                for source_model in source_models
            }
            union = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition(
                model_cls,
                source_models,
                cte_name=SqlCteName(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                source_queries=source_queries,
            )
            assert union is not None
            model_ctes.append(union)
            continue
        model_ctes.append(
            (
                str(get_table_name(model_cls)),
                _versioned_merged_source_cte(
                    model_cls,
                    ctx,
                    branch_id=graph_ctx.branch_anchor_expr,
                    include_deleted=False,
                    additional_data_columns=tuple(
                        column
                        for field_name in get_all_select_columns(model_cls)
                        if (
                            column := get_polymorphic_db_column_name(
                                model_cls,
                                DynamicFieldName(field_name),
                            )
                        )
                        not in metadata_columns
                    ),
                ),
            )
        )
    graph_id_expr: SqlRenderable
    if isinstance(graph_ctx.graph_id, ScalarServerRef):
        graph_id_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            graph_ctx.graph_id,
            ctx,
            default_field="sys_id",
        )
    else:
        graph_id_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(graph_ctx.graph_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    revision_expr = graph_ctx.revision_expr
    if revision_expr is None:
        raise RuntimeError("working-set graph queries require a revision expression")
    overview = pattern.overview_aggregation
    if overview is None:
        logical_edge_graph_id: SqlRenderable | None = graph_id_expr
    elif overview.graph_id is None:
        logical_edge_graph_id = None
    else:
        logical_edge_graph_id = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            overview.graph_id,
            ctx,
            default_field="graph_id",
        )
    path_edge_types = tuple(
        edge_type
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(pattern)
        for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression)
        for edge_type in step.edge_types
    )
    induced = pattern.induced_subgraph
    overview_edge_types = tuple(edge_type for _label, edge_type in overview.edge_models) if overview is not None else ()
    edge_types = path_edge_types + ((induced.edge_type,) if induced is not None else ()) + overview_edge_types
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        _get_table_root_class,
    )

    projected_edge_roots: dict[SqlTableName, type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {}
    for edge_type in edge_types:
        if not get_projected_edge_sources(edge_type):
            continue
        table_root = _get_table_root_class(edge_type) or edge_type
        if not issubclass(table_root, GraphEdge):
            raise TypeError(f"Projected edge table root must be a graph edge: {table_root.__name__}")
        projected_edge_roots.setdefault(get_table_name(table_root), table_root)
    projected_edge_types = tuple(projected_edge_roots.values())
    for edge_index, edge_type in enumerate(projected_edge_types):
        projected_sources = get_projected_edge_sources(edge_type)
        physical_overrides: dict[SqlTableName, SqlTableName] = {}
        physical_models = get_multitable_polymorphic_source_models(edge_type) or (edge_type,)
        for model_index, physical_model in enumerate(physical_models):
            physical_name = SqlTableName(f"working_physical_edges_{edge_index}_{model_index}")
            physical_overrides[get_table_name(physical_model)] = physical_name
            model_ctes.append(
                (
                    str(physical_name),
                    _versioned_merged_source_cte(
                        physical_model,
                        ctx,
                        branch_id=graph_ctx.branch_anchor_expr,
                        include_deleted=False,
                        physical_data_columns=tuple(
                            column
                            for field_name in get_all_select_columns(physical_model)
                            if (
                                column := get_polymorphic_db_column_name(
                                    physical_model,
                                    DynamicFieldName(field_name),
                                )
                            )
                            not in metadata_columns
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            )
        active_edge = _build_edge_cte_for_type(
            edge_type,
            logical_edge_graph_id,
            revision_expr,
            None,
            include_hash32_columns=False,
            include_dense_key_columns=False,
            application_versioned=True,
            model_transport=True,
            projected_source_table_overrides={
                model_type: get_table_name(model_type)
                for source in projected_sources
                for model_type in (
                    source.owner_type,
                    source.target_lookup_type,
                )
                if model_type is not None
            },
            physical_preversioned=True,
            physical_table_overrides=physical_overrides,
        )
        _active_name, edge_body = split_active_graph_cte(active_edge)
        model_ctes.append((str(get_table_name(edge_type)), edge_body))
    return model_ctes


def _build_query_builder(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    graph_ctx: SqlGraphExecutionCtx,
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
    result_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]],
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
    nodes: Mapping[str, NodePattern],
    current_path: PathPattern | None,
    cte_namespace: SqlCteName | None = None,
) -> Any:
    from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.sql_graph_query_builder import SqlGraphQueryBuilder

    builder = SqlGraphQueryBuilder(
        graph_ctx.graph_id,
        _versioning_strategy_from_graph_ctx(graph_ctx),
        _dialect_for_graph_compile(ctx, graph_ctx),
        compilation_context=ctx,
        graph_type=graph_type,
        result_node_type=result_node_type,
        cte_namespace=cte_namespace,
    )
    return builder.with_pattern_state(
        pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(pattern),
        nodes=nodes,
        current_path=deepcopy(current_path),
    )


def _process_graph_query_rows(
    raw_rows: Sequence[Any],
    target_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]],
) -> list[GraphNode]:
    from impl.common.l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import matches_polymorphic_row

    nodes: list[GraphNode] = []
    for raw_row in raw_rows:
        row_dict = dict(raw_row)
        coerced_type_id = row_dict.get("type_id")
        if coerced_type_id is not None:
            try:
                row_dict["type_id"] = int(coerced_type_id)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                # type_name is the live discriminator; tolerate stale non-numeric
                # type_id projections from older query shapes during hydration.
                row_dict.pop("type_id", None)
        if not matches_polymorphic_row(target_node_type, row_dict):
            continue
        model_cls, filtered = dispatch_polymorphic_type(target_node_type, row_dict)
        try:
            nodes.append(model_cls.model_validate(filtered))
        except ValidationError:
            target_fields = set(target_node_type.model_fields)
            target_row = {key: value for key, value in row_dict.items() if key in target_fields}
            nodes.append(target_node_type.model_validate(target_row))
    return nodes


def _process_graph_result_rows(
    raw_rows: Sequence[Any],
    target_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]],
    edge_type: type[GraphEdge[Any]],
    *,
    entity_kind_column: str = "__entity_kind",
    entity_id_column: str = "__entity_id",
    node_prefix: str = "__node_",
    edge_prefix: str = "__edge_",
    node_columns: tuple[str, ...],
    edge_columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> GraphResult[GraphNode, GraphEdge]:
    from impl.common.l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import (
        collect_polymorphic_type_names,
        matches_polymorphic_row,
    )
    from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import deserialize_json_fields

    node_results: list[GraphNode] = []
    edge_results: list[GraphEdge] = []
    seen_entities: dict[tuple[str, str], GraphTransportRow] = {}
    control_columns = {entity_kind_column, entity_id_column}
    expected_node_columns = frozenset(f"{node_prefix}{column}" for column in node_columns)
    expected_edge_columns = frozenset(f"{edge_prefix}{column}" for column in edge_columns)

    for raw_row in raw_rows:
        row_dict: GraphTransportRow = dict(raw_row)
        if entity_kind_column not in row_dict:
            msg = f"Graph-result row is missing entity kind column {entity_kind_column!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if entity_id_column not in row_dict or row_dict[entity_id_column] is None:
            msg = f"Graph-result row is missing entity ID column {entity_id_column!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if not isinstance(row_dict[entity_id_column], UUID):
            msg = "Graph-result entity ID must be a UUID produced by transport normalization"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        entity_kind = row_dict[entity_kind_column]
        if not isinstance(entity_kind, str) or entity_kind not in {"node", "edge"}:
            msg = f"Graph-result entity kind must be 'node' or 'edge', got {entity_kind!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        entity_id = str(row_dict[entity_id_column])
        entity_key = (entity_kind, entity_id)
        previous_row = seen_entities.get(entity_key)
        if previous_row is not None:
            differing_columns = tuple(
                sorted(key for key in set(previous_row) | set(row_dict) if previous_row.get(key) != row_dict.get(key)),
            )
            msg = f"duplicate graph-result {entity_kind} entity {entity_id!r}; differing columns={differing_columns!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        seen_entities[entity_key] = row_dict

        payload_columns = frozenset(row_dict) - control_columns
        unexpected_columns = payload_columns - expected_node_columns - expected_edge_columns
        if unexpected_columns:
            msg = f"Graph-result row contains undeclared transport columns: {tuple(sorted(unexpected_columns))!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        missing_transport_columns = (expected_node_columns | expected_edge_columns) - payload_columns
        if missing_transport_columns:
            msg = f"Graph-result row is missing declared transport columns: {tuple(sorted(missing_transport_columns))!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        edge_transport = {key: value for key, value in row_dict.items() if key in expected_edge_columns}
        node_transport = {key: value for key, value in row_dict.items() if key in expected_node_columns}

        if entity_kind == "node":
            active_edge_columns = tuple(key for key, value in edge_transport.items() if value is not None)
            if active_edge_columns:
                msg = f"Graph-result node row contains active edge payload: {active_edge_columns!r}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            required_node_columns = tuple(f"{node_prefix}{name}" for name in ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id"))
            missing_node_columns = tuple(column for column in required_node_columns if column not in node_transport)
            if missing_node_columns:
                msg = f"Graph-result row is missing required node column: {missing_node_columns!r}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            node_row = {key.removeprefix(node_prefix): value for key, value in node_transport.items() if key.startswith(node_prefix)}
            if str(node_row["sys_id"]) != entity_id:
                msg = "Graph-result node entity ID does not match node sys_id"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            node_type_name = node_row.get("type_name")
            allowed_node_type_names = {
                target_node_type.__name__,
                *collect_polymorphic_type_names(target_node_type),
            }
            if (node_type_name is not None and str(node_type_name) not in allowed_node_type_names) or not matches_polymorphic_row(
                target_node_type, node_row
            ):
                msg = "Graph-result node discriminator is outside the selected node hierarchy"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            for identifier_column in ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id"):
                identifier_value = node_row[identifier_column]
                if identifier_value is not None and not isinstance(identifier_value, UUID):
                    msg = f"Graph-result node {identifier_column} must be a driver-normalized UUID"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
            model_cls, filtered_node = dispatch_polymorphic_type(target_node_type, node_row)
            node_results.append(model_cls.model_validate(filtered_node))
            continue

        active_node_columns = tuple(key for key, value in node_transport.items() if value is not None)
        if active_node_columns:
            msg = f"Graph-result edge row contains active node payload: {active_node_columns!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        required_edge_columns = tuple(f"{edge_prefix}{name}" for name in ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id", "source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"))
        missing_edge_columns = tuple(column for column in required_edge_columns if column not in edge_transport)
        if missing_edge_columns:
            msg = f"Graph-result row is missing required edge column: {missing_edge_columns!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        edge_row = {key.removeprefix(edge_prefix): value for key, value in edge_transport.items()}
        if str(edge_row["sys_id"]) != entity_id:
            msg = "Graph-result edge entity ID does not match edge sys_id"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        edge_type_name = edge_row.get("type_name")
        allowed_edge_type_names = {
            edge_type.__name__,
            *collect_polymorphic_type_names(edge_type),
        }
        if (edge_type_name is not None and str(edge_type_name) not in allowed_edge_type_names) or not matches_polymorphic_row(
            edge_type, edge_row
        ):
            msg = "Graph-result edge discriminator is outside the selected edge hierarchy"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        for identifier_column in (
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
        ):
            identifier_value = edge_row[identifier_column]
            if identifier_value is not None and not isinstance(identifier_value, UUID):
                msg = f"Graph-result edge {identifier_column} must be a driver-normalized UUID"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        edge_row = deserialize_json_fields(edge_type, edge_row)
        edge_model_cls, filtered_edge = dispatch_polymorphic_type(edge_type, edge_row)
        edge_results.append(edge_model_cls.model_validate(filtered_edge))

    return GraphResult(nodes=node_results, edges=edge_results)


def _declared_graph_node_types(
    nodes: Mapping[str, NodePattern],
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
) -> dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]]]:
    node_types: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]]] = {variable: node.node_type for variable, node in nodes.items()}
    for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(pattern):
        node_types.setdefault(path.source.variable, path.source.node_type)
        node_types.setdefault(path.target.variable, path.target.node_type)
    return node_types


def _binding_node_sys_id_alias(binding_name: str) -> str:
    return f"__bind_{binding_name}_sys_id"


def _binding_edge_alias(binding_name: str, field_name: str) -> str:
    return f"__bind_{binding_name}_{field_name}"


_GRAPH_EDGE_BINDING_FIELDS = (
    "sys_id",
    "graph_sys_id",
    "source_sys_id",
    "target_sys_id",
    "type_name",
    PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
)


class GraphBindingScalarKind(StrEnum):
    NONE = "none"
    BOOL = "bool"
    INT = "int"
    FLOAT = "float"
    STR = "str"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingScalarProjectionSpec:
    binding_name: str
    field_path: str
    scalar_kind: GraphBindingScalarKind


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingDepthProjectionSpec:
    binding_name: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingEdgeProjectionSpec:
    binding_name: str
    edge_type: type[GraphEdge]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingNodeProjectionSpec:
    binding_name: str
    node_variable: str


type GraphBindingProjectionSpec = (
    GraphBindingScalarProjectionSpec | GraphBindingDepthProjectionSpec | GraphBindingEdgeProjectionSpec | GraphBindingNodeProjectionSpec
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingOrderSpec:
    column_name: SqlColumnName
    direction: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingNodeTypeSpec:
    variable: str
    node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GraphBindingMaterializationSpec:
    node_types: tuple[GraphBindingNodeTypeSpec, ...]
    projections: tuple[GraphBindingProjectionSpec, ...]
    order_by: tuple[GraphBindingOrderSpec, ...]


def _graph_binding_materialization_spec(
    *,
    nodes: Mapping[str, NodePattern],
    pattern: GraphQueryPattern,
) -> GraphBindingMaterializationSpec:
    node_types = tuple(
        GraphBindingNodeTypeSpec(variable=variable, node_type=node_type)
        for variable, node_type in sorted(
            _declared_graph_node_types(nodes, pattern).items(),
            key=lambda item: item[0],
        )
    )
    projections: list[GraphBindingProjectionSpec] = []
    declared_node_types = _declared_graph_node_types(nodes, pattern)
    declared_edge_types = {
        step.edge_binding: edge_type
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(pattern)
        for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression)
        if step.edge_binding is not None
        for edge_type in step.edge_types
    }
    for projection in pattern.binding_projections:
        if isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection):
            variable_name, field_name = projection.field_path.split(".", 1)
            node_type = declared_node_types.get(variable_name)
            annotation = (
                None if node_type is None or field_name not in node_type.model_fields else node_type.model_fields[field_name].annotation
            )
            annotation_types = {annotation, *get_args(annotation)}
            scalar_kind = next(
                (GraphBindingScalarKind(kind.__name__) for kind in (bool, int, float, str) if kind in annotation_types),
                GraphBindingScalarKind.NONE,
            )
            projections.append(
                GraphBindingScalarProjectionSpec(
                    projection.binding_name,
                    projection.field_path,
                    scalar_kind,
                ),
            )
        elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
            projections.append(
                GraphBindingDepthProjectionSpec(projection.binding_name),
            )
        elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
            edge_type = declared_edge_types.get(projection.edge_variable)
            if edge_type is None:
                msg = f"Edge binding {projection.binding_name!r} references undeclared variable {projection.edge_variable!r}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            projections.append(
                GraphBindingEdgeProjectionSpec(
                    projection.binding_name,
                    edge_type,
                ),
            )
        elif isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
            projections.append(
                GraphBindingNodeProjectionSpec(
                    projection.binding_name,
                    projection.node_variable,
                ),
            )
    recursive_path = (
        pattern.paths[0]
        if len(pattern.paths) == 1 and (pattern.paths[0].quantifier.min_hops != 1 or pattern.paths[0].quantifier.max_hops != 1)
        else None
    )
    order_by: list[GraphBindingOrderSpec] = []
    for clause in pattern.order_by:
        field_path = clause.expression
        if not isinstance(field_path, str):
            continue
        column_name = field_path
        scalar_projection = next(
            (
                projection
                for projection in projections
                if isinstance(projection, GraphBindingScalarProjectionSpec) and projection.field_path == field_path
            ),
            None,
        )
        if scalar_projection is not None:
            column_name = scalar_projection.binding_name
        elif "." in field_path:
            variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            if (
                recursive_path is not None
                and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                and field_name
                in {
                    "sys_id",
                    "graph_sys_id",
                    "source_sys_id",
                    "target_sys_id",
                    "type_name",
                }
            ):
                edge_projection = next(
                    (
                        projection
                        for projection in pattern.binding_projections
                        if isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection) and projection.edge_variable == variable_name
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                column_name = (
                    _binding_edge_alias(edge_projection.binding_name, field_name)
                    if edge_projection is not None
                    else f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                )
            elif (
                recursive_path is not None
                and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                and field_name
                not in {
                    "sys_id",
                    "graph_sys_id",
                    "source_sys_id",
                    "target_sys_id",
                    "type_name",
                }
            ):
                column_name = f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
            elif recursive_path is not None and variable_name == recursive_path.target.variable:
                column_name = get_db_column_name(
                    recursive_path.target.node_type,
                    DynamicFieldName(field_name),
                )
            elif field_name == "sys_id":
                bound_projection = next(
                    (
                        candidate
                        for candidate in pattern.binding_projections
                        if (isinstance(candidate, NodeBindingProjection) and candidate.node_variable == variable_name)
                        or (isinstance(candidate, EdgeBindingProjection) and candidate.edge_variable == variable_name)
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                if isinstance(bound_projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                    column_name = _binding_node_sys_id_alias(bound_projection.binding_name)
                elif isinstance(bound_projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                    column_name = _binding_edge_alias(bound_projection.binding_name, "sys_id")
                else:
                    column_name = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
            else:
                column_name = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
        order_by.append(GraphBindingOrderSpec(SqlColumnName(column_name), str(clause.direction)))
    return GraphBindingMaterializationSpec(
        node_types=node_types,
        projections=tuple(projections),
        order_by=tuple(order_by),
    )


def _process_graph_binding_rows(
    raw_rows: Sequence[Any],
    *,
    spec: GraphBindingMaterializationSpec,
) -> list[GraphBindingRow]:
    node_types = {node_type.variable: node_type.node_type for node_type in spec.node_types}

    def compare(left: Any, right: Any) -> int:
        left_values = dict(left)
        right_values = dict(right)
        for clause in spec.order_by:
            left_value = left_values.get(clause.column_name)
            right_value = right_values.get(clause.column_name)
            if left_value is None or right_value is None:
                if left_value is right_value:
                    continue
                return 1 if left_value is None else -1
            if left_value == right_value:
                continue
            comparison = -1 if left_value < right_value else 1
            return -comparison if clause.direction == "DESC" else comparison
        return 0

    ordered_rows = sorted(raw_rows, key=cmp_to_key(compare)) if spec.order_by else raw_rows
    binding_rows: list[GraphBindingRow] = []
    for raw_row in ordered_rows:
        row_dict = dict(raw_row)
        values: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for projection in spec.projections:
            if isinstance(projection, GraphBindingScalarProjectionSpec):
                scalar_value = row_dict.get(projection.binding_name)
                if scalar_value is not None:
                    if projection.scalar_kind is GraphBindingScalarKind.BOOL:
                        scalar_value = scalar_value if isinstance(scalar_value, bool) else str(scalar_value).lower() in {"1", "true"}
                    elif projection.scalar_kind is GraphBindingScalarKind.INT:
                        scalar_value = int(scalar_value)
                    elif projection.scalar_kind is GraphBindingScalarKind.FLOAT:
                        scalar_value = float(scalar_value)
                    elif projection.scalar_kind is GraphBindingScalarKind.STR:
                        scalar_value = str(scalar_value)
                values[projection.binding_name] = scalar_value
                continue
            if isinstance(projection, GraphBindingDepthProjectionSpec):
                values[projection.binding_name] = row_dict.get(projection.binding_name)
                continue
            if isinstance(projection, GraphBindingEdgeProjectionSpec):
                binding_name = projection.binding_name
                raw_sys_id = row_dict.get(_binding_edge_alias(binding_name, "sys_id"))
                if raw_sys_id is None:
                    values[binding_name] = None
                    continue
                edge_type = projection.edge_type
                edge_row = {
                    field_name: row_dict.get(_binding_edge_alias(binding_name, field_name)) for field_name in _GRAPH_EDGE_BINDING_FIELDS
                }
                projection_key = edge_row.pop(PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN, None)
                projected_sys_id = projected_edge_row_sys_id(
                    edge_row,
                    projection_key,
                    declared_type_name=ProjectedEdgeTypeName(edge_type.__name__),
                )
                if projected_sys_id is not None:
                    edge_row["sys_id"] = str(projected_sys_id)
                values[binding_name] = GraphEdgeBinding(
                    edge_type=edge_type,
                    sys_id=coerce_sys_id_value(edge_type, edge_row["sys_id"]),
                    graph_sys_id=(None if edge_row["graph_sys_id"] is None else coerce_sys_id_value(edge_type, edge_row["graph_sys_id"])),
                    source_sys_id=(
                        None if edge_row["source_sys_id"] is None else coerce_sys_id_value(edge_type, edge_row["source_sys_id"])
                    ),
                    target_sys_id=(
                        None if edge_row["target_sys_id"] is None else coerce_sys_id_value(edge_type, edge_row["target_sys_id"])
                    ),
                    type_name=None if edge_row["type_name"] is None else str(edge_row["type_name"]),
                )
                continue
            assert isinstance(projection, GraphBindingNodeProjectionSpec)
            binding_name = projection.binding_name
            raw_sys_id = row_dict.get(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(binding_name))
            if raw_sys_id is None:
                values[binding_name] = None
                continue
            node_type = node_types[projection.node_variable]
            values[binding_name] = GraphNodeBinding(
                node_type=node_type,
                sys_id=coerce_sys_id_value(node_type, raw_sys_id),
            )
        binding_rows.append(GraphBindingRow(values))
    return binding_rows


class SqlGrammarQueryStep[T](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[T]):
    """L0: Execute a pre-built SQL grammar and process results."""

    __slots__ = ("_cardinality", "_closed_post_op", "_grammar_builder")

    def cte_publication_contract(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

    def __init__(
        self: SqlGrammarQueryStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        grammar_builder: Callable[[], SqlRenderable],
        closed_post_op: CompiledPostOp,
        cardinality: Cardinality,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._grammar_builder = grammar_builder
        self._closed_post_op = closed_post_op
        self._cardinality = cardinality

    @property
    def level(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> Cardinality:
        return self._cardinality

    def is_read_only(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "grammar-query"})

    def tables_read(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"*"})

    def tables_written(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def internal_plan_ref_state(self: SqlGrammarQueryStep[T]) -> PlanPayloadState:
        return self.internal_plan_ref_state_excluding("_grammar_builder", "_closed_post_op")

    def compile(
        self: SqlGrammarQueryStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        grammar = self._grammar_builder()
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=self._closed_post_op,
        )


def _iter_path_expression_steps(expression: PathExpression) -> tuple[PathStep, ...]:
    return tuple(step for alternative in expression.normalized_step_alternatives() for step in alternative)


def _iter_graph_pattern_paths(graph_pattern: GraphQueryPattern) -> tuple[PathPattern, ...]:
    paths = list(graph_pattern.paths)
    for condition in graph_pattern.exists_conditions:
        paths.extend(_iter_graph_pattern_paths(condition.pattern))
    for minus_block in graph_pattern.minus_blocks:
        paths.extend(_iter_graph_pattern_paths(minus_block.pattern))
    for optional_block in graph_pattern.optional_blocks:
        paths.extend(_iter_graph_pattern_paths(optional_block.pattern))
    for union_block in graph_pattern.union_blocks:
        for branch in union_block.branches:
            paths.extend(_iter_graph_pattern_paths(branch))
    return tuple(paths)


class _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[T]):
    def cte_publication_contract(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        """Graph terminal results are runtime-owned unless a subclass opts in."""
        return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

    def __init__(
        self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _GraphExecuteConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._graph_id_ref = config.graph_id_ref
        self._compile_context = config.compile_context
        self._graph_type = config.graph_type
        self._result_node_type = config.result_node_type
        self._pattern = _copy_graph_pattern(config.pattern)
        self._nodes = deepcopy(dict(config.nodes))
        self._current_path = deepcopy(config.current_path)
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs
        self._sql_visible_after_refs = config.after_refs if config.sql_visible_after_refs is None else config.sql_visible_after_refs
        self._auth_scope_refs = config.auth_scope_refs

    @property
    def level(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> int:
        return 0

    def is_read_only(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> bool:
        return False

    def tables_read(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        table_names = {get_table_name(self._result_node_type)}
        induced = self._pattern.induced_subgraph
        if induced is not None:
            table_names.update(
                {
                    get_table_name(induced.node_type),
                    get_table_name(induced.edge_type),
                },
            )
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            table_names.update(
                {
                    get_table_name(path.source.node_type),
                    get_table_name(path.target.node_type),
                },
            )
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                table_names.update(get_table_name(edge_type) for edge_type in step.edge_types)
                table_names.update(
                    {
                        get_table_name(step.source_type),
                        get_table_name(step.target_type),
                    },
                )
        return frozenset(table_names)

    def tables_written(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self._graph_id_ref,
            site="_BaseExecuteGraphStep.dependencies",
        )
        from l2060_query_builder.query_builder import _expression_server_ref_dependencies

        predicate_dependencies = frozenset(
            dependency for condition in self._pattern.filters for dependency in _expression_server_ref_dependencies(condition.expression)
        )
        return (
            self._compile_context.dependencies()
            | graph_id_shape.dependency_refs
            | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs)
            | predicate_dependencies
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(ref_id for ref_id in self.dependencies() if not ref_id.partition(".")[0].startswith("seed_"))

    def graph_cte_namespace(self) -> SqlCteName | None:
        """Return the producer-owned namespace for internal traversal relations."""
        digest = hashlib.sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        return SqlCteName(f"graph_{digest}_")

    def _compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(
        self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T],
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[T] | None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_policy_read import compile_symbolic_policy_read

        if not self._compile_context.prefer_tip_strategy:
            return None
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_guarded_route_speculation and self._compile_context.predicted_source is not None:
            return None

        def compile_alternative(route_ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
            if route_ctx.selected_branch_policy_ref_id is None or route_ctx.branch_tip_materialized:
                return self.compile(route_ctx)
            from copy import copy

            sparse_step = copy(self)
            sparse_step._compile_context = replace(
                self._compile_context,
                prefer_tip_strategy=False,
                inherited_branch_visibility=True,
            )
            return sparse_step.compile(route_ctx)

        return compile_symbolic_policy_read(
            ctx,
            compile_alternative,
            policy_ref_id=self._compile_context.tip_materialization_ref_id,
            tip_revision_ref_id=self._compile_context.tip_revision_ref_id,
            allow_write_transaction=True,
            allow_statement_policy_dispatch=True,
        )

    def _build_graph_query_builder(
        self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T],
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        pattern: GraphQueryPattern | None = None,
        require_sparse_versioning: bool = False,
    ) -> Any:
        compile_context = (
            replace(self._compile_context, prefer_tip_strategy=False) if require_sparse_versioning else self._compile_context
        )
        graph_ctx = _build_graph_execution_ctx(
            ctx,
            graph_id_ref=self._graph_id_ref,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            compile_context=compile_context,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            permission_session_vars_from_context,
        )

        permission_session_vars = permission_session_vars_from_context(
            ctx,
            compile_context.permission_context_ref,
            compile_context.permission_context_type,
            site_name=type(self).__name__,
            result_contract="typed graph permission context",
        )
        graph_compilation_ctx = ctx if permission_session_vars is None else replace(ctx, permission_session_vars=permission_session_vars)
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import ServerRefs

        if graph_ctx.branch_anchor is not None:
            graph_compilation_ctx = replace(
                graph_compilation_ctx,
                branch_id=graph_ctx.branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str(),
                lazy_branch=ServerRefs.scalar(graph_ctx.branch_anchor),
            )
        if graph_ctx.revision_id is not None:
            graph_compilation_ctx = replace(
                graph_compilation_ctx,
                revision_id=graph_ctx.revision_id.unwrap_to_str(),
                lazy_revision=ServerRefs.scalar(graph_ctx.revision_id),
            )
        return _build_query_builder(
            ctx=graph_compilation_ctx,
            graph_ctx=graph_ctx,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            result_node_type=self._result_node_type,
            pattern=self._pattern if pattern is None else pattern,
            nodes=self._nodes,
            current_path=self._current_path,
            cte_namespace=self.graph_cte_namespace(),
        )

    def _collect_auxiliary_ctes(
        self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T],
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> list[tuple[str, Any]] | None:
        """Gather published auxiliary CTEs that the terminal's SQL must include.

        When a prerequisite step (e.g. ``ResolveBranchForRevisionStep``)
        executes in a separate batch group, the executor republishes its
        result as a :class:`CteReference` with an ``auxiliary_query``. The
        graph terminal references that CTE symbolically through
        :func:`lower_scalar_server_ref`, so the rendered SQL must prepend the
        auxiliary query inside its own WITH clause for the reference to
        resolve.
        """
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import (
            collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes,
        )

        collected = list(
            collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or [],
        )
        graph_ctx = _build_graph_execution_ctx(
            ctx,
            graph_id_ref=self._graph_id_ref,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            compile_context=self._compile_context,
        )
        collected.extend(
            _working_set_graph_ctes(
                ctx,
                graph_ctx,
                result_node_type=self._result_node_type,
                pattern=self._pattern,
            ),
        )
        seen = {name for name, _query in collected}
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None:
            for binding in ctx.cte_refs.values():
                if binding.auxiliary_query is not None and binding.ref_id not in seen and str(binding.ref_id).startswith("published_"):
                    seen.add(binding.ref_id)
                    collected.append((binding.ref_id, binding.auxiliary_query))
        return collected or None

    def _build_traversal_compile_plans(
        self: _BaseExecuteGraphStep[T],
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        pattern: GraphQueryPattern | None = None,
        nested_scope: GraphNestedPatternScope = GraphNestedPatternScope.INCLUDE_NESTED,
    ) -> tuple[GraphTraversalCompilePlan, ...]:
        """Build one backend-scoped traversal compile plan for each graph path."""
        from impl.common.l9700_sql_graph_query.steps.graph_traverse import (
            build_graph_traversal_compile_plan,
        )

        effective_pattern = self._pattern if pattern is None else pattern
        paths = (
            tuple(effective_pattern.paths)
            if nested_scope is GraphNestedPatternScope.TOP_LEVEL
            else _iter_graph_pattern_paths(effective_pattern)
        )
        plans = tuple(
            build_graph_traversal_compile_plan(
                ctx=ctx,
                node_type=witness.target_type,
                edge_type=witness.edge_types[0],
                direction=witness.direction,
                dependencies=tuple(self.dependencies()),
            )
            for path in paths
            for witness in (path.expression.compile_plan_witness(),)
        )
        graph_ctx = _build_graph_execution_ctx(
            ctx,
            graph_id_ref=self._graph_id_ref,
            graph_type=self._graph_type,
            compile_context=self._compile_context,
        )
        from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import GraphSqlVersioningMode

        if graph_ctx.versioning_mode is not GraphSqlVersioningMode.TIP:
            return plans
        # Forked TIP rows can retain endpoint candidate keys from their source branch.
        # Exact endpoint IDs remain authoritative after branch materialization.
        return tuple(
            replace(
                plan,
                source_endpoint=replace(plan.source_endpoint, candidate_kind="none", candidate_column=None),
                target_endpoint=replace(plan.target_endpoint, candidate_kind="none", candidate_column=None),
            )
            for plan in plans
        )


def _graph_grammar_requires_recursive_with(grammar: SqlRenderable) -> bool:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.graph.graph_select_cte import SqlGraphCteQuery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.graph.graph_sparse import (
        SqlSparseGraphTraversalQuery,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlWith

    if isinstance(grammar, SqlGraphCteQuery):
        return grammar.requires_recursive_with()
    if isinstance(grammar, SqlWith):
        return grammar.recursive
    return isinstance(grammar, SqlSparseGraphTraversalQuery)
