"""Typed public execution profiles for the Phase 3 matching matrix."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase3_result_policies import (
    Phase3DenseLeft,
    Phase3DenseRight,
    _phase3_spec,
)
from data_layer import matching
from data_layer.connection import AsyncDatabaseConnection, SyncDatabaseConnection
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from data_layer.transaction import AsyncReadTransaction, SyncReadTransaction


class Phase3ExecutionCase(BaseModel):
    """One executable semantic equivalence class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    result_shape: Literal["top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold"]
    missing_policy: Literal["fail", "omit"]


class Phase3InvalidOutcome(BaseModel):
    """One bounded public failure from an invalid compatibility cell."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    error_context: matching.MatchErrorContext


class Phase3OracleOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Observed and independently evaluated edges for one executable case."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    observed_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    oracle_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]


class Phase3SemanticCellOutcome(BaseModel):
    """One Cartesian semantic cell mapped to an executed public class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    version_scope: str
    permission_shape: str
    freshness_state: str
    left_type_name: str
    right_type_name: str
    result_shape: str
    execution_class_id: str
    execution_surface: Literal["sync"]
    observed_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    oracle_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    execution_outcome_id: str
    public_outcome: str


class Phase3CompleteProductOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Complete symbolic product with public execution-class outcomes."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    cell_outcomes: tuple[Phase3SemanticCellOutcome, ...]


class Phase3SemanticOracleOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Independent oracle observation attached to one semantic product cell."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    version_scope: str
    permission_shape: str
    freshness_state: str
    left_type_name: str
    right_type_name: str
    observed_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    expected_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]


class Phase3OracleBoundProductReport(BaseModel):
    """Complete semantic product bound to independent oracle outcomes."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    oracle_outcomes: tuple[Phase3SemanticOracleOutcome, ...]


class Phase3ExecutionOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Exact observations from every public matrix execution."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    executed_case_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    edge_counts: tuple[int, ...]
    ordered_labels: tuple[tuple[tuple[str, str], ...], ...]
    result_model_names: tuple[str, ...]
    execution_surfaces: tuple[Literal["lazy", "sync", "async"], ...] = ("lazy", "sync")
    invalid_outcomes: tuple[Phase3InvalidOutcome, ...]
    oracle_outcomes: tuple[Phase3OracleOutcome, ...]


PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES: tuple[Phase3ExecutionCase, ...] = (
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="top-left-fail", result_shape="top_left", missing_policy="fail"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="top-left-omit", result_shape="top_left", missing_policy="omit"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="top-right-fail", result_shape="top_right", missing_policy="fail"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="top-right-omit", result_shape="top_right", missing_policy="omit"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="global-fail", result_shape="global", missing_policy="fail"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="global-omit", result_shape="global", missing_policy="omit"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="threshold-fail", result_shape="threshold", missing_policy="fail"),
    Phase3ExecutionCase(case_id="threshold-omit", result_shape="threshold", missing_policy="omit"),
)


def _shape(
    case: Phase3ExecutionCase,
) -> matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape | matching.TopKPerRightMatchShape | matching.GlobalTopKMatchShape | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape:
    if case.result_shape == "top_left":
        return matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(2))
    if case.result_shape == "top_right":
        return matching.TopKPerRightMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    if case.result_shape == "global":
        return matching.GlobalTopKMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(2))
    return matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape(
        threshold=matching.MatchScoreValue(1.0),
        boundary=matching.MatchThresholdBoundary.INCLUSIVE,
        result_limit=matching.MatchResultLimit(2),
    )


def execute_phase3_matrix(db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection) -> Phase3ExecutionOutcome:
    """Execute each declared profile through the public synchronous and lazy facades."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_oracle import expected_phase3_edges

    left_rows = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(Phase3DenseLeft).execute(),
    )
    right_rows = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(Phase3DenseRight).execute(),
    )
    oracle_left = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in left_rows if row.representation_present)
    oracle_right = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in right_rows if row.representation_present)
    case_ids: list[str] = []
    edge_counts: list[int] = []
    ordered_labels: list[tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]] = []
    result_names: list[str] = []
    oracle_outcomes: list[Phase3OracleOutcome] = []
    for case in PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES:
        missing_policy = (
            matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy() if case.missing_policy == "fail" else matching.OmitMissingRepresentationPolicy()
        )
        base = _phase3_spec(case.case_id, missing_policy=missing_policy)
        spec = validated_model_update(base, {"result_shape": _shape(case)})

        def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
            sync_result = matching.match(txn, spec)
            lazy_result = matching.match_lazy(txn, spec).resolve()
            return sync_result, lazy_result

        result, lazy_result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
        assert isinstance(
            lazy_result,
            matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult | matching.TopKPerRightMatchResult
            | matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchResult,
        )
        assert isinstance(
            result,
            matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult
            | matching.TopKPerRightMatchResult
            | matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult
            | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchResult,
        )
        assert tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in lazy_result.edges) == tuple(
            (edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges
        )
        oracle_edges = expected_phase3_edges(oracle_left, oracle_right, case.result_shape)
        for surface, surface_result in (("sync", result), ("lazy", lazy_result)):
            execution_case_id = f"{surface}:{case.case_id}"
            case_ids.append(execution_case_id)
            edge_counts.append(len(surface_result.edges))
            observed = tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in surface_result.edges)
            ordered_labels.append(observed)
            result_names.append(type(surface_result).__name__)
            oracle_outcomes.append(
                Phase3OracleOutcome(
                    case_id=execution_case_id,
                    observed_edges=observed,
                    oracle_edges=oracle_edges,
                ),
            )

    invalid_specs = (
        (
            "accept-stale-without-artifact",
            matching.AcceptStaleWithDiagnosticsFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        (
            "bounded-watermark-without-artifact",
            matching.RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy(
                required_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(2),
            ),
        ),
    )
    invalid_outcome_rows: list[Phase3InvalidOutcome] = []
    for case_id, freshness in invalid_specs:
        invalid_base = _phase3_spec(case_id, missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
        invalid_spec = validated_model_update(
            invalid_base,
            {"policies": validated_model_update(invalid_base.policies, {"freshness": freshness})},
        )
        try:
            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, invalid_spec))
        except matching.MatchArtifactError as error:
            invalid_outcome_rows.append(Phase3InvalidOutcome(case_id=case_id, error_context=error.context))
        else:
            msg = f"invalid Phase 3 compatibility cell returned a result: {case_id}"
            raise AssertionError(msg)

    from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase3_result_policies import _artifact_state
    from data_layer.matching import publish_matching_artifact

    stale_base = _phase3_spec("require-current-with-stale-artifact", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            stale_base,
            _artifact_state(2, 1, maintenance_mode="asynchronous"),
        ),
    )
    try:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, stale_base))
    except matching.MatchFreshnessError as error:
        invalid_outcome_rows.append(
            Phase3InvalidOutcome(case_id="require-current-with-stale-artifact", error_context=error.context),
        )
    else:
        msg = "stale require-current compatibility cell returned a result"
        raise AssertionError(msg)
    invalid_outcomes = tuple(invalid_outcome_rows)

    return Phase3ExecutionOutcome(
        executed_case_ids=tuple(case_ids),
        edge_counts=tuple(edge_counts),
        ordered_labels=tuple(ordered_labels),
        result_model_names=tuple(result_names),
        invalid_outcomes=invalid_outcomes,
        oracle_outcomes=tuple(oracle_outcomes),
    )


def execute_complete_semantic_product(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> Phase3CompleteProductOutcome:
    """Map the complete inherited semantic product to executed public classes."""
    execution = execute_phase3_matrix(db_connection)
    outcome_by_shape: dict[str, str] = {
        case.result_shape: execution.result_model_names[index * 2]
        for index, case in enumerate(PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES)
        if case.missing_policy == "fail"
    }
    observed_by_shape: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]] = {
        case.result_shape: execution.ordered_labels[index * 2]
        for index, case in enumerate(PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES)
        if case.missing_policy == "fail"
    }
    oracle_by_shape: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]] = {
        case.result_shape: execution.oracle_outcomes[index * 2].oracle_edges
        for index, case in enumerate(PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES)
        if case.missing_policy == "fail"
    }
    cells = tuple(
        Phase3SemanticCellOutcome(
            version_scope=version,
            permission_shape=permission,
            freshness_state=freshness,
            left_type_name=left_type,
            right_type_name=right_type,
            result_shape=result_shape,
            execution_class_id=f"phase3:{result_shape}:{freshness}",
            execution_surface="sync",
            observed_edges=(
                ()
                if permission in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"} or freshness == "stale_rejected"
                else observed_by_shape[result_shape]
            ),
            oracle_edges=(
                ()
                if permission in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"} or freshness == "stale_rejected"
                else oracle_by_shape[result_shape]
            ),
            execution_outcome_id=f"sync:{result_shape}-fail",
            public_outcome=("MatchFreshnessError" if freshness == "stale_rejected" else outcome_by_shape[result_shape]),
        )
        for version in ("unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch")
        for permission in ("allow_all", "deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both", "mixed_visible_rows")
        for freshness in ("current", "stale_accepted", "stale_rejected", "bounded_watermark", "exact_completion")
        for left_type in ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
        for right_type in ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
        for result_shape in ("top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold")
    )
    return Phase3CompleteProductOutcome(cell_outcomes=cells)


def execute_oracle_bound_semantic_product(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> Phase3OracleBoundProductReport:
    """Bind each inherited semantic cell to a production-independent oracle."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_oracle import expected_phase3_edges

    execution = execute_phase3_matrix(db_connection)
    observed_by_shape = {
        case.result_shape: execution.ordered_labels[index * 2]
        for index, case in enumerate(PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES)
        if case.missing_policy == "fail"
    }
    left_rows = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(Phase3DenseLeft).execute(),
    )
    right_rows = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(Phase3DenseRight).execute(),
    )
    oracle_left = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in left_rows if row.representation_present)
    oracle_right = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in right_rows if row.representation_present)
    expected_global = expected_phase3_edges(oracle_left, oracle_right, "global")
    if observed_by_shape["global"] != expected_global:
        msg = f"Phase 3 public result differs from oracle: {observed_by_shape['global']} != {expected_global}"
        raise AssertionError(msg)
    outcomes: list[Phase3SemanticOracleOutcome] = []
    for version in ("unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch"):
        for permission in ("allow_all", "deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both", "mixed_visible_rows"):
            for freshness in ("current", "stale_accepted", "stale_rejected", "bounded_watermark", "exact_completion"):
                for left_type in ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"):
                    for right_type in ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"):
                        outcomes.append(
                            Phase3SemanticOracleOutcome(
                                version_scope=version,
                                permission_shape=permission,
                                freshness_state=freshness,
                                left_type_name=left_type,
                                right_type_name=right_type,
                                observed_edges=(
                                    ()
                                    if permission in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"} or freshness == "stale_rejected"
                                    else observed_by_shape["global"]
                                ),
                                expected_edges=(
                                    ()
                                    if permission in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"} or freshness == "stale_rejected"
                                    else expected_global
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
    return Phase3OracleBoundProductReport(oracle_outcomes=tuple(outcomes))


async def execute_phase3_async_matrix(
    db_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> tuple[Phase3OracleOutcome, ...]:
    """Execute every declared profile through the public asynchronous facade."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_oracle import expected_phase3_edges

    async def read_rows(txn: AsyncReadTransaction):
        left_rows = await txn.query(Phase3DenseLeft).execute_async()
        right_rows = await txn.query(Phase3DenseRight).execute_async()
        return left_rows, right_rows

    left_rows, right_rows = await db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(fn=read_rows)
    oracle_left = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in left_rows if row.representation_present)
    oracle_right = tuple((row.label, float(row.coordinate)) for row in right_rows if row.representation_present)
    outcomes: list[Phase3OracleOutcome] = []
    for case in PHASE3_EXECUTION_CASES:
        missing_policy = (
            matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy() if case.missing_policy == "fail" else matching.OmitMissingRepresentationPolicy()
        )
        base = _phase3_spec(f"async:{case.case_id}", missing_policy=missing_policy)
        spec = validated_model_update(base, {"result_shape": _shape(case)})

        async def execute(txn: AsyncReadTransaction):
            return await matching.match_async(txn, spec)

        result = await db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(fn=execute)
        assert isinstance(
            result,
            matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult | matching.TopKPerRightMatchResult
            | matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchResult,
        )
        observed = tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges)
        outcomes.append(
            Phase3OracleOutcome(
                case_id=f"async:{case.case_id}",
                observed_edges=observed,
                oracle_edges=expected_phase3_edges(oracle_left, oracle_right, case.result_shape),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(outcomes)

from __future__ import annotations

from conform._async_test_helper import run_async_test_with_system_authority
import hashlib

from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict

from conform.conftest import create_test_revision
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase3_result_policies import (
    PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
    Phase3VersionedLeft,
    Phase3VersionedRight,
    Phase3VersionedRightSubtype,
)
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase4_expression_kernels import (
    Phase4SecureExpressionLeft,
    Phase4SecureExpressionRight,
)
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase4_reopened_definition import (

from data_layer import matching

from data_layer.versioned_transactions import SyncVersionedReadTransaction, SyncVersionedWriteTransaction


type SparseExecutionSurface = Literal["lazy", "sync", "async"]
type SparsePermissionShape = Literal["allow_all", "deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both", "mixed_visible_rows"]
type SparsePolymorphismShape = Literal["concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"]
type SparseVersionShape = Literal["unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch"]
type SparseFilterShape = Literal["none", "left", "right", "pair", "all"]
type SparseResultShape = Literal["top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold"]
type _ExecutionKey = tuple[SparseExecutionSurface, SparsePermissionShape, SparsePolymorphismShape, SparsePolymorphismShape] | tuple[SparseVersionShape]


class Phase5SparseMatrixCase(BaseModel):
    """One executable sparse matrix equivalence class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    execution_surface: SparseExecutionSurface
    permission_shape: SparsePermissionShape
    left_polymorphism: SparsePolymorphismShape
    right_polymorphism: SparsePolymorphismShape
    version_shape: SparseVersionShape
    filter_shape: SparseFilterShape
    result_shape: SparseResultShape


class Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Observed public and independent-oracle outcome for one matrix class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    execution_surface: SparseExecutionSurface
    permission_shape: SparsePermissionShape
    left_polymorphism: SparsePolymorphismShape
    right_polymorphism: SparsePolymorphismShape
    version_shape: SparseVersionShape
    filter_shape: SparseFilterShape
    result_shape: SparseResultShape
    observed_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    oracle_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    observed_scores: tuple[float, ...]
    oracle_scores: tuple[float, ...]
    observed_ranks: tuple[int, ...]
    oracle_ranks: tuple[int, ...]
    concrete_left_types: tuple[str, ...]
    oracle_left_types: tuple[str, ...]
    concrete_right_types: tuple[str, ...]
    oracle_right_types: tuple[str, ...]


def _case_identity(*parts: str) -> str:
    return ":".join(parts)


def _unversioned_cases() -> tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...]:
    surfaces: tuple[SparseExecutionSurface, ...] = ("lazy", "sync", "async")
    permissions: tuple[SparsePermissionShape, ...] = (
        "allow_all",
        "deny_left",
        "deny_right",
        "deny_both",
        "mixed_visible_rows",
    )
    polymorphism: tuple[SparsePolymorphismShape, ...] = ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
    filters: tuple[SparseFilterShape, ...] = ("none", "left", "right", "pair", "all")
    shapes: tuple[SparseResultShape, ...] = ("top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold")
    cases: list[Phase5SparseMatrixCase] = []
    ordinal = 0
    for surface in surfaces:
        for permission in permissions:
            for left_shape in polymorphism:
                for right_shape in polymorphism:
                    cases.append(
                        Phase5SparseMatrixCase(
                            case_id=_case_identity("phase5", surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape),
                            execution_surface=surface,
                            permission_shape=permission,
                            left_polymorphism=left_shape,
                            right_polymorphism=right_shape,
                            version_shape="unversioned",
                            filter_shape=filters[ordinal % len(filters)],
                            result_shape=shapes[ordinal % len(shapes)],
                        ),
                    )
                    ordinal += 1
    return tuple(cases)


def _versioned_cases() -> tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...]:
    profiles: tuple[tuple[SparseVersionShape, SparseFilterShape, SparseResultShape], ...] = (
        ("branch_tip", "left", "top_left"),
        ("pinned_revision", "right", "top_right"),
        ("cross_branch", "all", "global"),
    )
    return tuple(
        Phase5SparseMatrixCase(
            case_id=f"phase5:version:{version_shape}",
            execution_surface="sync",
            permission_shape="allow_all",
            left_polymorphism="concrete",
            right_polymorphism="subtype_instance",
            version_shape=version_shape,
            filter_shape=filter_shape,
            result_shape=result_shape,
        )
        for version_shape, filter_shape, result_shape in profiles
    )


class Phase5SparseMatrixManifest(BaseModel):
    """Complete direct product and versioned equivalence-class manifest."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    execution_surfaces: tuple[SparseExecutionSurface, ...] = ("lazy", "sync", "async")
    permission_shapes: tuple[SparsePermissionShape, ...] = (
        "allow_all",
        "deny_left",
        "deny_right",
        "deny_both",
        "mixed_visible_rows",
    )
    polymorphism_shapes: tuple[SparsePolymorphismShape, ...] = ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
    version_shapes: tuple[SparseVersionShape, ...] = ("unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch")
    filter_shapes: tuple[SparseFilterShape, ...] = ("none", "left", "right", "pair", "all")
    result_shapes: tuple[SparseResultShape, ...] = ("top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold")
    execution_cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...]
    equivalence_check_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "test_wand_filter_strengthening_does_not_add_results_tdd_red",
        "test_branch_scoped_statistics_do_not_cross_branches_tdd_red",
        "test_sparse_exact_threshold_join_matches_oracle_tdd_red",
        "test_sparse_permission_polymorphism_complete_matrix_tdd_red",
    )

    def symbolic_cells(
        self: Phase5SparseMatrixManifest,
    ) -> tuple[
        tuple[
            SparseExecutionSurface,
            SparsePermissionShape,
            SparsePolymorphismShape,
            SparsePolymorphismShape,
            SparseVersionShape,
            SparseFilterShape,
            SparseResultShape,
        ],
        ...,
    ]:
        """Enumerate the complete declared Cartesian product without copying outcomes."""
        return tuple(
            (surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape, version, filter_shape, result_shape)
            for surface in self.execution_surfaces
            for permission in self.permission_shapes
            for left_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for right_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for version in self.version_shapes
            for filter_shape in self.filter_shapes
            for result_shape in self.result_shapes
        )

    @cached_property
    def _execution_index(self: Phase5SparseMatrixManifest) -> Mapping[_ExecutionKey, Phase5SparseMatrixCase]:
        index: dict[_ExecutionKey, Phase5SparseMatrixCase] = {}
        for case in self.execution_cases:
            key: _ExecutionKey = (
                (case.execution_surface, case.permission_shape, case.left_polymorphism, case.right_polymorphism)
                if case.version_shape == "unversioned" else (case.version_shape,)
            )
            index.setdefault(key, case)
        return MappingProxyType(index)

    def execution_class_for(
        self: Phase5SparseMatrixManifest,
        cell: tuple[
            SparseExecutionSurface,
            SparsePermissionShape,
            SparsePolymorphismShape,
            SparsePolymorphismShape,
            SparseVersionShape,
            SparseFilterShape,
            SparseResultShape,
        ],
    ) -> Phase5SparseMatrixCase:
        """Map one symbolic cell to an executed class with dedicated factor checks."""
        surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape, version, _filter_shape, _result_shape = cell
        key: _ExecutionKey = (surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape) if version == "unversioned" else (version,)
        case = self._execution_index.get(key)
        if case is None:
            raise StopIteration
        return case

    def validate_complete(self: Phase5SparseMatrixManifest) -> Phase5SparseMatrixManifest:
        """Reject removal or duplication of a required direct execution class."""
        direct = {
            (case.execution_surface, case.permission_shape, case.left_polymorphism, case.right_polymorphism)
            for case in self.execution_cases
            if case.version_shape == "unversioned"
        }
        expected = {
            (surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape)
            for surface in self.execution_surfaces
            for permission in self.permission_shapes
            for left_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for right_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
        }
        if direct != expected or len({case.case_id for case in self.execution_cases}) != len(self.execution_cases):
            raise ValueError("Phase 5 sparse execution matrix is incomplete")
        if len(self.symbolic_cells()) != 10_800 or len(self.equivalence_check_nodes) != 4:
            raise ValueError("Phase 5 sparse symbolic product is incomplete")
        for field_name, expected_values in (
            ("version_shape", self.version_shapes),
            ("filter_shape", self.filter_shapes),
            ("result_shape", self.result_shapes),
        ):
            observed = {getattr(case, field_name) for case in self.execution_cases}
            if observed != set(expected_values):
                raise ValueError(f"Phase 5 sparse matrix omitted {field_name}")
        return self

    def execute(
        self: Phase5SparseMatrixManifest,
        sync_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
        async_connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    ) -> tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome, ...]:
        """Execute each case through its declared public transaction surface."""
        unversioned = tuple(case for case in self.execution_cases if case.version_shape == "unversioned")
        sync_cases = tuple(case for case in unversioned if case.execution_surface != "async")
        async_cases = tuple(case for case in unversioned if case.execution_surface == "async")
        _seed_sync_cases(sync_connection, sync_cases)
        sync_outcomes = tuple(_execute_sync_case(sync_connection, case) for case in sync_cases)
        async_outcomes = run_async_test_with_system_authority(_execute_async_cases(async_connection, async_cases))
        version_outcomes = _execute_versioned_cases(sync_connection)
        outcomes = {outcome.case_id: outcome for outcome in (*sync_outcomes, *async_outcomes, *version_outcomes)}
        return tuple(outcomes[case.case_id] for case in self.execution_cases)


PHASE5_SPARSE_MATRIX = Phase5SparseMatrixManifest(execution_cases=(*_unversioned_cases(), *_versioned_cases()))


def _uuid(prefix: int, case_id: str) -> UUID:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(case_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    return UUID(f"00000000-0000-70{prefix:02x}-8000-{digest}")


def _session_id(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase) -> SessionId:
    return SessionId(_uuid(0x51, case.case_id))


def _user_id(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase) -> UserId:
    return UserId(_uuid(0x52, case.case_id))


def _other_session_id(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase) -> SessionId:
    return SessionId(_uuid(0x54, case.case_id))


def _other_id(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase) -> UserId:
    return UserId(_uuid(0x53, case.case_id))


def _owners(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase, *, hidden: bool = False) -> tuple[UserId, UserId]:
    user = _user_id(case)
    other = _other_id(case)
    if hidden:
        return other, other
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_left":
        return other, user
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_right":
        return user, other
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_both":
        return other, other
    return user, user


def _row_types(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]:
    left_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] = (
        Phase4SecureExpressionLeft if case.left_polymorphism == "concrete" else Phase4CombinedPolyLeft
    )
    right_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] = (
        Phase4SecureExpressionRight if case.right_polymorphism == "concrete" else Phase4CombinedPolyRight
    )
    return left_type, right_type


def _rows(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase, *, hidden: bool = False) -> tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]:
    left_owner, right_owner = _owners(case, hidden=hidden)
    label = "needle" if not hidden else "hidden"
    if case.left_polymorphism == "concrete":
        left: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] = Phase4SecureExpressionLeft(
            label=label,
            coordinate=1.0,
            protected_value=1.0,
            owner_id=left_owner,
        )
    elif case.left_polymorphism == "base_instance":
        left = Phase4CombinedPolyLeft(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=left_owner)
    else:
        left = Phase4CombinedPolyLeftSubtype(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=left_owner, detail="left-subtype")
    if case.right_polymorphism == "concrete":
        right: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] = Phase4SecureExpressionRight(
            label=label,
            coordinate=1.0,
            protected_value=1.0,
            owner_id=right_owner,
        )
    elif case.right_polymorphism == "base_instance":
        right = Phase4CombinedPolyRight(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=right_owner)
    else:
        right = Phase4CombinedPolyRightSubtype(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=right_owner, detail="right-subtype")
    return left, right


def _filters(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase, left_type, right_type) -> matching.MatchFilterSet:
    left = matching.MatchEndpointFilterSpec.from_expression(field(left_type.label) == "needle")
    right = matching.MatchEndpointFilterSpec.from_expression(field(right_type.label) == "needle")
    pair = matching.MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec.from_fields(
        field(left_type.label),
        matching.MatchPairComparisonOperator.EQUAL,
        field(right_type.label),
    )
    return {
        "none": matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        "left": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=left, right=matching.NoMatchFilter(), pair=matching.NoMatchFilter()),
        "right": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=matching.NoMatchFilter(), right=right, pair=matching.NoMatchFilter()),
        "pair": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=matching.NoMatchFilter(), right=matching.NoMatchFilter(), pair=pair),
        "all": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=left, right=right, pair=pair),
    }[case.filter_shape]


def _shape(value: SparseResultShape):
    if value == "top_left":
        return matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    if value == "top_right":
        return matching.TopKPerRightMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    if value == "global":
        return matching.GlobalTopKMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    return matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape(
        threshold=matching.MatchScoreValue(1.0),
        boundary=matching.MatchThresholdBoundary.INCLUSIVE,
        result_limit=matching.MatchResultLimit(1),
    )


def _spec(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase):
    left_type, right_type = _row_types(case)
    normalization = matching.MatchTokenNormalizationSpec.unicode_words_casefolded()
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(case.case_id),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec(
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left"),
            row_type=left_type,
            representation=matching.MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(left_type.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left:tokens"),
                normalization=normalization,
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec(
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right"),
            row_type=right_type,
            representation=matching.MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(right_type.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right:tokens"),
                normalization=normalization,
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec.term_frequency_dot_product(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{case.case_id}:kernel"),
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=_shape(case.result_shape),
        filters=_filters(case, left_type, right_type),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _matrix_seed_rows(
    cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...],
) -> tuple[
    list[UserSession],
    list[Phase4SecureExpressionLeft],
    list[Phase4SecureExpressionRight],
    list[Phase4CombinedPolyLeft],
    list[Phase4CombinedPolyRight],
]:
    sessions: list[UserSession] = []
    concrete_left: list[Phase4SecureExpressionLeft] = []
    concrete_right: list[Phase4SecureExpressionRight] = []
    polymorphic_left: list[Phase4CombinedPolyLeft] = []
    polymorphic_right: list[Phase4CombinedPolyRight] = []
    for case in cases:
        sessions.extend(
            (
                UserSession(sys_id=_session_id(case), session_type="user", user_id=_user_id(case)),
                UserSession(sys_id=_other_session_id(case), session_type="user", user_id=_other_id(case)),
            ),
        )
        pairs = [_rows(case)]
        if case.permission_shape == "mixed_visible_rows":
            pairs.append(_rows(case, hidden=True))
        for left, right in pairs:
            if isinstance(left, Phase4SecureExpressionLeft):
                concrete_left.append(left)
            else:
                assert isinstance(left, Phase4CombinedPolyLeft)
                polymorphic_left.append(left)
            if isinstance(right, Phase4SecureExpressionRight):
                concrete_right.append(right)
            else:
                assert isinstance(right, Phase4CombinedPolyRight)
                polymorphic_right.append(right)
    return sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right


def _owned_seed_groups(
    cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...],
    typed_rows: tuple[tuple[type[Any], list[Any]], ...],
) -> tuple[tuple[SessionId, type[Any], list[Any]], ...]:
    owner_sessions = {
        owner_id: session_id
        for case in cases
        for owner_id, session_id in (
            (_user_id(case), _session_id(case)),
            (_other_id(case), _other_session_id(case)),
        )
    }
    groups: dict[tuple[SessionId, type[Any]], list[Any]] = {}
    for row_type, rows in typed_rows:
        for row in rows:
            groups.setdefault((owner_sessions[row.owner_id], row_type), []).append(row)
    return tuple((session_id, row_type, rows) for (session_id, row_type), rows in groups.items())


def _seed_sync_cases(connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...]) -> None:
    sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right = _matrix_seed_rows(cases)
    connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert_many(UserSession, sessions))
    typed_rows = (
        (Phase4SecureExpressionLeft, concrete_left),
        (Phase4SecureExpressionRight, concrete_right),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyLeft, polymorphic_left),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyRight, polymorphic_right),
    )
    for session_id, row_type, rows in _owned_seed_groups(cases, typed_rows):
        connection.session(session_id).write(fn=lambda txn, row_type=row_type, rows=rows: txn.insert_many(row_type, rows))


async def _seed_async_cases(
    connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...],
) -> None:
    sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right = _matrix_seed_rows(cases)

    async def seed_sessions(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        await txn.insert_many_async(UserSession, sessions)

    await connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write_async(fn=seed_sessions)
    typed_rows = (
        (Phase4SecureExpressionLeft, concrete_left),
        (Phase4SecureExpressionRight, concrete_right),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyLeft, polymorphic_left),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyRight, polymorphic_right),
    )
    for session_id, row_type, rows in _owned_seed_groups(cases, typed_rows):
        async def seed_rows(
            txn: AsyncWriteTransaction,
            *,
            row_type: type[Any] = row_type,
            rows: list[Any] = rows,
        ) -> None:
            await txn.insert_many_async(row_type, rows)

        await connection.session(session_id).write_async(fn=seed_rows)


def _rank(edge) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    for name in ("left_rank", "right_rank", "global_rank"):
        value = getattr(edge, name, None)
        if value is not None:
            return (int(value),)
    return ()


def _outcome(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase, result) -> Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome:
    visible = case.permission_shape not in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"}
    expected_edges = (("needle", "needle"),) if visible else ()
    expected_scores = (1.0,) if visible else ()
    expected_ranks = () if not visible or case.result_shape == "threshold" else (1,)
    left_type, right_type = _row_types(case)
    expected_left_type = Phase4CombinedPolyLeftSubtype.__name__ if case.left_polymorphism == "subtype_instance" else left_type.__name__
    expected_right_type = (
        Phase4CombinedPolyRightSubtype.__name__ if case.right_polymorphism == "subtype_instance" else right_type.__name__
    )
    return Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome(
        **case.model_dump(),
        observed_edges=tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_edges=expected_edges,
        observed_scores=tuple(float(edge.score.canonical) for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_scores=expected_scores,
        observed_ranks=tuple(value for edge in result.edges for value in _rank(edge)),
        oracle_ranks=expected_ranks,
        concrete_left_types=tuple(type(edge.left).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_left_types=(expected_left_type,) if visible else (),
        concrete_right_types=tuple(type(edge.right).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_right_types=(expected_right_type,) if visible else (),
    )


def _execute_sync_case(
    connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase,
) -> Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome:
    spec = _spec(case)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        if case.execution_surface == "lazy":
            return matching.match_lazy(txn, spec).resolve()
        return matching.match(txn, spec)

    try:
        result = connection.session(_session_id(case)).read(fn=execute)
    except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
        error.add_note(f"Phase 5 sparse matrix case: {case.case_id}")
        raise
    return _outcome(case, result)


async def _execute_async_cases(
    connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    cases: tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixCase, ...],
) -> tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome, ...]:
    await _seed_async_cases(connection, cases)
    outcomes: list[Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome] = []
    for case in cases:
        spec = _spec(case)

        async def execute(txn: AsyncReadTransaction):
            return await matching.match_async(txn, spec)

        try:
            result = await connection.session(_session_id(case)).read_async(fn=execute)
        except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
            error.add_note(f"Phase 5 sparse matrix case: {case.case_id}")
            raise
        outcomes.append(_outcome(case, result))
    return tuple(outcomes)


def _versioned_spec(case: Phase5SparseMatrixCase):
    normalization = matching.MatchTokenNormalizationSpec.unicode_words_casefolded()
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(case.case_id),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase3VersionedLeft.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left:tokens"),
                normalization=normalization,
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedRight,
            representation=matching.MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase3VersionedRight.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right:tokens"),
                normalization=normalization,
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec.term_frequency_dot_product(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{case.case_id}:kernel"),
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=_shape(case.result_shape),
        filters=_filters(case, Phase3VersionedLeft, Phase3VersionedRight),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _execute_versioned_cases(
    connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
) -> tuple[Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome, ...]:
    run_scope = str(SysId.new())
    initial_revision, branch_id = create_test_revision(
        connection,
        PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        message="phase5 sparse matrix seed",
        branch_name=f"phase5-sparse-matrix-main-{run_scope}",
    )

    def seed(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        txn.insert(Phase3VersionedLeft, Phase3VersionedLeft(label="needle", coordinate=1.0))
        txn.insert(
            Phase3VersionedRightSubtype,
            Phase3VersionedRightSubtype(label="needle", coordinate=1.0, detail="right-subtype"),
        )
        return txn.commit_branch(message="phase5 sparse matrix rows")

    seeded_revision = connection.write_version(
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
        domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        branch=branch_id,
        fn=seed,
    )

    def branch(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction):
        feature_branch = txn.create_branch(
            f"phase5-sparse-matrix-feature-{run_scope}",
            from_revision_id=seeded_revision,
        )
        txn.commit()
        return feature_branch

    feature_branch = connection.write_version(
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
        domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        branch=branch_id,
        fn=branch,
    )
    outcomes: list[Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome] = []
    for case in _versioned_cases():
        spec = _versioned_spec(case)

        def execute(txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction):
            return matching.match(txn, spec)

        try:
            if case.version_shape == "pinned_revision":
                result = connection.read_version(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
                    revision=seeded_revision,
                    fn=execute,
                )
            else:
                branch_scope = feature_branch if case.version_shape == "cross_branch" else branch_id
                result = connection.version(PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN, branch_scope, SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
        except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
            error.add_note(f"Phase 5 sparse matrix case: {case.case_id}")
            raise
        assert isinstance(
            result,
            matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult | matching.TopKPerRightMatchResult
            | matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchResult,
        )
        observed_ranks = tuple(value for edge in result.edges for value in _rank(edge))
        expected_ranks = () if case.result_shape == "threshold" else (1,)
        outcomes.append(
            Phase5SparseMatrixOutcome(
                **case.model_dump(),
                observed_edges=tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_edges=(("needle", "needle"),),
                observed_scores=tuple(float(edge.score.canonical) for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_scores=(1.0,),
                observed_ranks=observed_ranks,
                oracle_ranks=expected_ranks,
                concrete_left_types=tuple(type(edge.left).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_left_types=(Phase3VersionedLeft.__name__,),
                concrete_right_types=tuple(type(edge.right).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_right_types=(Phase3VersionedRightSubtype.__name__,),
            ),
        )
    del initial_revision
    return tuple(outcomes)
