type StringExecutionSurface = Literal["lazy", "sync", "async"]
type StringPermissionShape = Literal["allow_all", "deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both", "mixed_visible_rows"]
type StringPolymorphismShape = Literal["concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"]
type StringVersionShape = Literal["unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch"]
type StringFilterShape = Literal["none", "left", "right", "pair", "all"]
type StringResultShape = Literal["top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold"]
type StringNormalizationShape = Literal["nfc_casefold", "nfc_preserve", "nfkc_casefold"]
type StringKernelShape = Literal["substring", "edit_distance"]
type StringInputShape = Literal["overlapping", "empty_pattern", "repeated_gram", "threshold_boundary"]
type _ExecutionKey = (
    tuple[StringExecutionSurface, StringPermissionShape, StringPolymorphismShape, StringPolymorphismShape] | tuple[StringVersionShape]
)


class Phase6StringMatrixCase(BaseModel):
    """One executable string matrix equivalence class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    execution_surface: StringExecutionSurface
    permission_shape: StringPermissionShape
    left_polymorphism: StringPolymorphismShape
    right_polymorphism: StringPolymorphismShape
    version_shape: StringVersionShape
    filter_shape: StringFilterShape
    result_shape: StringResultShape


class Phase6StringMatrixOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Observed public and independent-oracle outcome for one matrix class."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    case_id: str
    execution_surface: StringExecutionSurface
    permission_shape: StringPermissionShape
    left_polymorphism: StringPolymorphismShape
    right_polymorphism: StringPolymorphismShape
    version_shape: StringVersionShape
    filter_shape: StringFilterShape
    result_shape: StringResultShape
    observed_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    oracle_edges: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
    observed_scores: tuple[float, ...]
    oracle_scores: tuple[float, ...]
    observed_ranks: tuple[int, ...]
    oracle_ranks: tuple[int, ...]
    concrete_left_types: tuple[str, ...]
    oracle_left_types: tuple[str, ...]
    concrete_right_types: tuple[str, ...]
    oracle_right_types: tuple[str, ...]


def _case_identity(*parts: str) -> str:
    return ":".join(parts)


def _unversioned_cases() -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...]:
    surfaces: tuple[StringExecutionSurface, ...] = ("lazy", "sync", "async")
    permissions: tuple[StringPermissionShape, ...] = (
        "allow_all",
        "deny_left",
        "deny_right",
        "deny_both",
        "mixed_visible_rows",
    )
    polymorphism: tuple[StringPolymorphismShape, ...] = ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
    filters: tuple[StringFilterShape, ...] = ("none", "left", "right", "pair", "all")
    shapes: tuple[StringResultShape, ...] = ("top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold")
    cases: list[Phase6StringMatrixCase] = []
    ordinal = 0
    for surface in surfaces:
        for permission in permissions:
            for left_shape in polymorphism:
                for right_shape in polymorphism:
                    cases.append(
                        Phase6StringMatrixCase(
                            case_id=_case_identity("phase6", surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape),
                            execution_surface=surface,
                            permission_shape=permission,
                            left_polymorphism=left_shape,
                            right_polymorphism=right_shape,
                            version_shape="unversioned",
                            filter_shape=filters[ordinal % len(filters)],
                            result_shape=shapes[ordinal % len(shapes)],
                        ),
                    )
                    ordinal += 1
    return tuple(cases)


def _versioned_cases() -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...]:
    profiles: tuple[tuple[StringVersionShape, StringFilterShape, StringResultShape], ...] = (
        ("branch_tip", "left", "top_left"),
        ("pinned_revision", "right", "top_right"),
        ("cross_branch", "all", "global"),
    )
    return tuple(
        Phase6StringMatrixCase(
            case_id=f"phase6:version:{version_shape}",
            execution_surface="sync",
            permission_shape="allow_all",
            left_polymorphism="concrete",
            right_polymorphism="subtype_instance",
            version_shape=version_shape,
            filter_shape=filter_shape,
            result_shape=result_shape,
        )
        for version_shape, filter_shape, result_shape in profiles
    )


class Phase6StringMatrixManifest(BaseModel):
    """Complete direct product and versioned equivalence-class manifest."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    execution_surfaces: tuple[StringExecutionSurface, ...] = ("lazy", "sync", "async")
    permission_shapes: tuple[StringPermissionShape, ...] = (
        "allow_all",
        "deny_left",
        "deny_right",
        "deny_both",
        "mixed_visible_rows",
    )
    polymorphism_shapes: tuple[StringPolymorphismShape, ...] = ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance")
    version_shapes: tuple[StringVersionShape, ...] = ("unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch")
    filter_shapes: tuple[StringFilterShape, ...] = ("none", "left", "right", "pair", "all")
    result_shapes: tuple[StringResultShape, ...] = ("top_left", "top_right", "global", "threshold")
    normalization_shapes: tuple[StringNormalizationShape, ...] = ("nfc_casefold", "nfc_preserve", "nfkc_casefold")
    kernel_shapes: tuple[StringKernelShape, ...] = ("substring", "edit_distance")
    input_shapes: tuple[StringInputShape, ...] = ("overlapping", "empty_pattern", "repeated_gram", "threshold_boundary")
    execution_cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...]
    equivalence_check_nodes: tuple[str, ...] = (
        "test_unicode_normalization_profile_changes_artifact_tdd_red",
        "test_substring_empty_pattern_policy_is_explicit_tdd_red",
        "test_public_exact_substring_match_reports_overlapping_pairs_tdd_red",
        "test_repeated_qgrams_preserve_declared_multiplicity_tdd_red",
        "test_exact_levenshtein_matches_reference_matrix_tdd_red",
        "test_banded_edit_distance_matches_exact_within_threshold_tdd_red",
        "test_edit_unit_distinguishes_codepoint_and_grapheme_contracts_tdd_red",
        "test_aho_positions_use_declared_coordinate_space_tdd_red",
        "test_string_sqlite_postgres_mariadb_parity_tdd_red",
        "test_string_permission_polymorphism_complete_matrix_tdd_red",
    )

    def symbolic_cells(
        self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest,
    ) -> tuple[
        tuple[
            StringExecutionSurface,
            StringPermissionShape,
            StringPolymorphismShape,
            StringPolymorphismShape,
            StringVersionShape,
            StringFilterShape,
            StringResultShape,
            StringNormalizationShape,
            StringKernelShape,
            StringInputShape,
        ],
        ...,
    ]:
        """Enumerate the complete declared Cartesian product without copying outcomes."""
        return tuple(
            (
                surface,
                permission,
                left_shape,
                right_shape,
                version,
                filter_shape,
                result_shape,
                normalization,
                kernel,
                input_shape,
            )
            for surface in self.execution_surfaces
            for permission in self.permission_shapes
            for left_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for right_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for version in self.version_shapes
            for filter_shape in self.filter_shapes
            for result_shape in self.result_shapes
            for normalization in self.normalization_shapes
            for kernel in self.kernel_shapes
            for input_shape in self.input_shapes
        )

    @cached_property
    def _execution_index(self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest) -> Mapping[_ExecutionKey, Phase6StringMatrixCase]:
        index: dict[_ExecutionKey, Phase6StringMatrixCase] = {}
        for case in self.execution_cases:
            key: _ExecutionKey = (
                (case.execution_surface, case.permission_shape, case.left_polymorphism, case.right_polymorphism)
                if case.version_shape == "unversioned"
                else (case.version_shape,)
            )
            index.setdefault(key, case)
        return MappingProxyType(index)

    def execution_class_for(
        self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest,
        cell: tuple[
            StringExecutionSurface,
            StringPermissionShape,
            StringPolymorphismShape,
            StringPolymorphismShape,
            StringVersionShape,
            StringFilterShape,
            StringResultShape,
            StringNormalizationShape,
            StringKernelShape,
            StringInputShape,
        ],
    ) -> Phase6StringMatrixCase:
        """Map one symbolic cell to an executed class with dedicated factor checks."""
        surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape, version, _filter, _result, _normalization, _kernel, _input = cell
        key: _ExecutionKey = (surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape) if version == "unversioned" else (version,)
        case = self._execution_index.get(key)
        if case is None:
            raise StopIteration
        return case

    def symbolic_cell_count(self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest) -> int:
        """Return the number of declared symbolic cells."""
        return len(self.symbolic_cells())

    def validate_complete(self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest) -> Phase6StringMatrixManifest:
        """Reject removal or duplication of a required direct execution class."""
        direct = {
            (case.execution_surface, case.permission_shape, case.left_polymorphism, case.right_polymorphism)
            for case in self.execution_cases
            if case.version_shape == "unversioned"
        }
        expected = {
            (surface, permission, left_shape, right_shape)
            for surface in self.execution_surfaces
            for permission in self.permission_shapes
            for left_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
            for right_shape in self.polymorphism_shapes
        }
        if direct != expected or len({case.case_id for case in self.execution_cases}) != len(self.execution_cases):
            raise ValueError("Phase 6 string execution matrix is incomplete")
        if len(self.symbolic_cells()) != 259_200 or len(self.equivalence_check_nodes) != 10:
            raise ValueError("Phase 6 string symbolic product is incomplete")
        for field_name, expected_values in (
            ("version_shape", self.version_shapes),
            ("filter_shape", self.filter_shapes),
            ("result_shape", self.result_shapes),
        ):
            observed = {getattr(case, field_name) for case in self.execution_cases}
            if observed != set(expected_values):
                raise ValueError(f"Phase 6 string matrix omitted {field_name}")
        return self

    def execute(
        self: Phase6StringMatrixManifest,
        sync_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
        async_connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    ) -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixOutcome, ...]:
        """Execute each case through its declared public transaction surface."""
        unversioned = tuple(case for case in self.execution_cases if case.version_shape == "unversioned")
        sync_cases = tuple(case for case in unversioned if case.execution_surface != "async")
        async_cases = tuple(case for case in unversioned if case.execution_surface == "async")
        _seed_sync_cases(sync_connection, sync_cases)
        sync_outcomes = tuple(_execute_sync_case(sync_connection, case) for case in sync_cases)
        async_outcomes = run_async_test_with_system_authority(_execute_async_cases(async_connection, async_cases))
        version_outcomes = _execute_versioned_cases(sync_connection)
        outcomes = {outcome.case_id: outcome for outcome in (*sync_outcomes, *async_outcomes, *version_outcomes)}
        return tuple(outcomes[case.case_id] for case in self.execution_cases)


PHASE6_STRING_MATRIX = Phase6StringMatrixManifest(execution_cases=(*_unversioned_cases(), *_versioned_cases()))


def _uuid(prefix: int, case_id: str) -> UUID:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(case_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    return UUID(f"00000000-0000-70{prefix:02x}-8000-{digest}")


def _session_id(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase) -> SessionId:
    return SessionId(_uuid(0x51, case.case_id))


def _user_id(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase) -> UserId:
    return UserId(_uuid(0x52, case.case_id))


def _other_session_id(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase) -> SessionId:
    return SessionId(_uuid(0x54, case.case_id))


def _other_id(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase) -> UserId:
    return UserId(_uuid(0x53, case.case_id))


def _owners(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase, *, hidden: bool = False) -> tuple[UserId, UserId]:
    user = _user_id(case)
    other = _other_id(case)
    if hidden:
        return other, other
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_left":
        return other, user
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_right":
        return user, other
    if case.permission_shape == "deny_both":
        return other, other
    return user, user


def _row_types(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]:
    left_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] = (
        Phase4SecureExpressionLeft if case.left_polymorphism == "concrete" else Phase4CombinedPolyLeft
    )
    right_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] = (
        Phase4SecureExpressionRight if case.right_polymorphism == "concrete" else Phase4CombinedPolyRight
    )
    return left_type, right_type


def _rows(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase, *, hidden: bool = False) -> tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]:
    left_owner, right_owner = _owners(case, hidden=hidden)
    label = "needle" if not hidden else "hidden"
    if case.left_polymorphism == "concrete":
        left: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] = Phase4SecureExpressionLeft(
            label=label,
            coordinate=1.0,
            protected_value=1.0,
            owner_id=left_owner,
        )
    elif case.left_polymorphism == "base_instance":
        left = Phase4CombinedPolyLeft(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=left_owner)
    else:
        left = Phase4CombinedPolyLeftSubtype(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=left_owner, detail="left-subtype")
    if case.right_polymorphism == "concrete":
        right: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] = Phase4SecureExpressionRight(
            label=label,
            coordinate=1.0,
            protected_value=1.0,
            owner_id=right_owner,
        )
    elif case.right_polymorphism == "base_instance":
        right = Phase4CombinedPolyRight(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=right_owner)
    else:
        right = Phase4CombinedPolyRightSubtype(label=label, value=1.0, owner_id=right_owner, detail="right-subtype")
    return left, right


def _filters(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase, left_type, right_type) -> matching.MatchFilterSet:
    left = matching.MatchEndpointFilterSpec.from_expression(field(left_type.label) == "needle")
    right = matching.MatchEndpointFilterSpec.from_expression(field(right_type.label) == "needle")
    pair = matching.MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec.from_fields(
        field(left_type.label),
        matching.MatchPairComparisonOperator.EQUAL,
        field(right_type.label),
    )
    return {
        "none": matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        "left": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=left, right=matching.NoMatchFilter(), pair=matching.NoMatchFilter()),
        "right": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=matching.NoMatchFilter(), right=right, pair=matching.NoMatchFilter()),
        "pair": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=matching.NoMatchFilter(), right=matching.NoMatchFilter(), pair=pair),
        "all": matching.MatchFilterSet(left=left, right=right, pair=pair),
    }[case.filter_shape]


def _shape(value: StringResultShape):
    if value == "top_left":
        return matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    if value == "top_right":
        return matching.TopKPerRightMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    if value == "global":
        return matching.GlobalTopKMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1))
    return matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape(
        threshold=matching.MatchScoreValue(1.0),
        boundary=matching.MatchThresholdBoundary.INCLUSIVE,
        result_limit=matching.MatchResultLimit(1),
    )


def _spec(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase):
    left_type, right_type = _row_types(case)
    normalization = matching.MatchTextNormalizationSpec.unicode_nfc_casefolded()
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(case.case_id),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec(
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left"),
            row_type=left_type,
            representation=matching.MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(left_type.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left:text"),
                normalization=normalization,
                statistics_scope=matching.MatchTextStatisticsScope.BRANCH,
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec(
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right"),
            row_type=right_type,
            representation=matching.MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(right_type.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right:text"),
                normalization=normalization,
                statistics_scope=matching.MatchTextStatisticsScope.BRANCH,
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchSubstringKernelSpec.overlapping_occurrences(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{case.case_id}:kernel"),
            coordinate_space=matching.MatchTextCoordinateSpace.NORMALIZED,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=_shape(case.result_shape),
        filters=_filters(case, left_type, right_type),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _matrix_seed_rows(
    cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...],
) -> tuple[
    list[UserSession],
    list[Phase4SecureExpressionLeft],
    list[Phase4SecureExpressionRight],
    list[Phase4CombinedPolyLeft],
    list[Phase4CombinedPolyRight],
]:
    sessions: list[UserSession] = []
    concrete_left: list[Phase4SecureExpressionLeft] = []
    concrete_right: list[Phase4SecureExpressionRight] = []
    polymorphic_left: list[Phase4CombinedPolyLeft] = []
    polymorphic_right: list[Phase4CombinedPolyRight] = []
    for case in cases:
        sessions.extend(
            (
                UserSession(sys_id=_session_id(case), session_type="user", user_id=_user_id(case)),
                UserSession(sys_id=_other_session_id(case), session_type="user", user_id=_other_id(case)),
            ),
        )
        pairs = [_rows(case)]
        if case.permission_shape == "mixed_visible_rows":
            pairs.append(_rows(case, hidden=True))
        for left, right in pairs:
            if isinstance(left, Phase4SecureExpressionLeft):
                concrete_left.append(left)
            else:
                assert isinstance(left, Phase4CombinedPolyLeft)
                polymorphic_left.append(left)
            if isinstance(right, Phase4SecureExpressionRight):
                concrete_right.append(right)
            else:
                assert isinstance(right, Phase4CombinedPolyRight)
                polymorphic_right.append(right)
    return sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right


def _owned_seed_groups(
    cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...],
    typed_rows: tuple[tuple[type[Any], list[Any]], ...],
) -> tuple[tuple[SessionId, tuple[tuple[type[Any], tuple[Any, ...]], ...]], ...]:
    owner_sessions = {
        owner_id: session_id
        for case in cases
        for owner_id, session_id in (
            (_user_id(case), _session_id(case)),
            (_other_id(case), _other_session_id(case)),
        )
    }
    groups: dict[SessionId, dict[type[Any], list[Any]]] = {}
    for row_type, rows in typed_rows:
        for row in rows:
            groups.setdefault(owner_sessions[row.owner_id], {}).setdefault(row_type, []).append(row)
    return tuple(
        (
            session_id,
            tuple((row_type, tuple(rows)) for row_type, rows in rows_by_type.items()),
        )
        for session_id, rows_by_type in groups.items()
    )


def _seed_sync_cases(connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...]) -> None:
    sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right = _matrix_seed_rows(cases)
    connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert_many(UserSession, sessions))
    typed_rows = (
        (Phase4SecureExpressionLeft, concrete_left),
        (Phase4SecureExpressionRight, concrete_right),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyLeft, polymorphic_left),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyRight, polymorphic_right),
    )
    for session_id, owned_rows in _owned_seed_groups(cases, typed_rows):

        def seed_rows(
            txn: SyncWriteTransaction,
            *,
            owned_rows: tuple[tuple[type[Any], tuple[Any, ...]], ...] = owned_rows,
        ) -> None:
            for row_type, rows in owned_rows:
                txn.insert_many(row_type, rows)

        connection.session(session_id).write(fn=seed_rows)


async def _seed_async_cases(
    connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...],
) -> None:
    sessions, concrete_left, concrete_right, polymorphic_left, polymorphic_right = _matrix_seed_rows(cases)

    async def seed_sessions(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        await txn.insert_many_async(UserSession, sessions)

    await connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write_async(fn=seed_sessions)
    typed_rows = (
        (Phase4SecureExpressionLeft, concrete_left),
        (Phase4SecureExpressionRight, concrete_right),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyLeft, polymorphic_left),
        (Phase4CombinedPolyRight, polymorphic_right),
    )
    for session_id, owned_rows in _owned_seed_groups(cases, typed_rows):

        async def seed_rows(
            txn: AsyncWriteTransaction,
            *,
            owned_rows: tuple[tuple[type[Any], tuple[Any, ...]], ...] = owned_rows,
        ) -> None:
            for row_type, rows in owned_rows:
                await txn.insert_many_async(row_type, rows)

        await connection.session(session_id).write_async(fn=seed_rows)


def _rank(edge) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    for name in ("left_rank", "right_rank", "global_rank"):
        value = getattr(edge, name, None)
        if value is not None:
            return (int(value),)
    return ()


def _outcome(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase, result) -> Phase6StringMatrixOutcome:
    visible = case.permission_shape not in {"deny_left", "deny_right", "deny_both"}
    expected_edges = (("needle", "needle"),) if visible else ()
    expected_scores = (1.0,) if visible else ()
    expected_ranks = () if not visible or case.result_shape == "threshold" else (1,)
    left_type, right_type = _row_types(case)
    expected_left_type = Phase4CombinedPolyLeftSubtype.__name__ if case.left_polymorphism == "subtype_instance" else left_type.__name__
    expected_right_type = (
        Phase4CombinedPolyRightSubtype.__name__ if case.right_polymorphism == "subtype_instance" else right_type.__name__
    )
    return Phase6StringMatrixOutcome(
        **case.model_dump(),
        observed_edges=tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_edges=expected_edges,
        observed_scores=tuple(float(edge.score.canonical) for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_scores=expected_scores,
        observed_ranks=tuple(value for edge in result.edges for value in _rank(edge)),
        oracle_ranks=expected_ranks,
        concrete_left_types=tuple(type(edge.left).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_left_types=(expected_left_type,) if visible else (),
        concrete_right_types=tuple(type(edge.right).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
        oracle_right_types=(expected_right_type,) if visible else (),
    )


def _execute_sync_case(
    connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    case: Phase6StringMatrixCase,
) -> Phase6StringMatrixOutcome:
    spec = _spec(case)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        if case.execution_surface == "lazy":
            return matching.match_lazy(txn, spec).resolve()
        return matching.match(txn, spec)

    try:
        result = connection.session(_session_id(case)).read(fn=execute)
    except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
        error.add_note(f"Phase 6 string matrix case: {case.case_id}")
        raise
    return _outcome(case, result)


async def _execute_async_cases(
    connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    cases: tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...],
) -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixOutcome, ...]:
    await _seed_async_cases(connection, cases)
    outcomes: list[Phase6StringMatrixOutcome] = []
    for case in cases:
        spec = _spec(case)

        async def execute(txn: AsyncReadTransaction):
            return await matching.match_async(txn, spec)

        try:
            result = await connection.session(_session_id(case)).read_async(fn=execute)
        except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
            error.add_note(f"Phase 6 string matrix case: {case.case_id}")
            raise
        outcomes.append(_outcome(case, result))
    return tuple(outcomes)


def _versioned_spec(case: Phase6StringMatrixCase):
    normalization = matching.MatchTextNormalizationSpec.unicode_nfc_casefolded()
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(case.case_id),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase3VersionedLeft.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:left:text"),
                normalization=normalization,
                statistics_scope=matching.MatchTextStatisticsScope.BRANCH,
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedRight,
            representation=matching.MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase3VersionedRight.label),
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case.case_id}:right:text"),
                normalization=normalization,
                statistics_scope=matching.MatchTextStatisticsScope.BRANCH,
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchSubstringKernelSpec.overlapping_occurrences(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{case.case_id}:kernel"),
            coordinate_space=matching.MatchTextCoordinateSpace.NORMALIZED,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=_shape(case.result_shape),
        filters=_filters(case, Phase3VersionedLeft, Phase3VersionedRight),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _execute_versioned_cases(
    connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
) -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixOutcome, ...]:
    run_scope = str(SysId.new())
    initial_revision, branch_id = create_test_revision(
        connection,
        PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        message="phase6 string matrix seed",
        branch_name=f"phase6-sparse-matrix-main-{run_scope}",
    )

    def seed(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        txn.insert(Phase3VersionedLeft, Phase3VersionedLeft(label="needle", coordinate=1.0))
        txn.insert(
            Phase3VersionedRightSubtype,
            Phase3VersionedRightSubtype(label="needle", coordinate=1.0, detail="right-subtype"),
        )
        return txn.commit_branch(message="phase6 string matrix rows")

    seeded_revision = connection.write_version(
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
        domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        branch=branch_id,
        fn=seed,
    )

    def branch(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction):
        feature_branch = txn.create_branch(
            f"phase6-sparse-matrix-feature-{run_scope}",
            from_revision_id=seeded_revision,
        )
        txn.commit()
        return feature_branch

    feature_branch = connection.write_version(
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
        domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
        branch=branch_id,
        fn=branch,
    )
    outcomes: list[Phase6StringMatrixOutcome] = []
    for case in _versioned_cases():
        spec = _versioned_spec(case)

        def execute(txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction):
            return matching.match(txn, spec)

        try:
            if case.version_shape == "pinned_revision":
                result = connection.read_version(
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    domain=PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN,
                    revision=seeded_revision,
                    fn=execute,
                )
            else:
                branch_scope = feature_branch if case.version_shape == "cross_branch" else branch_id
                result = connection.version(PHASE3_MATCH_DOMAIN, branch_scope, SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
        except (matching.MatchError, ValueError) as error:
            error.add_note(f"Phase 6 string matrix case: {case.case_id}")
            raise
        assert isinstance(
            result,
            matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult
            | matching.TopKPerRightMatchResult
            | matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult
            | matching.ThresholdJoinMatchResult,
        )
        observed_ranks = tuple(value for edge in result.edges for value in _rank(edge))
        expected_ranks = () if case.result_shape == "threshold" else (1,)
        outcomes.append(
            Phase6StringMatrixOutcome(
                **case.model_dump(),
                observed_edges=tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_edges=(("needle", "needle"),),
                observed_scores=tuple(float(edge.score.canonical) for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_scores=(1.0,),
                observed_ranks=observed_ranks,
                oracle_ranks=expected_ranks,
                concrete_left_types=tuple(type(edge.left).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_left_types=(Phase3VersionedLeft.__name__,),
                concrete_right_types=tuple(type(edge.right).__name__ for edge in result.edges),
                oracle_right_types=(Phase3VersionedRightSubtype.__name__,),
            ),
        )
    del initial_revision
    return tuple(outcomes)


def phase6_string_cases() -> tuple[Phase6StringMatrixCase, ...]:
    """Return the directly executed unversioned semantic classes."""
    return _unversioned_cases()

"""Independent fixture construction and bit oracle for Phase 7 conformance."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
from typing import TypedDict

import numpy as np
from pydantic import TypeAdapter

from data_layer import matching
from data_layer.schema import field
from data_layer.transaction import AsyncWriteTransaction, LazyWriteTransaction
from data_layer.types import SysId
from data_layer.schema import DatabaseObjectRow



def _tensor(payload: bytes, shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> matching.ArtifactTensorRef:
    return matching.ArtifactTensorRef(
        digest=matching.ProjectionTensorDigest(hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()),
        shape=tuple(matching.MatchVectorDimensions(size) for size in shape),
        byte_count=matching.ProjectionTensorByteCount(len(payload)),
    )


def _build_h14_fixture_snapshot() -> tuple[
    matching.H14ProjectionArtifact,
    tuple[tuple[matching.ProjectionTensorDigest, bytes], ...],
]:
    """Build immutable deterministic tensors independently of the production fitter."""
    mean = bytes(768 * 4)
    rotation = np.eye(768, dtype="<f4").tobytes()
    threshold = bytes(768 * 4)
    generator = np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(256))
    residual = np.asarray(
        generator.standard_normal((768, 256), dtype=np.float32) / math.sqrt(768),
        dtype="<f4",
    ).tobytes()
    values: dict[str, object] = {
        "mean_tensor": _tensor(mean, (768,)),
        "rotation_tensor": _tensor(rotation, (768, 768)),
        "threshold_tensor": _tensor(threshold, (768,)),
        "residual_tensor": _tensor(residual, (768, 256)),
        "signal_order": tuple(matching.SignalDimensionIndex(index) for index in range(768)),
        "fit_scope": matching.MatchProjectionFitScope(
            tenant=matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue("tenant:phase7"),
            workspace=matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue("workspace:phase7"),
            branch=matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue("branch:phase7"),
            revision=matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue("revision:phase7"),
            permission=matching.MatchPermissionFitScope("permission:phase7"),
        ),
        "training_fingerprint": matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint("a" * 64),
        "training_identity_fingerprint": matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint("b" * 64),
        "evaluation_identity_fingerprint": matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint("d" * 64),
        "split_policy": matching.ProjectionSplitPolicyId("train-only:phase7"),
        "numeric_contract": matching.ProjectionNumericContract(
            numpy_version=matching.ProjectionImplementationVersion(np.__version__),
            svd_implementation=matching.ProjectionImplementationVersion("oracle:identity"),
        ),
    }
    artifact = matching.H14ProjectionArtifact.model_validate(
        {"artifact_id": matching.H14ProjectionArtifact.content_id(**values), **values},
    )
    return artifact, tuple({
        artifact.mean_tensor.digest: mean,
        artifact.rotation_tensor.digest: rotation,
        artifact.threshold_tensor.digest: threshold,
        artifact.residual_tensor.digest: residual,
    }.items())


_H14_ARTIFACT, _H14_BLOBS = _build_h14_fixture_snapshot()


def h14_fixture() -> tuple[
    matching.H14ProjectionArtifact,
    dict[matching.ProjectionTensorDigest, bytes],
]:
    """Return the deterministic artifact and a caller-owned mapping of immutable blobs."""
    return _H14_ARTIFACT, dict(_H14_BLOBS)


H14_ARTIFACT_ID = _H14_ARTIFACT.artifact_id


def bind_fixture_code[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
    artifact: matching.H14ProjectionArtifact,
    *,
    field_name: str = "code",
    source_field_name: str = "source_vector",
) -> None:
    """Bind one deterministic fixture code to its complete projection generation."""
    source_field = getattr(model_cls, field_name)
    representation_id = matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(
        f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}:{field_name}:h14",
    )
    matching.bind_h14_code_lazy(
        txn,
        model_cls,
        instance,
        matching.H14BinaryCodePayload(
            projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
            representation_id=representation_id,
            packed_bits=matching.PackedH14Code(getattr(instance, field_name)),
        ),
        code_field=field(source_field),
        source_field=field(getattr(model_cls, source_field_name)),
        artifact=artifact,
        tensor_blobs=h14_fixture()[1],
        source_fingerprint=matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint(
            hashlib.sha256(getattr(instance, source_field_name)).hexdigest(),
        ),
    )


async def bind_fixture_code_async[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    txn: AsyncWriteTransaction,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
    artifact: matching.H14ProjectionArtifact,
    *,
    field_name: str = "code",
    source_field_name: str = "source_vector",
) -> None:
    """Bind one deterministic fixture code through the async public surface."""
    representation_id = matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(
        f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}:{field_name}:h14",
    )
    await matching.bind_h14_code_async(
        txn,
        model_cls,
        instance,
        matching.H14BinaryCodePayload(
            projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
            representation_id=representation_id,
            packed_bits=matching.PackedH14Code(getattr(instance, field_name)),
        ),
        code_field=field(getattr(model_cls, field_name)),
        source_field=field(getattr(model_cls, source_field_name)),
        artifact=artifact,
        tensor_blobs=h14_fixture()[1],
        source_fingerprint=matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint(
            hashlib.sha256(getattr(instance, source_field_name)).hexdigest(),
        ),
    )


def reidentified_h14_artifact(
    artifact: matching.H14ProjectionArtifact,
    changes: dict[str, object],
) -> matching.H14ProjectionArtifact:
    """Apply fixture changes and derive the new content-bound generation ID."""
    values = {**artifact.model_dump(mode="python", exclude={"artifact_id"}), **changes}
    return matching.H14ProjectionArtifact.model_validate(
        {"artifact_id": matching.H14ProjectionArtifact.content_id(**values), **values},
    )


class H14FixtureValues(TypedDict):
    """Canonical source bytes and their generation-bound packed code."""

    source_vector: bytes
    code: matching.PackedH14Code


_H14_FIXTURE_VALUES_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(H14FixtureValues)


def _build_h14_fixture_value_snapshot(sign: int) -> tuple[bytes, matching.PackedH14Code]:
    """Encode one immutable zero, positive, or negative fixture value."""
    source = np.zeros(768, dtype="<f4")
    source[767] = np.float32(sign)
    artifact, blobs = h14_fixture()
    fitted = matching.H14ProjectionFitResult(
        artifact=artifact,
        mean_payload=blobs[artifact.mean_tensor.digest],
        rotation_payload=blobs[artifact.rotation_tensor.digest],
        threshold_payload=blobs[artifact.threshold_tensor.digest],
        residual_payload=blobs[artifact.residual_tensor.digest],
    )
    payload = matching.encode_h14_projection(
        source,
        fitted,
        representation_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("phase7-fixture"),
    )
    validated = _H14_FIXTURE_VALUES_ADAPTER.validate_python({
        "source_vector": source.tobytes(), "code": payload.packed_bits,
    })
    return validated["source_vector"], validated["code"]


_H14_VALUE_SNAPSHOTS = tuple(
    _build_h14_fixture_value_snapshot(sign) for sign in (-1, 0, 1)
)


def h14_fixture_values(marker: float) -> H14FixtureValues:
    """Return one caller-owned mapping over immutable canonical source and code bytes."""
    sign = 0 if marker == 0 else (-1 if math.copysign(1.0, marker) < 0 else 1)
    source, code = _H14_VALUE_SNAPSHOTS[sign + 1]
    return {"source_vector": source, "code": code}


def hamming_similarity(left: bytes, right: bytes) -> float:
    """Compute canonical H14 similarity without implementation imports."""
    assert len(left) == len(right) == 128
    distance = sum((a ^ b).bit_count() for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True))
    return 1.0 - distance / 1024

"""Phase 8 symbolic matrix and direct execution result contracts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import Literal, Mapping, Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator


PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES: Mapping[str, tuple[str, ...]] = MappingProxyType(
    {
        "backend": ("sqlite", "postgresql", "mariadb"),
        "execution_surface": ("lazy", "sync", "async"),
        "producer_family": (
            "external_model",
            "projection",
            "pagerank",
            "personalized_pagerank",
            "bipartite_svd",
            "spectral",
        ),
        "producer_role": (
            "stored_representation",
            "query_representation",
            "scored_candidate_relation",
        ),
        "fit_scope": ("inductive", "transductive"),
        "graph_seed_scope": ("none", "single_seed", "multiple_seeds"),
        "determinism": ("deterministic", "seeded"),
        "artifact_freshness": (
            "current",
            "stale_accepted",
            "stale_rejected",
            "bounded_watermark",
            "exact_completion",
        ),
        "fusion_method": ("none", "reciprocal_rank", "weighted", "learned"),
        "permission_shape": (
            "allow_all",
            "deny_left",
            "deny_right",
            "deny_both",
            "mixed_visible_rows",
        ),
        "left_polymorphism": ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"),
        "right_polymorphism": ("concrete", "base_instance", "subtype_instance"),
        "version_shape": ("unversioned", "branch_tip", "pinned_revision", "cross_branch"),
        "filter_shape": ("none", "left", "right", "pair", "all"),
        "result_shape": ("top_k_per_left", "top_k_per_right", "global_top_k", "threshold_join"),
    },
)


class Phase8FactorSelection(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """One factor value that a public execution observes."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    factor: str
    value: str

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_declared_value(self: Self) -> Self:
        allowed = PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES.get(self.factor)
        if allowed is None or self.value not in allowed:
            raise ValueError("Phase 8 observation must use one declared factor value")
        return self


class Phase8ExecutionOutcome(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """One public result with complete semantic and work observation."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    node_id: str
    outcome: Literal["result", "typed_error"]
    factors: tuple[Phase8FactorSelection, ...]
    ordered_pair_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    ordered_scores: tuple[float, ...]
    ordered_ranks: tuple[int, ...]
    concrete_left_types: tuple[str, ...]
    concrete_right_types: tuple[str, ...]
    visible_endpoint_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    artifact_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    source_watermarks: tuple[int, ...]
    graph_edge_visits: int = Field(ge=0)
    matrix_cell_evaluations: int = Field(ge=0)
    producer_calls: int = Field(ge=0)
    error_invariant: str = ""
    outcome_sha256: str = Field(pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_complete_outcome(self: Self) -> Self:
        names = tuple(item.factor for item in self.factors)
        if len(names) != len(PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES) or set(names) != set(PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES):
            raise ValueError("A Phase 8 outcome must identify every matrix factor")
        result_lengths = {
            len(self.ordered_pair_ids),
            len(self.ordered_scores),
            len(self.ordered_ranks),
            len(self.concrete_left_types),
            len(self.concrete_right_types),
        }
        if self.outcome == "result" and len(result_lengths) != 1:
            raise ValueError("A Phase 8 result outcome requires complete ordered rows")
        if self.outcome == "typed_error" and not self.error_invariant:
            raise ValueError("A Phase 8 error outcome requires the exact invariant")
        return self


class Phase8MatrixManifest(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """Keep the complete symbolic product separate from execution observation."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    symbolic_cell_count: int = Field(gt=0)
    direct_observation: tuple[Phase8ExecutionOutcome, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_symbolic_count(self: Self) -> Self:
        expected = math.prod(len(values) for values in PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES.values())
        if self.symbolic_cell_count != expected:
            raise ValueError("Phase 8 symbolic count must equal the complete factor product")
        return self

    def uncovered_values(self: Phase8MatrixManifest) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        covered = {
            (selection.factor, selection.value)
            for outcome in self.direct_observation
            for selection in outcome.factors
        }
        return tuple(
            f"{factor}={value}"
            for factor, values in PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES.items()
            for value in values
            if (factor, value) not in covered
        )


PHASE8_MATRIX = Phase8MatrixManifest(
    symbolic_cell_count=math.prod(len(values) for values in PHASE8_FACTOR_VALUES.values()),
    direct_observation=(),
)

"""Phase 1 matching matrix completeness tests."""

from __future__ import annotations

from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from data_layer.connection import SyncDatabaseConnection
from data_layer.session import SessionId, UserId, UserSession
from data_layer.transaction import AsyncReadTransaction, SyncReadTransaction, SyncWriteTransaction

from conform.bootstrap_families.core import CORE_V1
from conform.l5250_matching.case_matrix import Phase1LeftBase, Phase1RightBase

TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY = CORE_V1


def _case_matrix_module():
    from conform.l5250_matching import case_matrix

    return case_matrix


def _spec_for_case(case):
    from data_layer import matching

    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    case_name = str(case.case_id)
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(case_name),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase1LeftBase](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case_name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase1LeftBase,
            representation=matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case_name}:left:representation"),
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase1RightBase](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{case_name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase1RightBase,
            representation=matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{case_name}:right:representation"),
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{case_name}:kernel"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.MatchResultShapeSpec(
            kind=matching.MatchResultShapeKind(case.result_shape.value),
        ),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def test_every_valid_lazy_and_sync_case_reaches_the_public_surface(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """MATCH-API-007, MATCH-TST-010: every declared sync/lazy cell executes."""
    from data_layer import matching

    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    cases = tuple(
        case
        for case in matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_valid()
        if case.execution_surface in {matrix.ExecutionSurface.LAZY, matrix.ExecutionSurface.SYNC}
    )

    def exercise(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        for case in cases:
            spec = _spec_for_case(case)
            operation = matching.match_lazy if case.execution_surface is matrix.ExecutionSurface.LAZY else matching.match
            with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as exc_info:
                operation(txn, spec)
            assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE
            assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=exercise)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_every_valid_async_case_reaches_the_public_surface(async_db_connection, system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    """MATCH-API-007, MATCH-TST-010: every declared async cell executes."""
    from data_layer import matching

    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    cases = tuple(
        case for case in matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_valid() if case.execution_surface is matrix.ExecutionSurface.ASYNC
    )

    async def exercise(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        for case in cases:
            spec = _spec_for_case(case)
            with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as exc_info:
                await matching.match_async(txn, spec)
            assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE
            assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id

    await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(fn=exercise)


def test_semantic_case_matrix_enumerates_every_valid_factor_product_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-006, MATCH-TST-008: every compatible Phase 1 cell is declared."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    manifest = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX
    all_cases = manifest.enumerate_all()
    valid_cases = manifest.enumerate_valid()
    invalid_cases = manifest.enumerate_invalid()
    assert len(all_cases) == 675
    assert len(valid_cases) == 540
    assert len(invalid_cases) == 135
    assert len({case.case_id for case in all_cases}) == len(all_cases)
    assert set(valid_cases).isdisjoint(invalid_cases)
    assert set(valid_cases) | set(invalid_cases) == set(all_cases)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "case",
    _case_matrix_module().PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_invalid(),
    ids=lambda case: str(case.case_id),
)
def test_every_excluded_matrix_cell_fails_through_the_public_shape_contract(case) -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-010: every excluded assignment cell has one exact public error."""
    from data_layer import matching

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
        matching.MatchResultShapeSpec(kind=case.result_shape.value)

    assert exc_info.value.error_count() == 1
    error = exc_info.value.errors()[0]
    assert error["loc"] == ("kind",)
    assert error["type"] == "enum"
    assert error["input"] == "assignment"


def test_invalid_case_matrix_enumerates_every_excluded_product_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-010: every excluded product has one typed reason."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    invalid_cases = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_invalid()
    assert invalid_cases
    for case in invalid_cases:
        assert case.result_shape is matrix.Phase1ResultShape.ASSIGNMENT
        assert case.exclusion is not None
        assert case.exclusion.reason is matrix.MatchCaseExclusionReason.ASSIGNMENT_IS_SEPARATE
        assert case.exclusion.requirement_id == matrix.MatchRequirementId("MATCH-SCP-006")


def test_declared_permission_sessions_are_persisted_and_exercised(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-008: every permission factor uses a real isolated session."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    permission_cases = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.permission_cases

    def create_sessions(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        for permission_case in permission_cases:
            txn.insert(
                UserSession,
                UserSession(
                    sys_id=permission_case.session_id,
                    user_id=UserId.new(),
                ),
            )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=create_sessions)

    observed_session_ids: list[SessionId] = []
    for permission_case in permission_cases:

        def observe_session(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
            observed_session_ids.append(txn.session_id)

        db_connection.session(permission_case.session_id).read(fn=observe_session)

    assert tuple(observed_session_ids) == tuple(case.session_id for case in permission_cases)


def test_permission_cases_define_isolated_sessions_and_endpoint_outcomes_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-008: permission factors contain executable session declarations."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    manifest = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX
    permission_cases = manifest.permission_cases
    assert len(permission_cases) == len(matrix.PermissionShape)
    assert len({case.session_id for case in permission_cases}) == len(permission_cases)
    assert {case.shape for case in permission_cases} == set(matrix.PermissionShape)
    expected_outcomes = {
        matrix.PermissionShape.ALLOW_ALL: (
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.ALLOW,
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.ALLOW,
        ),
        matrix.PermissionShape.DENY_LEFT: (
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.DENY,
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.ALLOW,
        ),
        matrix.PermissionShape.DENY_RIGHT: (
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.ALLOW,
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.DENY,
        ),
        matrix.PermissionShape.DENY_BOTH: (
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.DENY,
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.DENY,
        ),
        matrix.PermissionShape.MIXED_VISIBLE_ROWS: (
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.MIXED,
            matrix.PermissionOutcome.MIXED,
        ),
    }
    assert {case.shape: (case.left_outcome, case.right_outcome) for case in permission_cases} == expected_outcomes
    for case in manifest.enumerate_all():
        assert case.permission.shape is case.permission_shape
        assert case.permission in permission_cases


def test_permission_polymorphism_matrix_has_no_missing_cells_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-010: permission and both polymorphism dimensions are complete."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    valid_cases = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_valid()
    observed = {(case.permission_shape, case.left_polymorphism, case.right_polymorphism) for case in valid_cases}
    expected = {
        (permission, left, right)
        for permission in matrix.PermissionShape
        for left in matrix.PolymorphismShape
        for right in matrix.PolymorphismShape
    }
    assert observed == expected
    assert len(expected) == 45
    assert matrix.Phase1LeftSubtype.__mro__[1] is matrix.Phase1LeftBase
    assert matrix.Phase1RightSubtype.__mro__[1] is matrix.Phase1RightBase


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "case",
    _case_matrix_module().PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX.enumerate_all(),
    ids=lambda case: str(case.case_id),
)
def test_every_phase1_matrix_cell_has_one_exact_typed_outcome_tdd_red(case) -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-008, MATCH-TST-010: every declared product cell has one outcome."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    if case.result_shape is matrix.Phase1ResultShape.ASSIGNMENT:
        assert isinstance(case, matrix.Phase1InvalidCase)
        assert case.exclusion.reason is matrix.MatchCaseExclusionReason.ASSIGNMENT_IS_SEPARATE
        assert case.exclusion.requirement_id == matrix.MatchRequirementId("MATCH-SCP-006")
    else:
        assert isinstance(case, matrix.Phase1ValidCase)
        assert not hasattr(case, "exclusion")


def test_matrix_manifest_rejects_missing_or_duplicate_factor_values_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-008, MATCH-TST-015: count edits cannot conceal factor drift."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    manifest = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX
    missing_surface = validated_model_update(
        manifest,
        {
            "execution_surfaces": (
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.LAZY,
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.SYNC,
            ),
            "expected_all_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(450),
            "expected_valid_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(360),
            "expected_invalid_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(90),
        },
    )
    duplicate_surface = validated_model_update(
        manifest,
        {
            "execution_surfaces": (
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.LAZY,
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.SYNC,
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.ASYNC,
                matrix.ExecutionSurface.ASYNC,
            ),
            "expected_all_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(900),
            "expected_valid_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(720),
            "expected_invalid_count": matrix.MatchCaseCount(180),
        },
    )
    for invalid_manifest in (missing_surface, duplicate_surface):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="factor"):
            invalid_manifest.validate_declared_counts()


def test_matrix_manifest_is_frozen_and_self_validating_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-TST-008, MATCH-TST-015: declared counts fail closed on drift."""
    matrix = _case_matrix_module()
    manifest = matrix.PHASE1_MATCH_CASE_MATRIX
    assert manifest.model_config.get("frozen") is True
    assert manifest.expected_all_count == matrix.MatchCaseCount(675)
    assert manifest.expected_valid_count == matrix.MatchCaseCount(540)
    assert manifest.expected_invalid_count == matrix.MatchCaseCount(135)
    assert manifest.validate_declared_counts() is manifest
sources.ae3412f94653d7871d3da6a94b52460f8aa5c821:
"""Phase 1 public matching contract tests.

Requirements: MATCH-API-001 through MATCH-API-015, MATCH-SPEC-001 through
MATCH-SPEC-009, MATCH-SCP-004, MATCH-SCP-006, MATCH-PLAN-009 through
MATCH-PLAN-012, MATCH-ERR-001 through MATCH-ERR-006, and MATCH-TST-004
through MATCH-TST-015.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from conform.bootstrap_families.core import CORE_V1
from data_layer.connection import SyncDatabaseConnection
from data_layer.matching import MatchDenseValue
from data_layer.schema import ApplicationObjectRow
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from data_layer.transaction import (
    AsyncReadTransaction,
    AsyncWriteTransaction,
    SyncReadTransaction,
    SyncWriteTransaction,
)
from data_layer.types import SysId


class Phase1LeftRow(ApplicationObjectRow[SysId]):
    """Concrete left endpoint used by declaration tests."""

    value: str
    score_value: MatchDenseValue = MatchDenseValue(0.0)
    represented: bool = True
    producer_failed: bool = False


class Phase1LeftSubtype(Phase1LeftRow):
    """Polymorphic left endpoint used by the matrix contract."""

    subtype_value: str


class Phase1RightRow(ApplicationObjectRow[SysId]):
    """Concrete right endpoint used by declaration tests."""

    value: str
    score_value: MatchDenseValue = MatchDenseValue(0.0)
    represented: bool = True
    producer_failed: bool = False


class Phase1RightSubtype(Phase1RightRow):
    """Polymorphic right endpoint used by the matrix contract."""

    subtype_value: str


TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY = CORE_V1


Phase1LeftRow.model_rebuild()
Phase1LeftSubtype.model_rebuild()
Phase1RightRow.model_rebuild()
Phase1RightSubtype.model_rebuild()


def _matching_module():
    from data_layer import matching

    return matching


def _spec(name: str = "phase1"):
    matching = _matching_module()
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(name),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase1LeftRow](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase1LeftRow,
            representation=matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{name}:left:representation"),
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase1RightRow](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"{name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase1RightRow,
            representation=matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"{name}:right:representation"),
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"{name}:kernel"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(
            neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1),
        ),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def test_match_spec_requires_typed_left_and_right_rows_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-API-003: relation endpoints reject non-row classes."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
        matching.MatchRelationSpec(
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId("invalid:left"),
            row_type=str,
            representation=matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("invalid:representation"),
            ),
        )
    assert exc_info.value.error_count() == 1
    assert exc_info.value.errors()[0]["loc"] == ("row_type",)


def test_application_spec_cannot_name_backend_or_access_method_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-API-015: physical selectors are rejected as extra fields."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    valid = _spec("physical-selector")
    for field_name, field_value in (
        ("backend", "postgres"),
        ("extension", "vector"),
        ("operator_class", "vector_cosine_ops"),
        ("index_type", "hnsw"),
        ("sql_operator", "<=>"),
        ("physical_storage", "halfvec"),
    ):
        payload = {
            "spec_ref_id": valid.spec_ref_id,
            "pair_scope": valid.pair_scope,
            "left": valid.left,
            "right": valid.right,
            "kernel": valid.kernel,
            "policies": valid.policies,
            "result_shape": valid.result_shape,
            "filters": valid.filters,
            "work_limits": valid.work_limits,
            field_name: field_value,
        }
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
            matching.MatchSpec.model_validate(payload)
        assert exc_info.value.errors()[0]["loc"] == (field_name,)
        assert exc_info.value.errors()[0]["type"] == "extra_forbidden"


def test_pydantic_validation_rejects_cross_branded_matching_values_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-API-012: validation cannot silently reinterpret another semantic brand."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    wrong_brand = matching.MatchSpecRefId("same-text")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
        matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=wrong_brand,
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        )
    assert exc_info.value.errors()[0]["loc"] == ("kernel_ref_id",)


def test_match_lazy_sync_async_accept_matching_transaction_kinds_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """MATCH-API-004, MATCH-API-007 through MATCH-API-009: all surfaces fail closed."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    spec = _spec("transactions")

    def exercise(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as lazy_error:
            matching.match_lazy(txn, spec)
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as sync_error:
            matching.match(txn, spec)
        assert lazy_error.value.context == sync_error.value.context
        assert lazy_error.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=exercise)

    def exercise_write(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as exc_info:
            matching.match(txn, spec)
        assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=exercise_write)


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_match_async_accepts_async_transaction_kind_tdd_red(async_db_connection, system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    """MATCH-API-007 through MATCH-API-009: async uses the same semantic declaration."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    spec = _spec("async-transaction")

    async def exercise(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as exc_info:
            await matching.match_async(txn, spec)
        assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE
        assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id

    await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(fn=exercise)

    async def exercise_write(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchPhysicalPlanError) as exc_info:
            await matching.match_async(txn, spec)
        assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE

    await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write_async(fn=exercise_write)


def test_matching_data_operation_rejects_connection_argument_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> None:
    """MATCH-API-004, MATCH-API-010: connections cannot enter data functions."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    spec = _spec("connection-rejection")
    for operation in (matching.match_lazy, matching.match):
        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchTransactionTypeError) as exc_info:
            operation(db_connection, spec)
        assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.TRANSACTION_REQUIRED
        assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id
        assert "Connection" not in exc_info.value.context.observed


def test_spec_fingerprint_is_canonical_complete_and_validated_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-001, MATCH-SPEC-002: fingerprints cover each declared meaning."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    baseline = _spec("fingerprint")
    assert len(baseline.semantic_fingerprint) == 64
    assert set(baseline.semantic_fingerprint) <= set("0123456789abcdef")
    assert baseline.semantic_fingerprint == _spec("fingerprint").semantic_fingerprint

    mutations = (
        validated_model_update(baseline, {"spec_ref_id": matching.MatchSpecRefId("changed-spec")}),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "left": validated_model_update(baseline.left, {"relation_ref_id": matching.MatchRelationRefId("changed-left")}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "left": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.left,
                    {
                        "representation": matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                            representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("changed-left-rep"),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "right": validated_model_update(baseline.right, {"relation_ref_id": matching.MatchRelationRefId("changed-right")}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "right": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.right,
                    {
                        "representation": matching.MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec(
                            representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("changed-right-rep"),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "kernel": validated_model_update(baseline.kernel, {"kernel_ref_id": matching.MatchKernelRefId("changed-kernel")}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "kernel": validated_model_update(baseline.kernel, {"kind": matching.MatchKernelKind.EDIT_DISTANCE}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "kernel": validated_model_update(baseline.kernel, {"score_direction": matching.MatchScoreDirection.LOWER_IS_BETTER}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "policies": validated_model_update(baseline.policies, {"self_edges": matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE}),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "result_shape": matching.MatchResultShapeSpec(
                    kind=matching.MatchResultShapeKind.THRESHOLD_JOIN,
                ),
            },
        ),
    )
    assert (
        len({baseline.semantic_fingerprint, *(mutation.semantic_fingerprint for mutation in mutations)})
        == len(
            mutations,
        )
        + 1
    )

    for invalid in ("short", "g" * 64, "A" * 64, "0" * 65):
        with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError, ValidationError)):
            matching.MatchSpecFingerprint(invalid)


def test_duplicate_spec_identity_rejects_different_fingerprint_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-006, MATCH-SPEC-007: duplicate identity has one meaning."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    first = _spec("duplicate")
    identical = _spec("duplicate")
    changed = validated_model_update(
        first,
        {
            "result_shape": matching.MatchResultShapeSpec(
                kind=matching.MatchResultShapeKind.THRESHOLD_JOIN,
            )
        },
    )
    registry = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty().register(first)
    assert registry.register(identical) == registry
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchDeclarationError) as exc_info:
        registry.register(changed)
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.DUPLICATE_SPEC_IDENTITY
    assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == first.spec_ref_id


def test_registry_composition_is_import_order_independent_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-008: composition sorts by stable specification identity."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    alpha = _spec("alpha")
    beta = _spec("beta")
    forward = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.compose((alpha, beta))
    reverse = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.compose((beta, alpha))
    assert forward == reverse
    assert forward.registrations == tuple(sorted(forward.registrations, key=lambda item: str(item.spec_ref_id)))


def test_registry_preserves_and_resolves_authoritative_typed_spec_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-006 through MATCH-SPEC-009: registration retains full meaning."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    alpha = _spec("authoritative-alpha")
    beta = _spec("authoritative-beta")
    registry = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.compose((beta, alpha))

    assert registry.resolve(alpha.spec_ref_id) == alpha
    assert registry.resolve(beta.spec_ref_id) == beta
    assert registry.registrations[0].spec == alpha
    assert registry.registrations[1].spec == beta

    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope(
        variant=matching.MatchPersistedVariantName(matching.MatchPersistedVariant.V1.value),
        spec_ref_id=alpha.spec_ref_id,
        fingerprint=alpha.semantic_fingerprint,
    )
    assert registry.validate_persisted(envelope) == alpha

    missing_id = matching.MatchSpecRefId("authoritative-missing")
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchDeclarationError) as exc_info:
        registry.resolve(missing_id)
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_SPEC_MISSING
    assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == missing_id
    assert exc_info.value.context.expected == matching.MatchExpectedValue("registered_specification")
    assert exc_info.value.context.observed == matching.MatchObservedValue("missing_specification")
    assert exc_info.value.context.safe_action is matching.MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC


def test_unknown_persisted_variant_fails_closed_tdd_red() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-009, MATCH-PLAN-010: unknown persisted dispatch never falls back."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope(
        variant=matching.MatchPersistedVariantName("future-v99"),
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId("persisted"),
        fingerprint=matching.MatchSpecFingerprint("0" * 64),
    )
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchUnknownVariantError) as exc_info:
        matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty().validate_persisted(envelope)
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.UNKNOWN_PERSISTED_VARIANT
    assert exc_info.value.context.observed == matching.MatchObservedValue("future-v99")


def test_every_closed_kernel_policy_and_result_variant_has_behavioral_coverage() -> None:
    """MATCH-PLAN-009, MATCH-TST-010: every Phase 1 semantic variant is reachable."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    baseline = _spec("closed-variants")
    fingerprints: set[str] = set()

    for kernel_kind in matching.MatchKernelKind:
        for direction in matching.MatchScoreDirection:
            changed = validated_model_update(
                baseline,
                {
                    "kernel": matching.MatchKernelSpec(
                        kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(
                            f"closed-variants:{kernel_kind.value}:{direction.value}",
                        ),
                        kind=kernel_kind,
                        score_direction=direction,
                    ),
                },
            )
            fingerprints.add(changed.semantic_fingerprint)
    assert len(fingerprints) == len(matching.MatchKernelKind) * len(matching.MatchScoreDirection)

    missing_policies = (
        matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
        matching.OmitMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
        matching.EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy(score=matching.MatchScoreValue(-1.0)),
        matching.RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy(),
    )
    duplicate_policies = (
        matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
        matching.KeepFirstDuplicatePairPolicy(),
        matching.CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy(
            score_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateScoreCombination.SUM,
            explanation_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateExplanationCombination.CONCATENATE_BOUNDED,
        ),
    )
    freshness_policies = (
        matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        matching.WaitForBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy(
            required_watermark=matching.MatchExpectedValue("watermark-1"),
        ),
        matching.AcceptStaleWithDiagnosticsFreshnessPolicy(),
        matching.ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy(),
    )
    policies_seen: set[str] = set()
    for guarantee in matching.MatchGuarantee:
        for missing in missing_policies:
            for self_edges in matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy:
                for duplicates in duplicate_policies:
                    for freshness in freshness_policies:
                        changed = validated_model_update(
                            baseline,
                            {
                                "policies": matching.MatchPolicies(
                                    guarantee=guarantee,
                                    missing_representation=missing,
                                    self_edges=self_edges,
                                    duplicates=duplicates,
                                    freshness=freshness,
                                ),
                            },
                        )
                        policies_seen.add(changed.semantic_fingerprint)
    expected_policy_count = (
        len(matching.MatchGuarantee)
        * len(missing_policies)
        * len(matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy)
        * len(duplicate_policies)
        * len(freshness_policies)
    )
    assert len(policies_seen) == expected_policy_count

    shape_fingerprints = {
        validated_model_update(baseline, {"result_shape": matching.MatchResultShapeSpec(kind=result_shape)}).semantic_fingerprint
        for result_shape in matching.MatchResultShapeKind
    }
    assert len(shape_fingerprints) == len(matching.MatchResultShapeKind)


def test_semantic_policies_reject_none_and_boolean_shortcuts() -> None:
    """MATCH-SPEC-003 through MATCH-SPEC-005: each semantic choice is explicit."""
    matching = _matching_module()
    fields_and_invalid_values = (
        ("guarantee", None),
        ("guarantee", True),
        ("missing_representation", None),
        ("missing_representation", False),
        ("self_edges", None),
        ("self_edges", True),
        ("duplicates", None),
        ("duplicates", False),
        ("freshness", None),
        ("freshness", True),
    )
    baseline = _spec("invalid-policies").policies.model_dump()
    for field_name, invalid_value in fields_and_invalid_values:
        payload = {**baseline, field_name: invalid_value}
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as exc_info:
            matching.MatchPolicies.model_validate(payload)
        assert exc_info.value.errors()[0]["loc"][0] == field_name

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
