"""Behavioral observation required by the reopened matching Phase 1 gate."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from pydantic import BaseModel

from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update
from data_layer.matching import MatchDenseCoordinateSpec, MatchSpec, MatchSpecRegistry
from data_layer.schema import field

from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase1_contracts import Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow, _spec


def _nested_model_types(value: object, path: str = "spec") -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, BaseModel):
        return ()
    nested: list[tuple[str, str]] = [(path, type(value).__qualname__)]
    for field_name in type(value).model_fields:
        field_value = getattr(value, field_name)
        if isinstance(field_value, BaseModel):
            nested.extend(_nested_model_types(field_value, f"{path}.{field_name}"))
        elif isinstance(field_value, tuple):
            for index, item in enumerate(field_value):
                nested.extend(_nested_model_types(item, f"{path}.{field_name}.{index}"))
    return tuple(nested)


def _json_round_trip(
    spec: MatchSpec[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow],
) -> MatchSpec[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow]:
    from data_layer import matching

    catalog = matching.MatchRowTypeCatalog.from_types((Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow))
    registry: MatchSpecRegistry[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow] = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty(
        row_types=catalog,
    )
    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec(spec)
    return registry.restore_json(envelope.model_dump_json())


def test_every_recursive_variant_survives_json_persistence() -> None:
    """Every closed Phase 1 variant restores with the same concrete nested type."""
    from data_layer import matching

    baseline = _spec("all-recursive-variants")
    left_coordinate: MatchDenseCoordinateSpec[Phase1LeftRow] = matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(
        field(Phase1LeftRow.score_value),
    )
    right_coordinate: MatchDenseCoordinateSpec[Phase1RightRow] = matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(
        field(Phase1RightRow.score_value),
    )
    expression = matching.MatchFunctionExpression(
        function=matching.MatchExpressionFunction.ABSOLUTE,
        argument=matching.MatchDivideExpression(
            numerator=matching.MatchSubtractExpression(
                left=matching.MatchAddExpression(
                    left=matching.MatchLeftFieldExpression.from_field(field(Phase1LeftRow.score_value)),
                    right=matching.MatchRightFieldExpression.from_field(field(Phase1RightRow.score_value)),
                ),
                right=matching.MatchMultiplyExpression(
                    left=matching.MatchLeftFieldExpression.from_field(field(Phase1LeftRow.score_value)),
                    right=matching.MatchRightFieldExpression.from_field(field(Phase1RightRow.score_value)),
                ),
            ),
            denominator=matching.MatchRightFieldExpression.from_field(field(Phase1RightRow.score_value)),
        ),
    )
    variants = (
        baseline,
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "left": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.left,
                    {
                        "source": matching.MatchSingletonRelationSource(
                            row_type=Phase1LeftRow,
                            row=Phase1LeftRow(value="query", score_value=matching.MatchDenseValue(1.0)),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "left": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.left,
                    {
                        "representation": matching.MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec(
                            representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("all-variants:left:packed"),
                            row_type=Phase1LeftRow,
                            field_name=matching.MatchFieldName("score_value"),
                            dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "left": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.left,
                    {
                        "representation": matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec(
                            representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("all-variants:left:dense"),
                            dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                            coordinates=(left_coordinate,),
                            availability=matching.MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec.from_field(
                                field(Phase1LeftRow.represented),
                            ),
                        ),
                        "identity": matching.MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec.from_field(field(Phase1LeftRow.value)),
                    },
                ),
                "right": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.right,
                    {
                        "representation": matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec(
                            representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId("all-variants:right:dense"),
                            dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                            coordinates=(right_coordinate,),
                            availability=matching.MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec.from_fields(
                                field(Phase1RightRow.represented),
                                field(Phase1RightRow.producer_failed),
                            ),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        *(
            validated_model_update(
                baseline,
                {"policies": validated_model_update(baseline.policies, {"missing_representation": policy})},
            )
            for policy in (
                matching.OmitMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
                matching.EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy(score=matching.MatchScoreValue(-1.0)),
                matching.RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy(),
            )
        ),
        *(
            validated_model_update(
                baseline,
                {"policies": validated_model_update(baseline.policies, {"duplicates": policy})},
            )
            for policy in (
                matching.KeepFirstDuplicatePairPolicy(),
                matching.CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy(
                    score_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateScoreCombination.SUM,
                    explanation_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateExplanationCombination.CONCATENATE_BOUNDED,
                ),
            )
        ),
        *(
            validated_model_update(
                baseline,
                {"policies": validated_model_update(baseline.policies, {"freshness": policy})},
            )
            for policy in (
                matching.RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy(
                    required_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(1),
                ),
                matching.AcceptStaleWithDiagnosticsFreshnessPolicy(),
                matching.ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy(),
            )
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "kernel": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.kernel,
                    {
                        "evaluation_complexity": validated_model_update(
                            baseline.kernel.evaluation_complexity,
                            {
                                "build_time": matching.UnknownComplexityBound(
                                    reason=matching.MatchExpectedValue("not_deployed"),
                                ),
                            },
                        ),
                    },
                ),
                "policies": validated_model_update(
                    baseline.policies,
                    {
                        "explanations": matching.DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy(
                            max_rows=matching.MatchExplanationRowLimit(1),
                        ),
                    },
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "kernel": matching.MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec(
                    kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId("all-variants:expression"),
                    expression=expression,
                    null_policy=matching.MatchExpressionNullPolicy.REJECT,
                    score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
                ),
            },
        ),
        validated_model_update(
            baseline,
            {
                "filters": matching.MatchFilterSet(
                    left=matching.MatchEndpointFilterSpec.from_expression(field(Phase1LeftRow.value) == "left"),
                    right=matching.NoMatchFilter(),
                    pair=matching.MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec.from_fields(
                        field(Phase1LeftRow.value),
                        matching.MatchPairComparisonOperator.EQUAL,
                        field(Phase1RightRow.value),
                    ),
                ),
            },
        ),
        *(
            validated_model_update(baseline, {"result_shape": shape})
            for shape in (
                matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(
                    neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1),
                    pagination=matching.FirstMatchPage(page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1)),
                ),
                matching.TopKPerRightMatchShape(
                    neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1),
                    pagination=matching.MatchPageAfterCursor(
                        page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1),
                        cursor=matching.MatchPageCursor(
                            spec_fingerprint=baseline.semantic_fingerprint,
                            snapshot_fingerprint=matching.MatchSnapshotFingerprint("0" * 64),
                            result_shape=matching.MatchResultShapeKind.TOP_K_PER_RIGHT,
                            score=matching.MatchScoreValue(0.0),
                            left_identity=matching.MatchCursorIdentity("left"),
                            right_identity=matching.MatchCursorIdentity("right"),
                            rank=matching.MatchRank(1),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                matching.GlobalTopKMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1)),
                matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape(
                    threshold=matching.MatchScoreValue(0.0),
                    boundary=matching.MatchThresholdBoundary.INCLUSIVE,
                    result_limit=matching.MatchResultLimit(1),
                ),
            )
        ),
    )

    observed_variant_names: set[str] = set()
    for spec in variants:
        restored = _json_round_trip(spec)
        restored_types = _nested_model_types(restored)[1:]
        assert restored_types == _nested_model_types(spec)[1:]
        assert restored.semantic_fingerprint == spec.semantic_fingerprint
        observed_variant_names.update(type_name.partition("[")[0] for _path, type_name in restored_types)
    assert {
        "AcceptStaleWithDiagnosticsFreshnessPolicy",
        "AllRowsRepresented",
        "CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy",
        "ConstantComplexityBound",
        "DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy",
        "EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy",
        "ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy",
        "FailMissingRepresentationPolicy",
        "FirstMatchPage",
        "GlobalTopKMatchShape",
        "KeepFirstDuplicatePairPolicy",
        "MatchAddExpression",
        "MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec",
        "MatchDenseRepresentationSpec",
        "MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec",
        "MatchDivideExpression",
        "MatchEndpointFilterSpec",
        "MatchFunctionExpression",
        "MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec",
        "MatchLeftFieldExpression",
        "MatchMultiplyExpression",
        "MatchPageAfterCursor",
        "MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec",
        "MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec",
        "MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec",
        "MatchRightFieldExpression",
        "MatchSubtractExpression",
        "MatchSingletonRelationSource",
        "MatchSysIdIdentitySpec",
        "MatchTableRelationSource",
        "MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec",
        "NoMatchFilter",
        "NoMatchPagination",
        "NoMatchPruningBound",
        "OmitMissingRepresentationPolicy",
        "ProductComplexityBound",
        "RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy",
        "RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy",
        "RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy",
        "SymbolComplexityBound",
        "ThresholdJoinMatchShape",
        "TopKPerLeftMatchShape",
        "TopKPerRightMatchShape",
        "UnknownComplexityBound",
        "RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy",
    } <= observed_variant_names


def test_recursive_contract_round_trip_preserves_every_closed_variant() -> None:
    """A persisted specification preserves each concrete nested contract variant."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _spec("recursive-round-trip")
    from_spec = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec
    assert callable(from_spec)
    envelope = from_spec(spec)
    encoded = envelope.model_dump_json()
    catalog = matching.MatchRowTypeCatalog.from_types((Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow))
    registry: MatchSpecRegistry[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow] = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty(
        row_types=catalog,
    )
    restore_json = registry.restore_json
    assert callable(restore_json)
    restored = restore_json(encoded)

    assert type(restored.left.representation) is type(spec.left.representation)
    assert type(restored.right.representation) is type(spec.right.representation)
    assert type(restored.kernel) is type(spec.kernel)
    assert type(restored.policies.missing_representation) is type(spec.policies.missing_representation)
    assert type(restored.policies.duplicates) is type(spec.policies.duplicates)
    assert type(restored.policies.freshness) is type(spec.policies.freshness)
    assert type(restored.result_shape) is type(spec.result_shape)
    assert type(restored.filters.left) is type(spec.filters.left)
    assert restored.semantic_fingerprint == spec.semantic_fingerprint

def test_each_unknown_nested_variant_returns_exact_public_error(variant_path: str) -> None:
    """Each nested dispatch family reports its exact bounded path and value."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _spec(f"unknown-{variant_path.replace('.', '-')}")
    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec(spec)
    payload = envelope.model_dump(round_trip=True)
    current: object = payload["specification"]
    for component in variant_path.split("."):
        assert isinstance(current, dict)
        current = current[component]
    assert isinstance(current, dict)
    current["kind"] = "unknown-variant"
    catalog = matching.MatchRowTypeCatalog.from_types((Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow))
    registry: MatchSpecRegistry[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow] = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty(
        row_types=catalog,
    )

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchUnknownVariantError) as exc_info:
        registry.restore_payload(payload)

    assert exc_info.value.context == matching.MatchErrorContext(
        invariant=matching.MatchInvariant.UNKNOWN_PERSISTED_VARIANT,
        expected=matching.MatchExpectedValue("registered_closed_variant"),
        observed=matching.MatchObservedValue(f"{variant_path}:unknown-variant"),
        safe_action=matching.MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
        spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
    )

        registry.restore_payload(payload)

    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.UNKNOWN_PERSISTED_VARIANT
    assert exc_info.value.context.safe_action is matching.MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC
    assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id
    assert exc_info.value.context.expected == "registered_closed_variant"
    assert exc_info.value.context.observed == "kernel:unknown-kernel-variant"


def test_persisted_row_type_requires_explicit_closed_catalog() -> None:
    """Persisted row classes never resolve through dynamic imports or process globals."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _spec("unknown-row-type")
    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec(spec)
    encoded = envelope.model_dump_json()
    empty_registry: MatchSpecRegistry[Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow] = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty()

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchUnknownVariantError) as exc_info:
        empty_registry.restore_json(encoded)

    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.UNKNOWN_PERSISTED_VARIANT
    assert exc_info.value.context.safe_action is matching.MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC
    assert exc_info.value.context.expected == "registered_row_type"
    assert exc_info.value.context.observed == "conform.l5250_matching.test_phase1_contracts.Phase1LeftRow"
    assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == spec.spec_ref_id


def test_registry_restores_complete_persisted_specification() -> None:
    """Restoration does not depend on an in-memory registration from this process."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _spec("complete-persisted-spec")
    from_spec = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec
    assert callable(from_spec)
    envelope = from_spec(spec)
    catalog = matching.MatchRowTypeCatalog.from_types((Phase1LeftRow, Phase1RightRow))
    empty_registry: object = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.empty(row_types=catalog)
    restore = getattr(empty_registry, "restore", None)
    assert callable(restore)

    restored = restore(envelope)

    assert restored == spec
    assert restored is not spec

from __future__ import annotations

from conform.l5250_matching.case_matrix import ExecutionSurface, PolymorphismShape

def test_exact_dense_work_envelope_exposes_every_required_hard_limit() -> None:
    """MATCH-CPLX-020 and MATCH-CPLX-021 require the complete resource envelope."""
    from data_layer import matching

    required_fields = {
        "max_candidate_pairs",
        "max_representation_bytes_read",
        "max_producer_calls",
        "max_working_memory_bytes",
    }
    assert required_fields <= set(matching.MatchWorkLimits.model_fields)


def test_threshold_oracle_outcomes_do_not_invent_rank_fields() -> None:
    """MATCH-RES-004 and MATCH-TST-002 forbid synthetic ranks on threshold edges."""
    from data_layer import matching

    assert "left_rank" not in matching.ThresholdMatchEdge.model_fields
    assert "right_rank" not in matching.ThresholdMatchEdge.model_fields
    threshold_cases = tuple(
        case
        for case in PHASE2_EXACT_DENSE_MATRIX.valid_cases
        if case.result_shape is Phase2ResultShape.THRESHOLD_JOIN
    )
    assert threshold_cases
    assert all(
        set(edge.model_fields_set) == {"left_label", "right_label", "score"}
        for case in threshold_cases
        for edge in case.expected_edges
    )


def test_expanded_polymorphic_cells_use_direct_concrete_type_check() -> None:
    """Each expanded subtype cell maps to the direct concrete-type behavior check."""
    expanded_subtype_cases = tuple(
        case
        for case in PHASE2_EXACT_DENSE_MATRIX.valid_cases
        if case.execution_surface is ExecutionSurface.SYNC
        and case.left_polymorphism is PolymorphismShape.SUBTYPE_INSTANCE
        and case.right_polymorphism is PolymorphismShape.SUBTYPE_INSTANCE
    )
    assert len(expanded_subtype_cases) == 1_350
    assert all(
        "test_lazy_and_async_polymorphic_endpoints_preserve_both_subtypes_tdd_red"
        in PHASE2_EXACT_DENSE_MATRIX.execution_class_for(case).collapse_check_test_ids
        for case in expanded_subtype_cases
    )

def _top_k_spec(name: str, neighbor_count: int):
    from data_layer import matching

    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(f"phase2:{name}"),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase2DenseLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase2:{name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase2DenseLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase2DenseLeft](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(
                    f"phase2:{name}:left:dense",
                ),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(2),
                coordinates=(
                    matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase2DenseLeft.coordinate_x)),
                    matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase2DenseLeft.coordinate_y)),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase2DenseRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase2:{name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase2DenseRight,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase2DenseRight](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(
                    f"phase2:{name}:right:dense",
                ),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(2),
                coordinates=(
                    matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase2DenseRight.coordinate_x)),
                    matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase2DenseRight.coordinate_y)),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"phase2:{name}:dot"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(
            neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(neighbor_count),
        ),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )

def test_public_exact_dense_singleton_match_returns_expected_pair_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """One-row relations execute through the public API with exact typed output."""
    from data_layer import matching

    inserted: dict[str, Phase2DenseLeft | Phase2DenseRight] = {}

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        inserted["left"] = txn.insert(
            Phase2DenseLeft,
            Phase2DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate_x=2.0, coordinate_y=1.0),
        )
        inserted["right"] = txn.insert(
            Phase2DenseRight,
            Phase2DenseRight(label="right", coordinate_x=3.0, coordinate_y=4.0),
        )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, _singleton_spec())

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert len(result.edges) == 1
    edge = result.edges[0]
    assert type(edge.left) is Phase2DenseLeft
    assert type(edge.right) is Phase2DenseRight
    assert edge.left.sys_id == inserted["left"].sys_id
    assert edge.right.sys_id == inserted["right"].sys_id
    assert edge.score.canonical == matching.MatchScoreValue(10.0)
    assert edge.score.exactness is matching.MatchExactness.EXACT
    assert edge.score.kernel_ref_id == matching.MatchKernelRefId("phase2:singleton:dot")
    assert edge.left_rank == matching.MatchRank(1)
    assert result.work.pair_evaluations == matching.MatchPairEvaluationCount(1)
    assert result.work.database_round_trips == matching.MatchDatabaseRoundTripCount(2)


def _threshold_spec(name: str, threshold: float):
    from data_layer import matching

    top_k = _top_k_spec(name, 1)
    return validated_model_update(
        top_k,
        {
            "result_shape": matching.ThresholdJoinMatchShape(
                threshold=matching.MatchScoreValue(threshold),
                boundary=matching.MatchThresholdBoundary.INCLUSIVE,
                result_limit=matching.MatchResultLimit(10),
            ),
        },
    )


def test_explicit_singleton_source_limits_shared_exact_executor_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,

    """A singleton source must not scan other persisted endpoint rows."""
    from data_layer import matching

    inserted: dict[str, Phase2DenseLeft] = {}

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:

    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """Database scores and order match an independent exhaustive evaluator."""
    from data_layer import matching

    left_values = (("left-x", 1.0, 0.0), ("left-y", 0.0, 1.0))
    right_values = (("right-a", 2.0, 1.0), ("right-b", 1.0, 3.0))

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        for label, x, y in left_values:
            txn.insert(Phase2DenseLeft, Phase2DenseLeft(label=label, coordinate_x=x, coordinate_y=y))

            txn.insert(Phase2DenseRight, Phase2DenseRight(label=label, coordinate_x=x, coordinate_y=y))

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)

    expected_scores = {
        (left_label, right_label): left_x * right_x + left_y * right_y

        for right_label, right_x, right_y in right_values
    }

    for left_label, _left_x, _left_y in left_values:
        observed = [edge.right.label for edge in result.edges if edge.left.label == left_label]
        expected = sorted(
            (right_label for right_label, _right_x, _right_y in right_values),

    scoped_spec = validated_model_update(spec, {"pair_scope": matching.MatchPairScope("alternate_visible_pair_scope")})

def _assert_each_work_limit_prevents_scoring(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> None:
    """Every exact-dense hard limit rejects admitted work before result publication."""
    from data_layer import matching

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        for index in range(2):
            txn.insert(Phase2PackedDenseLeft, Phase2PackedDenseLeft(label=f"left-{index}", vector=[1.0, 0.0]))
            txn.insert(Phase2PackedDenseRight, Phase2PackedDenseRight(label=f"right-{index}", vector=[1.0, 0.0]))

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)
    dimensions = matching.MatchVectorDimensions(2)
    base = matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId("phase2:all-limits"),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase2PackedDenseLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId("phase2:all-limits:left"),
            row_type=Phase2PackedDenseLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase2PackedDenseLeft.vector),
                dimensions=dimensions,
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase2PackedDenseRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId("phase2:all-limits:right"),
            row_type=Phase2PackedDenseRight,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase2PackedDenseRight.vector),
                dimensions=dimensions,
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId("phase2:all-limits:kernel"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(2)),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )
    limit_updates = (
        {"max_left_rows": matching.MatchRowCountLimit(1)},
        {"max_right_rows": matching.MatchRowCountLimit(1)},
        {"max_pair_evaluations": matching.MatchPairEvaluationLimit(3)},
        {"max_result_rows": matching.MatchResultLimit(3)},
        {"max_representation_values": matching.MatchRepresentationValueLimit(7)},
        {"max_database_round_trips": matching.MatchDatabaseRoundTripLimit(1)},
        {"max_hydration_payload_bytes": matching.MatchHydrationPayloadByteLimit(1)},
    )
    observed_by_limit = {
        "max_left_rows": "left_rows_2",
        "max_right_rows": "right_rows_2",
        "max_pair_evaluations": "pair_evaluations_4",
        "max_result_rows": "result_rows_4",
        "max_representation_values": "representation_values_8",
        "max_database_round_trips": "database_round_trips_2",
        "max_hydration_payload_bytes": "hydration_payload_bytes_436",
    }
    for update in limit_updates:
        spec = validated_model_update(base, {"work_limits": validated_model_update(base.work_limits, update)})

        def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
            return matching.match(txn, spec)

        with pytest.raises(matching.MatchWorkLimitError) as exc_info:
            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
        changed_field = next(iter(update))
        assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
        assert exc_info.value.context.expected == f"{changed_field.removeprefix('max_')}_at_most_{next(iter(update.values()))}"
        assert exc_info.value.context.observed == observed_by_limit[changed_field]
        assert exc_info.value.context.safe_action is matching.MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK
        assert exc_info.value.context.spec_ref_id == base.spec_ref_id

    registry = matching.MatchSpecRegistry.compose((spec,))
    envelope = matching.PersistedMatchSpecEnvelope.from_spec(spec)
    restored = registry.restore_json(envelope.model_dump_json())

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return lazy_tuple(matching.match_lazy(txn, spec), matching.match_lazy(txn, restored)).resolve()

    result, restored_result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in result.edges) == (("query", "right"),)
    assert isinstance(restored_result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert tuple((edge.left.label, edge.right.label) for edge in restored_result.edges) == (("query", "right"),)

"""Matrix behavioral contracts for matching Phase 3."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from conform.bootstrap_families.core import CORE_V1
from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase3_result_policies import (
    MATCHING_OPERATOR_TABLES,
    Phase3DenseLeft,
    Phase3DenseRight,
    _artifact_state,
    _phase3_spec,
)
from data_layer.connection import AsyncDatabaseConnection, SyncDatabaseConnection
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from data_layer.transaction import AsyncReadTransaction, AsyncWriteTransaction, SyncReadTransaction, SyncWriteTransaction
from data_layer import matching as matching_operator

TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES = (Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseRight, *MATCHING_OPERATOR_TABLES)
TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY = CORE_V1


def _seed_dense_rows(connection: SyncDatabaseConnection) -> None:
    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseRight, Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))

    connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)


def test_phase3_semantic_product_executes_each_cells_own_outcome(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A stale-rejected cell cannot reuse a current allow-all result-class outcome."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_matrix_execution import execute_complete_semantic_product

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    report = execute_complete_semantic_product(db_connection)
    stale = next(
        outcome
        for outcome in report.cell_outcomes
        if outcome.version_scope == "unversioned"
        and outcome.permission_shape == "allow_all"
        and outcome.freshness_state == "stale_rejected"
        and outcome.left_type_name == "concrete"
        and outcome.right_type_name == "concrete"
        and outcome.result_shape == "global"
    )
    assert stale.public_outcome == "MatchFreshnessError"


def test_phase3_oracle_product_uses_each_cells_permission_outcome(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A deny-both oracle outcome must contain no observed or expected edge."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_matrix_execution import execute_oracle_bound_semantic_product

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    report = execute_oracle_bound_semantic_product(db_connection)
    denied = next(
        outcome
        for outcome in report.oracle_outcomes
        if outcome.version_scope == "unversioned"
        and outcome.permission_shape == "deny_both"
        and outcome.freshness_state == "current"
        and outcome.left_type_name == "concrete"
        and outcome.right_type_name == "concrete"
    )
    assert denied.observed_edges == ()
    assert denied.expected_edges == ()


def test_phase3_invalid_product_executes_each_required_error_class(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The invalid matrix must execute each freshness compatibility error class."""
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_matrix_execution import execute_phase3_matrix

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    report = execute_phase3_matrix(db_connection)
    assert {outcome.case_id for outcome in report.invalid_outcomes} == {
        "accept-stale-without-artifact",
        "bounded-watermark-without-artifact",
        "require-current-with-stale-artifact",
    }


def test_operator_plan_explanation_executes_through_public_transaction_api(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """MATCH-OBS-001 and MATCH-OBS-003 require usable artifact-aware operator diagnostics."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    spec = _phase3_spec("operator-explanation", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, _artifact_state(1, 1)),
    )
    explanation = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: matching.explain_match_plan(txn, spec),
    )
    assert isinstance(explanation.artifact_state, matching.MatchArtifactExecutionState)
    assert explanation.artifact_state.source_watermark == matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(1)


def test_operator_plan_explanation_has_lazy_public_parity_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """Protected plan explanation must use the same lazy intent as its sync adapter."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    spec = _phase3_spec("explain-lazy", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(2, 2)
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state),
    )

    def explain(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.explain_match_plan(txn, spec), matching.explain_match_plan_lazy(txn, spec).resolve()

    sync_result, lazy_result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=explain)
    assert lazy_result == sync_result


async def test_operator_plan_explanation_has_async_public_parity_tdd_red(
    async_db_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """Protected plan explanation must execute through the async caller transaction."""
    from data_layer import matching

    async def seed(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        await txn.insert_async(Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        await txn.insert_async(Phase3DenseRight, Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))

    await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write_async(fn=seed)
    spec = _phase3_spec("explain-async", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(2, 2)

    async def publish(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        await matching.publish_matching_artifact_async(txn, spec, state)

    await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write_async(fn=publish)

    async def explain(txn: AsyncReadTransaction):
        return await matching.explain_match_plan_async(txn, spec)

    result = await async_db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(fn=explain)
    assert result.spec_fingerprint == spec.semantic_fingerprint
    assert result.artifact_state == state


def test_synchronous_artifact_publication_rejects_divergent_watermarks(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """MATCH-MNT-003: synchronous state cannot be published stale and repaired by a read."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    spec = _phase3_spec("synchronous-stale-publication", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchFreshnessError):
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
            fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, _artifact_state(8, 7)),
        )


def test_bounded_watermark_observes_earlier_write_in_same_transaction(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A bounded watermark check observes an earlier write in its transaction."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    base = _phase3_spec("transaction-local-bounded-watermark", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    spec = validated_model_update(
        base,
        {
            "policies": validated_model_update(
                base.policies,
                {
                    "freshness": matching.RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy(
                        required_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(8),
                    ),
                },
            ),
        },
    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            spec,
            _artifact_state(8, 7, maintenance_mode="asynchronous"),
        ),
    )

    def advance_and_match(txn: SyncWriteTransaction):
        matching.publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            spec,
            _artifact_state(8, 8, generation=2),
        )
        return matching.match(txn, spec)

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=advance_and_match)
    assert isinstance(result.freshness, matching.MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics)
    assert result.freshness.artifact_watermark == matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(8)
    metadata = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=matching.list_matching_artifact_metadata)
    assert len(metadata) == 1
    assert metadata[0].artifact_watermark == 8


def test_artifact_rebuild_requires_a_new_generation(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """MATCH-MNT-006: replacement publication cannot reuse the visible generation."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    spec = _phase3_spec("generation-reuse", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(1, 1, generation=1)
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state),
    )
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchArtifactError):
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
            fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state),
        )


def test_rebuild_persists_authoritative_source_watermark(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A successful rebuild must not replace an advanced watermark with caller-supplied stale state."""
    from data_layer import matching

    _seed_dense_rows(db_connection)
    spec = _phase3_spec("authoritative-persisted-watermark", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    stale_state = _artifact_state(1, 1)
    rebuild_state = _artifact_state(1, 2, generation=2)
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, stale_state),
    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseLeft,
            Phase3DenseLeft(label="left-2", coordinate=2.0, representation_present=True),
        ),
    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            spec,
            rebuild_state,
            expected_source_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(2),
        ),
    )
    metadata = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=matching_operator.list_matching_artifact_metadata)
    assert len(metadata) == 1
    assert metadata[0].source_watermark == 2
    assert metadata[0].artifact_watermark == 2

"""Behavioral tests for matching Phase 3."""

from __future__ import annotations

from conform._async_test_helper import run_async_test_with_system_authority

import pytest

from conform.bootstrap_families.core import CORE_V1
from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update
from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_matrix_execution import Phase3ExecutionOutcome, Phase3OracleOutcome
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase3_result_policies import (
    MATCHING_OPERATOR_TABLES,
    Phase3DenseLeft,
    Phase3DenseRight,
    _artifact_state,
    _phase3_spec,
)
from data_layer.connection import AsyncDatabaseConnection, SyncDatabaseConnection
from data_layer.schema import BranchAwareIndexPolicy
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from data_layer.transaction import AsyncWriteTransaction, SyncReadTransaction, SyncWriteTransaction
from data_layer import matching as matching_operator

TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES = (Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseRight, *MATCHING_OPERATOR_TABLES)
TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY = CORE_V1


def _execute_matrix(
    connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    async_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
) -> Phase3ExecutionOutcome:
    from conform.l5250_matching.phase3_matrix_execution import (
        execute_phase3_async_matrix,
        execute_phase3_matrix,
    )

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseRight, Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))

    connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)
    report = execute_phase3_matrix(connection)

    async def execute_async_surface() -> tuple[Phase3OracleOutcome, ...]:
        return await execute_phase3_async_matrix(async_connection)

    async_outcomes = run_async_test_with_system_authority(execute_async_surface())
    assert async_outcomes
    return type(report).model_validate(
        {
            **report.model_dump(),
            "executed_case_ids": (*report.executed_case_ids, *(outcome.case_id for outcome in async_outcomes)),
            "edge_counts": (*report.edge_counts, *(len(outcome.observed_edges) for outcome in async_outcomes)),
            "ordered_labels": (*report.ordered_labels, *(outcome.observed_edges for outcome in async_outcomes)),
            "result_model_names": (*report.result_model_names, *("AsyncMatchResult" for _ in async_outcomes)),
            "execution_surfaces": ("lazy", "sync", "async"),
            "oracle_outcomes": (*report.oracle_outcomes, *async_outcomes),
        },
    )


def test_phase3_matrix_executes_every_public_surface(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    async_db_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """Each Phase 3 matrix outcome identifies lazy, synchronous, and asynchronous execution."""
    outcome = _execute_matrix(db_connection, async_db_connection)
    assert outcome.execution_surfaces == ("lazy", "sync", "async")


def test_phase3_invalid_matrix_cells_return_exact_public_errors(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    async_db_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The Phase 3 outcome contains the bounded public error from each invalid matrix cell."""
    outcome = _execute_matrix(db_connection, async_db_connection)
    assert outcome.invalid_outcomes
    assert all(outcome.error_context.safe_action for outcome in outcome.invalid_outcomes)


def test_phase3_matrix_matches_independent_oracle(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    async_db_connection: AsyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The Phase 3 outcome contains an independent-oracle result for each executed cell."""
    outcome = _execute_matrix(db_connection, async_db_connection)
    assert len(outcome.oracle_outcomes) == len(outcome.executed_case_ids)
    assert all(outcome.observed_edges == outcome.oracle_edges for outcome in outcome.oracle_outcomes)


def test_matching_artifact_policy_updates_atomically_with_source_mutation(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """One write transaction publishes its source row and synchronous artifact state."""
    from data_layer import matching

    policy_type = getattr(Phase3DenseLeft, "MatchingIndexPolicy", None)
    assert isinstance(policy_type, type)
    assert issubclass(policy_type, BranchAwareIndexPolicy)
    spec = _phase3_spec("atomic-source-mutation", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(1, 1)

    def mutate(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseLeft,
            Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        )
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseRight,
            Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        )
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state)

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=mutate)
    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, spec))
    assert isinstance(result.freshness, matching.MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics)
    assert result.freshness.artifact_watermark == matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(1)


def test_artifact_rebuild_rejects_concurrent_source_delta(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """Artifact publication rejects a source watermark that changed during the rebuild."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _phase3_spec("concurrent-delta", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(7, 7)

    def publish(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        publisher = getattr(matching_operator, "publish_matching_artifact")
        publisher(
            txn,
            spec,
            state,
            expected_source_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(6),
        )

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchFreshnessError) as exc_info:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=publish)
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant.value == "artifact_source_delta"


def test_branch_deletion_cleans_only_branch_scoped_matching_artifacts(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The operator API removes one branch's references without creating shared orphans."""
    from data_layer import matching

    deleted_spec = _phase3_spec("deleted-branch", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    retained_spec = _phase3_spec("retained-branch", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    deleted_state = _artifact_state(7, 7)
    deleted_identity = type(deleted_state.identity).model_validate(
        {**deleted_state.identity.model_dump(), "branch_scope": "branch:deleted"},
    )
    deleted_state = type(deleted_state).model_validate(
        {
            **deleted_state.model_dump(),
            "identity": deleted_identity,
            "indexed_left_identities": ("shared:left",),
        },
    )
    retained_state = _artifact_state(7, 7)

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, deleted_spec, deleted_state)
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, retained_spec, retained_state)

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)

    def execute(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> int:
        return matching.cleanup_matching_artifacts_for_deleted_branch(
            txn,
            matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue("branch:deleted"),
        )

    deletion_count = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(deletion_count, matching.MatchArtifactReferenceDeletionCount)
    assert deletion_count == 1

    def inspect(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        metadata = matching_operator.list_matching_artifact_metadata(txn)
        coverage = matching_operator.list_matching_artifact_coverage(txn, "shared:left")
        return metadata, coverage

    metadata, coverage = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=inspect)
    assert tuple(row.spec_ref_id for row in metadata) == (str(retained_spec.spec_ref_id),)
    assert coverage == []


def test_bounded_watermark_policy_has_no_cross_transaction_wait_controls() -> None:
    """Bounded freshness is a transaction-local requirement, not a polling API."""
    from data_layer import matching

    policy_type = getattr(matching, "RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy", None)
    assert policy_type is not None
    assert set(policy_type.model_fields) == {"kind", "required_watermark"}
    wait_policy_type = matching.WaitForBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy
    assert set(wait_policy_type.model_fields) == {"kind", "required_watermark"}


def test_bounded_watermark_accepts_visible_artifact_state(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The bounded policy accepts an artifact state already visible to the transaction."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _phase3_spec("bounded-watermark", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    spec = type(spec).model_validate(
        {
            **{name: getattr(spec, name) for name in type(spec).model_fields},
            "policies": type(spec.policies).model_validate(
                {
                    **{name: getattr(spec.policies, name) for name in type(spec.policies).model_fields},
                    "freshness": matching.RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy(
                        required_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(8),
                    ),
                },
            ),
        },
    )

    def publish_initial(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            spec,
            _artifact_state(8, 7, maintenance_mode="asynchronous"),
        )

    def publish_advance(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, _artifact_state(8, 8, generation=2))

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=publish_initial)
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=publish_advance)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, spec)

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(result.freshness, matching.MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics)
    assert result.freshness.artifact_watermark >= matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(8)


def test_phase3_complete_semantic_product_executes_typed_cell_outcomes(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """The complete Phase 3 factor product must map to executed public outcomes."""
    from conform.l5250_matching import phase3_matrix_execution

    execute_product = phase3_matrix_execution.execute_complete_semantic_product
    assert callable(execute_product)
    outcome = execute_product(db_connection)
    assert outcome.cell_outcomes
    assert all(cell.public_outcome is not None for cell in outcome.cell_outcomes)
    assert all(cell.execution_class_id for cell in outcome.cell_outcomes)


def test_matching_source_mutation_automatically_advances_synchronous_artifact(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A normal source write must advance synchronous policy state without manual publication."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _phase3_spec("automatic-source-maintenance", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseLeft(label="left-1", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseRight, Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, _artifact_state(1, 1))

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)

    def mutate_and_match(txn: SyncWriteTransaction):
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseLeft,
            Phase3DenseLeft(label="left-2", coordinate=2.0, representation_present=True),
        )
        return matching.match(txn, spec)

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=mutate_and_match)
    metadata = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=matching_operator.list_matching_artifact_metadata,
    )
    assert len(metadata) == 1
    assert metadata[0].source_watermark == 2
    assert metadata[0].artifact_watermark == 2
    assert metadata[0].source_row_count == 3
    assert isinstance(result.freshness, matching.MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics)
    assert result.freshness.source_watermark == matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(2)
    assert result.freshness.artifact_watermark == matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(2)


def test_artifact_rebuild_checks_authoritative_source_watermark(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """A rebuild cannot conceal a source delta by supplying a stale matching state payload."""
    from data_layer import matching

    spec = _phase3_spec("authoritative-source-delta", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(1, 1)
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state),
    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseLeft,
            Phase3DenseLeft(label="delta", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        ),
    )
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchFreshnessError) as exc_info:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
            fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(
                txn,
                spec,
                _artifact_state(1, 1, generation=2),
                expected_source_watermark=matching.MatchArtifactWatermark(1),
            ),
        )
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_SOURCE_DELTA


def test_branch_cleanup_removes_unshared_artifact_coverage(

    spec = _phase3_spec("deleted-unshared", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    state = _artifact_state(1, 1)
    identity = validated_model_update(state.identity, {"branch_scope": "branch:deleted"})
    state = validated_model_update(

    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(txn, spec, state),
    )
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(
        fn=lambda txn: matching.cleanup_matching_artifacts_for_deleted_branch(

    )
    coverage = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: matching_operator.list_matching_artifact_coverage(txn, "branch-only:left"),
    )
    assert not coverage


def test_bounded_watermark_composes_in_one_public_operation(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    """One transaction can advance artifact state and match against that state."""
    from data_layer import matching

    base = _phase3_spec("single-transaction-watermark", missing_policy=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy())
    spec = validated_model_update(
        base,
        {

        txn.insert(Phase3DenseRight, Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        matching_operator.publish_matching_artifact(
            txn,
            spec,
            _artifact_state(8, 7, maintenance_mode="asynchronous"),

    def advance_and_match(txn: SyncWriteTransaction):

            txn,

            _artifact_state(8, 8, generation=2),

    assert isinstance(result.freshness, matching.MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics)

async def test_branch_cleanup_has_branded_sync_and_async_public_outcomes(

def _phase3_spec(name: str, *, missing_policy):
    from data_layer import matching

    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(f"phase3:{name}"),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3DenseLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase3DenseLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3DenseLeft](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left:dense"),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3DenseLeft.coordinate)),),
                availability=matching.MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec.from_fields(
                    field(Phase3DenseLeft.representation_present),
                    field(Phase3DenseLeft.producer_failed),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3DenseRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase3DenseRight,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3DenseRight](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:right:dense"),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3DenseRight.coordinate)),),
                availability=matching.MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec.from_fields(
                    field(Phase3DenseRight.representation_present),
                    field(Phase3DenseRight.producer_failed),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dot"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=missing_policy,
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1)),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _shared_spec(name: str, self_edges):
    from data_layer import matching

    representation = matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3SharedDense](
        representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dense"),
        dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
        coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3SharedDense.coordinate)),),
    )
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(f"phase3:{name}"),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3SharedDense](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase3SharedDense,
            representation=representation,
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3SharedDense](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase3SharedDense,
            representation=representation,
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dot"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=self_edges,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(2)),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def _logical_self_spec(name: str):
    from data_layer import matching

    representation = matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3DuplicateLeft](
        representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dense"),
        dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
        coordinates=(
            matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(
                field(Phase3DuplicateLeft.coordinate),
            ),
        ),
    )
    relation = matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3DuplicateLeft](
        relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left"),
        row_type=Phase3DuplicateLeft,
        identity=matching.MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec.from_field(
            field(Phase3DuplicateLeft.logical_identity),
        ),
        representation=representation,
    )
    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(f"phase3:{name}"),
        left=relation,
        right=validated_model_update(
            relation,
            {
                "relation_ref_id": matching.MatchRelationRefId(
                    f"phase3:{name}:right",
                ),
            },
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dot"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.KeepFirstDuplicatePairPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(
            neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(2),
        ),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )


def test_self_edge_exclusion_uses_declared_canonical_identity(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """Distinct physical rows with one logical identity are still a self edge."""
    from data_layer import matching

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        for label, identity, coordinate in (
            ("a-first", "a", 2.0),
            ("a-second", "a", 3.0),
            ("b", "b", 1.0),
        ):
            txn.insert(
                Phase3DuplicateLeft,
                Phase3DuplicateLeft(
                    label=label,
                    logical_identity=identity,
                    coordinate=coordinate,
                ),
            )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, _logical_self_spec("logical-self-edge"))

    result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert {(edge.left.logical_identity, edge.right.logical_identity) for edge in result.edges} == {("a", "b"), ("b", "a")}
    assert result.work.excluded_self_pairs == 5


def test_self_edge_include_and_exclude_policies_tdd_red(db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    """Self-edge policy compares canonical row identities before score ranking."""
    from data_layer import matching

    inserted: list[Phase3SharedDense] = []

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        inserted.append(txn.insert(Phase3SharedDense, Phase3SharedDense(label="a", coordinate=1.0)))
        inserted.append(txn.insert(Phase3SharedDense, Phase3SharedDense(label="b", coordinate=2.0)))

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        included = matching.match(txn, _shared_spec("self-include", matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE))
        excluded = matching.match(txn, _shared_spec("self-exclude", matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE))
        return included, excluded

    included, excluded = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(included, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert isinstance(excluded, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    identities = {row.sys_id for row in inserted}
    assert {(edge.left.sys_id, edge.right.sys_id) for edge in included.edges} == {
        (left_id, right_id) for left_id in identities for right_id in identities
    }
    assert {(edge.left.sys_id, edge.right.sys_id) for edge in excluded.edges} == {
        (inserted[0].sys_id, inserted[1].sys_id),
        (inserted[1].sys_id, inserted[0].sys_id),
    }
    assert included.work.pair_evaluations == 4
    assert excluded.work.pair_evaluations == 2


def _poly_shared_spec(name: str):
    from data_layer import matching

    representation = matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3PolySharedDense](
        representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dense"),
        dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
        coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3PolySharedDense.coordinate)),),
    )
    relation = matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3PolySharedDense](
        relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:relation"),
        row_type=Phase3PolySharedDense,
        representation=representation,

def test_duplicate_pair_reject_keep_and_combine_policies_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """Each duplicate policy has one exact result before ranking."""
    from data_layer import matching

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DuplicateLeft,
            Phase3DuplicateLeft(label="first", logical_identity="left", coordinate=1.0),
        )
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DuplicateLeft,
            Phase3DuplicateLeft(label="second", logical_identity="left", coordinate=2.0),
        )
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DuplicateRight,
            Phase3DuplicateRight(label="right", logical_identity="right", coordinate=3.0),
        )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)
    reject_spec = _duplicate_spec("duplicate-reject", matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy())

    def reject(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, reject_spec)

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchCompatibilityError) as exc_info:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=reject)
    assert exc_info.value.context == matching.MatchErrorContext(
        invariant=matching.MatchInvariant.DUPLICATE_LOGICAL_PAIR,
        expected=matching.MatchExpectedValue("one_physical_pair_per_logical_pair"),
        observed=matching.MatchObservedValue("duplicate_logical_pairs_1"),
        safe_action=matching.MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
        spec_ref_id=reject_spec.spec_ref_id,
    )

    keep_spec = _duplicate_spec("duplicate-keep", matching.KeepFirstDuplicatePairPolicy())
    combine_base = _duplicate_spec(
        "duplicate-combine",
        matching.CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy(
            score_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateScoreCombination.SUM,
            explanation_combination=matching.MatchDuplicateExplanationCombination.CONCATENATE_BOUNDED,
        ),
    )
    combine_spec = validated_model_update(
        combine_base,
        {
            "policies": validated_model_update(
                combine_base.policies,
                {
                    "explanations": matching.DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy(
                        max_rows=matching.MatchExplanationRowLimit(2),
                    ),
                },
            ),
        },
    )

    def execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, keep_spec), matching.match(txn, combine_spec)

    kept, combined = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=execute)
    assert isinstance(kept, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert isinstance(combined, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert tuple((edge.left.label, float(edge.score.canonical)) for edge in kept.edges) == (("first", 3.0),)
    assert tuple((edge.left.label, float(edge.score.canonical)) for edge in combined.edges) == (("first", 9.0),)
    assert kept.work.duplicate_physical_pairs == matching.MatchDuplicatePairCount(1)
    assert combined.work.duplicate_physical_pairs == matching.MatchDuplicatePairCount(1)
    assert isinstance(combined.edges[0].diagnostics, matching.MatchExactDiagnostics)
    assert tuple(
        (
            float(explanation.left_value),
            float(explanation.right_value),
            float(explanation.contribution),
        )
        for explanation in combined.edges[0].diagnostics.explanations
    ) == ((1.0, 3.0, 3.0), (2.0, 3.0, 6.0))

            Phase3DenseLeft,
            Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        )
        for index, coordinate in enumerate((10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.0, 6.0), start=1):
            txn.insert(
                Phase3DenseRight,
                Phase3DenseRight(
                    label=f"right-{index}",
                    coordinate=coordinate,
                    representation_present=True,
                ),
            )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)
    first_spec = _paginated_global_spec(
        "cursor-full-snapshot",
        matching.FirstMatchPage(page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1)),
    )
    first_result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
        fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, first_spec),
    )
    assert isinstance(first_result, matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult)
    assert isinstance(first_result.page, matching.MatchNextPage)

    def insert_nonwinner(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseRight,
            Phase3DenseRight(
                label="outside-top-k",
                coordinate=1.0,
                representation_present=True,
            ),
        )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=insert_nonwinner)
    next_spec = _paginated_global_spec(
        "cursor-full-snapshot",
        matching.MatchPageAfterCursor(
            page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1),
            cursor=first_result.page.cursor,
        ),
    )
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchCursorError) as exc_info:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(
            fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, next_spec),
        )
    assert exc_info.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH

def test_cursor_rejects_different_specification_or_snapshot_tdd_red(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    """A cursor fails closed after specification or endpoint snapshot drift."""
    from data_layer import matching

    inserted: dict[str, Phase3DenseRight] = {}

    def seed(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(Phase3DenseLeft, Phase3DenseLeft(label="left", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True))
        inserted["right"] = txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseRight,
            Phase3DenseRight(label="right", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        )
        txn.insert(
            Phase3DenseRight,
            Phase3DenseRight(label="other", coordinate=1.0, representation_present=True),
        )

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=seed)
    first_spec = _paginated_global_spec("cursor-binding", matching.FirstMatchPage(page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1)))

    def first(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, first_spec)

    first_result = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=first)
    assert isinstance(first_result, matching.GlobalTopKMatchResult)
    assert isinstance(first_result.page, matching.MatchNextPage)
    cursor = first_result.page.cursor
    wrong_spec = _paginated_global_spec(
        "cursor-other-spec",
        matching.MatchPageAfterCursor(page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1), cursor=cursor),
    )

    def wrong(txn: SyncReadTransaction):
        return matching.match(txn, wrong_spec)

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchCursorError) as spec_error:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=wrong)

        txn.update(Phase3DenseRight, row)

    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=mutate)
    stale_spec = _paginated_global_spec(
        "cursor-binding",
        matching.MatchPageAfterCursor(page_size=matching.MatchPageSize(1), cursor=cursor),
    )

    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchCursorError) as snapshot_error:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=stale)
    assert snapshot_error.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH


def _versioned_match_spec(name: str):
    from data_layer import matching

    return matching.match_spec(
        spec_ref_id=matching.MatchSpecRefId(f"phase3:{name}"),
        pair_scope=matching.MatchPairScope(f"branch:{name}"),
        left=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedLeft](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedLeft,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3VersionedLeft](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:left:dense"),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3VersionedLeft.coordinate)),),
            ),
        ),
        right=matching.MatchRelationSpec[Phase3VersionedRight](
            relation_ref_id=matching.MatchRelationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:right"),
            row_type=Phase3VersionedRight,
            representation=matching.MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Phase3VersionedRight](
                representation_ref_id=matching.MatchRepresentationRefId(f"phase3:{name}:right:dense"),
                dimensions=matching.MatchVectorDimensions(1),
                coordinates=(matching.MatchDenseCoordinateSpec.from_field(field(Phase3VersionedRight.coordinate)),),
            ),
        ),
        kernel=matching.MatchKernelSpec(
            kernel_ref_id=matching.MatchKernelRefId(f"phase3:{name}:dot"),
            kind=matching.MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
            score_direction=matching.MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER,
        ),
        policies=matching.MatchPolicies(
            guarantee=matching.MatchGuarantee.EXACT,
            missing_representation=matching.FailMissingRepresentationPolicy(),
            self_edges=matching.MatchSelfEdgePolicy.INCLUDE,
            duplicates=matching.RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy(),
            freshness=matching.RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy(),
        ),
        result_shape=matching.TopKPerLeftMatchShape(neighbor_count=matching.NeighborCount(1)),
        filters=matching.MatchFilterSet.no_filters(),
        work_limits=matching.MatchWorkLimits.standard_exact_dense(),
    )
