def _typed_score_expression(
    expression: MatchScoreExpression,
    null_policy: MatchExpressionNullPolicy,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    field_expression: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression):
        field_expression = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(expression.row_type, str(expression.field_name))),
            qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        )
    elif isinstance(expression, MatchRightFieldExpression):
        field_expression = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(expression.row_type, str(expression.field_name))),
            qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
        )
    if field_expression is not None:
        if null_policy is MatchExpressionNullPolicy.COALESCE_ZERO:
            return SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.COALESCE, (field_expression, SqlParam(0.0)))
        return field_expression
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.ADD,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchMultiplyExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.MUL,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchSubtractExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.SUB,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.numerator, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.DIV,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.denominator, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        functions = {MatchExpressionFunction.ABSOLUTE: FunctionKind.ABS}
        return SqlFuncCall(
            functions[expression.function],
            (_typed_score_expression(expression.argument, null_policy),),
        )
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _expression_kernels(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> tuple[MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec, ...]:
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec):
        return (spec.kernel.candidate_kernel, spec.kernel.final_kernel)
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec):
        return (spec.kernel,)
    return ()


def _expression_kernel(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec | None:
    kernels = _expression_kernels(spec)
    return kernels[-1] if kernels else None


def _dense_score_expression(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    with_receipt: bool = False,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    expression_kernel = _expression_kernel(spec)
    if expression_kernel is not None:
        return _typed_score_expression(expression_kernel.expression, expression_kernel.null_policy)
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if left_representation.normalization != right_representation.normalization:
            msg = "Exact sparse matching requires equal token normalization"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return SqlArtifactAwareTermFrequencyDotProduct(
            left_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_id=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            case_fold=left_representation.normalization.kind == "unicode_words_casefolded",
        )
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if left_representation.normalization != right_representation.normalization:
            msg = "Exact string matching requires equal text normalization"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if left_representation.normalization.tokenization is not MatchTextTokenization.CODE_POINTS:
            msg = "The initial exact string scorer supports code-point units"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        normalization = left_representation.normalization
        left_text = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        )
        right_text = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
        )
        arguments = [
            left_text,
            right_text,
            SqlParam(normalization.unicode_form.value),
            SqlParam(normalization.case.value),
        ]
        if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec):
            return SqlArtifactAwareSubstringOccurrences(
                left_text=left_text,
                right_text=right_text,
                left_id=SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
                    qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
                ),
                right_id=SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
                    qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                ),
                artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
                unicode_form=normalization.unicode_form.value,
                case_handling=normalization.case.value,
                qgram_length=int(right_representation.qgram_length),
                with_receipt=with_receipt,
                complete_changed_sources=isinstance(spec.policies.freshness, ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy),
            )
        if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec):
            return SqlFuncCall(
                "nera_matching_banded_evaluation" if with_receipt else "nera_matching_banded_levenshtein",
                (*arguments, SqlParam(int(spec.kernel.threshold))),
            )
        msg = "Text representations require a string kernel"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if left_representation.dimensions != right_representation.dimensions:
            raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("equal_packed_dense_dimensions"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("mixed_packed_dense_dimensions"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        packed_score = SqlPackedDenseDotProduct(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            dimensions=int(left_representation.dimensions),
            physical_type=left_representation.native_profile.physical_type,
        )
        return _apply_missing_score(spec, left_representation, right_representation, packed_score)
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec):
            raise TypeError("H14 representations require the H14 Hamming kernel")
        if left_representation.projection_artifact_id != right_representation.projection_artifact_id:
            raise ValueError("H14 scoring cannot mix projection artifact generations")
        h14_score = SqlH14Similarity(
            _h14_sql_value(left_representation, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            _h14_sql_value(right_representation, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
        )
        return _apply_missing_score(spec, left_representation, right_representation, h14_score)
    if not isinstance(
        left_representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires a dense left representation"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires a dense right representation"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if left_representation.dimensions != right_representation.dimensions:
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires equal left and right dimensions"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    products = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            _dense_coordinate_expression(left_representation, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS, index),
            BinaryOp.MUL,
            _dense_coordinate_expression(right_representation, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS, index),
        )
        for index in range(int(left_representation.dimensions))
    ]
    terms: list[SqlRenderable] = list(products)
    while len(terms) > 1:
        combined: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for index in range(0, len(terms), 2):
            if index + 1 == len(terms):
                combined.append(terms[index])
            else:
                combined.append(SqlBinaryOp(terms[index], BinaryOp.ADD, terms[index + 1]))
        terms = combined
    score: SqlRenderable = terms[0]
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        score = SqliteMatchingProjection(
            sqlite=SqlFuncCall(
                "nera_matching_json_dot",
                (
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(
                            cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name)),
                        ),
                        qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
                    ),
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(
                            cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name)),
                        ),
                        qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                    ),
                    SqlParam(int(left_representation.dimensions)),
                ),
            ),
            portable=score,
        )
    return _apply_missing_score(spec, left_representation, right_representation, score)


def _h14_sql_value(
    representation: MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[Any],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    value: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
        qualifier=alias,
    )
    return value


def _apply_missing_score(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    left_representation: MatchRepresentationSpec,
    right_representation: MatchRepresentationSpec,
    score: SqlRenderable,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    missing_policy = spec.policies.missing_representation
    if not isinstance(missing_policy, EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy):
        return score
    both_present = sql_and(
        _representation_presence_expression(left_representation, _LEFT_ALIAS),
        _representation_presence_expression(right_representation, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
    )
    return SqlCase(
        ((both_present, score),),
        else_=SqlParam(float(missing_policy.score)),
    )


type _PredicateKey = tuple[int, int, bool, bool, BranchId | None, bool]
type _PredicateEntry = tuple[MatchSpec[Any, Any], SqlRenderable | None, SqlRenderable | None]
_PREDICATE_BUILD_CACHE: ContextVar[dict[_PredicateKey, _PredicateEntry] | None] = ContextVar(
    "matching_predicate_build_cache",
    default=None,
)


def _share_statement_predicates[**P, R](build: Callable[P, R]) -> Callable[P, R]:
    @wraps(build)
    def scoped(*args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> R:
        if _PREDICATE_BUILD_CACHE.get() is not None:
            return build(*args, **kwargs)
        token = _PREDICATE_BUILD_CACHE.set({})
        try:
            return build(*args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            _PREDICATE_BUILD_CACHE.reset(token)

    return scoped


def _endpoint_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    versioned_source_prefiltered: bool,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    representation = (spec.left if left else spec.right).representation
    include_presence = (
        include_presence
        and isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
        )
        and isinstance(representation.availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec | MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec)
    )
    key = (id(spec), id(permission), left, include_presence, versioned_branch_id, versioned_source_prefiltered)
    memo = _PREDICATE_BUILD_CACHE.get()
    if memo is not None and key in memo:
        return memo[key][2]
    predicate = _build_endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=left,
        permission=permission,
        include_presence=include_presence,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=versioned_source_prefiltered,
    )
    if memo is not None:
        memo[key] = (spec, permission, predicate)
    return predicate


def _build_endpoint_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    versioned_source_prefiltered: bool,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    filter_spec = spec.filters.left if left else spec.filters.right
    predicates = [] if permission is None else [permission]
    type_names = collect_polymorphic_type_names(relation.row_type)
    if type_names:
        predicates.append(
            SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, "type_name")),
                    qualifier=alias,
                ),
                tuple(SqlParam(name) for name in type_names),
            )
        )
    if _is_versioned_model(relation.row_type) and not versioned_source_prefiltered:
        if versioned_branch_id is None:
            msg = "Versioned matching requires a literal branch snapshot"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(versioned_branch_id)),
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(filter_spec, MatchEndpointFilterSpec):
        predicates.append(
            ExpressionToGrammar(relation.row_type, table_alias=str(alias)).convert(filter_spec.expression),
        )
    representation = relation.representation
    if (
        include_presence
        and isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
        )
        and isinstance(
            representation.availability,
            MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec | MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec,
        )
    ):
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        cached_db_column_name(
                            representation.availability.row_type,
                            str(representation.availability.field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(True),
            ),
        )
    return None if not predicates else sql_and(*predicates)


def _candidate_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    versioned_sources_prefiltered: bool,
    include_presence: bool = True,
    apply_self_policy: bool = True,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    predicates = [
        predicate
        for predicate in (
            _endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=True,
                permission=left_permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=versioned_sources_prefiltered,
            ),
            _endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=False,
                permission=right_permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=versioned_sources_prefiltered,
            ),
        )
        if predicate is not None
    ]
    if apply_self_policy and spec.policies.self_edges is MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE:
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                _sql_canonical_identity(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.NE,
                _sql_canonical_identity(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(spec.filters.pair, MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec):
        pair_operators = {
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.EQUAL: BinaryOp.EQ,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.NOT_EQUAL: BinaryOp.NE,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.LESS_THAN: BinaryOp.LT,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: BinaryOp.LE,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.GREATER_THAN: BinaryOp.GT,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: BinaryOp.GE,
        }
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        cached_db_column_name(
                            spec.filters.pair.left_row_type,
                            str(spec.filters.pair.left_field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
                ),
                pair_operators[spec.filters.pair.operator],
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        cached_db_column_name(
                            spec.filters.pair.right_row_type,
                            str(spec.filters.pair.right_field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return None if not predicates else sql_and(*predicates)


def _sql_canonical_identity(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlColumnRef:
    identity = relation.identity
    field_name = "sys_id" if isinstance(identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec) else str(identity.field_name)
    return SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, field_name)),
        qualifier=alias,
    )


def _ranked_identity_text(column: SqlColumnName) -> SqlCast:
    return SqlCast(
        SqlColumnRef(column, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
        SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT"),
    )


def _cursor_predicate(spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any], cursor: MatchPageCursor) -> SqlRenderable:
    left_identity = _ranked_identity_text(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)
    right_identity = _ranked_identity_text(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)
    rank = SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS)
    score = SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS)
    left_after = SqlBinaryOp(left_identity, BinaryOp.GT, SqlParam(str(cursor.left_identity)))
    left_equal = SqlBinaryOp(left_identity, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(cursor.left_identity)))
    right_after = SqlBinaryOp(right_identity, BinaryOp.GT, SqlParam(str(cursor.right_identity)))
    right_equal = SqlBinaryOp(right_identity, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(cursor.right_identity)))
    rank_after = SqlBinaryOp(rank, BinaryOp.GT, SqlParam(int(cursor.rank)))
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
        return SqlBinaryOp(left_after, BinaryOp.OR, SqlBinaryOp(left_equal, BinaryOp.AND, rank_after))
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        return SqlBinaryOp(right_after, BinaryOp.OR, SqlBinaryOp(right_equal, BinaryOp.AND, rank_after))
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
        return rank_after
    score_operator = BinaryOp.LT if spec.kernel.score_direction is MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER else BinaryOp.GT
    score_after = SqlBinaryOp(score, score_operator, SqlParam(float(cursor.score)))
    score_equal = SqlBinaryOp(score, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(float(cursor.score)))
    identity_after = SqlBinaryOp(
        left_after,
        BinaryOp.OR,
        SqlBinaryOp(left_equal, BinaryOp.AND, right_after),
    )
    return SqlBinaryOp(score_after, BinaryOp.OR, SqlBinaryOp(score_equal, BinaryOp.AND, identity_after))


@_share_statement_predicates
def _exact_dense_statement(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    purpose: Literal["publication", "qualifying_count"] = "publication",
    native_declaration: MatchSpec[Any, Any] | None = None,
    statement_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    if spec.kernel.kind not in {
        MatchKernelKind.BAG_OF_WORDS,
        MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT,
        MatchKernelKind.TYPED_EXPRESSION,
        MatchKernelKind.SUBSTRING,
        MatchKernelKind.EDIT_DISTANCE,
        MatchKernelKind.H14_HAMMING,
    }:
        msg = "Exact pair execution supports dense, lexical, and typed-expression kernels"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if spec.kernel.kind is MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT and spec.kernel.score_direction is not MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER:
        msg = "Dense dot-product execution requires higher-is-better ordering"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if spec.policies.guarantee is not MatchGuarantee.EXACT:
        msg = "Phase 2 exact dense execution rejects approximate guarantees"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not isinstance(
        spec.result_shape,
        TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape | GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape,
    ):
        msg = "Exact dense execution requires a supported result shape"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    if purpose == "qualifying_count":
        assert isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
        left_projection: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
        right_projection: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
        left_columns: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        right_columns: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        left_hints = right_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints()
    else:
        left_projection, left_columns, left_hints = _selected_model_columns(
            spec.left.row_type,
            source_alias=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            output_prefix="left__",
        )
        right_projection, right_columns, right_hints = _selected_model_columns(
            spec.right.row_type,
            source_alias=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            output_prefix="right__",
        )
    late_hydration = (
        purpose == "publication"
        and isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.left.identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec)
        and left_source.columns is None
        and right_source.columns is None
        and not isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
    )
    scored_left_projection = [] if late_hydration else left_projection
    scored_right_projection = [] if late_hydration else right_projection
    scored_left_columns = () if late_hydration else left_columns
    scored_right_columns = () if late_hydration else right_columns
    string_receipt = isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec | MatchSubstringKernelSpec) and purpose == "publication"
    h14_receipt = isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
    packed_receipt = isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
    numeric_receipt = h14_receipt or packed_receipt
    numeric_receipt_column = _H14_EXECUTED_BITS_COLUMN if h14_receipt else _EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN
    score_receipt = string_receipt or numeric_receipt
    score = _dense_score_expression(spec, with_receipt=string_receipt)
    left_id = SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(spec.left.row_type, "sys_id")),
        qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
    )
    right_id = SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(spec.right.row_type, "sys_id")),
        qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
    )
    left_identity = _sql_canonical_identity(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS)
    right_identity = _sql_canonical_identity(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS)
    endpoint_where = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
        include_presence=not isinstance(
            spec.policies.missing_representation,
            EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy,
        ),
    )
    # Preflight is a separate statement. Gate candidates and publish authority
    # under the scoring snapshot, including a receipt when every candidate is removed.
    admission_identity = f"{spec.semantic_fingerprint}:{statement_ref}".encode()
    admission_name = SqlCteStepName(
        f"_nera_match_admission_{hashlib.sha256(admission_identity).hexdigest()[:24]}",
    )
    admission_columns: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []

    def admission_value(column: SqlColumnName, expression: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
        admission_columns.append(SqlSelectAlias(expression, SqlAliasName(column)))
        return SqlCteFieldRef(admission_name, column)

    scoring_authority_count: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if purpose == "publication":
        if packed_receipt:
            scoring_authority_count = _native_plan_count_subquery(
                native_declaration if native_declaration is not None else spec,
            )
        elif h14_receipt:
            scoring_authority_count = _h14_artifact_count_subquery(spec)
    if scoring_authority_count is not None:
        scoring_authority_count = admission_value(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN, scoring_authority_count)
        authority_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(scoring_authority_count, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1))
        endpoint_where = authority_predicate if endpoint_where is None else sql_and(endpoint_where, authority_predicate)
    scoring_population_admitted: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if numeric_receipt and purpose == "publication":
        bounded_population = sql_and(
            *(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=left,
                        permission=permission,
                        include_presence=False,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=source,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.LE,
                    SqlParam(int(limit)),
                )
                for left, permission, source, limit in (
                    (True, left_permission, left_source, spec.work_limits.max_left_rows),
                    (False, right_permission, right_source, spec.work_limits.max_right_rows),
                )
            )
        )
        scoring_population_admitted = admission_value(
            _SCORING_POPULATION_ADMITTED_COLUMN,
            SqlCase(((bounded_population, SqlParam(1)),), else_=SqlParam(0)),
        )
        population_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(scoring_population_admitted, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1))
        endpoint_where = population_predicate if endpoint_where is None else sql_and(endpoint_where, population_predicate)
    scoring_unsafe_sources: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if h14_receipt and purpose == "publication":
        scoring_unsafe_sources = SqlBinaryOp(
            _unsafe_coordinate_count_subquery(
                spec,
                left=True,
                permission=left_permission,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                source=left_source,
            ),
            BinaryOp.ADD,
            _unsafe_coordinate_count_subquery(
                spec,
                left=False,
                permission=right_permission,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                source=right_source,
            ),
        )
        scoring_unsafe_sources = admission_value(_SCORING_UNSAFE_SOURCE_COUNT_COLUMN, scoring_unsafe_sources)
        source_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(scoring_unsafe_sources, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(0))
        endpoint_where = source_predicate if endpoint_where is None else sql_and(endpoint_where, source_predicate)
    wand_top_k = (
        isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape)
    )
    candidate_score = score
    wand_bound_rank: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if wand_top_k:
        left_representation = spec.left.representation
        right_representation = spec.right.representation
        assert isinstance(left_representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        assert isinstance(right_representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        candidate_score = SqlArtifactAwareWandUpperBound(
            left_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_id=right_id,
            artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            case_fold=left_representation.normalization.kind == "unicode_words_casefolded",
        )
        wand_bound_rank = SqlWindow(
            func_name=FunctionKind.DENSE_RANK,
            partition_by=(left_identity,),
            order_by=(SqlOrderByItem(candidate_score, OrderDirection.DESC),),
        )
    duplicate_partition = (left_identity, right_identity)
    duplicate_policy = spec.policies.duplicates
    pair_identities_unique = (
        isinstance(spec.left.identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec)
        and left_source.columns is None
        and right_source.columns is None
    )
    if isinstance(duplicate_policy, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy) and not score_receipt and not pair_identities_unique:
        aggregate_name = "SUM" if duplicate_policy.score_combination is MatchDuplicateScoreCombination.SUM else "MAX"
        effective_score: SqlRenderable = SqlWindow(
            func=SqlFuncCall(aggregate_name, [candidate_score]),
            partition_by=duplicate_partition,
        )

    executed_weight: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(1024 if h14_receipt else 1)
    right_relation: SqlRenderable = _endpoint_source_relation(

    if (

        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape)
        and spec.native_exact_choice.strategy is NativeExactExecutionStrategy.PER_LEFT_LATERAL
    ):
        native_distance = SqlPackedDenseDotProduct(
            SqlColumnRef(

            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(
                    cached_db_column_name(

            physical_type=spec.left.representation.native_profile.physical_type,

        present = sql_and(
            _representation_presence_expression(spec.left.representation, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            _representation_presence_expression(spec.right.representation, _RIGHT_ALIAS),

        native_distance_expr: SqlRenderable = native_distance
        if isinstance(spec.policies.missing_representation, EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy):

        lateral_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlStar(_RIGHT_ALIAS),
                    SqlSelectAlias(native_distance_expr, SqlAliasName(_NATIVE_DISTANCE_COLUMN)),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlCase(((present, SqlParam(1)),), else_=SqlParam(None))])),
                        SqlAliasName(_NATIVE_INPUT_COUNT_COLUMN),

            ),
            from_=right_relation,
            where=endpoint_where,
            order_by=(
                SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_NATIVE_DISTANCE_COLUMN), OrderDirection.ASC),
                SqlOrderByItem(right_identity, OrderDirection.ASC),
                SqlOrderByItem(right_id, OrderDirection.ASC),
            ),
            limit=(

                if isinstance(spec.right.identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec)
                and not isinstance(spec.policies.missing_representation, EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy)
                else None

        )
        right_relation = SqlPostgresLateralRelation(
            postgres_inner=SqlSubqueryTableRef(lateral_query, SqlTableName(str(_RIGHT_ALIAS))),
            portable_fallback=right_relation,

        effective_score = SqlNativeExactProjection(
            postgres=_apply_missing_score(
                spec,
                spec.left.representation,
                spec.right.representation,

            postgres=SqlCase(
                (
                    (
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlWindow(
                                func_name=FunctionKind.ROW_NUMBER,
                                partition_by=(left_id,),
                                order_by=(
                                    SqlOrderByItem(SqlCase(((present, SqlParam(0)),), else_=SqlParam(1)), OrderDirection.ASC),
                                    SqlOrderByItem(right_id, OrderDirection.ASC),

                            ),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(1),

                        SqlColumnRef(_NATIVE_INPUT_COUNT_COLUMN, qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS),

            portable=executed_weight,

    candidates = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [

                *scored_right_projection,
                SqlSelectAlias(left_identity, SqlAliasName(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(right_identity, SqlAliasName(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(effective_score, SqlAliasName(_EDIT_EVALUATION_COLUMN if string_receipt else _EFFECTIVE_SCORE_COLUMN)),
                *(

                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            sql_and(

                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlParam(1)
                    if pair_identities_unique

                        func_name=FunctionKind.ROW_NUMBER,
                        partition_by=duplicate_partition,

                            SqlOrderByItem(left_id, OrderDirection.ASC),
                            SqlOrderByItem(right_id, OrderDirection.ASC),

                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlParam(1)
                    if pair_identities_unique

                    SqlAliasName(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
        joins=(

    if string_receipt:
        evaluation_columns = (
            *scored_left_columns,
            *scored_right_columns,
            str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
            str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
            str(_EDIT_EVALUATION_COLUMN),
            str(_DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN),

                    SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=evaluation_alias),
                ),

        candidates = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlStar(evaluation_alias),
                    SqlSelectAlias(evaluated_distance, SqlAliasName(_EFFECTIVE_SCORE_COLUMN)),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlFuncCall(
                            "COALESCE", (SqlJsonAccess(JsonAccessKind.GET_INT, evaluation, path=SqlJsonPath("$.overlap")), SqlParam(0))
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName(_STRING_OVERLAP_COLUMN),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlWindow(
                                func=SqlFuncCall(
                                    "SUM",
                                    [
                                        SqlFuncCall(
                                            "COALESCE",
                                            [SqlJsonAccess(JsonAccessKind.GET_INT, evaluation, path=SqlJsonPath("$.cells")), SqlParam(0)],

                                    ],

                            SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),

                        SqlAliasName(_EDIT_EXECUTED_CELLS_COLUMN),

                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlCast(SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("SUM", [value])), SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT")),

                                _STRING_POSTINGS_COLUMN,
                                SqlFuncCall(

                                    (SqlJsonAccess(JsonAccessKind.GET_INT, evaluation, path=SqlJsonPath("$.candidate")), SqlParam(0)),

                            ),

                                SqlCase(

                                    else_=SqlBinaryOp(

                                        BinaryOp.SUB,
                                        SqlFuncCall(
                                            "COALESCE",
                                            (
                                                SqlJsonAccess(JsonAccessKind.GET_INT, evaluation, path=SqlJsonPath("$.candidate")),

                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),

    if numeric_receipt:
        evaluation_columns = (
            *scored_left_columns,
            *scored_right_columns,
            str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
            str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
            str(_EFFECTIVE_SCORE_COLUMN),
            str(_NUMERIC_PRESENT_COLUMN),
            str(_EVALUATION_WEIGHT_COLUMN),

            str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),

        sentinel = SqlSelect(

        evaluation_alias = SqlAliasName("matching_evaluations")
        evaluated_score: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(_EFFECTIVE_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=evaluation_alias)

        if isinstance(duplicate_policy, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy) and not pair_identities_unique:

                func=SqlFuncCall(

                    [evaluated_score],

                    SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=evaluation_alias),

    explanation_columns: tuple[str, ...] = ()

        assert isinstance(right_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec)

        generated_columns: list[str] = []

        candidates = SqlSelect(

    deduplicated_score: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(_EFFECTIVE_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_CANDIDATE_ALIAS)
    deduplicated_predicate: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(

            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(_WAND_BOUND_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.LE,
                SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count)),

                SqlStar(_CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
                SqlSelectAlias(

                    SqlAliasName(_SCORE_COLUMN),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(candidates, _CANDIDATE_ALIAS),

    ranked_right_identity = SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS)
    ranked_score = SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS)
    rank_partition: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    rank_tie_identities: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        rank_partition = (ranked_right_identity,)
        rank_tie_identities = (ranked_left_identity,)
    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):

        rank_tie_identities = (ranked_right_identity,)

    output_columns = (

        str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_SCORE_COLUMN),
        str(_RANK_COLUMN),

        str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
        str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),

        *((str(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN),) if scoring_authority_count is not None else ()),
        *((str(_SCORING_POPULATION_ADMITTED_COLUMN),) if scoring_population_admitted is not None else ()),
        *((str(_SCORING_UNSAFE_SOURCE_COUNT_COLUMN),) if scoring_unsafe_sources is not None else ()),
        *((str(_H14_EXECUTED_BITS_COLUMN),) if h14_receipt else ()),
        *(

                str(_STRING_POSTINGS_COLUMN),
                str(_STRING_CANDIDATES_COLUMN),
                str(_STRING_COMPLETION_COLUMN),
                str(_STRING_OVERLAP_COLUMN),

            else ()

            receipt = SqlCast(

                SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({count_column})),

        return (

                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()]), SqlAliasName(count_column)),

                from_=SqlTableAlias(deduplicated, _DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS),

    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):

            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),

            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), OrderDirection.ASC),

    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        result_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),

            SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count)),
        )
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),

    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):

        result_predicate = _score_threshold_predicate(spec, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS)
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), score_order),
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
        )
        result_limit = int(spec.result_shape.result_limit) + 1
    pagination = spec.result_shape.pagination
    if isinstance(pagination, MatchPageAfterCursor):
        cursor = pagination.cursor
        if cursor.result_shape is not spec.result_shape.kind:
            raise MatchCursorError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SPECIFICATION_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"result_shape_{spec.result_shape.kind.value}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"result_shape_{cursor.result_shape.value}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.RESTART_PAGINATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if cursor.spec_fingerprint != spec.semantic_fingerprint:
            raise MatchCursorError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SPECIFICATION_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"spec_{spec.semantic_fingerprint}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"spec_{cursor.spec_fingerprint}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.RESTART_PAGINATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        cursor_predicate = _cursor_predicate(spec, cursor)
        result_predicate = cursor_predicate if result_predicate is None else SqlBinaryOp(result_predicate, BinaryOp.AND, cursor_predicate)
    if isinstance(pagination, FirstMatchPage | MatchPageAfterCursor):
        result_limit = int(pagination.page_size) + 1
    if score_receipt:
        sentinel_predicate = SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS))
        if result_predicate is not None:
            result_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(result_predicate, BinaryOp.OR, sentinel_predicate)
        result_order = (SqlOrderByItem(sentinel_predicate, OrderDirection.DESC), *result_order)
        if result_limit is not None:
            result_limit += 1
    outer_projection: list[SqlRenderable]
    outer_joins: tuple[SqlJoin, ...]
    if late_hydration:
        hydrated_left_projection, _, _ = _selected_model_columns(
            spec.left.row_type,
            source_alias=_HYDRATED_LEFT_ALIAS,
            output_prefix="left__",
        )
        hydrated_right_projection, _, _ = _selected_model_columns(
            spec.right.row_type,
            source_alias=_HYDRATED_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            output_prefix="right__",
        )
        endpoint_columns = {*left_columns, *right_columns}
        outer_projection = [
            *hydrated_left_projection,
            *hydrated_right_projection,
            *(
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                    SqlAliasName(column),
                )
                for column in output_columns
                if column not in endpoint_columns
            ),
        ]
        outer_joins = (
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.INNER,
                SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(_matching_table_name(spec.left.row_type)),
                    _HYDRATED_LEFT_ALIAS,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    _sql_canonical_identity(spec.left, _HYDRATED_LEFT_ALIAS),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.INNER,
                SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(_matching_table_name(spec.right.row_type)),
                    _HYDRATED_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    _sql_canonical_identity(spec.right, _HYDRATED_RIGHT_ALIAS),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
        )
    else:
        outer_projection = [
            SqlSelectAlias(
                scoring_authority_count
                if column == str(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN) and scoring_authority_count is not None
                else scoring_population_admitted
                if column == str(_SCORING_POPULATION_ADMITTED_COLUMN) and scoring_population_admitted is not None
                else scoring_unsafe_sources
                if column == str(_SCORING_UNSAFE_SOURCE_COUNT_COLUMN) and scoring_unsafe_sources is not None
                else SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                SqlAliasName(column),
            )
            for column in output_columns
        ]
        outer_joins = ()
    outer = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(outer_projection),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(ranked, _RANKED_ALIAS),
        joins=outer_joins,
        where=result_predicate,
        order_by=result_order,
        limit=result_limit,
    )
    hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
        output_columns,
        left_hints,
        right_hints,
        SqlColumnTypeHints(
            double_columns=frozenset({str(_SCORE_COLUMN), *explanation_columns}),
            text_columns=frozenset({str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN), str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)}),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(
                {
                    str(_RANK_COLUMN),
                    *((str(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN),) if isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape) else ()),
                    str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                    str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
                    *((str(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN),) if scoring_authority_count is not None else ()),
                    *((str(_SCORING_POPULATION_ADMITTED_COLUMN),) if scoring_population_admitted is not None else ()),
                    *((str(_SCORING_UNSAFE_SOURCE_COUNT_COLUMN),) if scoring_unsafe_sources is not None else ()),
                    *((str(_H14_EXECUTED_BITS_COLUMN),) if h14_receipt else ()),
                    *(
                        (str(_EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),)
                        if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
                        else ()
                    ),
                    *(
                        (
                            str(_EDIT_EXECUTED_CELLS_COLUMN),
                            str(_STRING_POSTINGS_COLUMN),
                            str(_STRING_CANDIDATES_COLUMN),
                            str(_STRING_COMPLETION_COLUMN),
                            str(_STRING_OVERLAP_COLUMN),
                        )
                        if string_receipt
                        else ()
                    ),
                },
            ),
        ),
    )
    if admission_columns:
        # LIMIT keeps this one-row relation non-mergeable on MariaDB.
        admission_query = SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList(admission_columns), limit=1)
        statement = SqlStatementLocalWith(
            (SqlCteDefinition(name=admission_name, query=admission_query, materialized=True),),
            outer,
        )
        return statement, output_columns, hints
    return outer, output_columns, hints


def _endpoint_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    count_expression: SqlRenderable = SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])
    if source.columns is not None:
        count_expression = SqlAggregate(
            AggregateKind.COUNT,
            _identity_sql_expression(relation, alias),
            distinct=True,
        )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([count_expression]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=_endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=left,
                permission=permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _endpoint_failure_count_expression(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    representation = relation.representation
    if not isinstance(
        representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ) or not isinstance(representation.availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec):
        return SqlParam(0)
    visibility = _endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=left,
        permission=permission,
        include_presence=False,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
    )
    failure = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(
                cached_db_column_name(
                    representation.availability.row_type,
                    str(representation.availability.producer_failure_field_name),
                ),
            ),
            qualifier=alias,
        ),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlParam(True),
    )
    where = failure if visibility is None else sql_and(visibility, failure)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=where,
        ),
    )

def _pair_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    apply_self_policy: bool = True,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    sources_are_prefiltered = left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None
    pair_source = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(_identity_sql_expression(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS), SqlAliasName("left_identity")),
                SqlSelectAlias(_identity_sql_expression(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS), SqlAliasName("right_identity")),
            ],
            distinct=sources_are_prefiltered,
        ),
        from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
        joins=(
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.CROSS,
                _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
            ),
        ),
        where=_candidate_predicate(
            spec,
            left_permission=left_permission,
            right_permission=right_permission,
            include_presence=include_presence,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            versioned_sources_prefiltered=sources_are_prefiltered,
            apply_self_policy=apply_self_policy,
        ),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(pair_source, SqlAliasName("match_counted_pairs")),
        ),
    )


def _identity_sql_expression(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlColumnRef:
    identity = relation.identity
    if isinstance(identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec):
        field_name = "sys_id"
    elif isinstance(identity, MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec):
        field_name = str(identity.field_name)
    else:
        msg = f"Unknown matching identity variant: {type(identity).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, field_name)),
        qualifier=alias,
    )


def _coverage_join_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    *,
    endpoint: str,
    endpoint_identity: SqlRenderable,
    coverage_alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    def coverage_column(field_name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
        return SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow, field_name)),
            qualifier=coverage_alias,
        )

    return sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlCast(endpoint_identity, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            coverage_column("identity"),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(coverage_column("spec_ref_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(spec.spec_ref_id))),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            coverage_column("spec_fingerprint"),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(spec.semantic_fingerprint)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(coverage_column("pair_scope"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(spec.pair_scope))),
        SqlBinaryOp(coverage_column("endpoint"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(endpoint)),
    )


def _indexed_pair_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not isinstance(spec.policies.freshness, ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy):
        return SqlParam(0)
    left_coverage_alias = SqlAliasName("match_left_coverage")
    right_coverage_alias = SqlAliasName("match_right_coverage")
    coverage_table = _matching_table_name(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(coverage_table), left_coverage_alias),
                    on=_coverage_join_predicate(
                        spec,
                        endpoint="left",
                        endpoint_identity=_identity_sql_expression(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS),
                        coverage_alias=left_coverage_alias,
                    ),
                ),
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(coverage_table), right_coverage_alias),
                    on=_coverage_join_predicate(
                        spec,
                        endpoint="right",
                        endpoint_identity=_identity_sql_expression(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                        coverage_alias=right_coverage_alias,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            where=_candidate_predicate(
                spec,
                left_permission=left_permission,
                right_permission=right_permission,
                include_presence=True,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _endpoint_payload_bytes_expression(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    terms: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    constant_width = 0
    columns = {name: cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, name) for name in relation.row_type.model_fields}
    hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(relation.row_type, tuple(columns.values()))
    if hints is None:
        raise TypeError("Payload accounting requires declared SQL column type metadata")
    for field_name, column_name in columns.items():
        if column_name in hints.text_columns:
            column = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=alias)
            terms.append(SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall("OCTET_LENGTH", (column,)), SqlParam(0))))
        elif isinstance(relation.representation, MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec) and field_name == str(
            relation.representation.field_name
        ):
            constant_width += int(relation.representation.dimensions) * 8
        elif column_name in hints.bool_columns:
            constant_width += 1
        elif field_name == "sys_id":
            constant_width += 16
        else:
            constant_width += 8
    total: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(constant_width)
    for term in terms:
        total = SqlBinaryOp(total, BinaryOp.ADD, term)
    return total


def _endpoint_payload_aggregate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    aggregate: str,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    payload = _endpoint_payload_bytes_expression(relation, alias)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall(aggregate, (payload,)), SqlParam(0)))]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=_endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=left,
                permission=permission,
                include_presence=True,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _pair_payload_bytes_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    def aggregate(left: bool, function: str) -> SqlSubquery:
        return _endpoint_payload_aggregate(
            spec,
            left=left,
            aggregate=function,
            permission=left_permission if left else right_permission,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            source=left_source if left else right_source,
        )

    def count(left: bool) -> SqlSubquery:
        return _endpoint_count_subquery(
            spec,
            left=left,
            permission=left_permission if left else right_permission,
            include_presence=True,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            source=left_source if left else right_source,
        )

    shape = spec.result_shape
    if isinstance(shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        partition_left = isinstance(shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape)
        k = SqlParam(int(shape.neighbor_count))
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlBinaryOp(aggregate(partition_left, "SUM"), BinaryOp.MUL, k),
            BinaryOp.ADD,
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlBinaryOp(count(partition_left), BinaryOp.MUL, k),
                BinaryOp.MUL,
                aggregate(not partition_left, "MAX"),
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
        k = SqlParam(int(shape.neighbor_count))
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlBinaryOp(aggregate(True, "MAX"), BinaryOp.ADD, aggregate(False, "MAX")),
            BinaryOp.MUL,
            k,
        )
    assert isinstance(shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape)
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlBinaryOp(aggregate(True, "SUM"), BinaryOp.MUL, count(False)),
        BinaryOp.ADD,
        SqlBinaryOp(aggregate(False, "SUM"), BinaryOp.MUL, count(True)),
    )


def _balanced_sql_or(predicates: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]) -> SqlRenderable:
    terms: list[SqlRenderable] = list(predicates)
    while len(terms) > 1:
        combined: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for index in range(0, len(terms), 2):
            combined.append(
                terms[index] if index + 1 == len(terms) else SqlBinaryOp(terms[index], BinaryOp.OR, terms[index + 1]),
            )
        terms = combined
    return terms[0]
