            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow, "batch_scan_cost"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(float(choice.batch_scan_cost)),
        ),
    )
    predicate = predicates[0]
    for item in predicates[1:]:
        predicate = SqlBinaryOp(predicate, BinaryOp.AND, item)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(get_table_name(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow))),
            where=predicate,
        )
    )


def _count_h14_tensor(reference: object, role: str, artifact: H14ProjectionArtifact) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not isinstance(reference, ArtifactTensorRef):
        raise TypeError("H14 artifact contains an invalid tensor reference")
    predicates = (
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "artifact_id"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(artifact.artifact_id),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "role"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(role),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "digest"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(reference.digest)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlSha256HexDigest(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "payload")),
                )
            ),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(reference.digest)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "byte_count"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(int(reference.byte_count)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlFuncCall(
                "LENGTH",
                (SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, "payload"))),),
            ),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(int(reference.byte_count)),
        ),
    )
    metadata = (
        ("shape", "x".join(str(int(size)) for size in reference.shape)),
        ("dtype", reference.dtype),
        ("byte_order", reference.byte_order),
        ("tenant_scope", str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant)),
        ("workspace_scope", str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace)),
        ("branch_scope", str(artifact.fit_scope.branch)),
        ("permission_scope", str(artifact.fit_scope.permission)),
    )
    predicate = sql_and(
        *predicates,
        *(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow, column))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(value),
            )
            for column, value in metadata
        ),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(get_table_name(MatchingProjectionTensorRow))),
            where=predicate,
        ),
    )


def _h14_artifact_count_subquery(spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any]) -> SqlRenderable:
    representation = spec.left.representation
    if not isinstance(representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec):
        return SqlParam(1)
    artifact = representation.projection_artifact
    if not isinstance(artifact, H14ProjectionArtifact):
        return SqlParam(1)
    artifact_predicates = (
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "artifact_id"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(artifact.artifact_id),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "artifact_fingerprint"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fingerprint())),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "contract_payload"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(artifact.model_dump_json()),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "algorithm_version"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.algorithm_version)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "tenant_scope"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "workspace_scope"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "branch_scope"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.branch)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "revision_scope"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.revision)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, "permission_scope"))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.permission)),
        ),
    )
    artifact_predicate = artifact_predicates[0]
    for item in artifact_predicates[1:]:
        artifact_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(artifact_predicate, BinaryOp.AND, item)
    artifact_count = SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(get_table_name(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow))),
            where=artifact_predicate,
        ),
    )
    complete = SqlBinaryOp(artifact_count, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1))
    if isinstance(spec.policies.freshness, RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy):
        activation_predicates = (
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "deployment_scope"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.deployment)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "tenant_scope"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "workspace_scope"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "branch_scope"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.branch)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "permission_scope"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fit_scope.permission)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "artifact_id"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(artifact.artifact_id),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow, "artifact_fingerprint"))),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fingerprint())),
            ),
        )
        activation_predicate = activation_predicates[0]
        for item in activation_predicates[1:]:
            activation_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(activation_predicate, BinaryOp.AND, item)
        activation_count = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(get_table_name(MatchingProjectionActivationRow))),
                where=activation_predicate,
            ),
        )
        complete = SqlBinaryOp(
            complete,
            BinaryOp.AND,
            SqlBinaryOp(activation_count, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1)),
        )
    for role, reference in (
        ("mean", artifact.mean_tensor),
        ("rotation", artifact.rotation_tensor),
        ("threshold", artifact.threshold_tensor),
        ("residual", artifact.residual_tensor),
    ):
        complete = SqlBinaryOp(
            complete,
            BinaryOp.AND,
            SqlBinaryOp(_count_h14_tensor(reference, role, artifact), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1)),
        )
    return SqlCase(((complete, SqlParam(1)),), else_=SqlParam(0))


def _unsafe_coordinate_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    representation = relation.representation
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    if isinstance(representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        representation.projection_artifact,
        H14ProjectionArtifact,
    ):
        artifact = representation.projection_artifact
        code = _h14_sql_value(representation, alias)
        row_id = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
            qualifier=alias,
        )
        source_value = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, str(representation.source_field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        )
        binding_alias = SqlAliasName("h14_code_binding")
        binding_predicates = (
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "row_type_ref")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(f"{representation.row_type.__module__}.{representation.row_type.__qualname__}"),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "row_id")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                row_id,
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "field_name")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(representation.field_name)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "source_field_name")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(representation.source_field_name)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "representation_ref_id")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(representation.representation_ref_id)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "artifact_id")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(representation.projection_artifact_id),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "artifact_fingerprint")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(artifact.fingerprint())),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "code_digest")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlH14CodeDigest(code),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow, "source_fingerprint")),
                    qualifier=binding_alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlSha256HexDigest(source_value),
            ),
        )
        binding_predicate = binding_predicates[0]
        for item in binding_predicates[1:]:
            binding_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(binding_predicate, BinaryOp.AND, item)
        binding_exists = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(get_table_name(MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow))),
                    binding_alias,
                ),
                where=binding_predicate,
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        unsafe_predicates: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] = (
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlH14BitLength(code), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(1024)),
            binding_exists,
        )
    elif isinstance(representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
        packed = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        )
        unsafe_predicates = (
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlPackedDenseIsValid(packed, dimensions=int(representation.dimensions)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
        )
    elif isinstance(representation, MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        vector = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        )
        unsafe_predicates = (
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlDenseJsonVectorIsValid(
                    vector,
                    dimensions=int(representation.dimensions),
                    maximum_coordinate=float(MatchDenseValue.maximum_exact_coordinate()),
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
        )
    elif isinstance(representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec):
        unsafe_predicates = tuple(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlFuncCall("ABS", (_dense_coordinate_expression(representation, relation.row_type, alias, index),)),
                BinaryOp.GT,
                SqlParam(float(MatchDenseValue.maximum_exact_coordinate())),
            )
            for index in range(int(representation.dimensions))
        )
    else:
        return SqlSubquery(SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(0)])))
    visibility = _endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=left,
        permission=permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
    )
    unsafe = _balanced_sql_or(unsafe_predicates)
    where = unsafe if visibility is None else sql_and(visibility, unsafe)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=where,
        ),
    )


def _score_threshold_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    *,
    qualifier: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlBinaryOp:
    shape = spec.result_shape
    assert isinstance(shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
    if spec.kernel.score_direction is MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER:
        operator = BinaryOp.GE if shape.boundary.value == "inclusive" else BinaryOp.GT
    else:
        operator = BinaryOp.LE if shape.boundary.value == "inclusive" else BinaryOp.LT
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=qualifier),
        operator,
        SqlParam(float(shape.threshold)),
    )


def _threshold_qualifying_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    numeric_receipt: bool = False,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape) or isinstance(
        spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec | MatchSubstringKernelSpec
    ):
        return SqlParam(0)
    if numeric_receipt != (
        isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
        or isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
    ):
        return SqlParam(None if numeric_receipt else 0)
    qualifying_query, _columns, _hints = _exact_dense_statement(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source=left_source,
        right_source=right_source,
        purpose="qualifying_count",
    )
    return SqlSubquery(qualifying_query)


def _expression_children(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> tuple[MatchScoreExpression, ...]:
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        return (expression.left, expression.right)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return (expression.numerator, expression.denominator)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        return (expression.argument,)
    return ()


def _expression_nodes(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> tuple[MatchScoreExpression, ...]:
    return (expression, *(node for child in _expression_children(expression) for node in _expression_nodes(child)))


def _expression_failure_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    expression_kernel: MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec,
    *,
    failure: str,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    nodes = _expression_nodes(expression_kernel.expression)
    predicates: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    if failure == "null":
        if expression_kernel.null_policy is MatchExpressionNullPolicy.COALESCE_ZERO:
            return SqlParam(0)
        fields = tuple(node for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchLeftFieldExpression | MatchRightFieldExpression))
        predicates = tuple(SqlIsNull(_typed_score_expression(node, MatchExpressionNullPolicy.REJECT)) for node in fields)
    elif failure == "zero_denominator":
        denominators = tuple(node.denominator for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchDivideExpression))
        predicates = tuple(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                _typed_score_expression(node, expression_kernel.null_policy),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(0.0),
            )
            for node in denominators
        )
    elif failure == "unsafe":
        multiplications = tuple(node for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchMultiplyExpression))
        divisions = tuple(node for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchDivideExpression))
        multiplication_predicates = tuple(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.left, expression_kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.right, expression_kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.left, expression_kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlParam(float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023")),
                        BinaryOp.DIV,
                        SqlFuncCall(
                            FunctionKind.ABS,
                            (_typed_score_expression(node.right, expression_kernel.null_policy),),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            for node in multiplications
        )
        division_predicates = tuple(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(
                        FunctionKind.ABS,
                        (_typed_score_expression(node.denominator, expression_kernel.null_policy),),
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlFuncCall(
                            FunctionKind.ABS,
                            (_typed_score_expression(node.numerator, expression_kernel.null_policy),),
                        ),
                        BinaryOp.DIV,
                        SqlParam(float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023")),
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlFuncCall(
                        FunctionKind.ABS,
                        (_typed_score_expression(node.denominator, expression_kernel.null_policy),),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            for node in divisions
        )
        predicates = (*multiplication_predicates, *division_predicates)
    else:
        msg = f"Unknown expression failure preflight: {failure}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not predicates:
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    failure_predicate = _balanced_sql_or(predicates)
    where = failure_predicate if candidate is None else sql_and(candidate, failure_predicate)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=where,
        ),
    )


def _add_sql_receipts(receipts: Sequence[SqlRenderable]) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not receipts:
        return SqlParam(0)
    pending = list(receipts)
    while len(pending) > 1:
        combined: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for index in range(0, len(pending), 2):
            if index + 1 == len(pending):
                combined.append(pending[index])
            else:
                combined.append(SqlBinaryOp(pending[index], BinaryOp.ADD, pending[index + 1]))
        pending = combined
    return pending[0]


def _safe_expression_receipt_value(
    node: MatchScoreExpression,
    kernel: MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Evaluate one expression node without bypassing portable failure preflight."""
    nodes = _expression_nodes(node)
    zero_denominators = tuple(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(candidate.denominator, kernel.null_policy),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(0.0),
        )
        for candidate in nodes
        if isinstance(candidate, MatchDivideExpression)
    )
    unsafe_multiplications = tuple(
        sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.right, kernel.null_policy),)),
                BinaryOp.GT,
                SqlParam(0.0),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.left, kernel.null_policy),)),
                BinaryOp.GT,
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlParam(float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023")),
                    BinaryOp.DIV,
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.right, kernel.null_policy),)),
                ),
            ),
        )
        for candidate in nodes
        if isinstance(candidate, MatchMultiplyExpression)
    )
    unsafe_divisions = tuple(
        sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.denominator, kernel.null_policy),)),
                BinaryOp.GT,
                SqlParam(0.0),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.numerator, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.DIV,
                    SqlParam(float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023")),
                ),
                BinaryOp.GT,
                SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(candidate.denominator, kernel.null_policy),)),
            ),
        )
        for candidate in nodes
        if isinstance(candidate, MatchDivideExpression)
    )
    failure_guards = (*zero_denominators, *unsafe_multiplications, *unsafe_divisions)
    value = _typed_score_expression(node, kernel.null_policy)
    if not failure_guards:
        return value
    return SqlCase(
        ((_balanced_sql_or(failure_guards), SqlParam(0.0)),),
        else_=value,
    )


def _expression_operation_receipt_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Count one database receipt for every candidate-stage expression node."""
    node_receipts = tuple(
        SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (_safe_expression_receipt_value(node, kernel),))
        for kernel in _expression_kernels(spec)
        for node in _expression_nodes(kernel.expression)
    )
    if not node_receipts:
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([_add_sql_receipts(node_receipts)]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=candidate,
        ),
    )


def _text_codepoint_receipt_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    representations = (spec.left.representation, spec.right.representation)
    if not all(isinstance(representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) for representation in representations):
        return SqlParam(0)
    receipts: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for left, representation, permission, source, alias, relation in (
        (True, representations[0], left_permission, left_source, _LEFT_ALIAS, spec.left),
        (False, representations[1], right_permission, right_source, _RIGHT_ALIAS, spec.right),
    ):
        assert isinstance(representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec)
        visible = _endpoint_predicate(
            spec,
            left=left,
            permission=permission,
            include_presence=True,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
        )
        length = SqlFuncCall(
            "LENGTH",
            (
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(representation.row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
                    qualifier=alias,
                ),
            ),
        )
        receipts.append(
            SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall("SUM", (length,)), SqlParam(0)))]),
                    from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
                    where=visible,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return SqlCast(
        SqlBinaryOp(receipts[0], BinaryOp.ADD, receipts[1]),
        SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),
    )


def _empty_substring_pattern_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    if not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec) or not isinstance(
        left_representation,
        MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        return SqlParam(0)
    visible = _endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=True,
        permission=left_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None,
    )
    empty = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        ),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlParam(""),
    )
    predicate = empty if visible is None else sql_and(visible, empty)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            where=predicate,
        ),
    )

def _text_changed_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    representation = relation.representation
    if not isinstance(representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec):
        return SqlParam(0)
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    stored_alias = SqlAliasName("matching_stored_text")
    normalized = SqlMatchingNormalize(
        source_text=SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        ),
        unicode_form=SqlParam(representation.normalization.unicode_form.value),
        case_handling=SqlParam(representation.normalization.case.value),
    )
    stored_hash = SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("representation_hash"), qualifier=stored_alias)]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_matching_normalized_texts")), stored_alias),
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("artifact_fingerprint"), qualifier=stored_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    _artifact_metadata_column("artifact_fingerprint"),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("endpoint"), qualifier=stored_alias), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam("left" if left else "right")
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), qualifier=stored_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(relation.row_type, "sys_id")), qualifier=alias),
                ),
            ),
            limit=1,
        )
    )
    changed = SqlBinaryOp(SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (stored_hash, SqlParam(""))), BinaryOp.NE, SqlSha256HexDigest(normalized))
    visible = _endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=left,
        permission=permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", (SqlStar(),))]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=changed if visible is None else sql_and(visible, changed),
        )
    )


def _edit_cell_receipt_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec):
        return SqlParam(0)
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    cells = SqlFuncCall(
        "nera_matching_banded_cell_count",
        (
            SqlMatchingNormalize(
                source_text=SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                    qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
                ),
                unicode_form=SqlParam(left_representation.normalization.unicode_form.value),
                case_handling=SqlParam(left_representation.normalization.case.value),
            ),
            SqlMatchingNormalize(
                source_text=SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                    qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                ),
                unicode_form=SqlParam(right_representation.normalization.unicode_form.value),
                case_handling=SqlParam(right_representation.normalization.case.value),
            ),
            SqlParam(int(spec.kernel.threshold)),
        ),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlCast(
                        SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall("SUM", (cells,)), SqlParam(0))),
                        SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=candidate,
        ),
    )


def _posting_advance_receipt_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        candidate = _candidate_predicate(
            spec,
            left_permission=left_permission,
            right_permission=right_permission,
            include_presence=True,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
        )
        overlap = SqlArtifactAwareQGramOverlap(
            left_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_id=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            unicode_form=left_representation.normalization.unicode_form.value,
            case_handling=left_representation.normalization.case.value,
            visits_only=True,
        )
        return SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall("SUM", (overlap,)), SqlParam(0))),
                            SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
                joins=(
                    SqlJoin(
                        JoinKind.CROSS,
                        _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                    ),
                ),
                where=candidate,
            ),
        )
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    receipt = SqlPersistedPostingAggregate(
        left_text=SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        ),
        right_id=SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
            qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
        ),
        artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
        case_fold=left_representation.normalization.kind == "unicode_words_casefolded",
        score=False,
    )
    posting_sum = SqlCast(
        SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", (SqlFuncCall("SUM", (receipt,)), SqlParam(0))),
        SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),
    )
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape) and int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count) == 1:
        receipt_column = SqlColumnName("wand_posting_receipt")
        bound_column = SqlColumnName("wand_document_bound")
        threshold_column = SqlColumnName("wand_partition_threshold")
        left_identity = _sql_canonical_identity(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS)
        bound = SqlArtifactAwareWandUpperBound(
            left_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(left_representation.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_text=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right_id=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(right_representation.row_type, "sys_id")),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            artifact_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            case_fold=left_representation.normalization.kind == "unicode_words_casefolded",
        )
        receipt_rows = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(receipt, SqlAliasName(receipt_column)),
                    SqlSelectAlias(bound, SqlAliasName(bound_column)),
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("MAX", (bound,)), partition_by=(left_identity,)),
                        SqlAliasName(threshold_column),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=candidate,
        )
        receipt_alias = SqlAliasName("wand_receipts")
        return SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlFuncCall(
                                "COALESCE",
                                (
                                    SqlFuncCall(
                                        "SUM",
                                        (SqlColumnRef(receipt_column, qualifier=receipt_alias),),
                                    ),
                                    SqlParam(0),
                                ),
                            ),
                            SqlCastTargetType(base_type="BIGINT"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(receipt_rows, receipt_alias),
                where=SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(bound_column, qualifier=receipt_alias),
                    BinaryOp.GE,
                    SqlColumnRef(threshold_column, qualifier=receipt_alias),
                ),
            ),
        )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([posting_sum]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=candidate,
        ),
    )

def _artifact_document_generation_count_subquery(spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any]) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not (
        isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
    ):
        return SqlParam(0)
    document_alias = SqlAliasName("match_artifact_documents")
    metadata_alias = SqlAliasName("match_artifact_generation")
    generation_subquery = SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlFuncCall(
                        "MAX",
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(
                                SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, "generation")),
                                qualifier=metadata_alias,
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(
                SqlTableIdent(_matching_table_name(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow)),
                metadata_alias,
            ),
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, "spec_fingerprint")),
                        qualifier=metadata_alias,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(str(spec.semantic_fingerprint)),

                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, "pair_scope")),
                        qualifier=metadata_alias,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(str(spec.pair_scope)),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(
                SqlTableIdent(_matching_table_name(MatchingDocumentStatRow)),
                document_alias,
            ),
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingDocumentStatRow, "artifact_fingerprint")),
                        qualifier=document_alias,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    _artifact_metadata_column("artifact_fingerprint"),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(cached_db_column_name(MatchingDocumentStatRow, "generation")),
                        qualifier=document_alias,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    generation_subquery,
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


@_share_statement_predicates
def _exact_dense_preflight_statement(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    native_declaration: MatchSpec[Any, Any] | None = None,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSelect:
    visible_pair_count = _pair_count_subquery(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=False,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source=left_source,
        right_source=right_source,
    )
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    left_all_rows = isinstance(left_representation, MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec) or isinstance(
        getattr(left_representation, "availability", None),
        AllRowsRepresented,
    )
    right_all_rows = isinstance(right_representation, MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec) or isinstance(
        getattr(right_representation, "availability", None),
        AllRowsRepresented,
    )
    if left_all_rows and right_all_rows:
        pair_count = visible_pair_count
    else:
        pair_count = _pair_count_subquery(
            spec,
            left_permission=left_permission,
            right_permission=right_permission,
            include_presence=True,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            left_source=left_source,
            right_source=right_source,
        )
    excluded_self_count: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(0)
    if spec.policies.self_edges is MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE and get_table_name(spec.left.row_type) == get_table_name(
        spec.right.row_type
    ):
        pairs_before_self_filter = _pair_count_subquery(
            spec,
            left_permission=left_permission,
            right_permission=right_permission,
            include_presence=False,
            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
            left_source=left_source,
            right_source=right_source,
            apply_self_policy=False,
        )
        excluded_self_count = SqlBinaryOp(pairs_before_self_filter, BinaryOp.SUB, visible_pair_count)
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(pair_count, SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _posting_advance_receipt_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        right_permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                        right_source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_POSTING_ADVANCES_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        _text_changed_count_subquery(
                            spec, left=True, permission=left_permission, versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id, source=left_source
                        ),
                        BinaryOp.ADD,
                        _text_changed_count_subquery(
                            spec, left=False, permission=right_permission, versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id, source=right_source
                        ),
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_TEXT_CHANGED_ROWS_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _edit_cell_receipt_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        right_permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                        right_source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_EDIT_CELLS_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _empty_substring_pattern_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_EMPTY_PATTERN_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _qgram_candidate_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        right_permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                        right_source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_QGRAM_CANDIDATE_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _text_codepoint_receipt_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        right_permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                        right_source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_TEXT_CODEPOINTS_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    visible_pair_count,
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    excluded_self_count,
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_EXCLUDED_SELF_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        include_presence=False,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        include_presence=False,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        include_presence=True,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        include_presence=True,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_failure_count_expression(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,

                        source=left_source,

                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
