_PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_CACHE: LocalMetadataCache[tuple[CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, SqlColumnTypeHints]] = LocalMetadataCache(
    name="matching:preflight_output_contract",
    max_entries=1,
    invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.IMMUTABLE_KEY_METADATA,
)


def _preflight_output_contract() -> tuple[CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    cached = _PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_CACHE.get("preflight-v1")
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    columns = (
        _PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_POSTING_ADVANCES_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_EDIT_CELLS_COLUMN,
        _TEXT_CHANGED_ROWS_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_EMPTY_PATTERN_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_QGRAM_CANDIDATE_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_TEXT_CODEPOINTS_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_EXCLUDED_SELF_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_LEFT_FAILURE_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_FAILURE_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_INDEXED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_PAYLOAD_BYTES_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_LEFT_UNSAFE_COORDINATES_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_UNSAFE_COORDINATES_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_H14_ARTIFACT_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PROFILE_ADMITTED_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PLAN_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_QUALIFYING_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_NUMERIC_RECEIPT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_STATE_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_PRODUCER_STATE_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_ROW_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_WATERMARK_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_WATERMARK_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_TRACKING_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_COUNT_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_NULL_EXPRESSION_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_ZERO_DENOMINATOR_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_UNSAFE_EXPRESSION_COLUMN,
        _PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_OPERATION_COLUMN,
    )
    text_columns = frozenset(
        {
            str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_STATE_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_PRODUCER_STATE_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_TRACKING_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PROFILE_ADMITTED_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_NUMERIC_RECEIPT_COLUMN),
        }
    )
    timestamp_columns = frozenset({str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN), str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)})
    shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(str(column), role="exact_dense_preflight") for column in columns))
    hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
        bigint_columns=frozenset(map(str, columns)) - text_columns - timestamp_columns,
        text_columns=text_columns,
        timestamptz_columns=timestamp_columns,
    )
    result = (shape, DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape), hints)
    _PREFLIGHT_OUTPUT_CACHE.set("preflight-v1", result)
    return result


def _exact_dense_read_tables(spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any]) -> frozenset[str]:
    tables = {
        str(_matching_table_name(spec.left.row_type)),
        str(_matching_table_name(spec.right.row_type)),
    }
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec):
        tables.update(
            str(_matching_table_name(model))
            for model in (
                MatchingProjectionArtifactRow,
                MatchingProjectionActivationRow,
                MatchingProjectionTensorRow,
                MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow,
            )
        )
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
        tables.add(str(_matching_table_name(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow)))
    return frozenset(tables)


class _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep(NonPublishingStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        *,
        left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
        left_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        right_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        native_declaration: MatchSpec[Any, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._spec = spec
        self._native_declaration = native_declaration
        self._left_permission = left_permission
        self._right_permission = right_permission
        self._versioned_branch_id = versioned_branch_id
        self._left_source_ref = left_source_ref
        self._right_source_ref = right_source_ref

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "matching", "exact_dense", "work_preflight"})

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in (self._left_source_ref, self._right_source_ref) if ref is not None)

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _exact_dense_read_tables(self._spec)

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _exact_dense_read_tables(self._spec)

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(
        self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        left_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._left_source_ref, self._spec.left)
        right_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._right_source_ref, self._spec.right)
        grammar = _exact_dense_preflight_statement(
            self._spec,
            native_declaration=self._native_declaration,
            left_permission=self._left_permission,
            right_permission=self._right_permission,
            versioned_branch_id=self._versioned_branch_id,
            left_source=left_source,
            right_source=right_source,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _preflight_output_contract()
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            (source.table_name, source.auxiliary_query) for source in (left_source, right_source) if source.auxiliary_query is not None
        ]
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=grammar,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
        )


class _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchPreflightCounters]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        permission_scope: str,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._spec = spec
        self._permission_scope = permission_scope

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchPreflightCounters]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(
        self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchPreflightCounters:
        try:
            return self._evaluate_preflight(resolved, hydrator)
        except MatchError as error:
            is_h14 = isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
            is_packed = isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
            if (is_h14 or is_packed) and isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
                raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref))
                assert isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence) and len(raw_rows) == 1
                raw_row = raw_rows[0]
                assert isinstance(raw_row, Mapping)
                encoded = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_NUMERIC_RECEIPT_COLUMN)]
                assert isinstance(encoded, str)
                receipt = json.loads(encoded)
                assert isinstance(receipt, dict)
                executed = receipt["executed_work"]
                assert isinstance(executed, int) and not isinstance(executed, bool) and executed >= 0
                context = {name: getattr(error.context, name) for name in type(error.context).model_fields}
                if is_h14:
                    context["executed_work"] = MatchH14ErrorWork(bit_comparisons=MatchBitComparisonCount(executed))
                else:
                    context["executed_work"] = MatchNativeErrorWork(pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(executed))
                raise type(error)(MatchErrorContext.model_validate(context)) from error
            raise

    def _evaluate_preflight(
        self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchPreflightCounters:
        """Validate materialized counts without database I/O."""
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref)) or []
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence) or len(raw_rows) != 1:
            msg = "Exact dense preflight must publish one count row"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        raw_row = raw_rows[0]
        if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight published a non-row value"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        count_values = {
            "pair_evaluations": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "posting_advances": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_POSTING_ADVANCES_COLUMN)],
            "edit_cells": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EDIT_CELLS_COLUMN)],
            "empty_patterns": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EMPTY_PATTERN_COLUMN)],
            "qgram_candidates": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_QGRAM_CANDIDATE_COLUMN)],
            "text_codepoints": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_TEXT_CODEPOINTS_COLUMN)],
            "visible_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "excluded_self_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EXCLUDED_SELF_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "left_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "right_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "left_represented_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN)],
            "right_represented_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN)],
            "left_producer_failures": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_FAILURE_COLUMN)],
            "right_producer_failures": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_FAILURE_COLUMN)],
            "indexed_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_INDEXED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "left_unsafe_coordinates": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_UNSAFE_COORDINATES_COLUMN)],
            "right_unsafe_coordinates": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_UNSAFE_COORDINATES_COLUMN)],
            "h14_artifact_count": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_H14_ARTIFACT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "native_profile_admitted": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PROFILE_ADMITTED_COLUMN)],
            "native_plan_count": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_NATIVE_PLAN_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "qualifying_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_QUALIFYING_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "null_expression_inputs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_NULL_EXPRESSION_COLUMN)],
            "zero_expression_denominators": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ZERO_DENOMINATOR_COLUMN)],
            "unsafe_expression_results": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_UNSAFE_EXPRESSION_COLUMN)],
            "expression_operations": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_OPERATION_COLUMN)],
        }
        h14_preflight_bits = 0
        preflight_scorer_calls = 0
        numeric_receipt = isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec) or isinstance(
            self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec
        )
        if numeric_receipt and isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
            encoded_receipt = raw_row.get(str(_PREFLIGHT_NUMERIC_RECEIPT_COLUMN))
            if not isinstance(encoded_receipt, str):
                raise TypeError("Numeric threshold preflight omitted its executed-work receipt")
            receipt = json.loads(encoded_receipt)
            if not isinstance(receipt, dict):
                raise TypeError("Numeric threshold preflight requires a receipt object")
            qualifying_count = receipt.get("qualifying_rows")
            executed_work = receipt.get("executed_work")
            if not isinstance(executed_work, int) or isinstance(executed_work, bool) or executed_work < 0:
                raise TypeError("Scorer receipt work must be a nonnegative integer")
            if not isinstance(qualifying_count, int) or isinstance(qualifying_count, bool) or qualifying_count < 0:
                raise TypeError("Scorer receipt cardinality must be a nonnegative integer")
            if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec):
                h14_preflight_bits = executed_work
            else:
                preflight_scorer_calls = executed_work
            count_values["qualifying_rows"] = qualifying_count
        numeric_counts = {name: value for name, value in count_values.items() if name != "native_profile_admitted"}
        if any(not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) for value in numeric_counts.values()):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight counts must be integers"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        pair_evaluations = count_values["pair_evaluations"]
        posting_advances = count_values["posting_advances"]
        edit_cells = count_values["edit_cells"]
        empty_patterns = count_values["empty_patterns"]
        qgram_candidates = count_values["qgram_candidates"]
        text_codepoints = count_values["text_codepoints"]
        visible_pairs = count_values["visible_pairs"]
        excluded_self_pairs = count_values["excluded_self_pairs"]
        left_rows = count_values["left_rows"]
        right_rows = count_values["right_rows"]
        left_represented_rows = count_values["left_represented_rows"]
        right_represented_rows = count_values["right_represented_rows"]
        left_producer_failures = count_values["left_producer_failures"]
        right_producer_failures = count_values["right_producer_failures"]
        indexed_pairs = count_values["indexed_pairs"]
        left_unsafe_coordinates = count_values["left_unsafe_coordinates"]
        right_unsafe_coordinates = count_values["right_unsafe_coordinates"]
        h14_artifact_count = count_values["h14_artifact_count"]
        native_profile_admitted = count_values["native_profile_admitted"]
        native_plan_count = count_values["native_plan_count"]
        qualifying_rows = count_values["qualifying_rows"]
        if empty_patterns:
            raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.EMPTY_SUBSTRING_PATTERN,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("nonempty_visible_substring_patterns"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"empty_pattern_rows_{empty_patterns}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_SOURCE_DATA,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        expression_failures = (
            (
                "null_expression_inputs",
                MatchInvariant.NULL_EXPRESSION_INPUT,
                "non_null_expression_inputs",
            ),
            (
                "zero_expression_denominators",
                MatchInvariant.EXPRESSION_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
                "nonzero_expression_denominators",
            ),
            (
                "unsafe_expression_results",
                MatchInvariant.NON_FINITE_EXPRESSION_RESULT,
                "finite_expression_results",
            ),
        )
        for count_name, invariant, expected in expression_failures:
            failure_count = count_values[count_name]
            if failure_count:
                raise MatchExpressionEvaluationError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=invariant,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(expected),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"{count_name}_{failure_count}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                        candidate_stage_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(failure_count),
                    ),
                )
        left_max_updated = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)]
        right_max_updated = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)]
        if left_max_updated is not None and not isinstance(left_max_updated, datetime):
            msg = "Matching left snapshot watermark must be a datetime"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if right_max_updated is not None and not isinstance(right_max_updated, datetime):
            msg = "Matching right snapshot watermark must be a datetime"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        snapshot_payload = "\x1f".join(
            (
                str(self._spec.pair_scope),
                str(left_rows),
                "none" if left_max_updated is None else left_max_updated.isoformat(),
                str(right_rows),
                "none" if right_max_updated is None else right_max_updated.isoformat(),
            ),
        )
        snapshot_fingerprint = MatchSnapshotFingerprint(
            hashlib.sha256(snapshot_payload.encode()).hexdigest(),
        )
        result_shape = self._spec.result_shape
        assert isinstance(
            result_shape,
            TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape | GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape,
        )
        pagination = result_shape.pagination
        if isinstance(pagination, MatchPageAfterCursor) and pagination.cursor.snapshot_fingerprint != snapshot_fingerprint:
            raise MatchCursorError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"snapshot_{snapshot_fingerprint}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(
                        f"snapshot_{pagination.cursor.snapshot_fingerprint}",
                    ),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.RESTART_PAGINATION,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        artifact_payload = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_STATE_COLUMN)]
        artifact_producer_state = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_PRODUCER_STATE_COLUMN)]
        artifact_source_row_count = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_ROW_COUNT_COLUMN)]
        artifact_source_watermark = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_WATERMARK_COLUMN)]
        artifact_watermark = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_WATERMARK_COLUMN)]
        artifact_source_tracking = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_SOURCE_TRACKING_COLUMN)]
        artifact_document_count = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ARTIFACT_DOCUMENT_COUNT_COLUMN)]
        if artifact_payload is None:
            artifact_state: NoMatchArtifactState | MatchArtifactExecutionState = NoMatchArtifactState()
        elif isinstance(artifact_payload, str):
            artifact_state = MatchArtifactExecutionState.model_validate_json(artifact_payload)
        else:
            msg = "Matching artifact metadata state must be serialized JSON text"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        for watermark_name, watermark in (
            ("source", artifact_source_watermark),
            ("artifact", artifact_watermark),
        ):
            if watermark is not None and (not isinstance(watermark, int) or isinstance(watermark, bool)):
                msg = f"Matching artifact {watermark_name} watermark must be an integer"
                raise TypeError(msg)
        if artifact_source_row_count is not None and (
            not isinstance(artifact_source_row_count, int) or isinstance(artifact_source_row_count, bool)
        ):
            msg = "Matching artifact source row count must be an integer"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(artifact_document_count, int) or isinstance(artifact_document_count, bool):
            msg = "Matching artifact document count must be an integer"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if artifact_source_tracking not in {None, "row_count", "snapshot_watermark"}:
            msg = "Matching artifact source tracking must use the closed mode vocabulary"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        freshness_policy = self._spec.policies.freshness
        if isinstance(artifact_state, NoMatchArtifactState) and isinstance(
            freshness_policy,
            AcceptStaleWithDiagnosticsFreshnessPolicy | ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy | RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy,
        ):
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("operator_artifact_metadata"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("artifact_metadata_missing"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState):
            changed_text_rows = raw_row[str(_TEXT_CHANGED_ROWS_COLUMN)]
            assert isinstance(changed_text_rows, int)
            if changed_text_rows and isinstance(self._spec.policies.freshness, RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy):
                raise MatchFreshnessError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("artifact_text_matches_visible_source"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"changed_text_rows_{changed_text_rows}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    )
                )
            if isinstance(artifact_source_watermark, int) and isinstance(artifact_watermark, int):
                artifact_state = MatchArtifactExecutionState.model_validate(
                    {
                        **artifact_state.model_dump(),
                        "source_watermark": MatchArtifactWatermark(artifact_source_watermark),
                        "artifact_watermark": MatchArtifactWatermark(artifact_watermark),
                    },
                )
            allowed_artifact_methods = {MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_DENSE_SCAN.value}
            if isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
                self._spec.right.representation,
                MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
            ):
                allowed_artifact_methods.update(
                    {
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SPARSE_POSTINGS.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.WAND.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.BLOCK_MAX_WAND.value,
                    },
                )
            if isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
                self._spec.right.representation,
                MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
            ):
                allowed_artifact_methods.update(
                    {
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SUBSTRING_SCAN.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.AHO_CORASICK.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.QGRAM_EXACT_SUBSTRING.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_LEVENSHTEIN.value,
                        MatchAccessMethodKind.BANDED_LEVENSHTEIN.value,
                    },
                )
            if artifact_state.identity.physical_method not in allowed_artifact_methods:
                raise MatchArtifactError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                            f"artifact_method_{MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_DENSE_SCAN.value}",
                        ),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(
                            f"artifact_method_{artifact_state.identity.physical_method}",
                        ),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            sparse_methods = {
                MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SPARSE_POSTINGS.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.WAND.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.BLOCK_MAX_WAND.value,
            }
            if artifact_state.identity.physical_method in sparse_methods and right_rows > 0 and artifact_document_count == 0:
                raise MatchArtifactError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_GENERATION_REUSE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                            "posting_generation_documents_present",
                        ),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("posting_generation_missing"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            if artifact_state.artifact_watermark > artifact_state.source_watermark:
                raise MatchFreshnessError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_FROM_FUTURE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                            f"artifact_watermark_at_most_source_{artifact_state.source_watermark}",
                        ),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(
                            f"artifact_watermark_{artifact_state.artifact_watermark}",
                        ),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            if (
                isinstance(freshness_policy, RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy)
                and artifact_state.artifact_watermark < artifact_state.source_watermark
            ):
                raise MatchFreshnessError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                            f"source_watermark_{artifact_state.source_watermark}",
                        ),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(
                            f"artifact_watermark_{artifact_state.artifact_watermark}",
                        ),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.WAIT_FOR_FRESHNESS,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            if (
                isinstance(freshness_policy, RequireBoundedWatermarkFreshnessPolicy)
                and artifact_state.artifact_watermark < freshness_policy.required_watermark
            ):
                raise MatchFreshnessError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                            f"artifact_watermark_at_least_{freshness_policy.required_watermark}",
                        ),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(
                            f"artifact_watermark_{artifact_state.artifact_watermark}",
                        ),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.WAIT_FOR_FRESHNESS,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        if isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState) and artifact_state.permission_scope != self._permission_scope:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_PERMISSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"permission_scope_{self._permission_scope}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(
                        f"permission_scope_{artifact_state.permission_scope}",
                    ),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if artifact_producer_state not in {None, "ready", "failed"}:
            msg = "Matching artifact producer state must use the closed lifecycle"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if artifact_producer_state == "failed":
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.REPRESENTATION_PRODUCER_FAILED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("representation_producer_success"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("artifact_producer_failed"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        payload_bytes_value = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_PAYLOAD_BYTES_COLUMN)]
        if isinstance(payload_bytes_value, Decimal) and payload_bytes_value == payload_bytes_value.to_integral_value():
            payload_bytes = int(payload_bytes_value)
        elif isinstance(payload_bytes_value, int) and not isinstance(payload_bytes_value, bool):
            payload_bytes = payload_bytes_value
        elif (
            isinstance(payload_bytes_value, float)
            and math.isfinite(payload_bytes_value)
            and payload_bytes_value.is_integer()
            and abs(payload_bytes_value) <= 2**53
        ):
            payload_bytes = int(payload_bytes_value)
        else:
            msg = "Exact dense preflight payload bytes must be an integer"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        assert isinstance(pair_evaluations, int)
        assert isinstance(visible_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(excluded_self_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(left_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(right_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(left_represented_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(right_represented_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(left_producer_failures, int)
        assert isinstance(right_producer_failures, int)
        assert isinstance(indexed_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(left_unsafe_coordinates, int)
        assert isinstance(right_unsafe_coordinates, int)
        assert isinstance(h14_artifact_count, int)
        assert isinstance(native_plan_count, int)
        assert isinstance(qualifying_rows, int)
        packed_representation = self._spec.left.representation
        if isinstance(packed_representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
            if native_plan_count != 1:
                raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_authoritative_native_exact_plan"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"matching_native_exact_plans_{native_plan_count}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        if native_profile_admitted != 1:
            raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("schema_admitted_native_source_storage"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("native_source_storage_mismatch"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                )
            )
        if h14_artifact_count != 1:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_current_h14_projection_generation"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_projection_generation_unavailable"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        unsafe_coordinates = left_unsafe_coordinates + right_unsafe_coordinates
        if unsafe_coordinates:
            h14_representation = isinstance(
                self._spec.left.representation,
                MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
            )
            error_context = MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=(
                    MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH if h14_representation else MatchInvariant.NON_FINITE_REPRESENTATION
                ),
                expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                    "canonical_h14_code_length_128" if h14_representation else "finite_exact_dense_accumulation_domain"
                ),
                observed=MatchObservedValue(
                    f"invalid_h14_code_rows_{unsafe_coordinates}" if h14_representation else f"unsafe_dense_rows_{unsafe_coordinates}"
                ),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
            )
            if h14_representation:
                raise MatchArtifactError(error_context)
            raise MatchCompatibilityError(error_context)
        if left_producer_failures > 0:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.REPRESENTATION_PRODUCER_FAILED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("representation_producer_success"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"left_producer_failure_{left_producer_failures}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if right_producer_failures > 0:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.REPRESENTATION_PRODUCER_FAILED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("representation_producer_success"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"right_producer_failure_{right_producer_failures}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        missing_policy = self._spec.policies.missing_representation
        if isinstance(
            missing_policy,
            FailMissingRepresentationPolicy | RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy,
        ):
            missing_left = left_rows - left_represented_rows
            missing_right = right_rows - right_represented_rows
            invariant = (
                MatchInvariant.MATERIALIZATION_REQUIRED
                if isinstance(missing_policy, RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy)
                else MatchInvariant.MISSING_REPRESENTATION
            )
            expected = (
                MatchExpectedValue("representations_materialized_before_snapshot")
                if isinstance(missing_policy, RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy)
                else MatchExpectedValue("all_visible_representations_present")
            )
            if missing_left > 0:
                raise MatchMissingRepresentationError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=invariant,
                        expected=expected,
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"left_representation_missing_{missing_left}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            if missing_right > 0:
                raise MatchMissingRepresentationError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=invariant,
                        expected=expected,
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"right_representation_missing_{missing_right}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        left_representation = self._spec.left.representation
        right_representation = self._spec.right.representation
        if isinstance(
            left_representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
        ) and isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            representation_values = left_rows * int(left_representation.dimensions) + right_rows * int(
                right_representation.dimensions,
            )
            dense_dimensions = int(left_representation.dimensions)
        elif isinstance(left_representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            representation_values = (left_rows + right_rows) * 16
            dense_dimensions = 0
        elif isinstance(
            left_representation,
            MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ) and isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            representation_values = 0
            dense_dimensions = 0
        else:
            msg = "Exact pair preflight requires compatible representations"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape) and qualifying_rows > int(self._spec.result_shape.result_limit):
            raise MatchResultCardinalityError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.RESULT_CARDINALITY_EXCEEDED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                        f"qualifying_rows_at_most_{self._spec.result_shape.result_limit}",
                    ),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"qualifying_rows_{qualifying_rows}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                left_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                right_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(pair_evaluations, int(self._spec.result_shape.result_limit))
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                left_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.left_neighbor_count),
                right_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.right_neighbor_count),
            )
        else:
            msg = "Exact dense preflight requires a supported result shape"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        explanation_policy = self._spec.policies.explanations
        explanation_rows = result_rows * dense_dimensions if isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy) else 0
        if isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy) and explanation_rows > int(explanation_policy.max_rows):
            raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"explanation_rows_at_most_{explanation_policy.max_rows}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"explanation_rows_{explanation_rows}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        expression_operations = count_values["expression_operations"]
        candidate_pairs = (
            qgram_candidates
            if isinstance(
                self._spec.left.representation,
                MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
            )
            or isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec)
            else 0
        )
        representation_bytes_read = representation_values * 8
        producer_calls = 0
        working_memory_bytes = max(representation_bytes_read + payload_bytes, result_rows * 256)
        runtime_services = hydrator.runtime_services
        if runtime_services is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Exact dense work accounting requires ServerPlan runtime services")
        completed_stage_receipts = tuple(
            receipt for receipt in runtime_services.execution_stage_receipts.snapshot() if receipt.contributes_to(str(self._source_ref))
        )
        completed_database_round_trips = sum(receipt.driver_round_trips for receipt in completed_stage_receipts)
        if completed_database_round_trips >= int(self._spec.work_limits.max_database_round_trips):
            raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                        f"database_round_trips_at_most_{self._spec.work_limits.max_database_round_trips}",
                    ),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(
                        f"database_round_trips_{completed_database_round_trips + 1}",
                    ),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        checks = (
            ("left_rows", left_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_left_rows)),
            ("right_rows", right_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_right_rows)),
            ("pair_evaluations", pair_evaluations, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_pair_evaluations)),
            ("candidate_pairs", candidate_pairs, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_candidate_pairs)),
            ("posting_advances", posting_advances, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_posting_advances)),
            ("text_codepoints", text_codepoints, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_text_codepoints)),
            ("edit_cells", edit_cells, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_edit_cells)),
            (
                "expression_evaluations",
                expression_operations,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_expression_evaluations),
            ),
            ("result_rows", result_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_result_rows)),
            (
                "representation_values",
                representation_values,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_representation_values),
            ),
            (
                "representation_bytes_read",
                representation_bytes_read,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_representation_bytes_read),
            ),
            ("producer_calls", producer_calls, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_producer_calls)),
            (
                "working_memory_bytes",
                working_memory_bytes,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_working_memory_bytes),
            ),
            (
                "hydration_payload_bytes",
                payload_bytes,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_hydration_payload_bytes),
            ),
        )
        for work_name, observed, limit in checks:
            if observed > limit:
                raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"{work_name}_at_most_{limit}"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"{work_name}_{observed}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        missing_pairs = visible_pairs - pair_evaluations
        emit_declared_score = isinstance(
            self._spec.policies.missing_representation,
            EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy,
        )
        exact_completion_pairs = (
            pair_evaluations - indexed_pairs
            if isinstance(self._spec.policies.freshness, ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy)
            else pair_evaluations - qgram_candidates
            if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec)
            else 0
        )
        return MatchPreflightCounters(
            pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(pair_evaluations),
            database_round_trips=MatchDatabaseRoundTripCount(completed_database_round_trips),
            bit_comparisons=MatchBitComparisonCount(h14_preflight_bits),
            executed_pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(preflight_scorer_calls),
            posting_advances=MatchPostingAdvanceCount(posting_advances),
            expression_evaluations=MatchExpressionEvaluationCount(expression_operations),
            qgram_posting_advances=MatchQGramPostingAdvanceCount(
                posting_advances if isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) else 0,
            ),
            edit_cells_evaluated=MatchEditCellEvaluationCount(edit_cells),
            candidate_pairs=MatchCandidatePairCount(candidate_pairs),
            omitted_missing_pairs=MatchOmittedPairCount(0 if emit_declared_score else missing_pairs),
            declared_missing_score_pairs=MatchDeclaredScorePairCount(missing_pairs if emit_declared_score else 0),
            excluded_self_pairs=MatchExcludedSelfPairCount(excluded_self_pairs),
            exact_completion_pairs=MatchExactCompletionPairCount(exact_completion_pairs),
            artifact_state=artifact_state,
            artifact_content_freshness=(
                MatchArtifactFreshnessState.STALE
                if isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState) and bool(raw_row[str(_TEXT_CHANGED_ROWS_COLUMN)])
                else MatchArtifactFreshnessState.CURRENT
            ),
            snapshot_fingerprint=snapshot_fingerprint,
        )


class _ExactDenseRowsStep(NonPublishingStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDenseRowsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        *,
        guard_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        native_declaration: MatchSpec[Any, Any] | None,
        left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
        left_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        right_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._spec = spec
        self._guard_ref = guard_ref
        self._native_declaration = native_declaration
        self._left_permission = left_permission
        self._right_permission = right_permission
        self._versioned_branch_id = versioned_branch_id
        self._left_source_ref = left_source_ref
        self._right_source_ref = right_source_ref

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "matching", "exact_dense", "scoring"}
        if isinstance(
            self._spec.left.representation,
            MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
        ) or isinstance(self._spec.right.representation, MatchProducedRepresentationSpec):
            tags.add("producer")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                str(self._guard_ref),
                *(str(ref) for ref in (self._left_source_ref, self._right_source_ref) if ref is not None),
            },
        )

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _exact_dense_read_tables(self._spec)

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _exact_dense_read_tables(self._spec)

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def runtime_step_expansion(
        self: _ExactDenseRowsStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
    ) -> tuple[Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None] | None:
        preflight = resolved.get(str(self._guard_ref))
        if not isinstance(preflight, MatchPreflightCounters):
            raise TypeError("Exact dense scoring requires validated preflight counters")
        if (
            preflight.pair_evaluations
            or preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs
            or isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
            or isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
        ):
            return None
        rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        return (ReturnValueStep(self.ref_id, rows),), self.ref_id

    def compile(self: _ExactDenseRowsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        left_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._left_source_ref, self._spec.left)
        right_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._right_source_ref, self._spec.right)
        grammar, output_columns, hints = _exact_dense_statement(
            self._spec,
            native_declaration=self._native_declaration,
            statement_ref=self.ref_id,
            left_permission=self._left_permission,
            right_permission=self._right_permission,
            versioned_branch_id=self._versioned_branch_id,
            left_source=left_source,
            right_source=right_source,
        )
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="exact_dense_match") for column in output_columns),
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            (source.table_name, source.auxiliary_query) for source in (left_source, right_source) if source.auxiliary_query is not None
        ]
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=hints,
            grammar=grammar,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ExactDenseDecodeConfig:
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    preflight_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    preflight_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    spec: InstanceOf[MatchSpec[Any, Any]]
    planning_operations: int


@dataclass(slots=True)
class _RuntimeStageReceipts:
    planning_operations: int
    executed_stage_receipts: tuple[ExecutedStageReceipt, ...]
    hydrated_endpoints: list[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]

    def metrics(self: _RuntimeStageReceipts) -> MatchRuntimeMetrics:
        """Build public metrics from executor-published completed-stage receipts."""
        matching_receipts = tuple(receipt for receipt in self.executed_stage_receipts if "matching" in receipt.tags)
        return MatchRuntimeMetrics(
            planning_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(self.planning_operations),
            dependency_traversal_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(
                sum(receipt.dependency_traversals for receipt in matching_receipts),
            ),
            database_execution_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(
                sum(receipt.database_statements for receipt in matching_receipts),
            ),
            hydrated_endpoint_rows=MatchStageOperationCount(len(self.hydrated_endpoints)),
            producer_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(
                sum(1 for receipt in self.executed_stage_receipts if "producer" in receipt.tags),
            ),
        )


def _model_payload(row: Mapping[str, object], prefix: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {key.removeprefix(prefix): value for key, value in row.items() if key.startswith(prefix)}


def _hydrate_endpoint[EndpointT: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    model_cls: type[EndpointT],
    payload: dict[str, Any],
    receipts: _RuntimeStageReceipts,
) -> EndpointT:
    concrete_cls, concrete_payload = dispatch_polymorphic_type(model_cls, payload)
    endpoint = concrete_cls.model_validate(concrete_payload)
    receipts.hydrated_endpoints.append(endpoint)
    return endpoint


def _score_value(
    value: object,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> MatchScoreValue:
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        numeric_value = float(value)
    elif isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        numeric_value = float(value)
    else:
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("numeric_exact_dense_score"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("malformed_packed_dense_score"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    if not math.isfinite(numeric_value):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.NON_FINITE_REPRESENTATION,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("finite_dense_coordinates"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("non_finite_dense_coordinate"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    return MatchScoreValue(numeric_value)


def _endpoint_snapshot_identity(endpoint: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]) -> str:
    updated_at = endpoint.model_dump()["updated_at"]
    if not isinstance(updated_at, datetime):
        msg = "Matched endpoint updated_at must be a datetime"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return updated_at.isoformat()


def _canonical_endpoint_identity(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    endpoint: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId],
) -> str:
    identity = relation.identity
    if isinstance(identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec):
        return str(endpoint.sys_id)
    if isinstance(identity, MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec):
        value = getattr(endpoint, str(identity.field_name))
        if not isinstance(value, str | int):
            msg = "Canonical matching identity must be a string or integer"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return str(value)
    msg = f"Unknown canonical identity variant: {type(identity).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _pair_identity(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
) -> MatchPairIdentity:
    payload = "\x1f".join(
        (
            str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            str(spec.pair_scope),
            _canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.left, left),
            _endpoint_snapshot_identity(left),
            _canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.right, right),
            _endpoint_snapshot_identity(right),
        ),
    )
    return MatchPairIdentity(hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())


def _freshness_diagnostics(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> NoMatchArtifactDiagnostics | MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics:
    del spec
    state = preflight.artifact_state
    if isinstance(state, NoMatchArtifactState):
        return NoMatchArtifactDiagnostics()
    assert isinstance(state, MatchArtifactExecutionState)
    freshness_state = (
        MatchArtifactFreshnessState.CURRENT
        if state.artifact_watermark == state.source_watermark
        and preflight.artifact_content_freshness is MatchArtifactFreshnessState.CURRENT
        else MatchArtifactFreshnessState.STALE
    )
    return MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics(
        identity=state.identity,
        source_watermark=state.source_watermark,
        artifact_watermark=state.artifact_watermark,
        state=freshness_state,
    )


def _dense_explanations(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
    row: Mapping[str, object],
) -> tuple[MatchDenseContributionExplanation, ...]:
    if not isinstance(spec.policies.explanations, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy):
        return ()
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.EXPLANATION_REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("dense_coordinate_representations"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("non_coordinate_representation"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    explanations: list[MatchDenseContributionExplanation] = []
    if isinstance(spec.policies.duplicates, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy):
        coordinate_count = len(left_representation.coordinates)
        physical_slot_count = max(1, int(spec.policies.explanations.max_rows) // coordinate_count)
        for physical_slot in range(1, physical_slot_count + 1):
            for coordinate_index in range(coordinate_count):
                left_value = row.get(f"match_explanation_{physical_slot}_{coordinate_index}_left")
                right_value = row.get(f"match_explanation_{physical_slot}_{coordinate_index}_right")
                if left_value is None and right_value is None:
                    continue
                if not isinstance(left_value, int | float) or isinstance(left_value, bool):
                    raise TypeError("Combined dense explanation left coordinate must be numeric")
                if not isinstance(right_value, int | float) or isinstance(right_value, bool):
                    raise TypeError("Combined dense explanation right coordinate must be numeric")
                explanations.append(
                    MatchDenseContributionExplanation(
                        coordinate_index=MatchExplanationCoordinateIndex(coordinate_index),
                        left_value=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value)),
                        right_value=MatchDenseValue(float(right_value)),
                        contribution=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value) * float(right_value)),
                    ),
                )
        return tuple(explanations)
    for coordinate_index, (left_coordinate, right_coordinate) in enumerate(
        zip(left_representation.coordinates, right_representation.coordinates, strict=True),
    ):
        left_value = getattr(left, str(left_coordinate.field_name))
        right_value = getattr(right, str(right_coordinate.field_name))
        if not isinstance(left_value, int | float) or isinstance(left_value, bool):
            msg = "Dense explanation left coordinate must be numeric"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(right_value, int | float) or isinstance(right_value, bool):
            msg = "Dense explanation right coordinate must be numeric"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        explanations.append(
            MatchDenseContributionExplanation(
                coordinate_index=MatchExplanationCoordinateIndex(coordinate_index),
                left_value=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value)),
                right_value=MatchDenseValue(float(right_value)),
                contribution=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value) * float(right_value)),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(explanations)


def _normalized_text(value: str, representation: MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec[Any]) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize(representation.normalization.unicode_form.value, value)
    return normalized.casefold() if representation.normalization.case.value == "casefold" else normalized


def _text_diagnostics(
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    left: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId],
    right: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId],
) -> tuple[MatchSubstringOccurrence, ...]:
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        return ()
    left_value = getattr(left, str(left_representation.field_name))
    right_value = getattr(right, str(right_representation.field_name))
    if not isinstance(left_value, str) or not isinstance(right_value, str):
        raise TypeError("Text diagnostics require string representation values")
    pattern = _normalized_text(left_value, left_representation)
    text = _normalized_text(right_value, right_representation)
    occurrences: tuple[MatchSubstringOccurrence, ...] = ()
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec) and pattern:
        normalized_ranges = tuple((offset, offset + len(pattern)) for offset in range(len(text)) if text.startswith(pattern, offset))
        if spec.kernel.coordinate_space.value == "source":
            source_spans = normalized_source_spans(
                right_value,
                unicode_form=right_representation.normalization.unicode_form,
                casefold=right_representation.normalization.case.value == "casefold",
            )
            occurrences = tuple(
                MatchSubstringOccurrence(
                    start=MatchTextPosition(min(span[0] for span in source_spans[start:end])),
                    end=MatchTextPosition(max(span[1] for span in source_spans[start:end])),
                    coordinate_space=spec.kernel.coordinate_space,
                )
                for start, end in normalized_ranges
            )
        else:
            occurrences = tuple(
                MatchSubstringOccurrence(
                    start=MatchTextPosition(start),
                    end=MatchTextPosition(end),
                    coordinate_space=spec.kernel.coordinate_space,
                )
                for start, end in normalized_ranges
            )
    return occurrences


def _exact_diagnostics(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
    row: Mapping[str, object],
) -> MatchExactDiagnostics:
    occurrences = _text_diagnostics(spec, left, right)
    overlap = row.get(str(_STRING_OVERLAP_COLUMN), 0)
    assert isinstance(overlap, int)
    return MatchExactDiagnostics(
        explanations=_dense_explanations(spec, left, right, row),
        substring_occurrences=occurrences,
        qgram_overlap=MatchQGramOverlapCount(overlap),
    )

def _database_duplicate_count(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> MatchDuplicatePairCount:
    duplicate_count = 0
    for row in rows:
        physical_count = row[str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN)]
        if not isinstance(physical_count, int) or isinstance(physical_count, bool):
            msg = "Exact dense SQL stage must publish an integer duplicate count"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        duplicate_count += physical_count - 1
    if duplicate_count and isinstance(spec.policies.duplicates, RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.DUPLICATE_LOGICAL_PAIR,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_physical_pair_per_logical_pair"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue(f"duplicate_logical_pairs_{duplicate_count}"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    return MatchDuplicatePairCount(duplicate_count)


def _page_rows_and_state(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> tuple[Sequence[Mapping[str, object]], MatchPageComplete | MatchNextPage]:
    result_shape = spec.result_shape
    assert isinstance(
        result_shape,
        TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape | GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape,
    )
    pagination = result_shape.pagination
    if not isinstance(pagination, FirstMatchPage | MatchPageAfterCursor):
        return rows, MatchPageComplete()
    page_size = int(pagination.page_size)
    selected = rows[:page_size]
    if len(rows) <= page_size:
        return selected, MatchPageComplete()
    last = selected[-1]
    raw_rank = last[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
    assert isinstance(raw_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_rank, bool)
    return selected, MatchNextPage(
        cursor=MatchPageCursor(
            spec_fingerprint=spec.semantic_fingerprint,
            snapshot_fingerprint=preflight.snapshot_fingerprint,
            result_shape=spec.result_shape.kind,
            score=_score_value(last[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
            left_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(str(last[str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)])),
            right_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(str(last[str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)])),
            rank=MatchRank(raw_rank),
        ),
    )


def _decode_top_k_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
    runtime_receipts: _RuntimeStageReceipts,
) -> TopKPerLeftMatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    page_rows, page = _page_rows_and_state(rows, spec, preflight)
    duplicate_count = _database_duplicate_count(page_rows, spec)
    edge_model = _specialized_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_top_k_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    edges: list[PerLeftMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in page_rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"), runtime_receipts)
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"), runtime_receipts)
        score = MatchScore(
            canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
        )
        raw_rank = row[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
        assert isinstance(raw_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_rank, bool)
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=score,
                left_rank=MatchRank(raw_rank),
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    return result_model(
        edges=tuple(edges),
        page=page,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec, preflight),
        runtime_metrics=runtime_receipts.metrics(),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            bit_comparisons=preflight.bit_comparisons,
            posting_advances=preflight.posting_advances,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            qgram_posting_advances=preflight.qgram_posting_advances,
            edit_cells_evaluated=preflight.edit_cells_evaluated,
            candidate_pairs=preflight.candidate_pairs,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )

    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
    runtime_receipts: _RuntimeStageReceipts,

    page_rows, page = _page_rows_and_state(rows, spec, preflight)
    duplicate_count = _database_duplicate_count(page_rows, spec)
    edge_model = _specialized_global_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_global_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    edges: list[GlobalMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in page_rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"), runtime_receipts)
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"), runtime_receipts)
        raw_rank = row[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
        assert isinstance(raw_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_rank, bool)
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=MatchScore(
                    canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
                    exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
                    kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
                ),
                global_rank=MatchRank(raw_rank),
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    return result_model(
        edges=tuple(edges),
        page=page,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec, preflight),
        runtime_metrics=runtime_receipts.metrics(),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            bit_comparisons=preflight.bit_comparisons,
            posting_advances=preflight.posting_advances,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            qgram_posting_advances=preflight.qgram_posting_advances,
            edit_cells_evaluated=preflight.edit_cells_evaluated,
            candidate_pairs=preflight.candidate_pairs,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )
