def _decode_exact_dense_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
    runtime_receipts: _RuntimeStageReceipts,
) -> MatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
        for row in rows:
            if str(_EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN) not in row:
                raise TypeError("Native exact scorer omitted its executed-pair receipt")
            value = row[str(_EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)]
            if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
                raise TypeError("Native exact scorer must publish an integer executed-pair receipt")
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
        return _decode_top_k_rows(rows, spec, preflight, runtime_receipts)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        return _decode_top_k_right_rows(rows, spec, preflight, runtime_receipts)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
        return _decode_global_rows(rows, spec, preflight, runtime_receipts)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
        return _decode_threshold_rows(rows, spec, preflight, runtime_receipts)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape):
        return _decode_mutual_rows(rows, spec, preflight, runtime_receipts)
    msg = "Unknown Phase 2 result decoder variant"
    raise TypeError(msg)


class _ExactDenseDecodeStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchResult[Any, Any]]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _ExactDenseDecodeConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref
        self._preflight_rows_ref = config.preflight_rows_ref
        self._preflight_ref = config.preflight_ref
        self._spec = config.spec
        self._planning_operations = config.planning_operations

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "matching", "result_decode"})

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref), str(self._preflight_ref)})

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchResult[Any, Any]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchResult[Any, Any]:
        return self._decode_materialized_result(resolved, hydrator)

    def _decode_materialized_result(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchResult[Any, Any]:
        """Decode published rows and receipts without database I/O."""
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref)) or []
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence):
            msg = "Exact dense SQL stage must publish a row sequence"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        preflight = resolved.get(str(self._preflight_ref))
        if not isinstance(preflight, MatchPreflightCounters):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight must publish typed counters"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        rows: list[Mapping[str, object]] = []
        edit_cells: int | None = 0 if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec | MatchSubstringKernelSpec) else None
        string_postings = string_candidates = string_completion = 0
        h14_bits: int | None = None
        packed_calls: int | None = None
        for raw_row in raw_rows:
            if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
                msg = "Exact dense SQL stage published a non-row value"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            native = isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
            if native or isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec):
                population_admitted = raw_row.get(str(_SCORING_POPULATION_ADMITTED_COLUMN))
                if type(population_admitted) is not int or population_admitted not in (0, 1):
                    raise TypeError("Numeric scorer omitted its endpoint population receipt")
                if not population_admitted:
                    receipt_column = _EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN if native else _H14_EXECUTED_BITS_COLUMN
                    executed = raw_row.get(str(receipt_column))
                    if not isinstance(executed, int) or isinstance(executed, bool) or executed < 0:
                        raise TypeError("Numeric scorer omitted its nonnegative work receipt")
                    raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue("endpoint_population_within_declared_limits"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue("endpoint_population_exceeded_before_scoring"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                            spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                            executed_work=(
                                MatchNativeErrorWork(
                                    pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(
                                        int(preflight.executed_pair_evaluations) + executed,
                                    )
                                )
                                if native
                                else MatchH14ErrorWork(
                                    bit_comparisons=MatchBitComparisonCount(
                                        int(preflight.bit_comparisons) + executed,
                                    )
                                )
                            ),
                        )
                    )
            if isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
                value = raw_row.get(str(_EXECUTED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN))
                if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0:
                    raise TypeError("Packed scorer omitted its nonnegative executed-pair receipt")
                authority_count = raw_row.get(str(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN))
                if not isinstance(authority_count, int) or isinstance(authority_count, bool):
                    raise TypeError("Packed scorer omitted its authority receipt")
                if authority_count != 1:
                    raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_authoritative_native_exact_plan"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue("native_authority_changed_before_scoring"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                            spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                            executed_work=MatchNativeErrorWork(
                                pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(
                                    int(preflight.executed_pair_evaluations) + value,
                                )
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                if packed_calls is not None and value != packed_calls:
                    raise ValueError("Packed scorer published inconsistent executed-pair receipts")
                packed_calls = value
                if raw_row[str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)] is None:
                    continue
            if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec):
                value = raw_row.get(str(_H14_EXECUTED_BITS_COLUMN))
                if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0:
                    raise TypeError("H14 scorer omitted its nonnegative executed-bit receipt")
                authority_count = raw_row.get(str(_SCORING_AUTHORITY_COUNT_COLUMN))
                if not isinstance(authority_count, int) or isinstance(authority_count, bool):
                    raise TypeError("H14 scorer omitted its authority receipt")
                if authority_count != 1:
                    raise MatchArtifactError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_current_h14_projection_generation"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_authority_changed_before_scoring"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                            spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                            executed_work=MatchH14ErrorWork(
                                bit_comparisons=MatchBitComparisonCount(
                                    int(preflight.bit_comparisons) + value,
                                )
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                unsafe_sources = raw_row.get(str(_SCORING_UNSAFE_SOURCE_COUNT_COLUMN))
                if not isinstance(unsafe_sources, int) or isinstance(unsafe_sources, bool) or unsafe_sources < 0:
                    raise TypeError("H14 scorer omitted its source admission receipt")
                if unsafe_sources:
                    raise MatchArtifactError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue("current_h14_source_and_code_bindings"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_source_changed_before_scoring"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_SOURCE_DATA,
                            spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                            executed_work=MatchH14ErrorWork(
                                bit_comparisons=MatchBitComparisonCount(
                                    int(preflight.bit_comparisons) + value,
                                )
                            ),
                        )
                    )
                if h14_bits is not None and value != h14_bits:
                    raise ValueError("H14 scorer published inconsistent executed-bit receipts")
                h14_bits = value
                if raw_row[str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)] is None:
                    continue
            if edit_cells is not None:
                executed_cells = raw_row[str(_EDIT_EXECUTED_CELLS_COLUMN)]
                assert isinstance(executed_cells, int)
                edit_cells = executed_cells
                postings = raw_row[str(_STRING_POSTINGS_COLUMN)]
                candidates = raw_row[str(_STRING_CANDIDATES_COLUMN)]
                completion = raw_row[str(_STRING_COMPLETION_COLUMN)]
                assert isinstance(postings, int) and isinstance(candidates, int) and isinstance(completion, int)
                string_postings, string_candidates, string_completion = postings, candidates, completion
                if isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
                    qualifying_rows = raw_row[str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)]
                    assert isinstance(qualifying_rows, int)
                    if qualifying_rows > int(self._spec.result_shape.result_limit):
                        raise MatchResultCardinalityError(
                            MatchErrorContext(
                                invariant=MatchInvariant.RESULT_CARDINALITY_EXCEEDED,
                                expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"qualifying_rows_at_most_{self._spec.result_shape.result_limit}"),
                                observed=MatchObservedValue(f"qualifying_rows_{qualifying_rows}"),
                                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                                spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                            )
                        )
                if raw_row[str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)] is None:
                    continue
            rows.append(raw_row)
        if isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec) and packed_calls is None:
            raise TypeError("Packed scorer omitted its executed-pair receipt row")
        if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec) and h14_bits is None:
            raise TypeError("H14 scorer omitted its executed-bit receipt row")
        runtime_services = hydrator.runtime_services
        if runtime_services is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Exact dense result accounting requires ServerPlan runtime services")
        owned_refs = (str(self._source_ref), str(self._preflight_ref), str(self._preflight_rows_ref))
        executed_stage_receipts = tuple(
            receipt
            for receipt in runtime_services.execution_stage_receipts.snapshot()
            if any(receipt.contributes_to(ref) for ref in owned_refs)
        )
        completed_preflight = MatchPreflightCounters.model_validate(
            {
                **{field_name: getattr(preflight, field_name) for field_name in type(preflight).model_fields},
                "database_round_trips": MatchDatabaseRoundTripCount(
                    sum(receipt.driver_round_trips for receipt in executed_stage_receipts),
                ),
                **(
                    {"pair_evaluations": MatchPairEvaluationCount(int(preflight.executed_pair_evaluations) + packed_calls)}
                    if packed_calls is not None
                    else {}
                ),
                **(
                    {"bit_comparisons": MatchBitComparisonCount(int(preflight.bit_comparisons) + h14_bits)}
                    if h14_bits is not None
                    else {}
                ),
                **({"edit_cells_evaluated": MatchEditCellEvaluationCount(edit_cells)} if edit_cells is not None else {}),
                **(
                    {
                        "qgram_posting_advances": MatchQGramPostingAdvanceCount(string_postings),
                        "posting_advances": MatchPostingAdvanceCount(string_postings),
                        "candidate_pairs": MatchCandidatePairCount(string_candidates),
                        "exact_completion_pairs": MatchExactCompletionPairCount(string_completion),
                    }
                    if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec)
                    else {}
                ),
            },
        )
        runtime_receipts = _RuntimeStageReceipts(
            planning_operations=self._planning_operations,
            executed_stage_receipts=executed_stage_receipts,
            hydrated_endpoints=[],
        )
        return _decode_exact_dense_rows(rows, self._spec, completed_preflight, runtime_receipts)


class _ExactDenseIntentInputs(BaseModel, Generic[LeftRowT, RightRowT]):
    """Frozen matching inputs shaped before the intent enters the plan."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", arbitrary_types_allowed=True)

    spec: InstanceOf[MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]]
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None
    left_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None
    right_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None
    planning_operations: MatchStageOperationCount

    native_declaration: InstanceOf[MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] | None = None


class ExactDenseMatchIntent(IntentStep[MatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]]):
    """One closed exact dense scan followed by typed result decoding."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "matching", "exact_dense", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: ExactDenseMatchIntent[Any, Any],
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: ScalarServerRef[_ExactDenseIntentInputs[LeftRowT, RightRowT]],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config
        self._resolved_config = _require_seeded_config(config, "ExactDenseMatchIntent")

    def lower(
        self: ExactDenseMatchIntent[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        config = self._resolved_config
        preflight_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_preflight_rows")
        preflight_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_preflight")
        rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_rows")
        return (
            _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep(
                preflight_rows_ref,
                config.spec,
                native_declaration=config.native_declaration,
                left_permission=config.left_permission,
                right_permission=config.right_permission,
                versioned_branch_id=config.versioned_branch_id,
                left_source_ref=config.left_source_ref,
                right_source_ref=config.right_source_ref,
            ),
            _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep(
                preflight_ref,
                source_ref=preflight_rows_ref,
                spec=config.spec,
                permission_scope=config.permission_scope,
            ),
            _ExactDenseRowsStep(
                rows_ref,
                config.spec,
                guard_ref=preflight_ref,
                native_declaration=config.native_declaration,
                left_permission=config.left_permission,
                right_permission=config.right_permission,
                versioned_branch_id=config.versioned_branch_id,
                left_source_ref=config.left_source_ref,
                right_source_ref=config.right_source_ref,
            ),
            _ExactDenseDecodeStep(
                self.ref_id,
                config=_ExactDenseDecodeConfig(
                    source_ref=rows_ref,
                    preflight_rows_ref=preflight_rows_ref,
                    preflight_ref=preflight_ref,
                    spec=config.spec,
                    planning_operations=config.planning_operations,
                ),
            ),
        )


@pure_lazy
def _versioned_projection_source_ref(
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    field_owners: dict[str, type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = {field_name: model_cls for field_name in model_cls.model_fields}
    for subtype in collect_polymorphic_dispatch_subtypes(model_cls):
        if issubclass(subtype, model_cls) and get_table_name(subtype) == get_table_name(model_cls):
            for field_name in subtype.model_fields:
                field_owners.setdefault(field_name, subtype)
    query = txn.query_lazy(model_cls).select(
        *(field(getattr(owner, field_name)) for field_name, owner in field_owners.items()),
    )
    lazy_method = getattr(query, "lazy", None)
    if not callable(lazy_method):
        msg = "Versioned matching projection requires a lazy relation source"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    projected = lazy_method(_internal_projection=True)
    shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
        projected,
        site="exact dense versioned endpoint projection",
    )
    if shape.symbolic_ref_id is None:
        msg = "Versioned matching projection must publish one SQL relation"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return shape.symbolic_ref_id


@pure_lazy
def build_exact_dense_match_intent(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    *,
    planning_operations: int,
) -> ExactDenseMatchIntent[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    """Compile both permission predicates before constructing the candidate intent."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._permission_filter import compile_permission_expression

    left_versioned = _is_versioned_model(spec.left.row_type)
    right_versioned = _is_versioned_model(spec.right.row_type)
    left_source_ref = _versioned_projection_source_ref(txn, spec.left.row_type) if left_versioned else None
    right_source_ref = _versioned_projection_source_ref(txn, spec.right.row_type) if right_versioned else None
    versioned_endpoint = left_versioned or right_versioned
    versioning_domain = getattr(txn, "domain", None) if versioned_endpoint else None
    left_permission = compile_permission_expression(
        spec.left.row_type,
        txn.session_id,
        txn,
        table_alias=str(_LEFT_ALIAS),
        versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
    )
    right_permission = compile_permission_expression(
        spec.right.row_type,
        txn.session_id,
        txn,
        table_alias=str(_RIGHT_ALIAS),
        versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
    )
    branch_value = getattr(txn, "branch_anchor", None) if versioned_endpoint else None
    if branch_value is not None and not isinstance(branch_value, BranchId):
        msg = "Versioned matching requires a resolved branch identity"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    versioned_branch_id = branch_value if isinstance(branch_value, BranchId) else None
    if versioned_branch_id is not None:
        snapshot_scope = f"branch:{versioned_branch_id}"
    else:
        revision_value = getattr(txn, "revision_id", None) if versioned_endpoint else None
        snapshot_scope = f"revision:{revision_value}" if isinstance(revision_value, RevisionId) else "unversioned"
    execution_spec = (
        type(spec).model_validate(
            {
                **{field_name: getattr(spec, field_name) for field_name in type(spec).model_fields},
                "pair_scope": MatchPairScope(f"{spec.pair_scope}|{snapshot_scope}"),
            },
            context=(
                NativeExactDeploymentPlan(profile=spec.left.representation.native_profile, choice=spec.native_exact_choice)
                if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
                else None
            ),
        )
        if versioned_endpoint
        else spec
    )
    inputs = _ExactDenseIntentInputs(
        spec=execution_spec,
        native_declaration=spec if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec) else None,
        left_permission=None if left_source_ref is not None else left_permission,
        right_permission=None if right_source_ref is not None else right_permission,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source_ref=left_source_ref,
        right_source_ref=right_source_ref,
        planning_operations=MatchStageOperationCount(planning_operations),
        permission_scope=MatchPermissionFitScope(str(txn.session_id)),
    )
    return ExactDenseMatchIntent(ref_id, ServerRefs.scalar(inputs))

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PersistedH14Refs:
    left: ServerPlanRefId
    right: ServerPlanRefId
    artifacts: ServerPlanRefId
    tensors: ServerPlanRefId
    left_codes: ServerPlanRefId
    right_codes: ServerPlanRefId
    guard: ServerPlanRefId


def _validated_h14_state(artifact_rows: list[object], tensor_rows: list[object]) -> H14ProjectionFitResult:
    if len(artifact_rows) != 1 or not isinstance(artifact_rows[0], QuantizedProjectionArtifactRow):
        raise ValueError("H14 projection artifact identity is not unique")
    artifact_row = artifact_rows[0]
    if artifact_row.family != "h14":
        raise ValueError("persisted H14 matching requires an H14 projection artifact")
    if not all(isinstance(row, QuantizedProjectionTensorRow) for row in tensor_rows):
        raise TypeError("H14 projection tensor source contains an invalid row")
    tensors = {row.role: row for row in tensor_rows if isinstance(row, QuantizedProjectionTensorRow)}
    try:
        mean = tensors["mean"]
        rotation = tensors["rotation"]
        threshold = tensors["threshold"]
        residual = tensors["residual"]
    except KeyError as error:
        raise ValueError("H14 projection tensors are incomplete") from error
    return H14ProjectionFitResult(
        artifact=H14ProjectionArtifact.model_validate_json(artifact_row.contract_payload),
        mean_payload=mean.payload,
        rotation_payload=rotation.payload,
        threshold_payload=threshold.payload,
        residual_payload=residual.payload,
    )


class _PersistedH14SpoolStep(_EncodedMatchingSpoolStep):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        refs: _PersistedH14Refs,
        sqlite_native: bool,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            ref_id,
            refs=_EncodedRefs(left=refs.left, right=refs.right, guard=refs.guard),
            sqlite_native=sqlite_native,
            spec=spec,
        )
        self._h14_refs = refs

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                str(self._h14_refs.left),
                str(self._h14_refs.right),
                str(self._h14_refs.artifacts),
                str(self._h14_refs.tensors),
                str(self._h14_refs.left_codes),
                str(self._h14_refs.right_codes),
                str(self._h14_refs.guard),
            },
        )

    def _prepare(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> _PreparedEncodedBatch:
        artifact_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.artifacts, list, site="persisted H14 artifacts")
        tensor_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.tensors, list, site="persisted H14 tensors")
        state = _validated_h14_state(artifact_rows, tensor_rows)
        left_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.left, list, site="persisted H14 left rows")
        right_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.right, list, site="persisted H14 right rows")
        left_code_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.left_codes, list, site="persisted H14 left codes")
        right_code_rows = resolved.require(self._h14_refs.right_codes, list, site="persisted H14 right codes")
        if not all(isinstance(row, QuantizedCodeRow) for row in (*left_code_rows, *right_code_rows)):
            raise TypeError("persisted H14 code source contains an invalid row")
        left_codes = {
            str(row.source_identity): row for row in left_code_rows if isinstance(row, QuantizedCodeRow) and row.family == "h14"
        }
        right_codes = {
            str(row.source_identity): row for row in right_code_rows if isinstance(row, QuantizedCodeRow) and row.family == "h14"
        }
        left_representation = self._spec.left.representation
        right_representation = self._spec.right.representation
        if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            raise TypeError("persisted H14 matching requires persisted H14 endpoint representations")
        if (
            left_representation.projection_artifact_id != state.artifact.artifact_id
            or right_representation.projection_artifact_id != state.artifact.artifact_id
        ):
            raise ValueError("persisted H14 artifact does not match the declared generation")
        require_current = isinstance(self._spec.policies.freshness, RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy)
        declared_watermark = int(left_representation.source_watermark)

        def require_fresh(row: object, representation: MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec[Any]) -> None:
            value = _row_value(row, str(representation.source_watermark_field_name))
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
                raise TypeError("H14 endpoint source watermark must be an integer")
            if require_current and value != declared_watermark:
                raise ValueError("H14 code generation is stale for a visible endpoint")

        requests: list[tuple[str, int, str, bytes, bytes]] = []
        query_identities: list[str] = []
        rights: list[tuple[str, int, bytes]] = []
        for key, right_row in enumerate(right_rows, start=1):
            require_fresh(right_row, right_representation)
            identity = str(_row_value(right_row, "sys_id"))
            code = right_codes.get(identity)
            if code is None:
                raise ValueError("visible H14 endpoint has no code for the declared generation")
            rights.append((identity, key, code.packed_primary))
        native_spec = json.dumps(
            {
                "dimensions": 1024,
                "encoding": "bits",
                "metric": "hamming",
                "normalized_hamming": True,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        )
        for left_row in left_rows:
            require_fresh(left_row, left_representation)
            query_identity = str(_row_value(left_row, "sys_id"))
            query_code = left_codes.get(query_identity)
            if query_code is None:
                raise ValueError("visible H14 endpoint has no code for the declared generation")
            query_identities.append(query_identity)
            requests.extend(
                (query_identity, native_key, native_spec, query_code.packed_primary, right_payload)
                for _identity, native_key, right_payload in rights
            )
        return _PreparedEncodedBatch(
            requests=tuple(requests),
            right_identities=tuple((identity, key) for identity, key, _payload in rights),
            query_identities=tuple(query_identities),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PersistedH14IntentConfig:
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any]
    left_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    right_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    artifact_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    tensor_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    left_code_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    right_code_ref: ServerPlanRefId


class PersistedH14MatchIntent(IntentStep[MatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]]):
    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "matching", "h14", "persisted", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config_ref: ScalarServerRef[_PersistedH14IntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import _require_seeded_config

        super().__init__(ref_id)
        config = _require_seeded_config(config_ref, type(self).__name__)
        self._spec = config.spec
        self._left_ref = config.left_ref
        self._right_ref = config.right_ref
        self._artifact_ref = config.artifact_ref
        self._tensor_ref = config.tensor_ref
        self._left_code_ref = config.left_code_ref
        self._right_code_ref = config.right_code_ref

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l5250_matching.native_result_support import (
            _ExactDenseDecodeConfig,
            _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
            _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep,
            _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l5250_matching.usearch_native import _USearchMatchingRowsStep

        preflight_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_preflight_rows")
        guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_preflight")
        spool_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_native_batch")
        rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_rows")
        return (
            _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep(
                preflight_rows_ref,
                self._spec,
                left_permission=None,
                right_permission=None,
                versioned_branch_id=None,
                left_source_ref=self._left_ref,
                right_source_ref=self._right_ref,
            ),
            _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep(guard_ref, source_ref=preflight_rows_ref, spec=self._spec),
            _PersistedH14SpoolStep(
                spool_ref,
                refs=_PersistedH14Refs(
                    left=self._left_ref,
                    right=self._right_ref,
                    artifacts=self._artifact_ref,
                    tensors=self._tensor_ref,
                    left_codes=self._left_code_ref,
                    right_codes=self._right_code_ref,
                    guard=guard_ref,
                ),
                sqlite_native=(ctx.backend_profile.providers.vector_candidate_provider.uses_database_native_vector_scalars()),
                spec=self._spec,
            ),
            _USearchMatchingRowsStep(
                rows_ref,
                spool_ref=spool_ref,
                left_ref=self._left_ref,
                right_ref=self._right_ref,
                spec=self._spec,
            ),
            _ExactDenseDecodeStep(
                self.ref_id,
                config=_ExactDenseDecodeConfig(
                    source_ref=rows_ref,
                    preflight_rows_ref=preflight_rows_ref,
                    preflight_ref=guard_ref,
                    spec=self._spec,
                ),
            ),
        )


@pure_lazy
def build_persisted_h14_match_intent(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
) -> PersistedH14MatchIntent[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    from impl.common.l5250_matching.usearch_native import _projection_source_ref

    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if (
        not isinstance(left_representation, MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec)
        or not isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec,
        )
        or not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
    ):
        raise TypeError("persisted H14 matching requires persisted H14 representations and Hamming kernel")
    if (
        left_representation.projection_artifact_id != right_representation.projection_artifact_id
        or left_representation.source_watermark != right_representation.source_watermark
    ):
        raise ValueError("persisted H14 endpoints must use one artifact and source generation")
    left_ref = _projection_source_ref(txn, spec.left, spec.filters.left, permission_filter_required=True)
    right_ref = _projection_source_ref(txn, spec.right, spec.filters.right, permission_filter_required=True)
    artifact_id = right_representation.projection_artifact_id
    artifacts = (
        txn.query_lazy(QuantizedProjectionArtifactRow)
        .filter(
            field(QuantizedProjectionArtifactRow.artifact_id) == artifact_id,
        )
        .execute_lazy()
    )
    tensors = (
        txn.query_lazy(QuantizedProjectionTensorRow)
        .filter(
            field(QuantizedProjectionTensorRow.artifact_id) == artifact_id,
        )
        .execute_lazy()
    )
    source_watermark = QuantizedSourceWatermark(int(right_representation.source_watermark))
    left_codes = (
        txn.query_lazy(QuantizedCodeRow)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.artifact_id) == artifact_id)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.representation_ref_id) == left_representation.representation_ref_id)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.source_watermark) == source_watermark)
        .execute_lazy()
    )
    right_codes = (
        txn.query_lazy(QuantizedCodeRow)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.artifact_id) == artifact_id)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.representation_ref_id) == right_representation.representation_ref_id)
        .filter(field(QuantizedCodeRow.source_watermark) == source_watermark)
        .execute_lazy()
    )
    config_ref = ServerRefs.scalar(
        _PersistedH14IntentConfig(
            spec=spec,
            left_ref=left_ref,
            right_ref=right_ref,
            artifact_ref=_one_ref(artifacts, "persisted H14 artifact query"),
            tensor_ref=_one_ref(tensors, "persisted H14 tensor query"),
            left_code_ref=_one_ref(left_codes, "persisted H14 left code query"),
            right_code_ref=_one_ref(right_codes, "persisted H14 right code query"),
        ),
    )
    return PersistedH14MatchIntent(ref_id, config_ref)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _EndpointSqlSource:
    table_name: SqlTableName
    columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    auxiliary_query: SqlRenderable | None = None


def _resolve_endpoint_source(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
) -> _EndpointSqlSource:
    model_cls = relation.row_type
    if source_ref is None and isinstance(relation.source, MatchSingletonRelationSource):
        row_values = relation.source.row.model_dump(mode="json")
        columns = tuple(model_cls.model_fields)
        singleton_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(row_values[field_name]), SqlAliasName(field_name)) for field_name in columns],
            ),
        )
        source_name = SqlTableName(
            f"match_singleton_{hashlib.sha256(str(relation.relation_ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]}",
        )
        return _EndpointSqlSource(source_name, columns, singleton_query)
    if source_ref is None:
        return _EndpointSqlSource(_matching_table_name(model_cls))
    source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(source_ref))
    if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
        msg = f"Matching endpoint source {source_ref} must be SQL-visible"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return _EndpointSqlSource(
        SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
        source_cte.columns,
        source_cte.auxiliary_query,
    )


def _catalog_polymorphic_subtypes(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None,
) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]:
    if planning_catalog is None:
        return tuple(collect_polymorphic_dispatch_subtypes(model_cls))
    shape = planning_catalog.polymorphic_for_base(model_cls)
    candidates = (
        *(shape.subtypes if shape is not None else ()),
        *planning_catalog.tables,
    )
    return tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            candidate
            for candidate in candidates
            if candidate is not model_cls and isinstance(candidate, type) and issubclass(candidate, model_cls)
        )
    )


def _endpoint_source_relation(
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlTableAlias:
    if source.columns is None:
        return SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(source.table_name), alias)
    source_alias = SqlAliasName(f"{alias}_source")
    available = frozenset(source.columns)
    projections: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
    field_owners: dict[str, type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = {field_name: model_cls for field_name in model_cls.model_fields}
    for subtype in collect_polymorphic_dispatch_subtypes(model_cls):
        if issubclass(subtype, model_cls) and get_table_name(subtype) == get_table_name(model_cls):
            for field_name in subtype.model_fields:
                field_owners.setdefault(field_name, subtype)
    projected_columns: set[str] = set()
    for field_name, owner in field_owners.items():
        db_column = _matching_db_column_name(owner, field_name)
        if field_name in available:
            expression: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(field_name), qualifier=source_alias)
        elif db_column in available:
            expression = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_column), qualifier=source_alias)
        else:
            expression = SqlParam(None)
        projections.append(SqlSelectAlias(expression, SqlAliasName(db_column)))
        projected_columns.add(str(db_column))
    projections.extend(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(column),
        )
        for column in source.columns
        if column not in projected_columns
    )
    normalized = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(projections),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(source.table_name), source_alias),
    )
    return SqlTableAlias(normalized, alias)


def _is_versioned_model(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> bool:
    return isinstance(getattr(model_cls, "__versioning_domain__", None), type)


def _matching_table_name(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> SqlTableName:
    return get_table_name(model_cls)


def _selected_model_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    source_alias: SqlAliasName,
    output_prefix: str,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None,
) -> tuple[list[SqlSelectAlias], tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    projections: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
    output_columns: list[str] = []
    renamed_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
    omitted_version_fields = {"revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"} if _is_versioned_model(model_cls) else set()
    field_owners: dict[str, type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = {
        field_name: model_cls for field_name in model_cls.model_fields if field_name not in omitted_version_fields
    }
    subtypes = _catalog_polymorphic_subtypes(model_cls, planning_catalog)
    for subtype in subtypes:
        if issubclass(subtype, model_cls) and get_table_name(subtype) == get_table_name(model_cls):
            for field_name in subtype.model_fields:
                if field_name not in omitted_version_fields:
                    field_owners.setdefault(field_name, subtype)
    for field_name, field_owner in field_owners.items():
        db_column = _matching_db_column_name(field_owner, field_name)
        output_name = f"{output_prefix}{field_name}"
        model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(field_owner, (db_column,))
        if model_hints is None:
            msg = f"Dense matching requires SQL type hints for {field_owner.__name__}.{field_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        projections.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_column), qualifier=source_alias),
                SqlAliasName(output_name),
            ),
        )
        output_columns.append(output_name)
        renamed_hints.append(model_hints.rename_column(db_column, output_name))
    return (
        projections,
        tuple(output_columns),
        combine_sql_column_type_hints(tuple(output_columns), *renamed_hints),
    )


DenseRepresentation = (
    MatchDenseRepresentationSpec[Any] | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[Any] | MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[Any]
)
ExecutableRepresentation = (
    DenseRepresentation
    | MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec[Any]
    | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[Any]
    | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec[Any]
    | MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[Any]
    | MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec[Any]
)


def _representation_dimensions(representation: ExecutableRepresentation) -> int:
    if isinstance(representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec):
        return 1024
    if isinstance(representation, MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        return int(representation.contract.dimensions)
    if isinstance(representation, MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec):
        return int(representation.source_dimensions)
    return int(representation.dimensions)


def _dense_coordinate_expression(
    representation: DenseRepresentation,
    row_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
    index: int,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if isinstance(representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec):
        coordinate = representation.coordinates[index]
        return SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(row_type, str(coordinate.field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        )
    return SqlJsonAccess(
        JsonAccessKind.GET_FLOAT,
        SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(row_type, str(representation.field_name))),
            qualifier=alias,
        ),
        SqlJsonPath(f"$[{index}]"),
    )


def _representation_presence_expression(
    representation: ExecutableRepresentation,
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    availability = representation.availability
    if isinstance(availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(availability.row_type, str(availability.field_name))),
                qualifier=alias,
            ),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(True),
        )
    return SqlParam(True)


def _typed_score_expression(
    expression: MatchScoreExpression,
    null_policy: MatchExpressionNullPolicy,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    field_expression: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression):
        field_expression = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(expression.row_type, str(expression.field_name))),
            qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        )
    elif isinstance(expression, MatchRightFieldExpression):
        field_expression = SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(expression.row_type, str(expression.field_name))),
            qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
        )
    if field_expression is not None:
        if null_policy is MatchExpressionNullPolicy.COALESCE_ZERO:
            return SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.COALESCE, (field_expression, SqlParam(0.0)))
        return field_expression
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.ADD,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchMultiplyExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.MUL,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchSubtractExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.left, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.SUB,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.right, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            _typed_score_expression(expression.numerator, null_policy),
            BinaryOp.DIV,
            _typed_score_expression(expression.denominator, null_policy),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        functions = {MatchExpressionFunction.ABSOLUTE: FunctionKind.ABS}
        return SqlFuncCall(
            functions[expression.function],
            (_typed_score_expression(expression.argument, null_policy),),
        )
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _expression_node_count(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> int:
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        return 1 + _expression_node_count(expression.left) + _expression_node_count(expression.right)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return 1 + _expression_node_count(expression.numerator) + _expression_node_count(expression.denominator)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        return 1 + _expression_node_count(expression.argument)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression | MatchRightFieldExpression):
        return 1
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _score_expression(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec):
        return _typed_score_expression(spec.kernel.expression, spec.kernel.null_policy)
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if left_representation.projection_artifact_id != right_representation.projection_artifact_id:
            raise ValueError("Exact H14 matching requires one projection artifact generation")
        left_code = SqlH14BytesToBit(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.left.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
        )
        right_code = SqlH14BytesToBit(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.right.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
        )
        return SqlH14Similarity(left_code, right_code)
    if isinstance(left_representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        if left_representation.dimensions != right_representation.dimensions:
            raise ValueError("Exact packed matching requires equal left and right dimensions")
        return SqlPackedDenseDotProduct(
            left=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.left.row_type, str(left_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
            ),
            right=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.right.row_type, str(right_representation.field_name))),
                qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
            ),
            dimensions=int(left_representation.dimensions),
            physical_type=left_representation.native_profile.physical_type,
        )
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires a dense left representation"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if not isinstance(right_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires a dense right representation"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if left_representation.dimensions != right_representation.dimensions:
        msg = "Exact dense matching requires equal left and right dimensions"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    products = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            _dense_coordinate_expression(left_representation, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS, index),
            BinaryOp.MUL,
            _dense_coordinate_expression(right_representation, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS, index),
        )
        for index in range(int(left_representation.dimensions))
    ]
    terms: list[SqlRenderable] = list(products)
    while len(terms) > 1:
        combined: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for index in range(0, len(terms), 2):
            if index + 1 == len(terms):
                combined.append(terms[index])
            else:
                combined.append(SqlBinaryOp(terms[index], BinaryOp.ADD, terms[index + 1]))
        terms = combined
    score = terms[0]
    missing_policy = spec.policies.missing_representation
    if isinstance(missing_policy, EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy):
        both_present = sql_and(
            _representation_presence_expression(left_representation, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            _representation_presence_expression(right_representation, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
        )
        return SqlCase(
            ((both_present, score),),
            else_=SqlParam(float(missing_policy.score)),
        )
    return score


def _endpoint_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    versioned_source_prefiltered: bool,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    filter_spec = spec.filters.left if left else spec.filters.right
    predicates = [] if permission is None else [permission]
    if _is_versioned_model(relation.row_type) and not versioned_source_prefiltered:
        if versioned_branch_id is None:
            msg = "Versioned matching requires a literal branch snapshot"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(str(versioned_branch_id)),
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(filter_spec, MatchEndpointFilterSpec):
        predicates.append(
            ExpressionToGrammar(relation.row_type, table_alias=str(alias)).convert(filter_spec.expression),
        )
    representation = relation.representation
    if (
        include_presence
        and isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
        )
        and isinstance(representation.availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec)
    ):
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        _matching_db_column_name(
                            representation.availability.row_type,
                            str(representation.availability.field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=alias,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(True),
            ),
        )
    return None if not predicates else sql_and(*predicates)


def _candidate_predicate(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    versioned_sources_prefiltered: bool,
    include_presence: bool = True,
    apply_self_policy: bool = True,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    predicates = [
        predicate
        for predicate in (
            _endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=True,
                permission=left_permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=versioned_sources_prefiltered,
            ),
            _endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=False,
                permission=right_permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=versioned_sources_prefiltered,
            ),
        )
        if predicate is not None
    ]
    if (
        apply_self_policy
        and spec.policies.self_edges is MatchSelfEdgePolicy.EXCLUDE
        and get_table_name(spec.left.row_type) == get_table_name(spec.right.row_type)
    ):
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                _identity_sql_expression(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.NE,
                _identity_sql_expression(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(spec.filters.pair, MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec):
        pair_operators = {
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.EQUAL: BinaryOp.EQ,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.NOT_EQUAL: BinaryOp.NE,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.LESS_THAN: BinaryOp.LT,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: BinaryOp.LE,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.GREATER_THAN: BinaryOp.GT,
            MatchPairComparisonOperator.GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: BinaryOp.GE,
        }
        predicates.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        _matching_db_column_name(
                            spec.filters.pair.left_row_type,
                            str(spec.filters.pair.left_field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
                ),
                pair_operators[spec.filters.pair.operator],
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(
                        _matching_db_column_name(
                            spec.filters.pair.right_row_type,
                            str(spec.filters.pair.right_field_name),
                        ),
                    ),
                    qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return None if not predicates else sql_and(*predicates)


def _cursor_predicate(cursor: MatchPageCursor) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
        BinaryOp.GT,
        SqlParam(int(cursor.rank)),
    )


def _exact_dense_statement(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None,
) -> tuple[SqlSelect, tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    if spec.kernel.kind not in {MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT, MatchKernelKind.H14_HAMMING} and not isinstance(
        spec.kernel,
        MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec,
    ):
        msg = "Exact matching supports only dense, H14, and typed-expression kernels"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    score_order_direction = (
        OrderDirection.DESC if spec.kernel.score_direction is MatchScoreDirection.HIGHER_IS_BETTER else OrderDirection.ASC
    )
    if spec.policies.guarantee is not MatchGuarantee.EXACT:
        msg = "Phase 2 exact dense execution rejects approximate guarantees"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not isinstance(
        spec.result_shape,
        TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape | GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape,
    ):
        msg = "Exact dense execution requires a supported result shape"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    left_projection, left_columns, left_hints = _selected_model_columns(
        spec.left.row_type,
        source_alias=_LEFT_ALIAS,
        output_prefix="left__",
        planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
    )
    right_projection, right_columns, right_hints = _selected_model_columns(
        spec.right.row_type,
        source_alias=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
        output_prefix="right__",
        planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
    )
    score = _score_expression(spec)
    left_id = SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.left.row_type, "sys_id")),
        qualifier=_LEFT_ALIAS,
    )
    right_id = SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(spec.right.row_type, "sys_id")),
        qualifier=_RIGHT_ALIAS,
    )
    endpoint_where = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
        include_presence=not isinstance(
            spec.policies.missing_representation,
            EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy,
        ),
    )
    left_identity = SqlCast(_identity_sql_expression(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS), parse_cast_target_type("TEXT"))
    right_identity = SqlCast(_identity_sql_expression(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS), parse_cast_target_type("TEXT"))
    duplicate_partition = (left_identity, right_identity)
    duplicate_policy = spec.policies.duplicates
    candidate_score: SqlRenderable = score
    if isinstance(duplicate_policy, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy):
        candidate_score = SqlWindow(
            func=SqlFuncCall(
                "SUM" if duplicate_policy.score_combination is MatchDuplicateScoreCombination.SUM else "MAX",
                [score],
            ),
            partition_by=duplicate_partition,
        )
    execution_receipt_projections: tuple[SqlSelectAlias, ...] = ()
    execution_receipt_columns: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec):
        execution_receipt_projections = (
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [left_id])),
                    BinaryOp.MUL,
                    SqlParam(_expression_node_count(spec.kernel.expression)),
                ),
                SqlAliasName(_EXPRESSION_EXECUTED_COLUMN),
            ),
        )
        execution_receipt_columns = (str(_EXPRESSION_EXECUTED_COLUMN),)
    candidates = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                *left_projection,
                *right_projection,
                SqlSelectAlias(left_identity, SqlAliasName(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(right_identity, SqlAliasName(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(candidate_score, SqlAliasName(_SCORE_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(
                        func_name=FunctionKind.ROW_NUMBER,
                        partition_by=duplicate_partition,
                        order_by=(
                            SqlOrderByItem(left_id, OrderDirection.ASC),
                            SqlOrderByItem(right_id, OrderDirection.ASC),
                        ),
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [left_id]), partition_by=duplicate_partition),
                    SqlAliasName(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlWindow(func=SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [left_id])), SqlAliasName(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)),
                *execution_receipt_projections,
            ],
        ),
        from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
        joins=(
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.CROSS,
                _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
            ),
        ),
        where=endpoint_where,
    )
    physical_candidate_columns = (
        *left_columns,
        *right_columns,
        str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_SCORE_COLUMN),
        str(_DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN),
        str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
        str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
        *execution_receipt_columns,
    )
    candidate_relation: SqlRenderable = candidates
    explanation_columns: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    explanation_policy = spec.policies.explanations
    if isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy) and isinstance(
        duplicate_policy,
        CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy,
    ):
        left_representation = spec.left.representation
        right_representation = spec.right.representation
        assert isinstance(left_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec)
        assert isinstance(right_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec)
        coordinate_count = len(left_representation.coordinates)
        physical_slot_count = max(1, int(explanation_policy.max_rows) // coordinate_count)
        generated_columns: list[str] = []
        generated_projections: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
        enriched_partition = (
            SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_ENRICHED_ALIAS),
            SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_ENRICHED_ALIAS),
        )
        for physical_slot in range(1, physical_slot_count + 1):
            for coordinate_index, (left_coordinate, right_coordinate) in enumerate(
                zip(left_representation.coordinates, right_representation.coordinates, strict=True),
            ):
                for side, field_name in (
                    ("left", str(left_coordinate.field_name)),
                    ("right", str(right_coordinate.field_name)),
                ):
                    column_name = f"match_explanation_{physical_slot}_{coordinate_index}_{side}"
                    generated_columns.append(column_name)
                    generated_projections.append(
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlWindow(
                                func=SqlFuncCall(
                                    "MAX",
                                    [
                                        SqlCase(
                                            (
                                                (
                                                    SqlBinaryOp(
                                                        SqlColumnRef(
                                                            _DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN,
                                                            qualifier=_ENRICHED_ALIAS,
                                                        ),
                                                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                                                        SqlParam(physical_slot),
                                                    ),
                                                    SqlColumnRef(
                                                        SqlColumnName(f"{side}__{field_name}"),
                                                        qualifier=_ENRICHED_ALIAS,
                                                    ),
                                                ),
                                            ),
                                            else_=SqlParam(None),
                                        ),
                                    ],
                                ),
                                partition_by=enriched_partition,
                            ),
                            SqlAliasName(column_name),
                        ),
                    )
        explanation_columns = tuple(generated_columns)
        candidate_relation = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    *(
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_ENRICHED_ALIAS),
                            SqlAliasName(column),
                        )
                        for column in physical_candidate_columns
                    ),
                    *generated_projections,
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(candidates, _ENRICHED_ALIAS),
        )
    candidate_columns = (
        *left_columns,
        *right_columns,
        str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
        str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
        *execution_receipt_columns,
        *explanation_columns,
    )
    deduplicated = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                *(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for column in candidate_columns
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
                    SqlAliasName(_SCORE_COLUMN),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(candidate_relation, _CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
        where=SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_DUPLICATE_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_CANDIDATE_ALIAS),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(1),
        ),
    )
    ranked_left_identity = SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS)
    ranked_right_identity = SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS)
    ranked_score = SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS)
    rank_partition: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    rank_tie_identities: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        rank_partition = (ranked_right_identity,)
        rank_tie_identities = (ranked_left_identity,)
    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
        rank_partition = ()
        rank_tie_identities = (ranked_left_identity, ranked_right_identity)
    else:
        rank_partition = (ranked_left_identity,)
        rank_tie_identities = (ranked_right_identity,)
    ranked_columns = (*candidate_columns, str(_SCORE_COLUMN))
    ranked = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                *(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for column in ranked_columns
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(
                        func_name=FunctionKind.ROW_NUMBER,
                        partition_by=rank_partition,
                        order_by=(
                            SqlOrderByItem(ranked_score, score_order_direction),
                            *(SqlOrderByItem(identity, OrderDirection.ASC) for identity in rank_tie_identities),
                        ),
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_RANK_COLUMN),
                ),
                *(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlWindow(
                                func_name=FunctionKind.ROW_NUMBER,
                                partition_by=(ranked_right_identity,),
                                order_by=(
                                    SqlOrderByItem(ranked_score, score_order_direction),
                                    SqlOrderByItem(ranked_left_identity, OrderDirection.ASC),
                                ),
                            ),
                            SqlAliasName(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN),
                        ),
                    ]
                    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape)
                    else []
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(deduplicated, _DEDUPLICATED_ALIAS),
    )
    output_columns = (
        *left_columns,
        *right_columns,
        str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN),
        str(_SCORE_COLUMN),
        str(_RANK_COLUMN),
        *((str(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN),) if isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape) else ()),
        str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
        str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
        *execution_receipt_columns,
        *explanation_columns,
    )
    result_order: tuple[SqlOrderByItem, ...]
    result_limit: int | None
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
        result_predicate: SqlRenderable | None = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
            BinaryOp.LE,
            SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count)),
        )
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), OrderDirection.ASC),
        )
        result_limit = None
    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        result_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
            BinaryOp.LE,
            SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count)),
        )
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), OrderDirection.ASC),
        )
        result_limit = None
    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
        result_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
            BinaryOp.LE,
            SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.neighbor_count)),
        )
        pagination = spec.result_shape.pagination
        if isinstance(pagination, MatchPageAfterCursor):
            result_predicate = sql_and(result_predicate, _cursor_predicate(pagination.cursor))
        result_order = (SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), OrderDirection.ASC),)
        result_limit = int(pagination.page_size) + 1 if isinstance(pagination, FirstMatchPage | MatchPageAfterCursor) else None
    elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape):
        result_predicate = sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.LE,
                SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.left_neighbor_count)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                BinaryOp.LE,
                SqlParam(int(spec.result_shape.right_neighbor_count)),
            ),
        )
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_RANK_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), OrderDirection.ASC),
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
        )
        result_limit = None
    else:
        assert isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
        threshold_operator = BinaryOp.GE if spec.result_shape.boundary.value == "inclusive" else BinaryOp.GT
        result_predicate = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
            threshold_operator,
            SqlParam(float(spec.result_shape.threshold)),
        )
        result_order = (
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(_SCORE_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS), score_order_direction),
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN, qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
        )
        result_limit = int(spec.result_shape.result_limit)
    outer = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=_RANKED_ALIAS),
                    SqlAliasName(column),
                )
                for column in output_columns
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(ranked, _RANKED_ALIAS),
        where=result_predicate,
        order_by=result_order,
        limit=result_limit,
    )
    hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
        output_columns,
        left_hints,
        right_hints,
        SqlColumnTypeHints(
            double_columns=frozenset({str(_SCORE_COLUMN), *explanation_columns}),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(
                {
                    str(_RANK_COLUMN),
                    str(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN),
                    str(_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                    str(_DUPLICATE_COUNT_COLUMN),
                    *execution_receipt_columns,
                }
                & set(output_columns),
            ),
            text_columns=frozenset({str(_LEFT_IDENTITY_COLUMN), str(_RIGHT_IDENTITY_COLUMN)}),
        ),
    )
    return outer, output_columns, hints


def _endpoint_max_updated_subquery(

    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlFuncCall(
                        "MAX",
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(
                                SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(relation.row_type, "updated_at")),
                                qualifier=alias,
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=_endpoint_predicate(
                spec,
                left=left,
                permission=permission,
                include_presence=False,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
            ),
        ),
    )
