def _endpoint_failure_count_expression(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left: bool,
    permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    relation = spec.left if left else spec.right
    alias = _LEFT_ALIAS if left else _RIGHT_ALIAS
    representation = relation.representation
    if not isinstance(
        representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
        | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
        | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
        | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec
        | MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec
        | MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
    ) or not isinstance(representation.availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceWithFailureSpec):
        return SqlParam(0)
    visibility = _endpoint_predicate(
        spec,
        left=left,
        permission=permission,
        include_presence=False,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_source_prefiltered=source.columns is not None,
    )
    failure = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(
                _matching_db_column_name(
                    representation.availability.row_type,
                    str(representation.availability.producer_failure_field_name),
                ),
            ),
            qualifier=alias,
        ),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlParam(True),
    )
    where = failure if visibility is None else sql_and(visibility, failure)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(source, relation.row_type, alias),
            where=where,
        ),
    )


def _pair_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    include_presence: bool,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    apply_self_policy: bool = True,
) -> SqlSubquery:
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=_candidate_predicate(
                spec,
                left_permission=left_permission,
                right_permission=right_permission,
                include_presence=include_presence,
                versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
                apply_self_policy=apply_self_policy,
            ),
        ),
    )


def _expression_nodes(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> tuple[MatchScoreExpression, ...]:
    children: tuple[MatchScoreExpression, ...]
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        children = (expression.left, expression.right)
    elif isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        children = (expression.numerator, expression.denominator)
    elif isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        children = (expression.argument,)
    else:
        children = ()
    return (expression, *(node for child in children for node in _expression_nodes(child)))


def _expression_failure_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    failure: str,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    kernel = spec.kernel
    if not isinstance(kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec):
        return SqlParam(0)
    nodes = _expression_nodes(kernel.expression)
    predicates: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    if failure == "null":
        if kernel.null_policy is MatchExpressionNullPolicy.COALESCE_ZERO:
            return SqlParam(0)
        fields = tuple(node for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchLeftFieldExpression | MatchRightFieldExpression))
        predicates = tuple(SqlIsNull(_typed_score_expression(node, MatchExpressionNullPolicy.REJECT)) for node in fields)
    elif failure == "zero_denominator":
        denominators = tuple(node.denominator for node in nodes if isinstance(node, MatchDivideExpression))
        predicates = tuple(
            SqlBinaryOp(_typed_score_expression(node, kernel.null_policy), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(0.0)) for node in denominators
        )
    elif failure == "unsafe":
        maximum = SqlParam(float.fromhex("0x1.fffffffffffffp+1023"))
        multiplication_predicates = tuple(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.left, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.right, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.left, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        maximum,
                        BinaryOp.DIV,
                        SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.right, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            for node in nodes
            if isinstance(node, MatchMultiplyExpression)
        )
        division_predicates = tuple(
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.denominator, kernel.null_policy),)),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0.0),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.numerator, kernel.null_policy),)),
                        BinaryOp.DIV,
                        maximum,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlFuncCall(FunctionKind.ABS, (_typed_score_expression(node.denominator, kernel.null_policy),)),
                ),
            )
            for node in nodes
            if isinstance(node, MatchDivideExpression)
        )
        predicates = (*multiplication_predicates, *division_predicates)
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown expression failure preflight: {failure}")
    if not predicates:
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    failure_predicate = sql_or(*predicates)
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=failure_predicate if candidate is None else sql_and(candidate, failure_predicate),
        ),
    )


def _identity_sql_expression(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
) -> SqlColumnRef:
    identity = relation.identity
    if isinstance(identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec):
        field_name = "sys_id"
    elif isinstance(identity, MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec):
        field_name = str(identity.field_name)
    else:
        msg = f"Unknown matching identity variant: {type(identity).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(_matching_db_column_name(relation.row_type, field_name)),
        qualifier=alias,
    )


def _indexed_pair_count_subquery(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    artifact_state = NoMatchArtifactState()
    if not isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState):
        return SqlParam(0)
    if not artifact_state.indexed_left_identities or not artifact_state.indexed_right_identities:
        return SqlParam(0)
    candidate = _candidate_predicate(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        versioned_sources_prefiltered=left_source.columns is not None or right_source.columns is not None,
    )
    indexed = sql_and(
        SqlIn(
            _identity_sql_expression(spec.left, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            tuple(SqlParam(str(identity)) for identity in artifact_state.indexed_left_identities),
        ),
        SqlIn(
            _identity_sql_expression(spec.right, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
            tuple(SqlParam(str(identity)) for identity in artifact_state.indexed_right_identities),
        ),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])]),
            from_=_endpoint_source_relation(left_source, spec.left.row_type, _LEFT_ALIAS),
            joins=(
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.CROSS,
                    _endpoint_source_relation(right_source, spec.right.row_type, _RIGHT_ALIAS),
                ),
            ),
            where=indexed if candidate is None else sql_and(candidate, indexed),
        ),
    )


def _exact_dense_preflight_statement(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    *,
    left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
    versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
    left_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
    right_source: _EndpointSqlSource,
) -> SqlSelect:
    pair_count = _pair_count_subquery(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=True,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source=left_source,
        right_source=right_source,
    )
    visible_pair_count = _pair_count_subquery(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=False,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source=left_source,
        right_source=right_source,
    )
    all_pair_count = _pair_count_subquery(
        spec,
        left_permission=left_permission,
        right_permission=right_permission,
        include_presence=False,
        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
        left_source=left_source,
        right_source=right_source,
        apply_self_policy=False,
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(pair_count, SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    visible_pair_count,
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    all_pair_count,
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_ALL_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        include_presence=False,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        include_presence=False,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        include_presence=True,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        include_presence=True,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_failure_count_expression(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_FAILURE_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_failure_count_expression(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_FAILURE_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_max_updated_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=True,
                        permission=left_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=left_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _endpoint_max_updated_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left=False,
                        permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    _indexed_pair_count_subquery(
                        spec,
                        left_permission=left_permission,
                        right_permission=right_permission,
                        versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                        left_source=left_source,
                        right_source=right_source,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName(_PREFLIGHT_INDEXED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                ),
                *(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        _expression_failure_count_subquery(
                            spec,
                            failure=failure,
                            left_permission=left_permission,
                            right_permission=right_permission,
                            versioned_branch_id=versioned_branch_id,
                            left_source=left_source,
                            right_source=right_source,
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for failure, column in (
                        ("null", _PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_NULL_COUNT_COLUMN),
                        ("zero_denominator", _PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_ZERO_DIVISOR_COUNT_COLUMN),
                        ("unsafe", _PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_UNSAFE_COUNT_COLUMN),
                    )
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )


class _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep(NonPublishingStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        *,
        left_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        right_permission: SqlRenderable | None,
        versioned_branch_id: BranchId | None,
        left_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        right_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._spec = spec
        self._left_permission = left_permission
        self._right_permission = right_permission
        self._versioned_branch_id = versioned_branch_id
        self._left_source_ref = left_source_ref
        self._right_source_ref = right_source_ref

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "matching", "exact_dense", "work_preflight"})

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in (self._left_source_ref, self._right_source_ref) if ref is not None)

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                str(_matching_table_name(self._spec.left.row_type)),
                str(_matching_table_name(self._spec.right.row_type)),
            },
        )

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(
        self: _ExactDensePreflightRowsStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        left_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._left_source_ref, self._spec.left)
        right_source = _resolve_endpoint_source(ctx, self._right_source_ref, self._spec.right)
        grammar = _exact_dense_preflight_statement(
            self._spec,
            left_permission=self._left_permission,
            right_permission=self._right_permission,
            versioned_branch_id=self._versioned_branch_id,
            left_source=left_source,
            right_source=right_source,
        )
        output_columns = (
            str(_PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_ALL_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_FAILURE_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_FAILURE_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_INDEXED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_NULL_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_ZERO_DIVISOR_COUNT_COLUMN),
            str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_UNSAFE_COUNT_COLUMN),
        )
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="exact_dense_preflight") for column in output_columns),
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            (source.table_name, source.auxiliary_query) for source in (left_source, right_source) if source.auxiliary_query is not None
        ]
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bigint_columns=frozenset(
                    column
                    for column in output_columns
                    if column not in {str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN), str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)}
                ),
                timestamptz_columns=frozenset(
                    {str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN), str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)},
                ),
            ),
            grammar=grammar,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
        )


class _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchPreflightCounters]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._spec = spec

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchPreflightCounters]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def _evaluate(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchPreflightCounters:
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref)) or []
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence) or len(raw_rows) != 1:
            msg = "Exact dense preflight must publish one count row"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        raw_row = raw_rows[0]
        if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight published a non-row value"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        artifact_state = NoMatchArtifactState()
        if (
            isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState)
            and isinstance(self._spec.policies.freshness, RequireCurrentFreshnessPolicy)
            and artifact_state.artifact_watermark != artifact_state.source_watermark
        ):
            raise MatchFreshnessError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"source_watermark_{artifact_state.source_watermark}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"artifact_watermark_{artifact_state.artifact_watermark}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.WAIT_FOR_FRESHNESS,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        count_values = {
            "pair_evaluations": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "visible_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_VISIBLE_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "all_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_ALL_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "left_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "right_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "left_represented_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN)],
            "right_represented_rows": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_REPRESENTED_COLUMN)],
            "left_producer_failures": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_FAILURE_COLUMN)],
            "right_producer_failures": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_FAILURE_COLUMN)],
            "indexed_pairs": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_INDEXED_PAIR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "expression_nulls": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_NULL_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "expression_zero_divisors": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_ZERO_DIVISOR_COUNT_COLUMN)],
            "expression_unsafe_values": raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_EXPRESSION_UNSAFE_COUNT_COLUMN)],
        }
        if any(not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) for value in count_values.values()):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight counts must be integers"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        pair_evaluations = count_values["pair_evaluations"]
        visible_pairs = count_values["visible_pairs"]
        all_pairs = count_values["all_pairs"]
        left_rows = count_values["left_rows"]
        right_rows = count_values["right_rows"]
        left_represented_rows = count_values["left_represented_rows"]
        right_represented_rows = count_values["right_represented_rows"]
        left_producer_failures = count_values["left_producer_failures"]
        right_producer_failures = count_values["right_producer_failures"]
        indexed_pairs = count_values["indexed_pairs"]
        expression_nulls = count_values["expression_nulls"]
        expression_zero_divisors = count_values["expression_zero_divisors"]
        expression_unsafe_values = count_values["expression_unsafe_values"]
        assert isinstance(pair_evaluations, int)
        assert isinstance(visible_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(all_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(left_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(right_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(left_represented_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(right_represented_rows, int)
        assert isinstance(left_producer_failures, int)
        assert isinstance(right_producer_failures, int)
        assert isinstance(indexed_pairs, int)
        assert isinstance(expression_nulls, int)
        assert isinstance(expression_zero_divisors, int)
        assert isinstance(expression_unsafe_values, int)
        expression_failure = next(
            (
                (failure_invariant, failure_observed)
                for failure_count, failure_invariant, failure_observed in (
                    (
                        expression_nulls,
                        MatchInvariant.NULL_EXPRESSION_INPUT,
                        f"null_expression_inputs_{expression_nulls}",
                    ),
                    (
                        expression_zero_divisors,
                        MatchInvariant.EXPRESSION_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
                        f"zero_expression_divisors_{expression_zero_divisors}",
                    ),
                    (
                        expression_unsafe_values,
                        MatchInvariant.NON_FINITE_EXPRESSION_RESULT,
                        f"unsafe_expression_results_{expression_unsafe_values}",
                    ),
                )
                if failure_count > 0
            ),
            None,
        )
        if expression_failure is not None:
            failure_invariant, failure_observed = expression_failure
            raise MatchExpressionEvaluationError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=failure_invariant,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("finite_non_null_expression_evaluation"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(failure_observed),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        left_max_updated = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_LEFT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)]
        right_max_updated = raw_row[str(_PREFLIGHT_RIGHT_MAX_UPDATED_COLUMN)]
        if left_max_updated is not None and not isinstance(left_max_updated, datetime):
            raise TypeError("Matching left snapshot watermark must be a datetime")
        if right_max_updated is not None and not isinstance(right_max_updated, datetime):
            raise TypeError("Matching right snapshot watermark must be a datetime")
        snapshot_payload = "\x1f".join(
            (
                str(self._spec.pair_scope),
                str(left_rows),
                "none" if left_max_updated is None else left_max_updated.isoformat(),
                str(right_rows),
                "none" if right_max_updated is None else right_max_updated.isoformat(),
            ),
        )
        snapshot_fingerprint = MatchSnapshotFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(snapshot_payload.encode()).hexdigest())
        if left_producer_failures > 0:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.REPRESENTATION_PRODUCER_FAILED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("representation_producer_success"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"left_producer_failure_{left_producer_failures}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if right_producer_failures > 0:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.REPRESENTATION_PRODUCER_FAILED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("representation_producer_success"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"right_producer_failure_{right_producer_failures}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        missing_policy = self._spec.policies.missing_representation
        if isinstance(
            missing_policy,
            FailMissingRepresentationPolicy | RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy,
        ):
            missing_left = left_rows - left_represented_rows
            missing_right = right_rows - right_represented_rows
            invariant = (
                MatchInvariant.MATERIALIZATION_REQUIRED
                if isinstance(missing_policy, RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy)
                else MatchInvariant.MISSING_REPRESENTATION
            )
            expected = (
                MatchExpectedValue("representations_materialized_before_snapshot")
                if isinstance(missing_policy, RequireMaterializedRepresentationPolicy)
                else MatchExpectedValue("all_visible_representations_present")
            )
            if missing_left > 0:
                raise MatchMissingRepresentationError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=invariant,
                        expected=expected,
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"left_representation_missing_{missing_left}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            if missing_right > 0:
                raise MatchMissingRepresentationError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=invariant,
                        expected=expected,
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"right_representation_missing_{missing_right}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        left_representation = self._spec.left.representation
        right_representation = self._spec.right.representation
        if not isinstance(
            left_representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec
            | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ) or not isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec
            | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec
            | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec
            | MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec
            | MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            msg = "Exact matching preflight requires executable representations"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        representation_values = left_rows * _representation_dimensions(left_representation) + right_rows * _representation_dimensions(
            right_representation
        )
        if isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                left_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                right_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                int(self._spec.result_shape.neighbor_count),
            )
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(pair_evaluations, int(self._spec.result_shape.result_limit))
        elif isinstance(self._spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape):
            result_rows = min(
                pair_evaluations,
                left_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.left_neighbor_count),
                right_rows * int(self._spec.result_shape.right_neighbor_count),
            )
        else:
            msg = "Exact dense preflight requires a supported result shape"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        explanation_policy = self._spec.policies.explanations
        explanation_rows = (
            result_rows * _representation_dimensions(left_representation)
            if isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy)
            else 0
        )
        if isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy) and explanation_rows > int(explanation_policy.max_rows):
            raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"explanation_rows_at_most_{explanation_policy.max_rows}"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"explanation_rows_{explanation_rows}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        working_memory_bytes = result_rows * 256
        expression_evaluations = (
            pair_evaluations * _expression_node_count(self._spec.kernel.expression)
            if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec)
            else 0
        )
        checks = (
            ("left_rows", left_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_left_rows)),
            ("right_rows", right_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_right_rows)),
            ("pair_evaluations", pair_evaluations, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_pair_evaluations)),
            (
                "expression_evaluations",
                expression_evaluations,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_expression_evaluations),
            ),
            ("result_rows", result_rows, int(self._spec.work_limits.max_result_rows)),
            (
                "representation_values",
                representation_values,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_representation_values),
            ),
            (
                "database_round_trips",
                2,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_database_round_trips),
            ),
            (
                "working_memory_bytes",
                working_memory_bytes,
                int(self._spec.work_limits.max_working_memory_bytes),
            ),
        )
        for work_name, observed, limit in checks:
            if observed > limit:
                raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"{work_name}_at_most_{limit}"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"{work_name}_{observed}"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        missing_pairs = visible_pairs - pair_evaluations
        emit_declared_score = isinstance(
            self._spec.policies.missing_representation,
            EmitDeclaredMissingScorePolicy,
        )
        exact_completion_pairs = (
            pair_evaluations - indexed_pairs if isinstance(self._spec.policies.freshness, ExactCompletionFreshnessPolicy) else 0
        )
        return MatchPreflightCounters(
            pair_evaluations=MatchPairEvaluationCount(pair_evaluations),
            omitted_missing_pairs=MatchOmittedPairCount(0 if emit_declared_score else missing_pairs),
            declared_missing_score_pairs=MatchDeclaredScorePairCount(missing_pairs if emit_declared_score else 0),
            excluded_self_pairs=MatchExcludedSelfPairCount(all_pairs - visible_pairs),
            exact_completion_pairs=MatchExactCompletionPairCount(exact_completion_pairs),
            snapshot_fingerprint=snapshot_fingerprint,
        )

    def execute_runtime(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchPreflightCounters:
        return self._evaluate(resolved)

    async def execute_runtime_async(
        self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchPreflightCounters:
        del hydrator
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        return self._evaluate(resolved)

    def async_runtime_callback(self: _ExactDenseWorkGuardStep) -> AsyncRuntimeCallback:
        return self.execute_runtime_async


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ExactDenseDecodeConfig:
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    preflight_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    preflight_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any]


def _model_payload(row: Mapping[str, object], prefix: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {key.removeprefix(prefix): value for key, value in row.items() if key.startswith(prefix)}


def _hydrate_endpoint[EndpointT: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    model_cls: type[EndpointT],
    payload: dict[str, Any],
) -> EndpointT:
    concrete_cls, concrete_payload = dispatch_polymorphic_type(model_cls, payload)
    return concrete_cls.model_validate(concrete_payload)


def _score_value(
    value: object,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> MatchScoreValue:
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        numeric_value = float(value)
    elif isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        numeric_value = float(value)
    else:
        msg = f"Exact dense score must be numeric, got {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if not math.isfinite(numeric_value):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.NON_FINITE_REPRESENTATION,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("finite_dense_coordinates"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("non_finite_dense_coordinate"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    return MatchScoreValue(numeric_value)


def _endpoint_snapshot_identity(endpoint: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]) -> str:
    updated_at = endpoint.model_dump()["updated_at"]
    if not isinstance(updated_at, datetime):
        msg = "Matched endpoint updated_at must be a datetime"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return updated_at.isoformat()


def _canonical_endpoint_identity(
    relation: MatchRelationSpec[Any],
    endpoint: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId],
) -> str:
    identity = relation.identity
    if isinstance(identity, MatchSysIdIdentitySpec):
        return str(endpoint.sys_id)
    if isinstance(identity, MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec):
        value = getattr(endpoint, str(identity.field_name))
        if not isinstance(value, str | int):
            msg = "Canonical matching identity must be a string or integer"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return str(value)
    msg = f"Unknown canonical identity variant: {type(identity).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _pair_identity(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
) -> MatchPairIdentity:
    payload = "\x1f".join(
        (
            str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            str(spec.pair_scope),
            _canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.left, left),
            _endpoint_snapshot_identity(left),
            _canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.right, right),
            _endpoint_snapshot_identity(right),
        ),
    )
    return MatchPairIdentity(hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())


def _freshness_diagnostics(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics | NoMatchArtifactDiagnostics:
    artifact_state = NoMatchArtifactState()
    if not isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState):
        return NoMatchArtifactDiagnostics()
    state = (
        MatchArtifactFreshnessState.STALE
        if artifact_state.artifact_watermark != artifact_state.source_watermark
        else MatchArtifactFreshnessState.CURRENT
    )
    return MatchArtifactFreshnessDiagnostics(
        identity=artifact_state.identity,
        source_watermark=artifact_state.source_watermark,
        artifact_watermark=artifact_state.artifact_watermark,
        state=state,
    )


def _dense_explanations(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
    row: Mapping[str, object],
) -> tuple[MatchDenseContributionExplanation, ...]:
    if not isinstance(spec.policies.explanations, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy):
        return ()
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    right_representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
        right_representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec,
    ):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.EXPLANATION_REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("dense_coordinate_representations"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("non_coordinate_representation"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    explanations: list[MatchDenseContributionExplanation] = []
    if isinstance(spec.policies.duplicates, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy):
        coordinate_count = len(left_representation.coordinates)
        physical_slot_count = max(1, int(spec.policies.explanations.max_rows) // coordinate_count)
        for physical_slot in range(1, physical_slot_count + 1):
            for coordinate_index in range(coordinate_count):
                left_value = row.get(f"match_explanation_{physical_slot}_{coordinate_index}_left")
                right_value = row.get(f"match_explanation_{physical_slot}_{coordinate_index}_right")
                if left_value is None and right_value is None:
                    continue
                if not isinstance(left_value, int | float) or isinstance(left_value, bool):
                    raise TypeError("Combined dense explanation left coordinate must be numeric")
                if not isinstance(right_value, int | float) or isinstance(right_value, bool):
                    raise TypeError("Combined dense explanation right coordinate must be numeric")
                explanations.append(
                    MatchDenseContributionExplanation(
                        coordinate_index=MatchExplanationCoordinateIndex(coordinate_index),
                        left_value=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value)),
                        right_value=MatchDenseValue(float(right_value)),
                        contribution=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value) * float(right_value)),
                    ),
                )
        return tuple(explanations)
    for coordinate_index, (left_coordinate, right_coordinate) in enumerate(
        zip(left_representation.coordinates, right_representation.coordinates, strict=True),
    ):
        left_value = getattr(left, str(left_coordinate.field_name))
        right_value = getattr(right, str(right_coordinate.field_name))
        if not isinstance(left_value, int | float) or isinstance(left_value, bool):
            msg = "Dense explanation left coordinate must be numeric"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(right_value, int | float) or isinstance(right_value, bool):
            msg = "Dense explanation right coordinate must be numeric"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        explanations.append(
            MatchDenseContributionExplanation(
                coordinate_index=MatchExplanationCoordinateIndex(coordinate_index),
                left_value=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value)),
                right_value=MatchDenseValue(float(right_value)),
                contribution=MatchDenseValue(float(left_value) * float(right_value)),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(explanations)


def _exact_diagnostics(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    left: LeftRowT,
    right: RightRowT,
    row: Mapping[str, object],
) -> MatchExactDiagnostics | MatchEncodedVectorDiagnostics | MatchH14Diagnostics | MatchQuantizedDiagnostics:
    representation = spec.right.representation
    kernel = spec.kernel
    if isinstance(representation, MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        contract = representation.contract
        return MatchEncodedVectorDiagnostics(
            representation_ref_id=representation.representation_ref_id,
            layout=contract.layout,
            encoding=contract.encoding,
            metric=contract.metric,
        )
    left_representation = spec.left.representation
    if (
        isinstance(representation, MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(left_representation, MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
    ):
        right_representation = representation
        left_watermark = getattr(left, str(left_representation.source_watermark_field_name))
        right_watermark = getattr(right, str(right_representation.source_watermark_field_name))
        if isinstance(left_watermark, bool) or not isinstance(left_watermark, int):
            raise TypeError("left H14 source watermark must be an integer")
        if isinstance(right_watermark, bool) or not isinstance(right_watermark, int):
            raise TypeError("right H14 source watermark must be an integer")
        return MatchH14Diagnostics(
            projection_artifact_id=representation.projection_artifact_id,
            source_watermark=representation.source_watermark,
            left_visible_source_watermark=MatchArtifactWatermark(int(left_watermark)),
            right_visible_source_watermark=MatchArtifactWatermark(int(right_watermark)),
        )
    if isinstance(representation, MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
        kernel,
        MatchQuantizedInnerProductKernelSpec,
    ):
        reranked = isinstance(kernel.rerank_candidate_count, NeighborCount)
        visible_watermark = getattr(right, str(representation.source_watermark_field_name))
        if isinstance(visible_watermark, bool) or not isinstance(visible_watermark, int):
            raise TypeError("quantized source watermark must be an integer")
        return MatchQuantizedDiagnostics(
            stage=(MatchExecutionStage.QUANTIZED_CANDIDATE_RERANK if reranked else MatchExecutionStage.QUANTIZED_ESTIMATOR),
            access_method=(MatchAccessMethodKind.QUANTIZED_CANDIDATE_RERANK if reranked else MatchAccessMethodKind.QUANTIZED_EXHAUSTIVE),
            projection_artifact_id=representation.projection_artifact_id,
            source_watermark=representation.source_watermark,
            visible_source_watermark=MatchArtifactWatermark(int(visible_watermark)),
            family=MatchQuantizedFamily(representation.family),
            score_target=(MatchQuantizedScoreTarget.SOURCE_DENSE if reranked else MatchQuantizedScoreTarget.ESTIMATOR),
            candidate_completeness=(MatchCandidateCompleteness.NOT_PROVEN if reranked else MatchCandidateCompleteness.COMPLETE),
        )
    return MatchExactDiagnostics(explanations=_dense_explanations(spec, left, right, row))

def _combined_duplicate_diagnostics(
    ordered_group: Sequence[Any],
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> Any:
    selected = ordered_group[0].diagnostics
    if not isinstance(spec.policies.duplicates, CombineDuplicatePairsPolicy) or not isinstance(
        selected,
        MatchExactDiagnostics,
    ):
        return selected
    explanation_policy = spec.policies.explanations
    if not isinstance(explanation_policy, DenseCoordinateExplanationPolicy):
        return selected
    explanations = tuple(explanation for edge in ordered_group for explanation in edge.diagnostics.explanations)[
        : int(explanation_policy.max_rows)
    ]
    return _validated_matching_update(selected, {"explanations": explanations})


def _observed_duplicate_count(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> MatchDuplicatePairCount:
    duplicate_count = 0
    for row in rows:
        raw_count = row.get("match_duplicate_count", 1)
        if not isinstance(raw_count, int) or isinstance(raw_count, bool) or raw_count < 1:
            raise TypeError("matching SQL stage published an invalid duplicate count")
        duplicate_count += raw_count - 1
    if duplicate_count and isinstance(spec.policies.duplicates, RejectDuplicatePairsPolicy):
        raise MatchCompatibilityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.DUPLICATE_LOGICAL_PAIR,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_physical_pair_per_logical_pair"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue(f"duplicate_logical_pairs_{duplicate_count}"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    return MatchDuplicatePairCount(duplicate_count)


def _runtime_expression_evaluations(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> MatchExpressionEvaluationCount | None:
    if not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec) or not rows:
        return None
    values = {row.get(str(_EXPRESSION_EXECUTED_COLUMN)) for row in rows}
    if len(values) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Expression execution counts changed within one result")
    value = next(iter(values))
    if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool) or value < 0:
        raise TypeError("Expression execution count must be a non-negative integer")
    return MatchExpressionEvaluationCount(value)


def _decode_top_k_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> TopKPerLeftMatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    edge_model = _specialized_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_top_k_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    edges: list[PerLeftMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"))
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"))
        score = MatchScore(
            canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
        )
        raw_rank = row[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
        assert isinstance(raw_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_rank, bool)
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=score,
                left_rank=MatchRank(raw_rank),
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    ranked_edges = tuple(edges)
    duplicate_count = _observed_duplicate_count(rows, spec)
    return result_model(
        edges=ranked_edges,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )

def _global_page_cursor(
    edge: GlobalMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    snapshot_fingerprint: MatchSnapshotFingerprint,
) -> MatchPageCursor:
    return MatchPageCursor(
        spec_fingerprint=spec.semantic_fingerprint,
        snapshot_fingerprint=snapshot_fingerprint,
        result_shape=MatchResultShapeKind.GLOBAL_TOP_K,
        score=edge.score.canonical,
        left_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(_canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.left, edge.left)),
        right_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(_canonical_endpoint_identity(spec.right, edge.right)),
        rank=edge.global_rank,
    )


def _decode_global_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> GlobalTopKMatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    edge_model = _specialized_global_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_global_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    assert isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape)
    pagination = spec.result_shape.pagination
    page_rows = rows
    has_next_page = False
    if isinstance(pagination, MatchPageAfterCursor):
        cursor = pagination.cursor
        if cursor.spec_fingerprint != spec.semantic_fingerprint or cursor.result_shape is not spec.result_shape.kind:
            raise MatchCursorError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SPECIFICATION_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(str(spec.semantic_fingerprint)),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(str(cursor.spec_fingerprint)),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        if cursor.snapshot_fingerprint != preflight.snapshot_fingerprint:
            raise MatchCursorError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.CURSOR_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(str(cursor.snapshot_fingerprint)),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(str(preflight.snapshot_fingerprint)),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.RESTART_PAGINATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
    if isinstance(pagination, FirstMatchPage | MatchPageAfterCursor):
        page_size = int(pagination.page_size)
        has_next_page = len(rows) > page_size
        page_rows = rows[:page_size]
    edges: list[GlobalMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in page_rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"))
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"))
        raw_rank = row[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
        assert isinstance(raw_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_rank, bool)
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=MatchScore(
                    canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
                    exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
                    kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
                ),
                global_rank=MatchRank(raw_rank),
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    ranked_edges = tuple(edges)
    duplicate_count = _observed_duplicate_count(rows, spec)
    page = (
        MatchNextPage(
            cursor=_global_page_cursor(ranked_edges[-1], spec, preflight.snapshot_fingerprint),
        )
        if has_next_page and ranked_edges
        else MatchPageComplete()
    )
    return result_model(
        edges=ranked_edges,
        page=page,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )


def _decode_threshold_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> ThresholdJoinMatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    assert isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
    result_limit = int(spec.result_shape.result_limit)
    edge_model = _specialized_threshold_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_threshold_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    edges: list[ThresholdMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"))
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"))
        score = MatchScore(
            canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
        )
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=score,
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    filtered_edges = tuple(edges)
    duplicate_count = _observed_duplicate_count(rows, spec)
    if len(filtered_edges) > result_limit:
        raise MatchResultCardinalityError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.RESULT_CARDINALITY_EXCEEDED,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"qualifying_rows_at_most_{result_limit}"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue(f"qualifying_rows_{len(filtered_edges)}"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    return result_model(
        edges=filtered_edges,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )


def _decode_mutual_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> MutualNeighborMatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    edge_model = _specialized_mutual_edge_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    result_model = _specialized_mutual_result_model(spec.left.row_type, spec.right.row_type)
    edges: list[MutualNeighborMatchEdge[LeftRowT, RightRowT]] = []
    for row in rows:
        left = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.left.row_type, _model_payload(row, "left__"))
        right = _hydrate_endpoint(spec.right.row_type, _model_payload(row, "right__"))
        raw_left_rank = row[str(_RANK_COLUMN)]
        raw_right_rank = row[str(_RIGHT_RANK_COLUMN)]
        assert isinstance(raw_left_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_left_rank, bool)
        assert isinstance(raw_right_rank, int) and not isinstance(raw_right_rank, bool)
        edges.append(
            edge_model(
                pair_identity=_pair_identity(spec, left, right),
                left=left,
                right=right,
                score=MatchScore(
                    canonical=_score_value(row[str(_SCORE_COLUMN)], spec),
                    exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
                    kernel_ref_id=spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id,
                ),
                left_rank=MatchRank(raw_left_rank),
                right_rank=MatchRank(raw_right_rank),
                diagnostics=_exact_diagnostics(spec, left, right, row),
            ),
        )
    ranked_edges = tuple(edges)
    duplicate_count = _observed_duplicate_count(rows, spec)
    return result_model(
        edges=ranked_edges,
        freshness=_freshness_diagnostics(spec),
        work=MatchWorkCounters(
            pair_evaluations=preflight.pair_evaluations,
            database_round_trips=preflight.database_round_trips,
            expression_evaluations=preflight.expression_evaluations,
            omitted_missing_pairs=preflight.omitted_missing_pairs,
            declared_missing_score_pairs=preflight.declared_missing_score_pairs,
            excluded_self_pairs=preflight.excluded_self_pairs,
            duplicate_physical_pairs=duplicate_count,
            exact_completion_pairs=preflight.exact_completion_pairs,
        ),
    )


def _decode_exact_dense_rows(
    rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    preflight: MatchPreflightCounters,
) -> MatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
    expression_evaluations = _runtime_expression_evaluations(rows, spec)
    if expression_evaluations is not None:
        preflight = _validated_matching_update(
            preflight,
            {"expression_evaluations": expression_evaluations},
        )
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
        return _decode_top_k_rows(rows, spec, preflight)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerRightMatchShape):
        return _decode_top_k_right_rows(rows, spec, preflight)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, GlobalTopKMatchShape):
        return _decode_global_rows(rows, spec, preflight)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape):
        return _decode_threshold_rows(rows, spec, preflight)
    if isinstance(spec.result_shape, MutualNeighborMatchShape):
        return _decode_mutual_rows(rows, spec, preflight)
    msg = "Unknown Phase 2 result decoder variant"
    raise TypeError(msg)


class _ExactDenseDecodeStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchResult[Any, Any]]):
    def __init__(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _ExactDenseDecodeConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref
        self._preflight_rows_ref = config.preflight_rows_ref
        self._preflight_ref = config.preflight_ref
        self._spec = config.spec

    @property
    def level(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "matching", "result_decode"})

    def tables_read(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref), str(self._preflight_ref)})

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchResult[Any, Any]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def _decode(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchResult[Any, Any]:
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref)) or []
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence):
            msg = "Exact dense SQL stage must publish a row sequence"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        preflight = resolved.get(str(self._preflight_ref))
        if not isinstance(preflight, MatchPreflightCounters):
            msg = "Exact dense preflight must publish typed counters"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        runtime_services = hydrator.runtime_services
        if runtime_services is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Matching result accounting requires ServerPlan runtime services")
        owned_refs = (str(self._source_ref), str(self._preflight_ref), str(self._preflight_rows_ref))
        executed_stage_receipts = tuple(
            receipt
            for receipt in runtime_services.execution_stage_receipts.snapshot()
            if any(receipt.contributes_to(ref) for ref in owned_refs)
        )
        preflight = type(preflight).model_validate(
            {
                **{field_name: getattr(preflight, field_name) for field_name in type(preflight).model_fields},
                "database_round_trips": MatchDatabaseRoundTripCount(
                    sum(receipt.driver_round_trips for receipt in executed_stage_receipts),
                ),
            },
        )
        rows: list[Mapping[str, object]] = []
        for raw_row in raw_rows:
            if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
                msg = "Exact dense SQL stage published a non-row value"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            rows.append(raw_row)
        return _decode_exact_dense_rows(rows, self._spec, preflight)

    def execute_runtime(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchResult[Any, Any]:
        return self._decode(resolved, hydrator)

    async def execute_runtime_async(
        self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: RuntimeHydrator[Any],
    ) -> MatchResult[Any, Any]:
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        return self._decode(resolved, hydrator)

    def async_runtime_callback(self: _ExactDenseDecodeStep) -> AsyncRuntimeCallback:
        return self.execute_runtime_async

"""Canonical H14 publication rows shared by transaction and schema declarations."""

from __future__ import annotations
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import MatchSpecRefId

import hashlib
from collections.abc import Mapping
from uuid import UUID

from impl.common.l5250_matching.operator_metadata import (
    MatchingProjectionActivationRow,
    MatchingProjectionArtifactRow,
    MatchingProjectionTensorRow,
)
from l1400_types import SysId
from l2055_lazy_result.purity import pure_lazy
from l2070_batching.backend_profile import BinaryHammingSqlProfile
from l1470_matching_contracts.projection_models import (
    H14ProjectionArtifact,
    ProjectionTensorDigest,
)
from l1470_matching_contracts.errors import (
    MatchArtifactError,
    MatchErrorContext,
)
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import (
    MatchCompatibilityVersion,
    MatchExpectedValue,
    MatchInvariant,
    MatchObservedValue,
    MatchSafeAction,
)


@pure_lazy
def projection_durable_id(*parts: object) -> SysId:
    """Retain the persisted identity algorithm for H14 operator rows."""
    payload = "\0".join(str(part) for part in parts).encode("utf-8")
    return SysId(UUID(bytes=hashlib.sha256(payload).digest()[:16]))


@pure_lazy
def verified_h14_publication_rows(
    artifact: H14ProjectionArtifact,
    blobs: Mapping[ProjectionTensorDigest, bytes],
) -> tuple[MatchingProjectionArtifactRow, tuple[MatchingProjectionTensorRow, ...]]:
    """Verify once and construct rows from the verified immutable tensor snapshot."""
    try:
        from impl.common.l5250_matching.h14_numerics import bind_h14_tensors

        tensors = bind_h14_tensors(artifact, blobs)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise MatchArtifactError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                spec_ref_id=MatchSpecRefId("producer:projection_declaration"),
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("verified_h14_publication_tensors"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_publication_tensor_mismatch"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
            )
        ) from error
    references = (
        ("mean", artifact.mean_tensor, tensors.mean),
        ("rotation", artifact.rotation_tensor, tensors.rotation),
        ("threshold", artifact.threshold_tensor, tensors.thresholds),
        ("residual", artifact.residual_tensor, tensors.residual_projection),
    )
    rows = tuple(
        MatchingProjectionTensorRow(
            sys_id=projection_durable_id("h14-tensor", artifact.artifact_id, role),
            artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
            tenant_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant),
            workspace_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace),
            branch_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.branch),
            permission_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.permission),
            role=role,
            digest=str(reference.digest),
            shape="x".join(str(int(size)) for size in reference.shape),
            byte_count=int(reference.byte_count),
            dtype=reference.dtype,
            byte_order=reference.byte_order,
            payload=payload,
        )
        for role, reference, payload in references
    )
    row = MatchingProjectionArtifactRow(
        sys_id=projection_durable_id("h14-artifact", artifact.artifact_id),
        artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        artifact_fingerprint=artifact.fingerprint(),
        algorithm_version=artifact.algorithm_version,
        tenant_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant),
        workspace_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace),
        branch_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.branch),
        revision_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.revision),
        permission_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.permission),
        contract_payload=artifact.model_dump_json(),
    )
    return row, rows


@pure_lazy
def h14_projection_activation_row(
    artifact: H14ProjectionArtifact,
    storage_profile: BinaryHammingSqlProfile,
) -> MatchingProjectionActivationRow:
    """Declare the fixed backend lowering; callers must enforce its prerequisites."""
    if storage_profile is BinaryHammingSqlProfile.PGVECTOR_BIT1024_V086:
        native_bits = True
    elif storage_profile is BinaryHammingSqlProfile.PORTABLE_PACKED:
        native_bits = False
    else:
        raise MatchArtifactError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                spec_ref_id=MatchSpecRefId("producer:projection_declaration"),
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("declared_binary_hamming_profile"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("unknown_binary_hamming_profile"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
            )
        )
    return MatchingProjectionActivationRow(
        sys_id=projection_durable_id(
            "h14-activation",
            artifact.fit_scope.deployment,
            artifact.fit_scope.tenant,
            artifact.fit_scope.workspace,
            artifact.fit_scope.branch,
            artifact.fit_scope.permission,
        ),
        deployment_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.deployment),
        tenant_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant),
        workspace_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace),
        branch_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.branch),
        permission_scope=str(artifact.fit_scope.permission),
        artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        artifact_fingerprint=artifact.fingerprint(),
        physical_type="bit1024" if native_bits else "portable_packed",
        operator="<~>" if native_bits else "nera_hamming_distance",
        extension_version=MatchCompatibilityVersion("0.8.6" if native_bits else "not-applicable"),
    )
