"""Deterministic QJL and TurboQuant estimator encoding and scoring."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
import hashlib
import math
import numpy as np
from numpy.typing import NDArray
from turboquant import get_codebook
from turboquant._accel import generate_orthogonal_matrix, generate_projection_matrix

from l1470_matching_contracts.projection_models import (
    ArtifactTensorRef,
    BinaryJaccardZeroUnionPolicy,
    ProjectionDimensions,
    ProjectionSeed,
    ProjectionTensorByteCount,
    ProjectionTensorDigest,
    QjlCodePayload,
    QjlProjectionArtifact,
    QjlProjectionState,
    QjlQueryParameters,
    QuantizationBitWidth,
    QuantizedCodeUnitCount,
    QuantizedLossMetrics,
    QuantizedLossValue,
    QuantizedResourceByteCount,
    QuantizedResourceMetrics,
    QuantizedScoreCallCount,
    QuantizedResidualNorm,
    QuantizedVectorNorm,
    ScalarCodebookArtifact,
    TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact,
    TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload,
    TurboQuantMseArtifact,
    TurboQuantMseCodePayload,
    TurboQuantMseProjectionState,
    TurboQuantProjectionState,
    TurboQuantQueryParameters,
    TurboQuantScoreComponents,
)
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import MatchVectorDimensions


def _canonical_vector(vector: NDArray[np.float32], dimensions: int) -> NDArray[np.float32]:
    result = np.asarray(vector, dtype="<f4")
    if result.shape != (dimensions,):
        raise ValueError("Estimator vector dimensions do not match the artifact")
    if not np.isfinite(result).all():
        raise ValueError("Estimator vectors must contain finite values")
    return result


def _tensor_ref(payload: bytes, shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> ArtifactTensorRef:
    return ArtifactTensorRef(
        digest=ProjectionTensorDigest(hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()),
        shape=tuple(MatchVectorDimensions(value) for value in shape),
        byte_count=ProjectionTensorByteCount(len(payload)),
    )


def _projection_matrix(rows: int, columns: int, seed: int) -> NDArray[np.float32]:
    """Use the pinned upstream data-oblivious projection construction."""
    return np.asarray(generate_projection_matrix(rows=rows, cols=columns, seed=seed), dtype="<f4")


def _orthogonal_matrix(dimensions: int, seed: int) -> NDArray[np.float32]:
    """Use the pinned upstream deterministic orthogonal rotation."""
    return np.asarray(generate_orthogonal_matrix(dimensions, seed=seed), dtype="<f4")


def _normal_codebook(dimensions: int, bit_width: int) -> ScalarCodebookArtifact:
    """Use the pinned upstream Beta-distribution Lloyd-Max codebook."""
    centroids, boundaries = get_codebook(dimensions, bit_width)
    return ScalarCodebookArtifact(
        algorithm="turboquant_beta_lloyd_max_v1",
        centroids=tuple(float(value) for value in centroids),
        boundaries=tuple(float(value) for value in boundaries[1:-1]),
    )


def build_qjl_projection(
    *,
    source_dimensions: int,
    projection_dimensions: int,
    seed: int,
) -> QjlProjectionState:
    """Build one deterministic data-oblivious QJL generation."""
    if projection_dimensions > source_dimensions:
        raise ValueError("QJL projection dimensions cannot exceed source dimensions")
    matrix = _projection_matrix(projection_dimensions, source_dimensions, seed)
    payload = matrix.tobytes(order="C")
    source_dimension_value = MatchVectorDimensions(source_dimensions)
    projection_dimension_value = ProjectionDimensions(projection_dimensions)
    projection_seed = ProjectionSeed(seed)
    projection_reference = _tensor_ref(payload, matrix.shape)
    artifact_id = QjlProjectionArtifact.content_id(
        source_dimensions=source_dimension_value,
        projection_dimensions=projection_dimension_value,
        projection_seed=projection_seed,
        projection_matrix=projection_reference,
    )
    artifact = QjlProjectionArtifact(
        artifact_id=artifact_id,
        source_dimensions=source_dimension_value,
        projection_dimensions=projection_dimension_value,
        projection_seed=projection_seed,
        projection_matrix=projection_reference,
    )
    return QjlProjectionState(artifact=artifact, projection_payload=payload)


def build_turboquant_mse_projection(
    *,
    source_dimensions: int,
    bit_width: int,
    seed: int,
) -> TurboQuantMseProjectionState:
    """Build one pinned or SQL-extended TurboQuant MSE generation."""
    if bit_width not in range(1, 9):
        raise ValueError("TurboQuant MSE bit width must be between one and eight")
    rotation = _orthogonal_matrix(source_dimensions, seed)
    rotation_payload = rotation.tobytes(order="C")
    algorithm = "turboquant_mse_v1" if bit_width <= 4 else "turboquant_mse_sql_extended_v1"
    source_dimension_value = MatchVectorDimensions(source_dimensions)
    width = QuantizationBitWidth(bit_width)
    rotation_seed = ProjectionSeed(seed)
    rotation_reference = _tensor_ref(rotation_payload, rotation.shape)
    codebook = _normal_codebook(source_dimensions, bit_width)
    artifact_id = TurboQuantMseArtifact.content_id(
        algorithm_version=algorithm,
        source_dimensions=source_dimension_value,
        bit_width=width,
        rotation_seed=rotation_seed,
        rotation_matrix=rotation_reference,
        codebook=codebook,
    )
    artifact = TurboQuantMseArtifact.model_validate(
        {
            "artifact_id": artifact_id,
            "algorithm_version": algorithm,
            "source_dimensions": source_dimension_value,
            "bit_width": width,
            "rotation_seed": rotation_seed,
            "rotation_matrix": rotation_reference,
            "codebook": codebook,
        },
    )
    return TurboQuantMseProjectionState(artifact=artifact, rotation_payload=rotation_payload)


def build_turboquant_projection(
    *,
    source_dimensions: int,
    total_bit_width: int,
    residual_dimensions: int,
    seed: int,
) -> TurboQuantProjectionState:
    """Build one deterministic TurboQuant inner-product generation."""
    if total_bit_width not in range(2, 9):
        raise ValueError("TurboQuant total bit width must be between two and eight")
    if residual_dimensions != source_dimensions:
        raise ValueError("TurboQuant residual dimensions must equal source dimensions")
    rotation = _orthogonal_matrix(source_dimensions, seed)
    residual = _projection_matrix(residual_dimensions, source_dimensions, seed + 1_000_000)
    rotation_payload = rotation.tobytes(order="C")
    residual_payload = residual.tobytes(order="C")
    algorithm = "turboquant_inner_product_v1" if total_bit_width <= 4 else "turboquant_inner_product_sql_extended_v1"
    source_dimension_value = MatchVectorDimensions(source_dimensions)
    total_width = QuantizationBitWidth(total_bit_width)
    mse_width = QuantizationBitWidth(total_bit_width - 1)
    residual_dimension_value = ProjectionDimensions(residual_dimensions)
    rotation_seed = ProjectionSeed(seed)
    residual_seed = ProjectionSeed(seed + 1_000_000)
    rotation_reference = _tensor_ref(rotation_payload, rotation.shape)
    residual_reference = _tensor_ref(residual_payload, residual.shape)
    codebook = _normal_codebook(source_dimensions, total_bit_width - 1)
    artifact_id = TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact.content_id(
        algorithm_version=algorithm,
        source_dimensions=source_dimension_value,
        total_bit_width=total_width,
        mse_bit_width=mse_width,
        residual_dimensions=residual_dimension_value,
        rotation_seed=rotation_seed,
        residual_seed=residual_seed,
        rotation_matrix=rotation_reference,
        residual_matrix=residual_reference,
        codebook=codebook,
    )
    artifact = TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact.model_validate(
        {
            "artifact_id": artifact_id,
            "algorithm_version": algorithm,
            "source_dimensions": source_dimension_value,
            "total_bit_width": total_width,
            "mse_bit_width": mse_width,
            "residual_dimensions": residual_dimension_value,
            "rotation_seed": rotation_seed,
            "residual_seed": residual_seed,
            "rotation_matrix": rotation_reference,
            "residual_matrix": residual_reference,
            "codebook": codebook,
        },
    )
    return TurboQuantProjectionState(
        artifact=artifact,
        rotation_payload=rotation_payload,
        residual_payload=residual_payload,
    )


def _pack_unsigned(values: NDArray[np.uint8], width: int) -> bytes:
    result = 0
    for value in values:
        result = (result << width) | int(value)
    bit_count = len(values) * width
    padding = (-bit_count) % 8
    return (result << padding).to_bytes((bit_count + padding) // 8, "big")


def _pack_signs(values: NDArray[np.bool_]) -> bytes:
    return np.packbits(values, bitorder="big").tobytes()


def _unpack_signs(payload: bytes, count: int) -> NDArray[np.float32]:
    bits = np.unpackbits(np.frombuffer(payload, dtype=np.uint8), bitorder="big")[:count]
    return np.where(bits == 1, 1.0, -1.0).astype(np.float32)


def encode_qjl(vector: NDArray[np.float32], state: QjlProjectionState) -> QjlCodePayload:
    """Encode one source vector into a packed QJL sign code."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    source = _canonical_vector(vector, int(artifact.source_dimensions))
    matrix = np.frombuffer(state.projection_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.projection_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    projected = matrix @ source
    return QjlCodePayload(
        projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        packed_signs=_pack_signs(projected >= 0.0),
        vector_norm=QuantizedVectorNorm(float(np.linalg.norm(source))),
    )


def prepare_qjl_query(
    vector: NDArray[np.float32],
    state: QjlProjectionState,
) -> QjlQueryParameters:
    """Project one QJL query without storing request state in the artifact."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    source = _canonical_vector(vector, int(artifact.source_dimensions))
    matrix = np.frombuffer(state.projection_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.projection_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    return QjlQueryParameters(
        projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        projected_query=tuple(float(value) for value in matrix @ source),
    )


def score_qjl(
    query: QjlQueryParameters,
    code: QjlCodePayload,
    artifact: QjlProjectionArtifact,
) -> float:
    """Evaluate the exact QJL estimator over one packed code."""
    if query.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id or code.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id:
        raise ValueError("QJL score inputs use a different artifact generation")
    if code.vector_norm == 0.0:
        return 0.0
    projected = np.asarray(query.projected_query, dtype=np.float32)
    signs = _unpack_signs(code.packed_signs, int(artifact.projection_dimensions))
    return float(
        math.sqrt(math.pi / 2.0) / int(artifact.projection_dimensions) * code.vector_norm * float(projected @ signs),
    )


def encode_turboquant_mse(
    vector: NDArray[np.float32],
    state: TurboQuantMseProjectionState,
) -> TurboQuantMseCodePayload:
    """Encode one vector into a packed TurboQuant MSE code."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    source = _canonical_vector(vector, int(artifact.source_dimensions))
    norm = float(np.linalg.norm(source))
    unit = np.zeros_like(source) if norm == 0.0 else source / norm
    rotation = np.frombuffer(state.rotation_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    rotated = rotation.T @ unit
    boundaries = np.asarray(artifact.codebook.boundaries, dtype=np.float32)
    indices = np.searchsorted(boundaries, rotated, side="right").astype(np.uint8)
    return TurboQuantMseCodePayload(
        projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        packed_indices=_pack_unsigned(indices, int(artifact.bit_width)),
        vector_norm=QuantizedVectorNorm(norm),
    )


def decode_turboquant_mse(
    code: TurboQuantMseCodePayload,
    state: TurboQuantMseProjectionState,
) -> NDArray[np.float32]:
    """Reconstruct one vector from its declared MSE generation."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    if code.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id:
        raise ValueError("TurboQuant MSE code uses a different artifact generation")
    rotation = np.frombuffer(state.rotation_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    indices = np.asarray(code.unpack_indices(artifact), dtype=np.int64)
    centroids = np.asarray(artifact.codebook.centroids, dtype=np.float32)
    return np.asarray(float(code.vector_norm) * (rotation @ centroids[indices]), dtype=np.float32)


def encode_turboquant(
    vector: NDArray[np.float32],
    state: TurboQuantProjectionState,
) -> TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload:
    """Encode one vector into packed MSE indices and residual signs."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    source = _canonical_vector(vector, int(artifact.source_dimensions))
    norm = float(np.linalg.norm(source))
    unit = np.zeros_like(source) if norm == 0.0 else source / norm
    rotation = np.frombuffer(state.rotation_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    residual_matrix = np.frombuffer(state.residual_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.residual_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    rotated = rotation.T @ unit
    boundaries = np.asarray(artifact.codebook.boundaries, dtype=np.float32)
    indices = np.searchsorted(boundaries, rotated, side="right").astype(np.uint8)
    centroids = np.asarray(artifact.codebook.centroids, dtype=np.float32)
    reconstructed = rotation @ centroids[indices]
    residual = unit - reconstructed
    residual_norm = float(np.linalg.norm(residual))
    return TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload(
        projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        packed_mse_indices=_pack_unsigned(indices, int(artifact.mse_bit_width)),
        packed_residual_signs=_pack_signs(residual_matrix @ residual >= 0.0),
        vector_norm=QuantizedVectorNorm(norm),
        residual_norm=QuantizedResidualNorm(residual_norm),
    )


def prepare_turboquant_query(
    vector: NDArray[np.float32],
    state: TurboQuantProjectionState,
) -> TurboQuantQueryParameters:
    """Prepare rotated and residual-projected query parameters."""
    artifact = state.artifact
    source = _canonical_vector(vector, int(artifact.source_dimensions))
    rotation = np.frombuffer(state.rotation_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    residual_matrix = np.frombuffer(state.residual_payload, dtype="<f4").reshape(
        int(artifact.residual_dimensions),
        int(artifact.source_dimensions),
    )
    return TurboQuantQueryParameters(
        projection_artifact_id=artifact.artifact_id,
        rotated_query=tuple(float(value) for value in rotation.T @ source),
        projected_query=tuple(float(value) for value in residual_matrix @ source),
    )


def score_turboquant_components(
    query: TurboQuantQueryParameters,
    code: TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload,
    artifact: TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact,
) -> TurboQuantScoreComponents:
    """Evaluate and retain both exact TurboQuant estimator terms."""
    if query.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id or code.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id:
        raise ValueError("TurboQuant score inputs use a different artifact generation")
    if code.vector_norm == 0.0:
        return TurboQuantScoreComponents(mse_term=0.0, residual_term=0.0, total=0.0)
    indices = np.asarray(code.unpack_mse_indices(artifact), dtype=np.int64)
    centroids = np.asarray(artifact.codebook.centroids, dtype=np.float32)
    rotated_query = np.asarray(query.rotated_query, dtype=np.float32)
    projected_query = np.asarray(query.projected_query, dtype=np.float32)
    residual_signs = _unpack_signs(code.packed_residual_signs, int(artifact.residual_dimensions))
    mse_term = float(code.vector_norm) * float(rotated_query @ centroids[indices])
    residual_term = (
        float(code.vector_norm)
        * float(code.residual_norm)
        * math.sqrt(math.pi / 2.0)
        / int(artifact.residual_dimensions)
        * float(projected_query @ residual_signs)
    )
    return TurboQuantScoreComponents(
        mse_term=mse_term,
        residual_term=residual_term,
        total=mse_term + residual_term,
    )


def score_turboquant(
    query: TurboQuantQueryParameters,
    code: TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload,
    artifact: TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact,
) -> float:
    """Evaluate the exact declared TurboQuant estimator over one packed code."""
    return score_turboquant_components(query, code, artifact).total


def quantized_resource_metrics(
    *,
    artifact: QjlProjectionArtifact | TurboQuantInnerProductArtifact,
    query: QjlQueryParameters | TurboQuantQueryParameters,
    codes: Sequence[QjlCodePayload | TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload],
    estimator_score_calls: int,
    rerank_score_calls: int,
    compression_loss: float,
    candidate_loss: float,
    index_loss: float,
) -> QuantizedResourceMetrics:
    """Measure separate quantized resources and loss stages."""
    if query.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id:
        raise ValueError("Quantized resource metrics use a different query generation")
    if any(code.projection_artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id for code in codes):
        raise ValueError("Quantized resource metrics use a different code generation")
    if isinstance(artifact, QjlProjectionArtifact):
        if not isinstance(query, QjlQueryParameters):
            raise TypeError("QJL resource metrics require QJL query and code payloads")
        qjl_codes: list[QjlCodePayload] = []
        for code in codes:
            if not isinstance(code, QjlCodePayload):
                raise TypeError("QJL resource metrics require QJL query and code payloads")
            qjl_codes.append(code)
        working_memory = len(query.projected_query) * 4
        storage = sum(len(code.packed_signs) + 4 for code in qjl_codes)
    else:
        if not isinstance(query, TurboQuantQueryParameters):
            raise TypeError("TurboQuant resource metrics require TurboQuant query and code payloads")
        turboquant_codes: list[TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload] = []
        for code in codes:
            if not isinstance(code, TurboQuantInnerProductCodePayload):
                raise TypeError("TurboQuant resource metrics require TurboQuant query and code payloads")
            turboquant_codes.append(code)
        working_memory = (len(query.rotated_query) + len(query.projected_query)) * 4
        storage = sum(
            len(code.packed_mse_indices) + len(code.packed_residual_signs) + 8 for code in turboquant_codes
        )
    return QuantizedResourceMetrics(
        code_units=QuantizedCodeUnitCount(len(codes) * int(artifact.source_dimensions)),
        estimator_score_calls=QuantizedScoreCallCount(estimator_score_calls),
        rerank_score_calls=QuantizedScoreCallCount(rerank_score_calls),
        working_memory_bytes=QuantizedResourceByteCount(working_memory),
        persistent_storage_bytes=QuantizedResourceByteCount(storage),
        loss=QuantizedLossMetrics(
            compression_loss=QuantizedLossValue(compression_loss),
            candidate_loss=QuantizedLossValue(candidate_loss),
            index_loss=QuantizedLossValue(index_loss),
        ),
    )


def binary_jaccard_score(
    left: bytes,
    right: bytes,
    zero_union: BinaryJaccardZeroUnionPolicy,
) -> float:
    """Score equal-width packed bits with an explicit zero-union policy."""
    if len(left) != len(right):
        raise ValueError("Binary Jaccard payloads must have equal widths")
    intersection = sum((left_byte & right_byte).bit_count() for left_byte, right_byte in zip(left, right, strict=True))
    union = sum((left_byte | right_byte).bit_count() for left_byte, right_byte in zip(left, right, strict=True))
    if union == 0:
        return 1.0 if zero_union is BinaryJaccardZeroUnionPolicy.MATCH else 0.0
    return intersection / union

"""Contracts for external representation preparation and publication."""

from __future__ import annotations

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
import hashlib
import json
import math
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Self

from pydantic import AliasChoices, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from l1400_types import SysId

from l1470_matching_contracts.graph_producer_models import MatchRepresentationProducerRefId
from l1470_matching_contracts.producer_lifecycle_models import (
    MatchExternalComplexityContract,
    MatchProducerDeterminism,
    MatchProducerInputSpec,
    MatchProducerLifecycleDefaults,
    MatchProducerOutputSpec,
    MatchProducerUpdateMode,
)
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import (
    MatchArtifactFingerprint,
    MatchArtifactWatermark,
    MatchProducerCallLimit,
    MatchRepresentationByteLimit,
    MatchFieldName,
    MatchPermissionFitScope,
    MatchSnapshotFingerprint,
    MatchVectorDimensions,
    _MatchBrandedString,
)


class MatchExternalScalarValue(_MatchBrandedString):
    """One authorized scalar value sent to an external provider."""


class MatchExternalModelId(_MatchBrandedString):
    """Stable external model identity."""


class MatchAuthorizedSessionIdentity(_MatchBrandedString):
    """Session identity that authorized one external input."""


class MatchExternalProviderId(_MatchBrandedString):
    """Stable identity of one approved external provider."""


class MatchExternalTrustClass(StrEnum):
    """Closed trust classification for representation providers."""

    LOCAL_TRUSTED = "local_trusted"
    APPROVED_REMOTE = "approved_remote"


class MatchExternalFieldValue(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """One explicitly named value approved for provider egress."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: MatchFieldName
    value: MatchExternalScalarValue


class MatchExternalInput(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """Bounded ordered provider input without database or transaction access."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    fields: tuple[MatchExternalFieldValue, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_fields(self: Self) -> Self:
        if not self.fields:
            raise ValueError("External producer input requires at least one field")
        names = tuple(field.name for field in self.fields)
        if len(set(names)) != len(names):
            raise ValueError("External producer input fields must be distinct")
        return self


def _default_external_complexity() -> MatchExternalComplexityContract:
    return MatchExternalComplexityContract(
        producer_call_limit=MatchProducerCallLimit(1),
        egress_byte_limit=MatchRepresentationByteLimit(1_048_576),
    )


class MatchExternalProducerSpec(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """Provider trust, egress, model, and output-shape declaration."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    producer_ref_id: MatchRepresentationProducerRefId
    provider_id: MatchExternalProviderId
    model_id: MatchExternalModelId
    trust_class: MatchExternalTrustClass
    approved_egress_fields: tuple[MatchFieldName, ...]
    output_dimensions: MatchVectorDimensions
    source_snapshot: MatchSnapshotFingerprint
    visibility_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope
    fit_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope = Field(
        default=MatchPermissionFitScope("derive:visibility-scope"),
        validation_alias=AliasChoices("fit_scope", "visibility_scope"),
    )
    input_spec: MatchProducerInputSpec = Field(
        default_factory=MatchProducerLifecycleDefaults.input_spec,
    )
    output_spec: MatchProducerOutputSpec = Field(
        default_factory=MatchProducerLifecycleDefaults.output_spec,
    )
    determinism: MatchProducerDeterminism = MatchProducerDeterminism.DETERMINISTIC
    update_mode: MatchProducerUpdateMode = MatchProducerUpdateMode.COMPLETE_REBUILD
    source_watermark: MatchArtifactWatermark = MatchArtifactWatermark(0)
    complexity: MatchExternalComplexityContract = Field(
        default_factory=_default_external_complexity,
    )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_spec(self: Self) -> Self:
        if self.fit_scope != self.visibility_scope:
            raise ValueError("External producer fit scope must equal its visibility scope")
        if not self.model_id:
            raise ValueError("External producer model identity cannot be empty")
        if not self.approved_egress_fields:
            raise ValueError("External producer requires approved egress fields")
        if len(set(self.approved_egress_fields)) != len(self.approved_egress_fields):
            raise ValueError("Approved egress fields must be distinct")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "approved_egress_fields",
            tuple(sorted(self.approved_egress_fields, key=str)),
        )
        return self

    @property
    def spec_fingerprint(self: MatchExternalProducerSpec) -> MatchArtifactFingerprint:
        """Bind provider configuration to source snapshot and visibility authority."""
        payload = {
            "approved_egress_fields": [str(value) for value in self.approved_egress_fields],
            "model_id": self.model_id,
            "output_dimensions": int(self.output_dimensions),
            "producer_ref_id": str(self.producer_ref_id),
            "provider_id": str(self.provider_id),
            "source_snapshot": str(self.source_snapshot),
            "source_watermark": int(self.source_watermark),
            "determinism": self.determinism.value,
            "update_mode": self.update_mode.value,
            "trust_class": self.trust_class.value,
            "visibility_scope": str(self.visibility_scope),
        }
        encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        return MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())


class MatchAuthorizedExternalInput(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """Fields read through one authorized transaction snapshot."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    source_id: SysId
    authorized_session_id: MatchAuthorizedSessionIdentity
    request: MatchExternalInput
    source_snapshot: MatchSnapshotFingerprint
    visibility_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope


class MatchPreparedExternalRepresentation(BaseModel, frozen=True):
    """Completed provider output safe to publish in a later transaction."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    spec: MatchExternalProducerSpec
    request_fingerprint: MatchArtifactFingerprint
    artifact_fingerprint: MatchArtifactFingerprint
    embedding: tuple[float, ...]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_embedding(self: Self) -> Self:
        if len(self.embedding) != self.spec.output_dimensions:
            raise ValueError("External representation dimensions do not match the declaration")
        if any(not math.isfinite(value) for value in self.embedding):
            raise ValueError("External representation values must be finite")
        return self


class MatchExternalRepresentationProvider(ABC):
    """Provider boundary that cannot receive a database transaction."""

    @abstractmethod
    def embed(self, request: MatchExternalInput) -> tuple[float, ...]:
        """Return one representation without database access."""


def external_request_fingerprint(request: MatchExternalInput) -> MatchArtifactFingerprint:
    """Return a deterministic digest of the approved outbound values."""
    encoded = json.dumps(
        [(str(field.name), field.value) for field in request.fields],
        ensure_ascii=False,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode()
    return MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())


def external_artifact_fingerprint(
    spec: MatchExternalProducerSpec,
    request_fingerprint: MatchArtifactFingerprint,
    embedding: tuple[float, ...],
) -> MatchArtifactFingerprint:
    """Bind provider output to its model, request, trust, and dimensions."""
    payload = {
        "embedding": [format(value, ".17g") for value in embedding],
        "model_id": spec.model_id,
        "output_dimensions": int(spec.output_dimensions),
        "producer_ref_id": str(spec.producer_ref_id),
        "provider_id": str(spec.provider_id),
        "request_fingerprint": str(request_fingerprint),
        "source_snapshot": str(spec.source_snapshot),
        "trust_class": spec.trust_class.value,
        "visibility_scope": str(spec.visibility_scope),
    }
    encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    return MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())

LeftRowT = TypeVar("LeftRowT", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])
RightRowT = TypeVar("RightRowT", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])
RowT = TypeVar("RowT", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])
ValueT = TypeVar("ValueT")


class _FrozenMatchModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", arbitrary_types_allowed=True)


class MatchFilterSpec(_FrozenMatchModel):
    """Nominal base for closed matching filter variants."""


class NoMatchFilter(MatchFilterSpec):
    """Concrete declaration that no semantic filter applies."""


class MatchEndpointFilterSpec(MatchFilterSpec, Generic[RowT]):
    """One typed endpoint predicate evaluated before pair creation."""

    expression: Annotated[Expression[bool, RowT], SkipValidation]
    row_type: Annotated[type[RowT], SkipValidation]

    @classmethod
    def from_expression(
        cls: type[MatchEndpointFilterSpec[RowT]],
        expression: Expression[bool, RowT],
    ) -> MatchEndpointFilterSpec[RowT]:
        """Capture a typed endpoint expression and its owner."""
        if not isinstance(expression.owner, type) or not issubclass(expression.owner, DatabaseObjectRow):
            msg = "matching endpoint filter requires one typed row owner"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return cls.model_validate({"expression": expression, "row_type": expression.owner})


class MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec(MatchFilterSpec, Generic[LeftRowT, RightRowT, ValueT]):
    """One closed comparison between typed fields on both endpoints."""

    left_row_type: Annotated[type[LeftRowT], SkipValidation]
    left_field_name: MatchFieldName
    operator: MatchPairComparisonOperator
    right_row_type: Annotated[type[RightRowT], SkipValidation]
    right_field_name: MatchFieldName

    @classmethod
    def from_fields(
        cls: type[MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT, ValueT]],
        left_field: Field[ValueT, LeftRowT],
        operator: MatchPairComparisonOperator,
        right_field: Field[ValueT, RightRowT],
    ) -> MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT, ValueT]:
        """Capture one type-compatible comparison without a raw expression string."""
        if left_field.field_type != right_field.field_type:
            msg = "pair comparison fields must have the same value type"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return cls.model_validate(
            {
                "left_row_type": left_field.owner,
                "left_field_name": MatchFieldName(left_field.name),
                "operator": operator,
                "right_row_type": right_field.owner,
                "right_field_name": MatchFieldName(right_field.name),
            },
        )


class MatchFilterSet(_FrozenMatchModel):
    """Two-sided and pair filter declarations for the initial contract profile."""

    left: NoMatchFilter | MatchEndpointFilterSpec | MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec
    right: NoMatchFilter | MatchEndpointFilterSpec | MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec
    pair: NoMatchFilter | MatchEndpointFilterSpec | MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec

    @classmethod
    def no_filters(cls: type[MatchFilterSet]) -> MatchFilterSet:
        """Construct the explicit no-filter declaration."""
        return cls(left=NoMatchFilter(), right=NoMatchFilter(), pair=NoMatchFilter())

        if presence_field.field_type is not bool:

        return cls(

class MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec(MatchRepresentationSpec[RowT], Generic[RowT]):
    """One canonical native-core vector payload stored in a typed binary field."""

    row_type: Annotated[type[RowT], SkipValidation]
    field_name: MatchFieldName
    contract: VectorRepresentationContract
    indices_field_name: MatchFieldName | NoMatchFieldName = NoMatchFieldName("none")
    availability: MatchRepresentationAvailabilityBaseVariant = PydanticField(default_factory=AllRowsRepresented)

    @classmethod
    def from_fields(
        cls: type[MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]],
        source_field: Field[bytes, RowT],
        *,
        contract: VectorRepresentationContract,
        indices_field: Field[Any, RowT] | None = None,
    ) -> MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        """Bind an encoded payload and optional sparse indices to one numerical contract."""
        if indices_field is not None and indices_field.owner is not source_field.owner:
            raise ValueError("encoded vector payload and indices must belong to one row type")
        return cls(
            representation_ref_id=contract.identity,
            row_type=source_field.owner,
            field_name=MatchFieldName(source_field.name),
            contract=contract,
            indices_field_name=(
                MatchFieldName(indices_field.name) if indices_field is not None else NoMatchFieldName("none")
            ),
        )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_fields(self: MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]) -> MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        source_field = self.row_type.model_fields.get(str(self.field_name))
        if source_field is None or source_field.annotation is not bytes:
            raise ValueError("encoded vector representation must identify a typed bytes Field")
        sparse = self.contract.layout is VectorLayout.SPARSE
        if sparse != isinstance(self.indices_field_name, MatchFieldName):
            raise ValueError("sparse encoded vectors require one indices field, and other layouts forbid it")
        if isinstance(self.indices_field_name, MatchFieldName) and str(self.indices_field_name) not in self.row_type.model_fields:
            raise ValueError("encoded sparse indices must identify a typed Field")
        return self


class MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec(MatchRepresentationSpec[RowT], Generic[RowT]):
    """One packed H14 code field bound to an immutable projection generation."""

    kind: Literal["h14_binary_field"] = "h14_binary_field"
    row_type: Annotated[type[RowT], SkipValidation]
    field_name: MatchFieldName
    source_field_name: MatchFieldName | NoMatchFieldName = NoMatchFieldName("none")
    projection_artifact_id: MatchProjectionArtifactId
    projection_artifact: H14ProjectionArtifact | NoH14ProjectionArtifact = PydanticField(
        default_factory=NoH14ProjectionArtifact,
    )
    availability: MatchRepresentationAvailabilityBaseVariant = PydanticField(
        default_factory=AllRowsRepresented,
    )

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _bind_artifact_identity(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return value
        artifact = value.get("projection_artifact")
        if isinstance(artifact, H14ProjectionArtifact):
            fields = dict(value)
            fields["projection_artifact_id"] = artifact.artifact_id
            return fields
        return value

    @classmethod
    def from_field(
        cls: type[MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]],
        code_field: Field[Any, RowT],
        *,
        source_field: Field[bytes, RowT] | None = None,
        projection_artifact: H14ProjectionArtifact | None = None,
        projection_artifact_id: MatchProjectionArtifactId | None = None,
    ) -> MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        """Capture one typed canonical packed-code field."""
        artifact_id = projection_artifact.artifact_id if projection_artifact is not None else projection_artifact_id
        if artifact_id is None:
            raise ValueError("H14 representation requires a projection artifact identity")
        representation_suffix = ":h14" if projection_artifact is not None else f":h14:{artifact_id}"
        return cls(
            representation_ref_id=MatchRepresentationRefId(
                f"{code_field.owner.__module__}.{code_field.owner.__qualname__}:{code_field.name}{representation_suffix}",
            ),
            row_type=code_field.owner,
            field_name=MatchFieldName(code_field.name),
            source_field_name=(
                MatchFieldName(source_field.name) if source_field is not None else NoMatchFieldName("none")
            ),
            projection_artifact_id=artifact_id,
            projection_artifact=projection_artifact or NoH14ProjectionArtifact(),
        )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_binary_field(
        self: MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT],
    ) -> MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        source_field = self.row_type.model_fields.get(str(self.field_name))
        annotation = None if source_field is None else source_field.annotation
        if annotation is not bytes and not getattr(annotation, "__nera_h14_code_type__", False):
            raise ValueError("H14 representation must identify a typed packed-code Field")
        return self

class MatchRelationSpec(_FrozenMatchModel, Generic[RowT]):
    """One typed endpoint relation and its semantic representation."""

    relation_ref_id: MatchRelationRefId
    row_type: Annotated[type[RowT], SkipValidation]
    representation: "SerializeAsAny[MatchRepresentationVariant[RowT]]"
    identity: MatchSysIdIdentitySpec | MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec = PydanticField(
        default_factory=MatchSysIdIdentitySpec,
    )
    source: "MatchRelationSourceVariant" = PydanticField(default_factory=lambda: MatchTableRelationSource())

    @field_validator("representation", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _restore_representation_variant(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return value
        kind = value.get("kind")
        if not isinstance(kind, str):
            return MatchRepresentationSpec.model_validate(value)
        variants: dict[str, type[BaseModel]] = {
            "identity_only": MatchIdentityOnlyRepresentationSpec,
            "dense_vector_field": MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec,
            "packed_dense_field": MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec,
            "h14_binary_field": MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
            "dense_coordinates": MatchDenseRepresentationSpec,
            "token_field": MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
            "text_field": MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
            "produced": MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
        }
        variant = variants.get(kind)
        if variant is None:
            return MatchRepresentationSpec.model_validate(value)
        return variant.model_validate(value)

    @field_validator("row_type")
    @classmethod
    def _require_database_row(cls: type[MatchRelationSpec[RowT]], value: type[RowT]) -> type[RowT]:
        if not isinstance(value, type) or not issubclass(value, DatabaseObjectRow):
            msg = "row_type must be a DatabaseObjectRow class"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return value

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _validate_representation_owner(self: MatchRelationSpec[RowT]) -> MatchRelationSpec[RowT]:
        representation = self.representation
        if isinstance(self.identity, MatchCanonicalIdentityFieldSpec) and not issubclass(
            self.identity.row_type,
            self.row_type,
        ):
            msg = "canonical identity field must belong to the relation row type"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        representation_row_type = getattr(representation, "row_type", self.row_type)
        if isinstance(representation_row_type, type) and issubclass(representation_row_type, DatabaseObjectRow):
            if (
                representation_row_type is not self.row_type
                and not issubclass(representation_row_type, self.row_type)
                and not issubclass(self.row_type, representation_row_type)
            ):
                msg = "representation source fields must belong to the relation row type"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ) and get_table_name(representation.row_type) != get_table_name(self.row_type):
            msg = "representation owner must share the relation storage"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            if representation.row_type is not self.row_type and not issubclass(
                representation.row_type,
                self.row_type,
            ):
                msg = "dense vector source field must belong to the relation row type"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(representation, MatchDenseRepresentationSpec):
            for coordinate in representation.coordinates:
                if coordinate.row_type is not self.row_type and not issubclass(coordinate.row_type, self.row_type):
                    msg = "dense coordinate field must belong to the relation row type"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec,
        ) and isinstance(representation.availability, MatchRepresentationPresenceSpec):
            if representation.availability.row_type is not self.row_type and not issubclass(
                representation.availability.row_type,
                self.row_type,
            ):
                msg = "representation presence field must belong to the relation row type"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        return self

    @classmethod
    def from_row(
        cls: type[MatchRelationSpec[RowT]],
        *,
        relation_ref_id: MatchRelationRefId,
        row: RowT,
        representation: MatchRepresentationVariant[RowT],
        identity: MatchIdentityVariant | None = None,
    ) -> MatchRelationSpec[RowT]:
        """Lower one application query row to a typed singleton relation."""
        row_type = type(row)
        return cls(
            relation_ref_id=relation_ref_id,
            row_type=row_type,
            representation=representation,
            identity=identity or MatchSysIdIdentitySpec(),
            source=MatchSingletonRelationSource(row_type=row_type, row=row),
        )

    @field_validator("row_type", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _restore_row_type(cls, value: object, info: ValidationInfo) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        catalog = (info.context or {}).get("row_type_catalog")
        resolver = getattr(catalog, "resolve", None)
        if not callable(resolver):
            raise ValueError("Serialized matching relations require a row-type catalog")
        return resolver(MatchRowTypeRef(value))

    @field_serializer("row_type", when_used="json")
    def _serialize_row_type(self: MatchRelationSpec[RowT], value: type[RowT]) -> str:
        return f"{value.__module__}.{value.__qualname__}"


def _expression_fingerprint_payload(expression: Expression[bool, RowT]) -> dict[str, object]:
    value = expression.value
    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
        normalized_value: object = tuple(str(item) for item in value)
    elif value is None or isinstance(value, str | int | float | bool):
        normalized_value = value
    else:
        normalized_value = str(value)
    return {
        "owner": (None if expression.owner is None else f"{expression.owner.__module__}.{expression.owner.__qualname__}"),
        "field": expression.field,
        "operator": expression.operator,
        "value": normalized_value,
        "logical_op": expression.logical_op,
        "function": expression.function,
        "left": None if expression.left is None else _expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.left),
        "right": None if expression.right is None else _expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.right),
        "args": tuple(
            _expression_fingerprint_payload(argument) if isinstance(argument, Expression) else str(argument)
            for argument in expression.args
        ),
    }


def _filter_fingerprint_payload(filter_spec: MatchFilterSpec) -> dict[str, object]:
    if type(filter_spec) is NoMatchFilter:
        return {"kind": "none"}
    if isinstance(filter_spec, MatchEndpointFilterSpec):
        return {
            "kind": "endpoint_expression",
            "expression": _expression_fingerprint_payload(filter_spec.expression),
        }
    if isinstance(filter_spec, MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec):
        return {
            "kind": "pair_field_comparison",
            "left_owner": f"{filter_spec.left_row_type.__module__}.{filter_spec.left_row_type.__qualname__}",
            "left_field": str(filter_spec.left_field_name),
            "operator": filter_spec.operator.value,
            "right_owner": f"{filter_spec.right_row_type.__module__}.{filter_spec.right_row_type.__qualname__}",
            "right_field": str(filter_spec.right_field_name),
        }
    msg = f"Unknown matching filter variant: {type(filter_spec).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _availability_fingerprint_payload(

    if type(availability) is AllRowsRepresented:

    if isinstance(representation, MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):

    if isinstance(representation, MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec):

            "artifact": str(representation.projection_artifact_id),

class MatchComplexityBound(_FrozenMatchModel):
    """Nominal base for closed symbolic worst-case bounds."""


class ConstantComplexityBound(MatchComplexityBound):
    """Constant symbolic work or storage bound."""

    kind: Literal["constant"] = "constant"
    value: MatchComplexityConstant


class SymbolComplexityBound(MatchComplexityBound):
    """One declared matching complexity symbol."""

    kind: Literal["symbol"] = "symbol"
    symbol: MatchComplexitySymbol


class ProductComplexityBound(MatchComplexityBound):
    """Product of two or more closed complexity factors."""

    kind: Literal["product"] = "product"
    factors: "tuple[MatchComplexityBoundVariant, ...]"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_factors(self: ProductComplexityBound) -> ProductComplexityBound:
        if len(self.factors) < 2:
            msg = "product complexity requires at least two factors"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return self


class MatchComplexityContract(_FrozenMatchModel):
    """Complete worst-case complexity contract for one executable stage."""

    build_time: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    incremental_update_time: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    query_time: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    working_memory: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    persistent_storage: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    write_amplification: ConstantComplexityBound | SymbolComplexityBound | ProductComplexityBound | UnknownComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound
    exactness: MatchExactness
    assumptions: tuple[MatchExpectedValue, ...]

    @classmethod
    def exact_dense(cls: type[MatchComplexityContract]) -> MatchComplexityContract:
        """Return O(L*R*D) exact scan and O(L*K) result-heap bounds."""
        zero = ConstantComplexityBound(value=MatchComplexityConstant(0))
        return cls(
            build_time=zero,
            incremental_update_time=zero,
            query_time=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.DIMENSIONS),
                ),
            ),
            working_memory=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.NEIGHBORS),
                ),
            ),
            persistent_storage=zero,
            write_amplification=zero,
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            assumptions=(MatchExpectedValue("finite_dense_coordinates"),),
        )

    @classmethod
    def exact_substring(cls: type[MatchComplexityContract]) -> MatchComplexityContract:
        """Return a safe exact substring scan bound over every visible pair."""
        zero = ConstantComplexityBound(value=MatchComplexityConstant(0))
        return cls(
            build_time=zero,
            incremental_update_time=zero,
            query_time=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_TEXT_LENGTH),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_TEXT_LENGTH),
                ),
            ),
            working_memory=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.NEIGHBORS),
                ),
            ),
            persistent_storage=zero,
            write_amplification=zero,
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            assumptions=(MatchExpectedValue("finite_normalized_text"),),
        )

    @classmethod
    def banded_edit_distance(cls: type[MatchComplexityContract]) -> MatchComplexityContract:
        """Return O(L*R*T*min(M,N)) exact thresholded edit work."""
        zero = ConstantComplexityBound(value=MatchComplexityConstant(0))
        minimum_length = MinimumComplexityBound(
            factors=(
                SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_TEXT_LENGTH),
                SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_TEXT_LENGTH),
            ),
        )
        return cls(
            build_time=zero,
            incremental_update_time=zero,
            query_time=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.EDIT_THRESHOLD),
                    minimum_length,
                ),
            ),
            working_memory=minimum_length,
            persistent_storage=zero,
            write_amplification=zero,
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            assumptions=(MatchExpectedValue("ukkonen_threshold_band"),),
        )

    @classmethod
    def exact_edit_distance(cls: type[MatchComplexityContract]) -> MatchComplexityContract:
        """Return O(L*R*M*N) exact edit work and linear rolling-row memory."""
        zero = ConstantComplexityBound(value=MatchComplexityConstant(0))
        return cls(
            build_time=zero,
            incremental_update_time=zero,
            query_time=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_TEXT_LENGTH),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_TEXT_LENGTH),
                ),
            ),
            working_memory=SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_TEXT_LENGTH),
            persistent_storage=zero,
            write_amplification=zero,
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            assumptions=(MatchExpectedValue("levenshtein_rolling_rows"),),
        )

    @classmethod
    def exact_expression(cls: type[MatchComplexityContract]) -> MatchComplexityContract:
        """Return O(L*R*E) exact expression work and O(L*K) result memory."""
        zero = ConstantComplexityBound(value=MatchComplexityConstant(0))
        return cls(
            build_time=zero,
            incremental_update_time=zero,
            query_time=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.RIGHT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.EXPRESSION_NODES),
                ),
            ),
            working_memory=ProductComplexityBound(
                factors=(
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.LEFT_ROWS),
                    SymbolComplexityBound(symbol=MatchComplexitySymbol.NEIGHBORS),
                ),
            ),
            persistent_storage=zero,
            write_amplification=zero,
            exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
            assumptions=(MatchExpectedValue("finite_expression_score"),),
        )

class MatchSpec(_FrozenMatchModel, Generic[LeftRowT, RightRowT]):
    """Canonical typed relation-to-relation matching declaration."""

    spec_ref_id: MatchSpecRefId
    pair_scope: MatchPairScope
    left: MatchRelationSpec[LeftRowT]
    right: MatchRelationSpec[RightRowT]
    kernel: "SerializeAsAny[MatchKernelVariant]"
    policies: MatchPolicies
    result_shape: (
        TopKPerLeftMatchShape
        | TopKPerRightMatchShape
        | GlobalTopKMatchShape
        | ThresholdJoinMatchShape
        | MutualNeighborMatchShape
        | MatchResultShapeSpec
    )
    filters: MatchFilterSet
    work_limits: MatchWorkLimits
    _resolved_native_choice: NativeExactPlanChoice | NoNativeExactPlanChoice = PrivateAttr(
        default_factory=NoNativeExactPlanChoice,
    )

    @field_validator("kernel", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _restore_kernel_variant(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return value
        variants: dict[MatchKernelKind, type[BaseModel]] = {
            MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT: MatchKernelSpec,
            MatchKernelKind.DENSE_COSINE: MatchKernelSpec,
            MatchKernelKind.H14_HAMMING: MatchH14HammingKernelSpec,
            MatchKernelKind.BAG_OF_WORDS: MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec,
            MatchKernelKind.SUBSTRING: MatchSubstringKernelSpec,
            MatchKernelKind.EDIT_DISTANCE: MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec,
        }
        kind_value = value.get("kind")
        try:
            kind = MatchKernelKind(kind_value) if isinstance(kind_value, str) else None
        except ValueError:
            kind = None
        variant = variants.get(kind) if kind is not None else None
        return value if variant is None else variant.model_validate(value)

    @field_validator("result_shape", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _restore_result_shape_variant(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            return value
        variants: dict[MatchResultShapeKind, type[BaseModel]] = {
            MatchResultShapeKind.TOP_K_PER_LEFT: TopKPerLeftMatchShape,
            MatchResultShapeKind.TOP_K_PER_RIGHT: TopKPerRightMatchShape,
            MatchResultShapeKind.GLOBAL_TOP_K: GlobalTopKMatchShape,
            MatchResultShapeKind.THRESHOLD_JOIN: ThresholdJoinMatchShape,
            MatchResultShapeKind.MUTUAL_NEIGHBORS: MutualNeighborMatchShape,
        }
        kind_value = value.get("kind")
        try:
            kind = MatchResultShapeKind(kind_value) if isinstance(kind_value, str) else None
        except ValueError:
            kind = None
        variant = variants.get(kind) if kind is not None else None
        return value if variant is None else variant.model_validate(value)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _validate_filter_owners(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
        if isinstance(self.filters.left, MatchEndpointFilterSpec) and not issubclass(
            self.filters.left.row_type,
            self.left.row_type,
        ):
            msg = "left filter owner must belong to the left relation"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.filters.right, MatchEndpointFilterSpec) and not issubclass(
            self.filters.right.row_type,
            self.right.row_type,
        ):
            msg = "right filter owner must belong to the right relation"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.filters.pair, MatchPairFieldComparisonSpec):
            if not issubclass(self.filters.pair.left_row_type, self.left.row_type):
                msg = "pair filter left owner must belong to the left relation"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if not issubclass(self.filters.pair.right_row_type, self.right.row_type):
                msg = "pair filter right owner must belong to the right relation"
                raise ValueError(msg)
        return self

    @property
    def semantic_fingerprint(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> MatchSpecFingerprint:
        """Return the stable fingerprint of every semantic declaration field."""
        payload = {
            "filters": {
                "left": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.left),
                "pair": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.pair),
                "right": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.right),
            },
            "kernel": {
                "kind": self.kernel.kind.value,
                "ref": str(self.kernel.kernel_ref_id),
                "score_direction": self.kernel.score_direction.value,
                "left_representation_kind": self.kernel.left_representation_kind.value,
                "right_representation_kind": self.kernel.right_representation_kind.value,
                "score_domain": self.kernel.score_domain.value,
                "normalization": self.kernel.normalization.value,
                "symmetry": self.kernel.symmetry.value,
                "additive_decomposition": self.kernel.additive_decomposition.value,
                "exact_evaluator": self.kernel.exact_evaluator.value,
                "pruning_bound": self.kernel.pruning_bound.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "evaluation_complexity": self.kernel.evaluation_complexity.model_dump(mode="json"),
            },
            "left": {
                "relation_ref": str(self.left.relation_ref_id),
                "identity": _identity_fingerprint_payload(self.left.identity),
                "representation": _representation_fingerprint_payload(self.left.representation),
                "row_type": f"{self.left.row_type.__module__}.{self.left.row_type.__qualname__}",
            },
            "pair_scope": str(self.pair_scope),
            "policies": {
                "duplicates": self.policies.duplicates.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "freshness": self.policies.freshness.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "guarantee": self.policies.guarantee.value,
                "missing_representation": self.policies.missing_representation.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "self_edges": self.policies.self_edges.value,
            },
            "result_shape": _result_shape_fingerprint_payload(self.result_shape),
            "work_limits": self.work_limits.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "right": {
                "relation_ref": str(self.right.relation_ref_id),
                "identity": _identity_fingerprint_payload(self.right.identity),
                "representation": _representation_fingerprint_payload(self.right.representation),
                "row_type": f"{self.right.row_type.__module__}.{self.right.row_type.__qualname__}",
            },
            "spec_ref": str(self.spec_ref_id),
        }
        encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        return MatchSpecFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())

    @field_validator("kernel", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _require_typed_kernel(cls, value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, str):
            msg = "kernel must be a typed matching kernel specification"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return value

    @field_validator("kernel")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_expression_owners(
        cls,
        kernel: (
            MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec
            | MatchH14HammingKernelSpec
            | MatchSubstringKernelSpec
            | MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec
            | MatchKernelSpec
            | MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec
            | MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec
        ),
        info: ValidationInfo,
    ) -> MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec | MatchKernelSpec | MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec | MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec:
        expression_kernels = (
            (kernel.candidate_kernel, kernel.final_kernel)
            if isinstance(kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec)
            else (kernel,)
            if isinstance(kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec)
            else ()
        )
        if not expression_kernels:
            return kernel
        left_relation = info.data.get("left")
        right_relation = info.data.get("right")
        if not isinstance(left_relation, MatchRelationSpec) or not isinstance(right_relation, MatchRelationSpec):
            return kernel
        for expression_kernel in expression_kernels:
            for expression_leaf in _score_expression_leaves(expression_kernel.expression):
                if isinstance(expression_leaf, MatchLeftFieldExpression) and not issubclass(
                    expression_leaf.row_type,
                    left_relation.row_type,
                ):
                    msg = "left expression field owner must belong to the left relation"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if isinstance(expression_leaf, MatchRightFieldExpression) and not issubclass(
                    expression_leaf.row_type,
                    right_relation.row_type,
                ):
                    msg = "right expression field owner must belong to the right relation"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
        return kernel

    def _native_exact_inputs(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> NativeExactExecutionInputs:
        """Describe the declaration bounds without selecting an execution strategy."""
        selected_right = (
            min(int(self.result_shape.neighbor_count), int(self.work_limits.max_right_rows))
            if isinstance(self.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape)
            else int(self.work_limits.max_right_rows)
        )
        return NativeExactExecutionInputs(
            left_rows=NativeEstimatedRowCount(self.work_limits.max_left_rows),
            right_rows=NativeEstimatedRowCount(self.work_limits.max_right_rows),
            selected_right_rows=NativeEstimatedRowCount(selected_right),
            dimensions=MatchVectorDimensions(getattr(self.left.representation, "dimensions", 1)),
            score_schedule=(
                NativeExactScoreSchedule.THRESHOLD_PREFLIGHT_AND_RESULT
                if isinstance(self.result_shape, ThresholdJoinMatchShape)
                else NativeExactScoreSchedule.RESULT_ONLY
            ),
        )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _resolve_native_choice(
        self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT], info: ValidationInfo,
    ) -> MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]:
        deployment = info.context
        if not isinstance(self.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
            if isinstance(deployment, NativeExactDeploymentPlan):
                raise ValueError("A native deployment requires packed dense endpoints")
            return self
        inputs = self._native_exact_inputs()
        if isinstance(deployment, NoNativeExactPlanChoice):
            raise ValueError("Persisted native declarations require a deployment plan")
        if isinstance(deployment, NativeExactDeploymentPlan):
            if deployment.profile != self.left.representation.native_profile or deployment.choice.inputs != inputs:
                raise ValueError("Persisted native deployment does not match the declaration")
            self._resolved_native_choice = deployment.choice
        elif isinstance(self._resolved_native_choice, NoNativeExactPlanChoice):
            self._resolved_native_choice = select_native_exact_strategy(inputs)
        elif self._resolved_native_choice.inputs != inputs:
            raise ValueError("Native choice inputs require explicit declaration reconstruction")
        return self

    @property
    def native_exact_choice(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> NativeExactPlanChoice:
        """Return the resolved immutable choice without strategy selection."""
        choice = self._resolved_native_choice
        if not isinstance(choice, NativeExactPlanChoice) or choice.inputs != self._native_exact_inputs():
            raise ValueError("The declaration has no compatible resolved native choice")
        return choice

    def _fingerprint_payload(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> dict[str, object]:
        """Build the complete declaration identity without transport-specific state."""
        expression_kernel = (
            self.kernel.final_kernel
            if isinstance(self.kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec)
            else self.kernel
            if isinstance(self.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec)
            else None
        )
        payload: dict[str, object] = {
            "filters": {
                "left": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.left),
                "pair": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.pair),
                "right": _filter_fingerprint_payload(self.filters.right),
            },
            "kernel": {
                "kind": self.kernel.kind.value,
                "ref": str(self.kernel.kernel_ref_id),
                "score_direction": self.kernel.score_direction.value,
                "left_representation_kind": self.kernel.left_representation_kind.value,
                "right_representation_kind": self.kernel.right_representation_kind.value,
                "score_domain": self.kernel.score_domain.value,
                "normalization": self.kernel.normalization.value,
                "symmetry": self.kernel.symmetry.value,
                "additive_decomposition": self.kernel.additive_decomposition.value,
                "exact_evaluator": self.kernel.exact_evaluator.value,
                "pruning_bound": self.kernel.pruning_bound.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "evaluation_complexity": self.kernel.evaluation_complexity.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "expression": (
                    _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression_kernel.expression) if expression_kernel is not None else None
                ),
                "expression_null_policy": (expression_kernel.null_policy.value if expression_kernel is not None else None),
                "expression_node_count": (int(expression_kernel.expression_node_count) if expression_kernel is not None else None),
                "candidate_kernel": (
                    {
                        "ref": str(self.kernel.candidate_kernel.kernel_ref_id),
                        "expression": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(self.kernel.candidate_kernel.expression),
                        "null_policy": self.kernel.candidate_kernel.null_policy.value,
                        "score_direction": self.kernel.candidate_kernel.score_direction.value,
                    }
                    if isinstance(self.kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec)
                    else None
                ),
            },
            "left": {
                "relation_ref": str(self.left.relation_ref_id),
                "identity": _identity_fingerprint_payload(self.left.identity),
                "representation": _representation_fingerprint_payload(self.left.representation),
                "row_type": f"{self.left.row_type.__module__}.{self.left.row_type.__qualname__}",
                "source": _relation_source_fingerprint_payload(self.left.source),
            },
            "pair_scope": str(self.pair_scope),
            "policies": {
                "duplicates": self.policies.duplicates.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "explanations": self.policies.explanations.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "freshness": self.policies.freshness.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "guarantee": self.policies.guarantee.value,
                "missing_representation": self.policies.missing_representation.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "self_edges": self.policies.self_edges.value,
            },
            "result_shape": _result_shape_fingerprint_payload(self.result_shape),
            "work_limits": self.work_limits.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "right": {
                "relation_ref": str(self.right.relation_ref_id),
                "identity": _identity_fingerprint_payload(self.right.identity),
                "representation": _representation_fingerprint_payload(self.right.representation),
                "row_type": f"{self.right.row_type.__module__}.{self.right.row_type.__qualname__}",
                "source": _relation_source_fingerprint_payload(self.right.source),
            },
            "spec_ref": str(self.spec_ref_id),
        }
        return payload

    @property
    def native_deployment_scope(self: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> MatchPlanIdentity:
        """Identify one deployment scope independently of its work estimates and limits."""
        payload = self._fingerprint_payload()
        del payload["work_limits"]
        encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        return MatchPlanIdentity(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())

class MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec(MatchRepresentationSpec[RowT], Generic[RowT]):
    """One canonical little-endian fp32 dense vector stored as packed bytes."""

    kind: Literal["packed_dense_field"] = "packed_dense_field"
    row_type: Annotated[type[RowT], SkipValidation]
    field_name: MatchFieldName
    dimensions: MatchVectorDimensions
    dtype: Literal["float32"] = "float32"
    byte_order: Literal["little_endian"] = "little_endian"
    availability: MatchRepresentationAvailabilityVariant = PydanticField(default_factory=AllRowsRepresented)

    @property
    def native_profile(self: MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]) -> NativeExactVectorProfile:
        """Return the fixed V1 physical profile used by exact SQL lowering."""
        return NativeExactVectorProfile(
            extension_version=MatchCompatibilityVersion("0.8.6"),
            physical_type=PgvectorPhysicalType.VECTOR,
            metric=PgvectorMetric.INNER_PRODUCT,
            dimensions=self.dimensions,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_field(
        cls: type[MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]],
        source_field: Field[Any, RowT],
        *,
        dimensions: MatchVectorDimensions,
    ) -> MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        """Capture one typed packed vector field."""
        return cls(
            representation_ref_id=MatchRepresentationRefId(
                f"{source_field.owner.__module__}.{source_field.owner.__qualname__}:{source_field.name}:packed-fp32",
            ),
            row_type=source_field.owner,
            field_name=MatchFieldName(source_field.name),
            dimensions=dimensions,
        )

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _require_binary_field(self: MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]) -> MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec[RowT]:
        source_field = getattr(self.row_type, str(self.field_name), None)
        model_field = self.row_type.model_fields.get(str(self.field_name))
        field_type = model_field.annotation if model_field is not None else getattr(source_field, "field_type", None)
        metadata = model_field.json_schema_extra if model_field is not None else None
        declared_dimensions = metadata.get("embedding_dimensions") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
        native_embedding = declared_dimensions is not None
        if field_type is not bytes and not native_embedding:
            raise ValueError("packed dense representation must identify bytes or a typed embedding Field")
        if native_embedding and declared_dimensions != self.dimensions:
            raise ValueError("typed embedding field dimensions must match the semantic representation")
        return self

def _score_expression_leaves(
    expression: MatchScoreExpression,
) -> tuple[MatchLeftFieldExpression[Any] | MatchRightFieldExpression[Any], ...]:
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression | MatchRightFieldExpression):
        return (expression,)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        return _score_expression_leaves(expression.argument)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        return (*_score_expression_leaves(expression.left), *_score_expression_leaves(expression.right))
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return (
            *_score_expression_leaves(expression.numerator),
            *_score_expression_leaves(expression.denominator),
        )
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _score_expression_node_count(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> MatchExpressionNodeCount:
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression | MatchRightFieldExpression):
        return MatchExpressionNodeCount(1)
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        return MatchExpressionNodeCount(1 + int(_score_expression_node_count(expression.argument)))
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        return MatchExpressionNodeCount(
            1 + int(_score_expression_node_count(expression.left)) + int(_score_expression_node_count(expression.right)),
        )
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return MatchExpressionNodeCount(
            1 + int(_score_expression_node_count(expression.numerator)) + int(_score_expression_node_count(expression.denominator)),
        )
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression: MatchScoreExpression) -> dict[str, object]:
    if isinstance(expression, MatchLeftFieldExpression):
        return {
            "kind": expression.kind,
            "row_type": f"{expression.row_type.__module__}.{expression.row_type.__qualname__}",
            "field": str(expression.field_name),
        }
    if isinstance(expression, MatchRightFieldExpression):
        return {
            "kind": expression.kind,
            "row_type": f"{expression.row_type.__module__}.{expression.row_type.__qualname__}",
            "field": str(expression.field_name),
        }
    if isinstance(expression, MatchAddExpression | MatchMultiplyExpression | MatchSubtractExpression):
        return {
            "kind": expression.kind,
            "left": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.left),
            "right": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.right),
        }
    if isinstance(expression, MatchFunctionExpression):
        return {
            "kind": expression.kind,
            "function": expression.function.value,
            "argument": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.argument),
        }
    if isinstance(expression, MatchDivideExpression):
        return {
            "kind": expression.kind,
            "numerator": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.numerator),
            "denominator": _score_expression_fingerprint_payload(expression.denominator),
        }
    msg = f"Unknown matching score-expression variant: {type(expression).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _relation_source_fingerprint_payload(source: MatchRelationSourceVariant) -> dict[str, object]:
    if isinstance(source, MatchTableRelationSource):
        return {"kind": source.kind}
    if isinstance(source, MatchSingletonRelationSource):
        return {
