LeftRowT = TypeVar("LeftRowT", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])
RightRowT = TypeVar("RightRowT", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])


@pure_lazy
def _complexity_contains_unknown(bound: MatchComplexityBound) -> bool:
    if isinstance(bound, UnknownComplexityBound):
        return True
    if isinstance(bound, ProductComplexityBound | MinimumComplexityBound):
        return any(_complexity_contains_unknown(factor) for factor in bound.factors)
    return False


@pure_lazy
def _validate_exact_dense_spec(spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT]) -> int:
    planning_operations = 0
    planning_operations += 1
    expression_kernel = (
        spec.kernel.final_kernel
        if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchCandidateFinalKernelSpec)
        else spec.kernel
        if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchTypedExpressionKernelSpec)
        else None
    )
    if expression_kernel is not None:
        complexity = expression_kernel.evaluation_complexity
        if any(
            _complexity_contains_unknown(bound)
            for bound in (
                complexity.build_time,
                complexity.incremental_update_time,
                complexity.query_time,
                complexity.working_memory,
                complexity.persistent_storage,
                complexity.write_amplification,
            )
        ):
            raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.COMPLEXITY_BOUND_UNKNOWN,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("finite_typed_expression_query_bound"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("typed_expression_query_bound_unknown"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
    planning_operations += 1
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec) and spec.kernel.unit.value != "code_point":
        raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("initial_edit_unit_code_point"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue(f"{spec.kernel.unit.value}_not_deployed"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    dense_kernel = (
        spec.kernel.kind is MatchKernelKind.DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT
        and spec.kernel.symmetry is MatchKernelSymmetry.SYMMETRIC
        and spec.kernel.additive_decomposition is MatchAdditiveDecomposition.VALID
        and spec.kernel.exact_evaluator is MatchExactEvaluatorKind.SQL_DENSE_DOT_PRODUCT
    )
    expression_kernel_compatible = (
        expression_kernel is not None
        and expression_kernel.kind is MatchKernelKind.TYPED_EXPRESSION
        and expression_kernel.exact_evaluator is MatchExactEvaluatorKind.SQL_TYPED_EXPRESSION
    )
    sparse_kernel = (
        spec.kernel.kind is MatchKernelKind.BAG_OF_WORDS
        and spec.kernel.symmetry is MatchKernelSymmetry.SYMMETRIC
        and spec.kernel.additive_decomposition is MatchAdditiveDecomposition.VALID
        and spec.kernel.exact_evaluator is MatchExactEvaluatorKind.SQL_TERM_FREQUENCY_DOT_PRODUCT
    )
    left_dense = isinstance(
        spec.left.representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
    )
    right_dense = isinstance(
        spec.right.representation,
        MatchDenseRepresentationSpec | MatchDenseVectorFieldRepresentationSpec | MatchProducedRepresentationSpec,
    )
    left_packed = isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
    right_packed = isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
    dense_dimensions_match = getattr(spec.left.representation, "dimensions", None) == getattr(
        spec.right.representation, "dimensions", None
    )
    dense_compatible = (
        ((left_dense and right_dense) or (left_packed and right_packed))
        and dense_dimensions_match
        and (dense_kernel or expression_kernel_compatible)
        and spec.kernel.left_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.DENSE_COORDINATES
        and spec.kernel.right_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.DENSE_COORDINATES
    )
    string_kernel = isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec | MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec)
    string_compatible = (
        isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and string_kernel
        and spec.kernel.left_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.TEXT
        and spec.kernel.right_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.TEXT
    )
    h14_generation_matches = (
        not (
            isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec)
            and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec)
        )
        or spec.left.representation.projection_artifact_id == spec.right.representation.projection_artifact_id
    )
    if not h14_generation_matches:
        raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("same_h14_projection_artifact_generation"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("mixed_h14_projection_artifact_generations"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    h14_compatible = (
        isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
        and spec.kernel.left_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.H14_BINARY_CODE
        and spec.kernel.right_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.H14_BINARY_CODE
    )
    sparse_compatible = (
        isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        and sparse_kernel
        and spec.kernel.left_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.TOKEN_COUNTS
        and spec.kernel.right_representation_kind is MatchRepresentationKind.TOKEN_COUNTS
    )
    compatible = (
        (dense_compatible or sparse_compatible or string_compatible or h14_compatible)
        and spec.kernel.score_domain is MatchScoreDomainKind.FINITE_REAL
        and spec.kernel.normalization is MatchScoreNormalizationKind.IDENTITY
        and spec.policies.guarantee is MatchGuarantee.EXACT
        and isinstance(
            spec.result_shape,
            TopKPerLeftMatchShape | TopKPerRightMatchShape | GlobalTopKMatchShape | ThresholdJoinMatchShape | MutualNeighborMatchShape,
        )
    )
    if compatible:
        return planning_operations
    raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
        MatchErrorContext(
            invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
            expected=MatchExpectedValue("phase_2_exact_dense_specification"),
            observed=MatchObservedValue("incompatible_matching_specification"),
            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
            spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
        ),
    )


@pure_lazy
def plan_matching_intent(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
) -> IntentStep[MatchResult[LeftRowT, RightRowT]]:
    """Resolve one supported specification through closed physical dispatch."""
    if isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchUSearchIndexRepresentationSpec):
        return build_usearch_match_intent(ref_id, spec, txn)
    if isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchEncodedVectorFieldRepresentationSpec):
        return build_encoded_match_intent(ref_id, spec, txn)
    if isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchPersistedH14CodeRepresentationSpec):
        return build_persisted_h14_match_intent(ref_id, spec, txn)
    if isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchQuantizedCodeRepresentationSpec):
        return build_quantized_match_intent(ref_id, spec, txn)
    planning_operations = _validate_exact_dense_spec(spec)
    return build_exact_dense_match_intent(
        ref_id,
        spec,
        txn,
        planning_operations=planning_operations,
    )


class _MatchPlanExplanationStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchPlanExplanation]):
    def __init__(
        self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        native_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        projection_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        physical_admission_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        backend_type: BackendType,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._native_source_ref = native_source_ref
        self._projection_source_ref = projection_source_ref
        self._physical_admission_refs = physical_admission_refs
        self._spec = spec
        self._backend_type = backend_type

    @property
    def level(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        refs = {str(self._source_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._physical_admission_refs)}
        if self._native_source_ref is not None:
            refs.add(str(self._native_source_ref))
        if self._projection_source_ref is not None:
            refs.add(str(self._projection_source_ref))
        return frozenset(refs)

    def tables_read(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchPlanExplanation]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self: _MatchPlanExplanationStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchPlanExplanation:
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref)) or []
        native_rows = resolved.get(str(self._native_source_ref)) if self._native_source_ref is not None else None
        projection_rows = resolved.get(str(self._projection_source_ref)) if self._projection_source_ref is not None else None
        deployed_native: MatchingNativeExactPlanRow | None = None
        if self._native_source_ref is not None:
            if (
                not isinstance(native_rows, Sequence)
                or len(native_rows) != 1
                or not isinstance(native_rows[0], MatchingNativeExactPlanRow)
            ):
                raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_authoritative_native_exact_plan"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("native_exact_plan_unavailable"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            deployed_native = native_rows[0]
            representation = self._spec.left.representation
            assert isinstance(representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec)
            profile = representation.native_profile
            if (
                deployed_native.deployment_scope != self._spec.native_deployment_scope
                or deployed_native.left_schema_fingerprint != compute_declared_physical_contract_fingerprint(self._spec.left.row_type)
                or deployed_native.right_schema_fingerprint != compute_declared_physical_contract_fingerprint(self._spec.right.row_type)
                or deployed_native.profile_identity != str(profile.identity())
                or deployed_native.physical_type != profile.physical_type.value
                or deployed_native.metric != profile.metric.value
                or deployed_native.operator != profile.operator
                or deployed_native.operator_class != profile.operator_class
                or deployed_native.dimensions != int(profile.dimensions)
                or deployed_native.extension_version != str(profile.extension_version)
            ):
                raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("authoritative_native_exact_profile"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("persisted_native_exact_profile_drift"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        if self._projection_source_ref is not None:
            representation = self._spec.left.representation
            assert isinstance(representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec)
            if not isinstance(projection_rows, Sequence) or len(projection_rows) != 1:
                raise MatchArtifactError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("one_verified_h14_projection"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_projection_unavailable"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            projection = projection_rows[0]
            artifact = representation.projection_artifact
            assert isinstance(artifact, H14ProjectionArtifact)
            if not isinstance(projection, MatchingProjectionArtifactRow) or (
                projection.contract_payload != artifact.model_dump_json()
                or projection.artifact_fingerprint != artifact.fingerprint()
                or projection.artifact_id != artifact.artifact_id
                or projection.algorithm_version != str(artifact.algorithm_version)
                or projection.tenant_scope != str(artifact.fit_scope.tenant)
                or projection.workspace_scope != str(artifact.fit_scope.workspace)
                or projection.branch_scope != str(artifact.fit_scope.branch)
                or projection.revision_scope != str(artifact.fit_scope.revision)
                or projection.permission_scope != str(artifact.fit_scope.permission)
            ):
                raise MatchArtifactError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("content_bound_h14_projection"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("h14_projection_contract_mismatch"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, Sequence):
            msg = "Matching plan metadata must publish a row sequence"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not raw_rows:
            return describe_matching_plan(
                self._spec,
                NoMatchArtifactState(),
                deployed_native=deployed_native,
                backend_type=self._backend_type,
            )
        metadata = raw_rows[0]
        if not isinstance(metadata, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow):
            msg = "Matching plan metadata must publish typed artifact rows"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        state = MatchArtifactExecutionState.model_validate_json(metadata.state_payload)
        sparse_spec = isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
            self._spec.right.representation,
            MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
        )
        string_spec = isinstance(self._spec.left.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) and isinstance(
            self._spec.right.representation,
            MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
        )
        expected_methods = (
            {
                MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SPARSE_POSTINGS.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.WAND.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.BLOCK_MAX_WAND.value,
            }
            if sparse_spec
            else {
                MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SUBSTRING_SCAN.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.AHO_CORASICK.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.QGRAM_EXACT_SUBSTRING.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_LEVENSHTEIN.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.BANDED_LEVENSHTEIN.value,
            }
            if string_spec
            else {
                MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_H14_PACKED_SCAN.value,
                MatchAccessMethodKind.PGVECTOR_EXACT_BIT_SCAN.value,
            }
            if isinstance(self._spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec)
            else {MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_DENSE_SCAN.value}
        )
        if metadata.physical_method not in expected_methods:
            raise MatchArtifactError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue(
                        "artifact_method_matching_resolved_plan",
                    ),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue(f"artifact_method_{metadata.physical_method}"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                    spec_ref_id=self._spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        current_state = MatchArtifactExecutionState.model_validate(
            {
                **state.model_dump(),
                "source_watermark": metadata.source_watermark,
                "artifact_watermark": metadata.artifact_watermark,
            },
        )
        return describe_matching_plan(
            self._spec,
            current_state,
            deployed_native=deployed_native,
            backend_type=self._backend_type,
        )


@pure_lazy
def plan_matching_explanation(
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
) -> LazyResult[MatchPlanExplanation]:
    """Plan an artifact-aware operator explanation."""
    metadata = (
        txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow)
        .filter(
            (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.spec_fingerprint) == str(spec.semantic_fingerprint))
            & (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.pair_scope) == str(spec.pair_scope)),
        )
        .execute_lazy()
    )
    native_source_ref = None
    projection_source_ref = None
    physical_admission_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
        physical_admission_refs = _native_storage_admission_refs(txn, spec)
        native = (
            txn.query_lazy(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow)
            .filter(
                (field(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow.spec_ref_id) == spec.spec_ref_id)
                & (field(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow.spec_fingerprint) == spec.semantic_fingerprint)
                & (field(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow.physical_type) == spec.left.representation.native_profile.physical_type)
                & (field(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow.metric) == spec.left.representation.native_profile.metric)
                & (field(MatchingNativeExactPlanRow.strategy) == spec.native_exact_choice.strategy),
            )
            .execute_lazy()
        )
        native_source_ref = next(iter(collect_plan_ref_dependencies(native)))
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchH14BinaryFieldRepresentationSpec):
        projection = (
            txn.query_lazy(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow)
            .filter(field(MatchingProjectionArtifactRow.artifact_id) == spec.left.representation.projection_artifact_id)
            .execute_lazy()
        )
        projection_source_ref = next(iter(collect_plan_ref_dependencies(projection)))
    dependencies = collect_plan_ref_dependencies(metadata)
    if len(dependencies) != 1:
        msg = "Matching plan explanation requires one metadata dependency"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    step = _MatchPlanExplanationStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        source_ref=next(iter(dependencies)),
        native_source_ref=native_source_ref,
        projection_source_ref=projection_source_ref,
        physical_admission_refs=physical_admission_refs,
        spec=spec,
        backend_type=txn.backend_type,
    )
    return ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, step)


def describe_matching_plan(
    spec: MatchSpec[LeftRowT, RightRowT],
    artifact_state: MatchArtifactStateVariant,
    *,
    deployed_native: MatchingNativeExactPlanRow | None = None,
    backend_type: BackendType | None = None,
) -> MatchPlanExplanation:
    """Return the protected description of the resolved plan."""
    _validate_exact_dense_spec(spec)
    physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_DENSE_SCAN
    if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchH14HammingKernelSpec):
        physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_H14_PACKED_SCAN
    elif isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec):
        physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SUBSTRING_SCAN
    elif isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec):
        physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.BANDED_LEVENSHTEIN
    if isinstance(artifact_state, MatchArtifactExecutionState) and (
        (
            isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
            and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec)
        )
        or (
            isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec)
            and isinstance(spec.right.representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec)
        )
    ):
        physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind(str(artifact_state.identity.physical_method))
    plan_payload = f"{spec.semantic_fingerprint}|{physical_method.value}"
    compatibility_versions = [MatchCompatibilityVersion("matching-contract-v1")]
    native_exact_choice: NativeExactPlanChoice | NoNativeExactPlanChoice = NoNativeExactPlanChoice()
    if isinstance(spec.left.representation, MatchPackedDenseFieldRepresentationSpec):
        if deployed_native is None:
            compatibility_versions.append(spec.left.representation.native_profile.extension_version)
            native_exact_choice = spec.native_exact_choice
        else:
            compatibility_versions.append(deployed_native.extension_version)
            expected_choice = spec.native_exact_choice
            observed = (
                deployed_native.cost_model_version,
                deployed_native.left_rows,
                deployed_native.right_rows,
                deployed_native.selected_right_rows,
                deployed_native.dimensions,
                deployed_native.strategy,
                (
                    float(expected_choice.lateral_cost)
                    if math.isclose(deployed_native.lateral_cost, float(expected_choice.lateral_cost), rel_tol=1e-12)
                    else deployed_native.lateral_cost
                ),
                (
                    float(expected_choice.batch_scan_cost)
                    if math.isclose(deployed_native.batch_scan_cost, float(expected_choice.batch_scan_cost), rel_tol=1e-12)
                    else deployed_native.batch_scan_cost
                ),
                deployed_native.plan_identity,
            )
            expected = (
                expected_choice.model_version,
                int(expected_choice.inputs.left_rows),
                int(expected_choice.inputs.right_rows),
                int(expected_choice.inputs.selected_right_rows),
                int(expected_choice.inputs.dimensions),
                expected_choice.strategy.value,
                float(expected_choice.lateral_cost),
                float(expected_choice.batch_scan_cost),
                str(expected_choice.plan_identity),
            )
            if observed != expected:
                mismatch = next(
                    name
                    for name, observed_value, expected_value in zip(
                        (
                            "model",
                            "left_rows",
                            "right_rows",
                            "selected_right_rows",
                            "dimensions",
                            "strategy",
                            "lateral_cost",
                            "batch_cost",
                            "identity",
                        ),
                        observed,
                        expected,
                        strict=True,
                    )
                    if observed_value != expected_value
                )
                raise MatchCompatibilityError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("authoritative_native_exact_choice"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue(f"persisted_native_exact_{mismatch}_drift"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.MIGRATE_PERSISTED_SPEC,
                        spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            native_exact_choice = expected_choice
            if backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
                physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.PGVECTOR_EXACT_VECTOR_SCAN
    return MatchPlanExplanation(
        plan_identity=MatchPlanIdentity(hashlib.sha256(plan_payload.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()),
        spec_fingerprint=spec.semantic_fingerprint,
        exactness=MatchExactness.EXACT,
        physical_method=physical_method,
        artifact_state=artifact_state,
        complexity=spec.kernel.evaluation_complexity,
        compatibility_versions=tuple(compatibility_versions),
        native_exact_choice=native_exact_choice,
    )

"""Authority validation for materialized Phase 8 producer artifacts."""

from __future__ import annotations
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import MatchSpecRefId

from typing import Any, Literal

from l1470_matching_contracts.errors import MatchArtifactError, MatchErrorContext
from l1470_matching_contracts.models import MatchResult
from l1470_matching_contracts.producer_artifact_models import (
    MatchMaterializedProducerRepresentation,
    MatchProducerArtifactAuthority,
    MatchProducerMatchObservation,
)
from l1470_matching_contracts.types import (
    MatchArtifactWatermark,
    MatchExpectedValue,
    MatchInvariant,
    MatchObservedValue,
    MatchPermissionFitScope,
    MatchSafeAction,
    MatchSnapshotFingerprint,
)


def observe_producer_match(
    result: MatchResult[Any, Any],
    *,
    artifacts: tuple[MatchMaterializedProducerRepresentation, ...],
    backend: Literal["sqlite", "postgres", "mariadb"],
    execution_surface: Literal["lazy", "sync", "async"],
) -> MatchProducerMatchObservation:
    """Build a closed observation from completed artifact and matching results."""
    if not artifacts:
        raise ValueError("Producer matching observations require artifacts")
    family = artifacts[0].producer_family
    if any(artifact.producer_family is not family for artifact in artifacts):
        raise ValueError("Producer matching observations require one producer family")
    unique_artifacts = tuple(dict.fromkeys(artifacts))
    edges = tuple(getattr(result, "edges"))
    ranks = tuple(
        int(
            getattr(
                edge,
                "left_rank",
                getattr(edge, "right_rank", getattr(edge, "global_rank", index + 1)),
            ),
        )
        for index, edge in enumerate(edges)
    )
    return MatchProducerMatchObservation(
        backend=backend,
        execution_surface=execution_surface,
        producer_family=family,
        artifact_ids=tuple(artifact.artifact_id for artifact in unique_artifacts),
        ordered_pair_ids=tuple(str(edge.pair_identity) for edge in edges),
        canonical_scores=tuple(float(edge.score.canonical) for edge in edges),
        ranks=ranks,
        concrete_endpoint_types=tuple(
            (
                f"{type(edge.left).__module__}.{type(edge.left).__qualname__}",
                f"{type(edge.right).__module__}.{type(edge.right).__qualname__}",
            )
            for edge in edges
        ),
        visibility_scopes=tuple(artifact.fit_scope for artifact in unique_artifacts),
        source_snapshots=tuple(artifact.source_snapshot for artifact in unique_artifacts),
        source_watermarks=tuple(artifact.source_watermark for artifact in unique_artifacts),
        producer_work=tuple(artifact.work_metrics for artifact in unique_artifacts),
        matching_work=result.work,
        runtime_metrics=result.runtime_metrics,
    )


def validate_producer_artifact_scope(
    *,
    family: str,
    authority: MatchProducerArtifactAuthority,
    current_fit_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope,
    current_source_snapshot: MatchSnapshotFingerprint,
    current_source_watermark: MatchArtifactWatermark,
) -> None:
    """Reject producer output fitted under stale source or permission authority."""
    if authority.fit_scope != current_fit_scope:
        raise MatchArtifactError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                spec_ref_id=MatchSpecRefId("producer:producer_artifacts"),
                invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_PERMISSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("current_permission_fit_scope"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("different_permission_fit_scope"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
            ),
        )
    if authority.source_snapshot != current_source_snapshot:
        raise MatchArtifactError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                spec_ref_id=MatchSpecRefId("producer:producer_artifacts"),
                invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("current_source_snapshot"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("different_source_snapshot"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
            ),
        )
    if authority.source_watermark != current_source_watermark:
        raise MatchArtifactError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                spec_ref_id=MatchSpecRefId("producer:producer_artifacts"),
                invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_STALE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("current_source_watermark"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("different_source_watermark"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
            ),
        )
    if not family:
        raise ValueError("Producer family cannot be empty")

type _ArtifactRow = (
    MatchingArtifactMetadataRow
    | MatchingArtifactCoverageRow
    | MatchingFeatureLexiconRow
    | MatchingPostingRow
    | MatchingPostingBlockRow
    | MatchingDocumentStatRow
)
type _ArtifactRowType = (
    type[MatchingArtifactMetadataRow]
    | type[MatchingArtifactCoverageRow]
    | type[MatchingFeatureLexiconRow]
    | type[MatchingPostingRow]
    | type[MatchingPostingBlockRow]
    | type[MatchingDocumentStatRow]
)
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SparseArtifactMutationRefs:
    """Named mutation refs for one sparse artifact replacement."""

    postings: ServerPlanRefId
    lexicon: ServerPlanRefId
    blocks: ServerPlanRefId
    documents: ServerPlanRefId
    metadata: ServerPlanRefId
    coverage: ServerPlanRefId


type _ProjectionKind = Literal[
    "artifact_fingerprints",
    "metadata",
    "coverage",
    "lexicon",
    "postings",
    "blocks",
    "documents",
]


class _SparseArtifactPreparation(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)

    artifact_fingerprints: tuple[str, ...]
    metadata: MatchingArtifactMetadataRow
    coverage: tuple[MatchingArtifactCoverageRow, ...]
    lexicon: tuple[MatchingFeatureLexiconRow, ...]
    postings: tuple[MatchingPostingRow, ...]
    blocks: tuple[MatchingPostingBlockRow, ...]
    documents: tuple[MatchingDocumentStatRow, ...]
    state: MatchArtifactExecutionState
    result: MatchArtifactBuildResult
    source_fts_fingerprint: MatchArtifactFingerprint | None = None
    reused_posting_count: MatchPostingCount = MatchPostingCount(0)
    migration_state: MatchArtifactMigrationState | None = None


@pure_lazy
def _owner_connection_id(txn: LazyWriteTransaction) -> ConnectionId:
    return txn._planning_connection_id


@pure_lazy
def _single_ref[T](value: LazyResult[T]) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    refs = collect_plan_ref_dependencies(value)
    if len(refs) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Sparse artifact operation requires one plan-owned dependency")
    return next(iter(refs))


def _matching_tokens(text: str, *, case_fold: bool) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    normalized = text.casefold() if case_fold else text
    return tuple(token for token in normalized.strip().split(" ") if token)


def _posting_block_id(right_sys_id: SysId) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(str(right_sys_id).encode()).hexdigest()


def _rows[T](resolved: ResolvedRefs, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, row_type: type[T]) -> tuple[T, ...]:
    value = resolved.get(str(ref_id)) or ()
    if not isinstance(value, Sequence):
        raise TypeError(f"Expected row sequence from {ref_id}")
    result: list[T] = []
    for row in value:
        if not isinstance(row, row_type):
            raise TypeError(f"Expected {row_type.__name__} from {ref_id}, got {type(row).__name__}")
        result.append(row)
    return tuple(result)


@pure_lazy
def _scope_spec(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> tuple[MatchSpec[Any, Any], str, str, RevisionId | None]:
    versioned = issubclass(spec.left.row_type, VersionedObjectRow) or issubclass(spec.right.row_type, VersionedObjectRow)
    branch_value = getattr(txn, "branch_anchor", None) if versioned else None
    revision_value = getattr(txn, "revision_id", None) if versioned and not isinstance(branch_value, BranchId) else None
    if isinstance(branch_value, BranchId):
        snapshot_scope = f"branch:{branch_value}"
        branch_scope = snapshot_scope
    elif isinstance(revision_value, RevisionId):
        snapshot_scope = f"revision:{revision_value}"
        branch_scope = "branch:pinned-revision"
    else:
        snapshot_scope = "unversioned"
        branch_scope = "branch:main"
    if not versioned:
        return spec, branch_scope, snapshot_scope, None
    scoped = type(spec).model_validate(
        {
            **{field_name: getattr(spec, field_name) for field_name in type(spec).model_fields},
            "pair_scope": MatchPairScope(f"{spec.pair_scope}|{snapshot_scope}"),
        },
    )
    return scoped, branch_scope, snapshot_scope, revision_value if isinstance(revision_value, RevisionId) else None


class _PrepareSparseArtifactStep(NonPublishingStep[_SparseArtifactPreparation]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        branch_scope: str,
        snapshot_scope: str,
        revision_id: RevisionId | None,
        permission_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope,
        left_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        right_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        fts_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        fts_config_fingerprint: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._spec = spec
        self._branch_scope = branch_scope
        self._snapshot_scope = snapshot_scope
        self._revision_id = revision_id
        self._permission_scope = permission_scope
        self._left_rows_ref = left_rows_ref
        self._right_rows_ref = right_rows_ref
        self._metadata_ref = metadata_ref
        self._fts_rows_ref = fts_rows_ref
        self._fts_config_fingerprint = fts_config_fingerprint

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        refs = (self._left_rows_ref, self._right_rows_ref, self._metadata_ref)
        if self._fts_rows_ref is None:
            return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in refs)
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in (*refs, self._fts_rows_ref))

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[_SparseArtifactPreparation]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> _SparseArtifactPreparation:
        spec = self._spec
        representation = spec.right.representation
        if not isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchBagOfWordsKernelSpec) or not isinstance(
            representation,
            MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
                MatchErrorContext(
                    invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                    expected=MatchExpectedValue("nonnegative_additive_bag_of_words_kernel"),
                    observed=MatchObservedValue("wand_requires_nonnegative_additive_kernel"),
                    safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                    spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        left_rows = _rows(resolved, self._left_rows_ref, spec.left.row_type)
        right_rows = _rows(resolved, self._right_rows_ref, spec.right.row_type)
        metadata_rows = _rows(resolved, self._metadata_ref, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow)
        source_fts_fingerprint: MatchArtifactFingerprint | None = None
        reused_posting_count = MatchPostingCount(0)
        migration_state: MatchArtifactMigrationState | None = None
        migrated_frequencies: dict[str, Counter[str]] | None = None
        if self._fts_rows_ref is not None:
            if self._fts_config_fingerprint is None:
                raise TypeError("FTS migration requires its configuration fingerprint")
            fts_rows = _rows(resolved, self._fts_rows_ref, FTSInvertedIndex)
            expected_hashes = {value for row in right_rows if isinstance((value := getattr(row, "sys_fts_content_hash", None)), str)}
            indexed_hashes = {row.content_hash for row in fts_rows}
            if expected_hashes != indexed_hashes:
                raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
                    MatchErrorContext(
                        invariant=MatchInvariant.ARTIFACT_SOURCE_DELTA,
                        expected=MatchExpectedValue("fts_artifact_covers_visible_right_relation"),
                        observed=MatchObservedValue("fts_artifact_coverage_mismatch"),
                        safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                        spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                    ),
                )
            source_payload = json.dumps(
                {
                    "config": self._fts_config_fingerprint,
                    "rows": sorted((row.content_hash, row.token, row.field_name, row.position, row.frequency) for row in fts_rows),
                },
                separators=(",", ":"),
            )
            source_fts_fingerprint = MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(source_payload.encode()).hexdigest())
            frequencies_by_hash: dict[str, Counter[str]] = {}
            for row in fts_rows:
                if row.field_name != str(representation.field_name):
                    continue
                frequencies = frequencies_by_hash.setdefault(row.content_hash, Counter())
                frequencies[row.token] = max(frequencies[row.token], row.frequency)
            migrated_frequencies = {}
            for right_row in right_rows:
                content_hash = getattr(right_row, "sys_fts_content_hash", None)
                if not isinstance(content_hash, str):
                    raise TypeError("FTS migration source row omitted its content hash")
                fts_frequencies = frequencies_by_hash.get(content_hash, Counter())
                source_value = getattr(right_row, str(representation.field_name))
                if not isinstance(source_value, str):
                    raise TypeError("FTS migration token source must be text")
                expected_frequencies = Counter(_matching_tokens(source_value, case_fold=True))
                if fts_frequencies != expected_frequencies:
                    raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue("fts_tokens_match_representation_normalization"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue("fts_token_semantics_incompatible"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REBUILD_ARTIFACT,
                            spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
                        ),
                    )
                migrated_frequencies[str(right_row.sys_id)] = fts_frequencies
            reused_posting_count = MatchPostingCount(sum(len(value) for value in migrated_frequencies.values()))
        producer_ref_id = (
            f"producer:fts-migration:{source_fts_fingerprint}" if source_fts_fingerprint is not None else "producer:sparse-postings"
        )
        current_metadata = next(
            (
                row
                for row in metadata_rows
                if row.producer_ref_id == producer_ref_id and row.source_row_count == len(left_rows) + len(right_rows)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if source_fts_fingerprint is not None and current_metadata is not None:
            generation = current_metadata.generation
            migration_state = MatchArtifactMigrationState.ALREADY_CURRENT
        else:
            generation = 1 + max((row.generation for row in metadata_rows), default=0)
            if source_fts_fingerprint is not None:
                migration_state = MatchArtifactMigrationState.COMPLETE
        if isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape) and len(right_rows) >= 32:
            physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.BLOCK_MAX_WAND
        elif isinstance(spec.result_shape, TopKPerLeftMatchShape):
            physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.WAND
        else:
            physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.EXACT_SPARSE_POSTINGS
        case_fold = representation.normalization.kind == "unicode_words_casefolded"
        corpus = tuple(
            (
                str(row.sys_id),
                tuple(sorted(Counter(_matching_tokens(getattr(row, str(representation.field_name)), case_fold=case_fold)).items())),
            )
            for row in sorted(right_rows, key=lambda candidate: str(candidate.sys_id))
        )
        artifact_payload = json.dumps(
            {
                "spec_fingerprint": str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
                "pair_scope": str(spec.pair_scope),
                "normalization": representation.normalization.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "corpus_statistics_version": generation,
                "posting_order": ("feature_id", "right_sys_id"),
                "block_layout": "one_document_per_block_sha256_identity",
                "physical_method": physical_method.value,
                "source_fts_fingerprint": source_fts_fingerprint,
                "fit_scope": (
                    "tenant:system",
                    "workspace:default",
                    self._branch_scope,
                    self._snapshot_scope,
                    str(self._permission_scope),
                ),
                "corpus": corpus,
            },
            separators=(",", ":"),
            sort_keys=True,
        )
        fingerprint = MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(artifact_payload.encode()).hexdigest())
        feature_documents: Counter[str] = Counter()
        feature_max_frequency: Counter[str] = Counter()
        postings: list[MatchingPostingRow] = []
        blocks: list[MatchingPostingBlockRow] = []
        documents: list[MatchingDocumentStatRow] = []
        for right_row in right_rows:
            value = getattr(right_row, str(representation.field_name))
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                raise TypeError("Token-field representation source must be text")
            frequencies = (
                migrated_frequencies[str(right_row.sys_id)]
                if migrated_frequencies is not None
                else Counter(_matching_tokens(value, case_fold=case_fold))
            )
            block_id = _posting_block_id(right_row.sys_id)
            for feature_id, frequency in sorted(frequencies.items()):
                postings.append(
                    MatchingPostingRow(
                        artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        generation=generation,
                        feature_id=feature_id,
                        right_sys_id=right_row.sys_id,
                        frequency=frequency,
                        weight=float(frequency),
                        field_id=str(representation.field_name),
                        block_id=block_id,
                    ),
                )
                blocks.append(
                    MatchingPostingBlockRow(
                        artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        generation=generation,
                        feature_id=feature_id,
                        block_id=block_id,
                        first_right_id=str(right_row.sys_id),
                        last_right_id=str(right_row.sys_id),
                        max_contribution=float(frequency),
                    ),
                )
                feature_documents[feature_id] += 1
                feature_max_frequency[feature_id] = max(feature_max_frequency[feature_id], frequency)
            documents.append(
                MatchingDocumentStatRow(
                    artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                    generation=generation,
                    right_sys_id=right_row.sys_id,
                    length=sum(frequencies.values()),
                    norm=math.sqrt(sum(frequency * frequency for frequency in frequencies.values())),
                    feature_count=len(frequencies),
                    representation_hash=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                ),
            )
        lexicon = tuple(
            MatchingFeatureLexiconRow(
                artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                generation=generation,
                feature_id=feature_id,
                document_frequency=feature_documents[feature_id],
                max_contribution=float(feature_max_frequency[feature_id]),
                corpus_statistic_version=generation,
            )
            for feature_id in sorted(feature_documents)
        )
        source_watermark = MatchArtifactWatermark(len(left_rows) + len(right_rows))
        identity = MatchArtifactIdentity(
            artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            tenant_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue("tenant:system"),
            workspace_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue("workspace:default"),
            branch_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue(self._branch_scope),
            revision_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue(
                f"revision:{self._revision_id}" if self._revision_id is not None else self._snapshot_scope,
            ),
            producer_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue(producer_ref_id),
            representation_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue(str(representation.representation_ref_id)),
            kernel_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue(str(spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id)),
            physical_method=MatchArtifactScopeValue(physical_method.value),
            generation=MatchArtifactGeneration(generation),
        )
        persisted_state = MatchArtifactExecutionState(
            identity=identity,
            source_watermark=source_watermark,
            artifact_watermark=source_watermark,
            maintenance_mode=MatchArtifactMaintenanceMode.SYNCHRONOUS,
            permission_scope=self._permission_scope,
            indexed_left_identities=(),
            indexed_right_identities=(),
        )
        metadata = MatchingArtifactMetadataRow(
            spec_ref_id=str(spec.spec_ref_id),
            spec_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            artifact_fingerprint=str(fingerprint),
            pair_scope=str(spec.pair_scope),
            tenant_scope=str(identity.tenant_scope),
            workspace_scope=str(identity.workspace_scope),
            branch_scope=str(identity.branch_scope),
            revision_scope=str(identity.revision_scope),
            producer_ref_id=str(identity.producer_ref_id),
            representation_ref_id=str(identity.representation_ref_id),
            kernel_ref_id=str(identity.kernel_ref_id),
            physical_method=str(identity.physical_method),
            generation=generation,
            source_watermark=int(source_watermark),
            artifact_watermark=int(source_watermark),
            source_row_count=int(source_watermark),
            source_tracking_mode="row_count" if self._snapshot_scope == "unversioned" else "snapshot_watermark",
            permission_scope=str(self._permission_scope),
            state_payload=persisted_state.model_dump_json(),
            producer_state="ready",
        )
        scope_digest = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{spec.semantic_fingerprint}\x1f{spec.pair_scope}\x1f{identity.branch_scope}".encode(),
        ).hexdigest()
        coverage = tuple(
            MatchingArtifactCoverageRow(
                spec_ref_id=str(spec.spec_ref_id),
                spec_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
                pair_scope=str(spec.pair_scope),
                branch_scope=str(identity.branch_scope),
                scope_digest=scope_digest,
                endpoint="right",
                identity=str(row.sys_id),
                identity_digest=hashlib.sha256(str(row.sys_id).encode()).hexdigest(),
            )
            for row in right_rows
        )
        block_bound_metrics = tuple(
            MatchPostingBlockBoundMetrics(
                feature_identity=MatchFeatureIdentity(block.feature_id),
                block_identity=MatchPostingBlockIdentity(block.block_id),
                first_right_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(block.first_right_id),
                last_right_identity=MatchCursorIdentity(block.last_right_id),
                persisted_bound=MatchScoreValue(block.max_contribution),
                observed_max_contribution=MatchScoreValue(
                    max(
                        posting.weight
                        for posting in postings
                        if posting.feature_id == block.feature_id and posting.block_id == block.block_id
                    ),
                ),
                corpus_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            )
            for block in blocks
        )
        result = MatchArtifactBuildResult(
            artifact_identity=identity,
            artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            document_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(right_rows)),
            feature_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(feature_documents)),
            posting_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(postings)),
            block_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(blocks)),
            block_bound_metrics=block_bound_metrics,
        )
        replaced = tuple(sorted({str(fingerprint), *(row.artifact_fingerprint for row in metadata_rows)}))
        return _SparseArtifactPreparation(
            artifact_fingerprints=replaced,
            metadata=metadata,
            coverage=coverage,
            lexicon=lexicon,
            postings=tuple(postings),
            blocks=tuple(blocks),
            documents=tuple(documents),
            state=persisted_state,
            result=result,
            source_fts_fingerprint=source_fts_fingerprint,
            reused_posting_count=reused_posting_count,
            migration_state=migration_state,
        )


def _model_contract(step: ServerPlanStep[object], model_cls: _ArtifactRowType) -> CtePublicationContract:
    columns = tuple(plan.db_column for plan in writable_field_plans(model_cls))
    hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    if hints is None:
        raise TypeError(f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {model_cls.__name__}")
    return CtePublicationContract(
        publication_source_kind=PublicationSourceKind.DECLARED_LITERAL_RELATION,
        columns=columns,
        column_type_hints=hints,
        relation_contract=CteRelationContract.model(model_cls),
        relation_role=step.cte_relation_role(),
    )


class _ProjectSparseArtifactStep[T](ServerPlanStep[T]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preparation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        kind: _ProjectionKind,
        model_cls: _ArtifactRowType | None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preparation_ref = preparation_ref
        self._kind = kind
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE if self._kind == "metadata" else Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def executor_visible_publication_uses_python_result(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_decoded_value_as_executor_value(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._preparation_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._model_cls is not None:
            return _model_contract(self, self._model_cls)
        hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({"__result"}))
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=PublicationSourceKind.DECLARED_LITERAL_RELATION,
            columns=("__result",),
            column_type_hints=hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.literal_mapping(columns=("__result",)),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        del ctx
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> T:
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _SparseArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("Sparse artifact preparation did not publish its typed payload")
        value: T = getattr(prepared, self._kind)
        return value


class _CompleteSparseArtifactStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchArtifactBuildResult]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preparation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        write_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        owner_connection_id: ConnectionId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preparation_ref = preparation_ref
        self._write_refs = write_refs
        self._spec = spec
        self._owner_connection_id = owner_connection_id

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._preparation_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._write_refs)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchArtifactBuildResult]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchArtifactBuildResult:
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _SparseArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("Sparse artifact preparation did not publish its typed payload")
        register_matching_source_maintenance(
            self._spec,
            prepared.state,
            str(self._spec.pair_scope),
            self._owner_connection_id,
        )
        return prepared.result


class _CompleteFtsArtifactMigrationStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchFtsArtifactMigrationResult]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preparation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        write_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        owner_connection_id: ConnectionId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preparation_ref = preparation_ref
        self._write_refs = write_refs
        self._spec = spec
        self._owner_connection_id = owner_connection_id

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._preparation_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._write_refs)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchFtsArtifactMigrationResult]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchFtsArtifactMigrationResult:
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _SparseArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("FTS migration preparation did not publish its typed payload")
        if prepared.source_fts_fingerprint is None or prepared.migration_state is None:
            raise TypeError("FTS migration preparation omitted migration provenance")
        register_matching_source_maintenance(
            self._spec,
            prepared.state,
            str(self._spec.pair_scope),
            self._owner_connection_id,
        )
        return MatchFtsArtifactMigrationResult(
            source_fts_fingerprint=prepared.source_fts_fingerprint,
            artifact_fingerprint=prepared.result.artifact_fingerprint,
            generation=prepared.result.artifact_identity.generation,
            reused_posting_count=prepared.reused_posting_count,
            state=prepared.migration_state,
        )


@pure_lazy
def _plan_sparse_artifact_writes(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
    *,
    fts_row_type: type[FTSInvertedIndex] | None = None,
    fts_config_fingerprint: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[MatchSpec[Any, Any], ServerPlanRefId, frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]]:
    scoped_spec, branch_scope, snapshot_scope, revision_id = _scope_spec(txn, spec)
    left_rows = txn.query_lazy(scoped_spec.left.row_type).execute_lazy()
    right_rows = txn.query_lazy(scoped_spec.right.row_type).execute_lazy()
    metadata_scope = (
        (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.spec_fingerprint) == str(scoped_spec.semantic_fingerprint))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.pair_scope) == str(scoped_spec.pair_scope))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.branch_scope) == branch_scope)
    )
    metadata_rows = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow).filter(metadata_scope).execute_lazy()
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    fts_rows = txn.query_lazy(fts_row_type).execute_lazy() if fts_row_type is not None else None
    prepare_step = _PrepareSparseArtifactStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        spec=scoped_spec,
        branch_scope=branch_scope,
        snapshot_scope=snapshot_scope,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        permission_scope=MatchPermissionFitScope(str(txn.session_id)),
        left_rows_ref=_single_ref(left_rows),
        right_rows_ref=_single_ref(right_rows),
        metadata_ref=_single_ref(metadata_rows),
        fts_rows_ref=_single_ref(fts_rows) if fts_rows is not None else None,
        fts_config_fingerprint=fts_config_fingerprint,
    )
    preparation = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, prepare_step)
    preparation_ref = _single_ref(preparation)

    fingerprints = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
        _ProjectSparseArtifactStep[list[str]](
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="artifact_fingerprints",
            model_cls=None,
        ),
    )
    def delete_artifact_rows(artifact_row_type: _ArtifactRowType) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        deleted = (
            txn.query_lazy(artifact_row_type)
            .filter(IN(field(artifact_row_type.artifact_fingerprint), fingerprints))
            .delete_after_lazy(after=(preparation,))
        )
        return _single_ref(deleted)

    posting_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingPostingRow)
    lexicon_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingFeatureLexiconRow)
    block_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingPostingBlockRow)
    document_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingDocumentStatRow)
    coverage_scope = (
        (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.spec_fingerprint) == str(scoped_spec.semantic_fingerprint))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.pair_scope) == str(scoped_spec.pair_scope))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.branch_scope) == branch_scope)
    )
    coverage_delete = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow).filter(coverage_scope).delete_after_lazy(after=(preparation,))
    metadata_delete = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow).filter(metadata_scope).delete_after_lazy(after=(preparation,))
    mutation_refs = SparseArtifactMutationRefs(
        postings=posting_delete_ref,
        lexicon=lexicon_delete_ref,
        blocks=block_delete_ref,
        documents=document_delete_ref,
        metadata=_single_ref(metadata_delete),
        coverage=_single_ref(coverage_delete),
    )

    def enqueue_projection(
        kind: _ProjectionKind,
        projection_row_type: _ArtifactRowType,
        delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        rows = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
            plan,
            projection_row_type,
            _ProjectSparseArtifactStep[Sequence[_ArtifactRow]](
                ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
                preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
                kind=kind,
                model_cls=projection_row_type,
                after_refs=frozenset({delete_ref}),
            ),
        )
        return _single_ref(txn.insert_many_lazy(projection_row_type, rows))

    write_refs = {
        enqueue_projection("postings", MatchingPostingRow, mutation_refs.postings),
        enqueue_projection("lexicon", MatchingFeatureLexiconRow, mutation_refs.lexicon),
        enqueue_projection("blocks", MatchingPostingBlockRow, mutation_refs.blocks),
        enqueue_projection("documents", MatchingDocumentStatRow, mutation_refs.documents),
    }
    metadata = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
        _ProjectSparseArtifactStep[MatchingArtifactMetadataRow](
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="metadata",
            model_cls=MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
            after_refs=frozenset({mutation_refs.metadata}),
        ),
    )
    write_refs.add(_single_ref(txn.insert_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, metadata)))
    coverage = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactCoverageRow,
        _ProjectSparseArtifactStep[Sequence[MatchingArtifactCoverageRow]](
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="coverage",
            model_cls=MatchingArtifactCoverageRow,
            after_refs=frozenset({mutation_refs.coverage}),
        ),
    )
    write_refs.add(_single_ref(txn.insert_many_lazy(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow, coverage)))
    return scoped_spec, preparation_ref, frozenset(write_refs)


@pure_lazy
def rebuild_matching_artifact_lazy(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> LazyResult[MatchArtifactBuildResult]:
    """Plan a complete sparse artifact replacement in the caller transaction."""
    scoped_spec, preparation_ref, write_refs = _plan_sparse_artifact_writes(txn, spec)
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    completion = _CompleteSparseArtifactStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
        write_refs=write_refs,
        spec=scoped_spec,
        owner_connection_id=_owner_connection_id(txn),
    )
    return ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, completion)


@pure_lazy
def migrate_fts_artifact_lazy(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> LazyResult[MatchFtsArtifactMigrationResult]:
    """Plan a restartable migration from one compatible maintained FTS artifact."""
    representation = spec.right.representation
    if not isinstance(representation, MatchTokenFieldRepresentationSpec):
        raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("token_field_right_representation"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("fts_migration_requires_token_field"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    config = get_fts_config(spec.right.row_type)
    if (
        config is None
        or config.implementation is not FTSIndexImplementation.POLYFILL
        or config.fields != [str(representation.field_name)]
    ):
        raise MatchPhysicalPlanError(
            MatchErrorContext(
                invariant=MatchInvariant.PHYSICAL_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE,
                expected=MatchExpectedValue("compatible_polyfill_fts_artifact"),
                observed=MatchObservedValue("fts_configuration_mismatch"),
                safe_action=MatchSafeAction.FIX_DECLARATION,
                spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
            ),
        )
    fts_row_type = create_fts_index_class(get_table_name(spec.right.row_type))
    scoped_spec, preparation_ref, write_refs = _plan_sparse_artifact_writes(
        txn,
        spec,
        fts_row_type=fts_row_type,
        fts_config_fingerprint=config.bootstrap_fingerprint(),
    )
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    completion = _CompleteFtsArtifactMigrationStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
        write_refs=write_refs,
        spec=scoped_spec,
        owner_connection_id=_owner_connection_id(txn),
    )
    return ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, completion)

def migrate_fts_artifact(

type _TextArtifactRow = (

    | MatchingArtifactCoverageRow
    | MatchingTextGramRow

    type[MatchingArtifactMetadataRow]
    | type[MatchingArtifactCoverageRow]

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TextArtifactMutationRefs:
    """Named mutation refs for one text artifact replacement."""

    grams: ServerPlanRefId
    patterns: ServerPlanRefId
    transitions: ServerPlanRefId
    emissions: ServerPlanRefId

type _ProjectionKind = Literal[
    "artifact_fingerprints",

class _TextArtifactPreparation(BaseModel):

    artifact_fingerprints: tuple[str, ...]
