@pure_lazy
def _owner_connection_id(txn: LazyWriteTransaction) -> ConnectionId:
    return txn._planning_connection_id


@pure_lazy
def _single_ref[T](value: LazyResult[T]) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    refs = collect_plan_ref_dependencies(value)
    if len(refs) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("Text artifact operation requires one plan-owned dependency")
    return next(iter(refs))


def _rows[T](resolved: ResolvedRefs, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, row_type: type[T]) -> tuple[T, ...]:
    value = resolved.get(str(ref_id)) or ()
    if not isinstance(value, Sequence):
        raise TypeError(f"Expected row sequence from {ref_id}")
    result: list[T] = []
    for row in value:
        if not isinstance(row, row_type):
            raise TypeError(f"Expected {row_type.__name__} from {ref_id}, got {type(row).__name__}")
        result.append(row)
    return tuple(result)


@pure_lazy
def _scope_spec(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> tuple[MatchSpec[Any, Any], str, str, RevisionId | None]:
    versioned = issubclass(spec.left.row_type, VersionedObjectRow) or issubclass(spec.right.row_type, VersionedObjectRow)
    branch_value = getattr(txn, "branch_anchor", None) if versioned else None
    revision_value = getattr(txn, "revision_id", None) if versioned and not isinstance(branch_value, BranchId) else None
    if isinstance(branch_value, BranchId):
        snapshot_scope = f"branch:{branch_value}"
        branch_scope = snapshot_scope
    elif isinstance(revision_value, RevisionId):
        snapshot_scope = f"revision:{revision_value}"
        branch_scope = "branch:pinned-revision"
    else:
        snapshot_scope = "unversioned"
        branch_scope = "branch:main"
    scoped_spec = (
        type(spec).model_validate(
            {
                **{name: getattr(spec, name) for name in type(spec).model_fields},
                "pair_scope": MatchPairScope(f"{spec.pair_scope}|{snapshot_scope}"),
            }
        )
        if versioned
        else spec
    )
    return scoped_spec, branch_scope, snapshot_scope, revision_value if isinstance(revision_value, RevisionId) else None


def _normalize(value: str, representation: MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec[Any]) -> str:
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize(representation.normalization.unicode_form.value, value)
    if representation.normalization.case is MatchTextCaseHandling.CASEFOLD:
        return normalized.casefold()
    return normalized


def _qgrams(value: str, length: int) -> Counter[str]:
    return Counter(value[index : index + length] for index in range(max(0, len(value) - length + 1)))


def _aho_dfa(
    patterns: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...],
    corpus: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...],
    *,
    max_states: MatchAutomatonStateLimit,
    spec_ref_id: MatchSpecRefId,
) -> tuple[tuple[tuple[int, str, int], ...], tuple[tuple[int, str], ...]]:
    del corpus
    transitions: list[dict[str, int]] = [{}]
    outputs: list[set[str]] = [set()]
    for pattern_id, pattern in patterns:
        state = 0
        for symbol in pattern:
            next_state = transitions[state].get(symbol)
            if next_state is None:
                next_state = len(transitions)
                if next_state + 1 > int(max_states):
                    raise MatchWorkLimitError(
                        MatchErrorContext(
                            invariant=MatchInvariant.WORK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,
                            expected=MatchExpectedValue(f"automaton_states_at_most_{max_states}"),
                            observed=MatchObservedValue(f"automaton_states_{next_state + 1}"),
                            safe_action=MatchSafeAction.REDUCE_WORK,
                            spec_ref_id=spec_ref_id,
                        ),
                    )
                transitions[state][symbol] = next_state
                transitions.append({})
                outputs.append(set())
            state = next_state
        outputs[state].add(pattern_id)
    failures = [0] * len(transitions)
    pending: deque[int] = deque(transitions[0].values())
    while pending:
        state = pending.popleft()
        for symbol, next_state in transitions[state].items():
            pending.append(next_state)
            fallback = failures[state]
            while fallback and symbol not in transitions[fallback]:
                fallback = failures[fallback]
            failures[next_state] = transitions[fallback].get(symbol, 0)
            outputs[next_state].update(outputs[failures[next_state]])
    completed = [(state, symbol, target) for state, edges in enumerate(transitions) for symbol, target in sorted(edges.items())]
    completed.extend((state, "", target) for state, target in enumerate(failures))
    emissions = tuple((state, pattern_id) for state, state_outputs in enumerate(outputs) for pattern_id in sorted(state_outputs))
    return tuple(completed), emissions


class _PrepareTextArtifactStep(NonPublishingStep[_TextArtifactPreparation]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        branch_scope: str,
        snapshot_scope: str,
        permission_scope: MatchPermissionFitScope,
        left_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        right_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._spec = spec
        self._branch_scope = branch_scope
        self._snapshot_scope = snapshot_scope
        self._permission_scope = permission_scope
        self._left_rows_ref = left_rows_ref
        self._right_rows_ref = right_rows_ref
        self._metadata_ref = metadata_ref

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in (self._left_rows_ref, self._right_rows_ref, self._metadata_ref))

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[_TextArtifactPreparation]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> _TextArtifactPreparation:
        spec = self._spec
        left_representation = spec.left.representation
        right_representation = spec.right.representation
        if not isinstance(left_representation, MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec) or not isinstance(
            right_representation,
            MatchTextFieldRepresentationSpec,
        ):
            raise TypeError("Text artifact rebuild requires two text-field representations")
        if left_representation.normalization != right_representation.normalization:
            raise ValueError("Text artifact rebuild requires equal normalization profiles")
        left_rows = _rows(resolved, self._left_rows_ref, spec.left.row_type)
        right_rows = _rows(resolved, self._right_rows_ref, spec.right.row_type)
        metadata_rows = _rows(resolved, self._metadata_ref, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow)
        generation = 1 + max((row.generation for row in metadata_rows), default=0)
        if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec):
            physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.AHO_CORASICK if len(left_rows) > 1 else MatchAccessMethodKind.QGRAM_EXACT_SUBSTRING
        elif isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchEditDistanceKernelSpec):
            physical_method = MatchAccessMethodKind.BANDED_LEVENSHTEIN
        else:
            raise TypeError("Text artifact rebuild requires a substring or edit-distance kernel")
        patterns = tuple(
            sorted(
                (
                    str(row.sys_id),
                    _normalize(str(getattr(row, str(left_representation.field_name))), left_representation),
                )
                for row in left_rows
            )
        )
        corpus = tuple(
            sorted(
                (
                    str(row.sys_id),
                    _normalize(str(getattr(row, str(right_representation.field_name))), right_representation),
                )
                for row in right_rows
            )
        )
        artifact_payload = json.dumps(
            {
                "spec_fingerprint": str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
                "pair_scope": str(spec.pair_scope),
                "normalization": right_representation.normalization.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "qgram_length": int(right_representation.qgram_length),
                "statistics_scope": right_representation.statistics_scope.value,
                "patterns": patterns,
                "corpus": corpus,
                "pattern_coordinate_space": (
                    spec.kernel.coordinate_space.value if isinstance(spec.kernel, MatchSubstringKernelSpec) else "not_applicable"
                ),
                "branch_scope": self._branch_scope,
                "snapshot_scope": self._snapshot_scope,
                "permission_scope": str(self._permission_scope),
                "physical_method": physical_method.value,
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        )
        fingerprint = MatchArtifactFingerprint(hashlib.sha256(artifact_payload.encode()).hexdigest())
        gram_rows: list[MatchingTextGramRow] = []
        gram_length = int(right_representation.qgram_length)
        for right_id, text in corpus:
            representation_hash = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
            for gram, count in sorted(_qgrams(text, gram_length).items()):
                gram_rows.append(
                    MatchingTextGramRow(
                        artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                        generation=generation,
                        gram_hash=hashlib.sha256(gram.encode()).hexdigest(),
                        gram_value=gram,
                        right_sys_id=SysId(UUID(right_id)),
                        gram_count=count,
                        text_length=len(text),
                        representation_hash=representation_hash,
                    )
                )
        pattern_rows = tuple(
            MatchingAutomatonPatternRow(
                artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                generation=generation,
                pattern_hash=hashlib.sha256(pattern.encode()).hexdigest(),
                left_sys_id=SysId(UUID(left_id)),
                normalized_pattern=pattern,
                pattern_length=len(pattern),
            )
            for left_id, pattern in patterns
        )
        dfa_transitions, dfa_emissions = _aho_dfa(
            patterns,
            corpus,
            max_states=spec.work_limits.max_automaton_states,
            spec_ref_id=spec.spec_ref_id,
        )
        automaton_state_count = 1 + max((state for state, _, _ in dfa_transitions), default=0)
        transition_rows = tuple(
            MatchingAutomatonTransitionRow(
                artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                generation=generation,
                state=state,
                symbol=symbol,
                next_state=next_state,
            )
            for state, symbol, next_state in dfa_transitions
        )
        emission_rows = tuple(
            MatchingAutomatonEmissionRow(
                artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                generation=generation,
                state=state,
                left_sys_id=SysId(UUID(left_id)),
            )
            for state, left_id in dfa_emissions
        )
        normalized_texts = tuple(
            MatchingNormalizedTextRow(
                artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                generation=generation,
                endpoint=endpoint,
                source_sys_id=SysId(UUID(source_id)),
                normalized_text=text,
                representation_hash=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
            )
            for endpoint, rows in (("left", patterns), ("right", corpus))
            for source_id, text in rows
        )
        source_watermark = MatchArtifactWatermark(len(left_rows) + len(right_rows))
        identity = MatchArtifactIdentity(
            artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            tenant_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue("tenant:system"),
            workspace_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue("workspace:default"),
            branch_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue(self._branch_scope),
            revision_scope=MatchArtifactScopeValue(self._snapshot_scope),
            producer_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue("producer:string-candidates"),
            representation_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue(str(right_representation.representation_ref_id)),
            kernel_ref_id=MatchArtifactScopeValue(str(spec.kernel.kernel_ref_id)),
            physical_method=MatchArtifactScopeValue(physical_method.value),
            generation=MatchArtifactGeneration(generation),
        )
        state = MatchArtifactExecutionState(
            identity=identity,
            source_watermark=source_watermark,
            artifact_watermark=source_watermark,
            maintenance_mode=MatchArtifactMaintenanceMode.ASYNCHRONOUS,
            permission_scope=self._permission_scope,
            indexed_left_identities=(),
            indexed_right_identities=(),
        )
        metadata = MatchingArtifactMetadataRow(
            spec_ref_id=str(spec.spec_ref_id),
            spec_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
            artifact_fingerprint=str(fingerprint),
            pair_scope=str(spec.pair_scope),
            tenant_scope=str(identity.tenant_scope),
            workspace_scope=str(identity.workspace_scope),
            branch_scope=str(identity.branch_scope),
            revision_scope=str(identity.revision_scope),
            producer_ref_id=str(identity.producer_ref_id),
            representation_ref_id=str(identity.representation_ref_id),
            kernel_ref_id=str(identity.kernel_ref_id),
            physical_method=str(identity.physical_method),
            generation=generation,
            source_watermark=int(source_watermark),
            artifact_watermark=int(source_watermark),
            source_row_count=int(source_watermark),
            source_tracking_mode="row_count" if self._snapshot_scope == "unversioned" else "snapshot_watermark",
            permission_scope=str(self._permission_scope),
            state_payload=state.model_dump_json(),
            producer_state="ready",
        )
        scope_digest = hashlib.sha256(
            f"{spec.semantic_fingerprint}\x1f{spec.pair_scope}\x1f{identity.branch_scope}".encode(),
        ).hexdigest()
        coverage = tuple(
            MatchingArtifactCoverageRow(
                spec_ref_id=str(spec.spec_ref_id),
                spec_fingerprint=str(spec.semantic_fingerprint),
                pair_scope=str(spec.pair_scope),
                branch_scope=str(identity.branch_scope),
                scope_digest=scope_digest,
                endpoint=endpoint,
                identity=row_id,
                identity_digest=hashlib.sha256(row_id.encode()).hexdigest(),
            )
            for endpoint, rows in (("left", patterns), ("right", corpus))
            for row_id, _ in rows
        )
        result = MatchArtifactBuildResult(
            artifact_identity=identity,
            artifact_fingerprint=fingerprint,
            document_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(corpus)),
            feature_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len({row.gram_hash for row in gram_rows})),
            posting_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(gram_rows)),
            block_count=MatchStageOperationCount(0),
            block_bound_metrics=(),
            pattern_count=MatchPatternCount(len(patterns)),
            qgram_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(gram_rows)),
            automaton_state_count=MatchStageOperationCount(automaton_state_count),
            automaton_transition_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(transition_rows)),
            automaton_emission_count=MatchStageOperationCount(len(emission_rows)),
            candidate_representation_kind=(
                MatchRepresentationKind.AUTOMATON
                if physical_method is MatchAccessMethodKind.AHO_CORASICK
                else MatchRepresentationKind.Q_GRAMS
            ),
        )
        return _TextArtifactPreparation(
            artifact_fingerprints=tuple(row.artifact_fingerprint for row in metadata_rows),
            metadata=metadata,
            coverage=coverage,
            grams=tuple(gram_rows),
            patterns=pattern_rows,
            transitions=transition_rows,
            emissions=emission_rows,
            texts=normalized_texts,
            state=state,
            result=result,
        )


def _model_contract(step: ServerPlanStep[object], model_cls: _TextArtifactRowType) -> CtePublicationContract:
    columns = tuple(plan.db_column for plan in writable_field_plans(model_cls))
    hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    if hints is None:
        raise TypeError(f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {model_cls.__name__}")
    return CtePublicationContract(
        publication_source_kind=PublicationSourceKind.DECLARED_LITERAL_RELATION,
        columns=columns,
        column_type_hints=hints,
        relation_contract=CteRelationContract.model(model_cls),
        relation_role=step.cte_relation_role(),
    )


class _ProjectTextArtifactStep[T](ServerPlanStep[T]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preparation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        kind: _ProjectionKind,
        model_cls: _TextArtifactRowType | None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preparation_ref = preparation_ref
        self._kind = kind
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return (
            Cardinality.MANY
            if self._kind in {"artifact_fingerprints", "coverage", "grams", "patterns", "transitions", "emissions", "texts"}
            else Cardinality.ONE
        )

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def executor_visible_publication_uses_python_result(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_decoded_value_as_executor_value(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._preparation_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._model_cls is not None:
            return _model_contract(self, self._model_cls)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=PublicationSourceKind.DECLARED_LITERAL_RELATION,
            columns=("__result",),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({"__result"})),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.literal_mapping(columns=("__result",)),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        del ctx
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> T:
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _TextArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("Text artifact projection requires typed preparation")
        value: T = getattr(prepared, self._kind)
        return value


class _ProjectTextArtifactFingerprintsStep(_ProjectTextArtifactStep[list[str]]):
    def execute_runtime(self: _ProjectTextArtifactFingerprintsStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> list[str]:
        assert self._kind == "artifact_fingerprints"
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _TextArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("Text artifact fingerprint projection requires typed preparation")
        return list(prepared.artifact_fingerprints)


class _CompleteTextArtifactStep(NonPublishingStep[MatchArtifactBuildResult]):
    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preparation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        write_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
        owner_connection_id: ConnectionId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preparation_ref = preparation_ref
        self._write_refs = write_refs
        self._spec = spec
        self._owner_connection_id = owner_connection_id

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._preparation_ref), *(str(ref) for ref in self._write_refs)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[MatchArtifactBuildResult]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> MatchArtifactBuildResult:
        prepared = resolved.get(str(self._preparation_ref))
        if not isinstance(prepared, _TextArtifactPreparation):
            raise TypeError("Text artifact completion requires typed preparation")
        register_matching_source_maintenance(
            self._spec,
            prepared.state,
            str(self._spec.pair_scope),
            self._owner_connection_id,
        )
        return prepared.result


@pure_lazy
def rebuild_text_matching_artifact_lazy(
    txn: LazyWriteTransaction,
    spec: MatchSpec[Any, Any],
) -> LazyResult[MatchArtifactBuildResult]:
    """Plan complete q-gram and pattern-artifact replacement."""
    scoped_spec, branch_scope, snapshot_scope, _revision_id = _scope_spec(txn, spec)
    left_query = txn.query_lazy(scoped_spec.left.row_type)
    if isinstance(scoped_spec.filters.left, MatchEndpointFilterSpec):
        left_query = left_query.filter(scoped_spec.filters.left.expression)
    right_query = txn.query_lazy(scoped_spec.right.row_type)
    if isinstance(scoped_spec.filters.right, MatchEndpointFilterSpec):
        right_query = right_query.filter(scoped_spec.filters.right.expression)
    left_rows = left_query.execute_lazy()
    right_rows = right_query.execute_lazy()
    metadata_scope = (
        (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.spec_fingerprint) == str(scoped_spec.semantic_fingerprint))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.pair_scope) == str(scoped_spec.pair_scope))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow.branch_scope) == branch_scope)
    )
    metadata_rows = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow).filter(metadata_scope).execute_lazy()
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    prepare = _PrepareTextArtifactStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        spec=scoped_spec,
        branch_scope=branch_scope,
        snapshot_scope=snapshot_scope,
        permission_scope=MatchPermissionFitScope(str(txn.session_id)),
        left_rows_ref=_single_ref(left_rows),
        right_rows_ref=_single_ref(right_rows),
        metadata_ref=_single_ref(metadata_rows),
    )
    preparation = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, prepare)
    preparation_ref = _single_ref(preparation)
    fingerprints = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
        _ProjectTextArtifactFingerprintsStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="artifact_fingerprints",
            model_cls=None,
        ),
    )
    def delete_artifact_rows(delete_row_type: _TextArtifactRowType) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        deleted = (
            txn.query_lazy(delete_row_type)
            .filter(
                IN(field(delete_row_type.artifact_fingerprint), fingerprints),
            )
            .delete_after_lazy(
                after=(preparation,),
            )
        )
        return _single_ref(deleted)

    gram_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingTextGramRow)
    pattern_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingAutomatonPatternRow)
    transition_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingAutomatonTransitionRow)
    emission_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingAutomatonEmissionRow)
    text_delete_ref = delete_artifact_rows(MatchingNormalizedTextRow)
    coverage_scope = (
        (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.spec_fingerprint) == str(scoped_spec.semantic_fingerprint))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.pair_scope) == str(scoped_spec.pair_scope))
        & (field(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow.branch_scope) == branch_scope)
    )
    coverage_delete = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow).filter(coverage_scope).delete_after_lazy(after=(preparation,))
    metadata_delete = txn.query_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow).filter(metadata_scope).delete_after_lazy(after=(preparation,))
    mutation_refs = TextArtifactMutationRefs(
        grams=gram_delete_ref,
        patterns=pattern_delete_ref,
        transitions=transition_delete_ref,
        emissions=emission_delete_ref,
        texts=text_delete_ref,
        metadata=_single_ref(metadata_delete),
        coverage=_single_ref(coverage_delete),
    )
    write_refs: set[ServerPlanRefId] = set()
    projections: tuple[tuple[_ProjectionKind, _TextArtifactRowType, ServerPlanRefId], ...] = (
        ("grams", MatchingTextGramRow, mutation_refs.grams),
        ("patterns", MatchingAutomatonPatternRow, mutation_refs.patterns),
        ("transitions", MatchingAutomatonTransitionRow, mutation_refs.transitions),
        ("emissions", MatchingAutomatonEmissionRow, mutation_refs.emissions),
        ("texts", MatchingNormalizedTextRow, mutation_refs.texts),
    )
    for kind, projection_row_type, delete_ref in projections:
        rows = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
            plan,
            projection_row_type,
            _ProjectTextArtifactStep[Sequence[_TextArtifactRow]](
                ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
                preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
                kind=kind,
                model_cls=projection_row_type,
                after_refs=frozenset({delete_ref}),
            ),
        )
        write_refs.add(_single_ref(txn.insert_many_lazy(projection_row_type, rows)))
    metadata = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
        _ProjectTextArtifactStep[MatchingArtifactMetadataRow](
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="metadata",
            model_cls=MatchingArtifactMetadataRow,
            after_refs=frozenset({mutation_refs.metadata}),
        ),
    )
    write_refs.add(_single_ref(txn.insert_lazy(MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, metadata)))
    coverage = ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(
        plan,
        MatchingArtifactCoverageRow,
        _ProjectTextArtifactStep[Sequence[MatchingArtifactCoverageRow]](
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
            kind="coverage",
            model_cls=MatchingArtifactCoverageRow,
            after_refs=frozenset({mutation_refs.coverage}),
        ),
    )
    write_refs.add(_single_ref(txn.insert_many_lazy(MatchingArtifactCoverageRow, coverage)))
    completion = _CompleteTextArtifactStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
        preparation_ref=preparation_ref,
        write_refs=frozenset(write_refs),
        spec=scoped_spec,
        owner_connection_id=_owner_connection_id(txn),
    )
    return ReadQueryBuilder.publish_step_lazy(plan, MatchingArtifactMetadataRow, completion)

from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict
class MatchSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)
    name: str|None
